tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang rat+na'i bka' 'bum nga pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /rgyal dbang rat+na'i bka' 'bum nga pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang rat+na'i bka' 'bum nga pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ ༄༅// rgyal dbang rat+na'i bka' 'bum nga par/ ka)rje btsun tham cad mkhyen pa rat+na'i mtshan can gyi mgur 'bum 00000255chad pa 00000000 yid bzhin nor bu'i gter mdzod dgos 'dod mngon par 'byung ba dang*/ kha)dus ngan tha ma'i spyod tshul ring mo'ang zer ming gzhan sdug thug yid chad kyi kha glu ring mo/ ga)khri thog tu zhen pa spong bar rang nyid la bskul ba/ nga)rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bkra shis rgya mtsho la skabs shig tu tshigs su bcad pa/ ca)lag dal du bgyis pa/ cha)lta sgom spyod pa sku gsum sogs la bstod pa/ ja)mi rtag par bskul ba/ nya)gter sgrom rmu zam steng khar dpe don rang nyams smras pa/ ta)khams su rdzong chen pa so pa chos dar la gdams pa/ tha)'gro mgon nyang po kun dga' la gdams pa/ da)rang la bskul ba'i gros 'debs/ na)bya btang rin bkras la gdams pa/ pa)gtsang se brag bla ma gdams pa/ pha)gter sgrom 'brong ngur gyi gnas bstod/ ba)cham kha dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal po la gdams pa/ ma)'bri gung thel du yum drung la phul ba/ tsa)'brong dur gyi g.yam spyil du smras pa/ tsha)rang sems chos nyid ma/ dza)phyag chen ma bcos rig pa/ wa)nyams dga' bya bral du shar ba zhes bya/ zha)sems nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas/ za)'dra chos nyer lnga/ 'a)nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len/ ya)bdag mo snye mo ba la gdams pa/ ra)bla ma mgon po rgya mtsho la gdams pa/ la)rtogs ldan dhor dpal gdams pa/ sha)snye mo dar rgyas chos mdzad ma la gdams pa/ sa)khro phu lo tsa ba'i gdung rigs phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gdams pa/ ha)stod lungs snang rtse ba la gdams pa/ a)legs drug dang tshig gsum gnad dril/ ki)'phyogs rgyas pa tshe dbang phun tshogs la gdams pa/ khi)mtshams ma la bcad bya'i dus bla ma gtsang pa la gdams pa/ gi)bya btang 'brug smyon la gdams pa/ ngi)dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i don de bzhin nyid kyi gtam glur brjod pa/

ci)yar stod chos mdzad rin chen nyi ma la gdams pa/ chi)kun bsam la gdams pa/ ji)stod lungs snang rtse ba la gdams pa/ nyi)lugs log yi ge'i phyi mo/ ti)rang gshis rnyog med/ thi)gzhis ka khri khang rtser rang la bskul ba/ di)yang snang rtse ba la gdams pa/ ni)yi ge'i phyi mo spro lung du sbyar ba/ pi)rtogs brjod kyi gtam/ phi)bla ma la stod pa shākya gdams pa/ bi)snang rtse ba nam mkha' tshe brtan la gdams pa/ mi)bla ma la stod pa la yi ge'i phyi mo/ tsi)a stag bla ma kun dga'i dris lan ma 'ongs lung bstan/ tshi)yang bla ma la bstod pa shākya dpal gyi dris lan/ dzi)lho brag chos mdzad ma la gdams pa'i yi ge wi)nges pa'i gsang tshig bcu gsum pa zhes bya ba dbon po o rgyan la gdams pa/ zhi)yang de nyid la gdams pa/ zi)nye gnas kun dga' rgyan 'phel la gdams pa/ 'i)nye gnas rgyan bkras la gdams pa/ yi)nye gnas kun dga' mtha' yas la gdams pa/ ri)rnal 'byor chos dbang la gdams pa/ li)bla ma rin po che'i nye gnas btsun chung zhig la gdams pa/ shi)bla ma snye lung pa'i grwa pa gcig la smras pa/ si)rnam 'joms mgon po la gdams pa/ hi)lta sgom spyod pa gcig tu dril ba'i nyams len gnad kyi yi ge zhes bya ba/ i)rgya ba bkra shis la gdams pa/ ku)mgar sprul sku la gdams pa/ khu)rin chen bzang po la gdams pa/ gu)bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgongs don/ ngu)sprul sku ye shes khyung grags kyi gdung 'dzin pu ṇ+ya dh+wa tsha la gnang ba/ cu)dad ldan gc-i+ig gis zhus pa'i lan/ chu)'phyong rgyas dbon po seng rdor ba la gdams pa/ ju)mched grogs rnams la kha ta'i tshul du smras pa/ nyu)sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po'i sras la gdams pa/ tu)gtsang rgyang rtse chos mdzad mchog grub rdo rje la gdams pa/ thu)yol mo ba rgyal sras rdo rje dpal 'bar la bla thang du gdams pa/ du)'tsho byed skar ma la ku re'i tshigs bcad ka kha ma bcas mkhyen/

nu)chab shog gi bskor las thog mar spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar con pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa dpal chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po la phul ba dang*/ pu)spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du zhu lan du phul ba/ phu)rgya nag rgyal pos las ka gnang dus brda lan phul ba'i zhu zhig bu)dpon sa gong ma chen po la phul ba/ mu)chos rje karmā pa kong rta bar na bzhugs dus phul ba/ tsu)rig 'dzin chen po mnga' ris ba la phul ba/ tshu)'brug pa dbon rin po che la zhu lan/ dzu)rgya bston chos rje nam mkha'i zhu lan/ wu)ri bo che nas ja 'dren dang gdan 'dren byung ba'i zhu lan sngo rgyal brag rtsa nas phul ba/ zhu)rngo stod gangs shongs nas rgya ston chos rje'i zhu lan/ zu)sde stengs sgar du bzhugs dus rgya ston chos rje'i zhu lan/ 'u)gdan sa chen po 'bri gung thel gyi tshogs pa spyi la khams nas zhu lan/ yu)slon dpon legs pa'i mtshan can la/ ru)zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa 'dzam gling rnam rgyal grags pa la phul ba/ lu)yangs pa can du spyul pa'i sku la phul ba/ shu)karma pa 'bri gung du phebs dus ja 'dzin zhu yig phul ba/ su)yang chos rje karma pa la yangs pa can nas phul ba'i zhu lan/ hu)chos rje karma pa la dog pa gcig gi dri ba/ u)gzhi ka rin spungs nas ja 'dren byung ba'i lan du sde pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal la gnang ba/ ke)yangs pa can nas yum drung du phul ba/ khe)gse ma rabs 'byams pa la yangs pa can nas gnang ba/ ge)dpon pa gong ma chen po la phul ba/ nge)mchims phur dpon pa bdag mo la gnang ba/ ce)skyor mo lung du bdag mo la gnang ba/ che)sding rgyal dhor 'dzin kun legs la zhu lan/ je)yang dhor 'dzin kun legs pa'i zhu lan du gnang ba/ nye)bye bral bgyid khar drung pa snang gsal bar phul ba/ te)bya bral bgyid khar phag mor phul ba/ the)mkhar thog du dpon blon la gnang ba/ de)mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po la phul ba/

ne)rgya ston dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan la zhu lan/ pe)nang so rgya ston pa sku gzhon pa dpon slob khams la 'byon khar rgya ston chos rje la gnang ba/ phe)karma pa la phul ba'i zhu lan/ be)snye mo bdag mo gser khang ma la zhu lan/ me)chos sde bye mkhar ba'i gdan sa pa 'dzam gling rab 'byams la zhu lan/ tse)'brug pa gcung khri thog pa'i zhu lan phul ba*/ tshe)yang bdag mo gser khang ma la zhu lan/ dze)rab brtan ma'i dri lan/ we)yang stod lungs bde chen nas snye mor (3) gnang ba/ zhe)gtsang sa dge slong ngag dbang rin chen rnam rgyal la gnang ba/ ze)gnas nang nang so rdo rje snying po'i dris lan/ 'e)stod lungs snangs rtse ba'i zhu lan/ ye)rgya ston chos rje kun spangs pas brgya tshan gsum gyi 'bul skyail byung dus gnang ba'i zhu lan/ re)de'i yig chung zhu lan/ le)gtsang se brag bla ma'i zhu lan/ she)thel gyi gzims khang rtser ba'o/ se)e waṃ du shes rab 'od zer la gnang ba/ he)rgyal 'bed du bla ma gtsang pa la gnang ba/ e)'bri gung thel gyi slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen pa la gnang ba/ ko)rgyal 'bed dben gnas su bla ma gtsang pas mched grogs la gnang ba/ kho)'phyong rgyas pa tshe dbang phun tshogs kyi pha la dad brten du zhus pa'i tshigs bcad/ go)gung red dbon po kun dga' la gnang ba/ ngo)khro phu dbon po'i zhu lan/ co)chos rje blo gros rab yangs pa'i zhu lan/ cho)bya btang rin chen 'phel la gnang ba/ jo)'phyong rgyas pa rgyal bu 'gres pa'i zhu lan/ nyo)phan yul mkhar rtse'i lha bris pa la gnang ba/ to)sa pho spre'u lor sku mtshams dus su bla ma gtsang la gnang ba/ tho)yang bla ma gtsang pa la gnang ba'i/ do)yang bla ma gtsang pa'i zhu lan/ no)yang de'i dus su bla ma gtsang pa'i zhu lan/ po)phyag mdzod pa sga ma mo ba la gnang ba/ pho)bla ma chu 'phur ba la skyor mo lung nas gnyan mkhar nag rtser gnang ba/ bo)dge bsnyen chen po bar lha dang sog ra chu 'phan rnams gtsos pa'i 'bri gung gi gzhi bdag rnams la bka' shog gnang ba/

mo)bla ma khro phu ba nyi zla phun tshogs grags pa la gnang ba'i zhu lan/ tso)bka' brgyad sgrub chen sman sgrub dang bcas pa grol 'phral tsa rir sman mchod 'bul lam yig dang smon lam byi lo zla ba bdun pa la'o/ tsho)smon lam ni/ dzo)grogs sna ba mgon po rgyal gyi zhu lan/ wo)dar rtse mdor rgya mi chen la zhu lan du gnang ba'i bka' shog zho)rin chen bsam sgrub la bsam bho tra'i lan du gdams pa/ zo)dpon rgyal po la springs pa/ 'o)gdan sa chen po 'bri gung thel gyis tshogs pa spyi pa la/ yo)rgya ston dbon nam kha' rdo rje la/ ro)zla dgon spyi bar gnang ba/ lo)skyor mo lung pa gdung rgyud rin po cher phul ba/ sho)bla ma chos dbang la gnang ba/ so)mon pa brtson 'grus phun tshogs la gnang ba/ ho)g.yu shel ban brgyud la gnang ba/ o)zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu la springs pa/ kā)chos skyong chen po la bkra shis rab brtan nas gnang ba/ khā)bla ma la bstod pa la gnang ba/ gā)dus 'khrug gi dus su gsungs pa dang bcas khyon pa'o/ ngā)thugs rje chen po'i nyams len rgyun khyer snying po gsal ba/ cā)yang gsang zab mo'i tshe sgrub snying po gsal ba/ chā)dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom bzlas snying po gsal ba/ jā)sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub snying po gsal ba/ nyā)rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa sbrul mjug ltar bsgrub pa snying po gsal ba/ tā)sku gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i nyams len snying po gsal ba/ thā)sku gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i zhal gdams zab mo dang*/ dā)sku gsum dril sgrub kyi sgrub pa/ nā)sgrub dbang gi dus gsol ba gdabs pa bcas la/ pā)gu ru drag po yang gsang sgrub pa brkyang cig snying po gsal ba/ phā)khro bo'i rgyal po rme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs snying gsal ba/ bā)dpal rdo rje gtum po dregs pa kun 'dul gyi bsnyen sgrub rgyun khyer snying po gsal ba/

mā)drang srong dri med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/ tsā)log tri'i ngag 'den bsgrigs ma snying po gsal ba/ tshā)rgyun khyer gyi tshe sgrub sde sa 'phyong rgyas pa sku bgres pa la gnang ba'o/ dzā)nā ga rak+sha'i bsnyen sgrub/ wā)'jam dpal gshing rje tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs so/ zhā)lnga bsdus kyi rtsis gzhi gser 'phyang ma zhes bya ba/ zā)gter bzlog bya mgo ma'i las khrigs bstan srung mtshon cha/ 'ā)de'i dpe bris ('di nas yā rā lā shā sā hā ā bar chad 'dug)bsngo ba smon lam/ kun sgril bas shog grangs nyi brgya dang drug bzhugs so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // (4)/// nga pa la gur 'bum/(62) chab shog skor rnams/(57) thugs rje chen po'i nyams len rgyun khyer/(3) yang gsang zab mo'i tshe sgrub/(2)rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/(2) sgrol dkar tshe sgrub/(2) rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa sbrul mjug ltar bsgrub pa/(2) sku gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub/(5) tshe sgrub zhal gdams/(4) gu ru drag po yang gsang sgrub pa rkyang cig(3) rme rtsegs sgrub thabs/(3) rdo rje gtum po dregs pa kun 'dul gyis sgrub thabs/(4) drang srong dri med la brten pa'i tshe bsgrub/(1) log tri'i ngag 'don bsgrigs ma/(6) rgyun khyer tshe sgrub/(2) nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs/(2) tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs/(2) lnga bsdus kyi rtsis gzhi/(3) gtor bzlog bya mgo'i las khyigs/(12) de'i dpe bris/(23) bsngo ba smon lam/(3) kun sgyil bas shog grangs nyis brgya dang gsum bzhugs so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅//rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rat+na'i mtshan can gyi mgur 'bum yid bzhin nor bu'i gter mdzod dgos 'dod mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // ka)༄༅/// rtogs ldan rdor dpal la gdams pa// ༄༅/// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī/ khams gsum ye nas dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su// rang byung rang gsal kun byed rgyal po nga*// dngos 'dzin sgyu ma'i 'khrul las 'das pa'i yul// grag stong brag cha 'dra ba'i sgra brnyan ngag

/tha snyad brjod tshig gting med yid can la// dad ldan lam zhugs sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs can// bu mchog mos pa'i gdung bas bskul ba las// rang rig bla ma des ni 'di skad do lo// kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po sems zhes la// sangs rgyas sems can dbye bya dbye byed bral// bzang ngan dge sdig spang blang ming ma grag /mkha' dbyings dri med nam mkha' lta bu'am// g.ya' bral me long rnyog bral mtsho dwangs 'dra// kun khyab kun gsal 'dzin med de lta la// cir yang 'char zhing cir yang snang ba yi// 'gag med rtsal gyi 'phrul du shar ba la// byed po sems nyid sdong bu ma rtogs par// snang brnyan 'khrul pa'i yal 'dab la zhen te// nga khyod chags sdang kha rgyud rang du 'das// de tshe dge sdig ming ni ma grags kyang*// nga zhes bya dang chags pas kha brid pas// dge ba'ang srid la khyod ces sdang ba las// sdig pa nyid du babs kyis ldang bar gyur// de ltar shar la a 'thas rjes 'brangs pas// bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i rten dang brten pa'ang snang*// dge rtog mtha' ru phyin pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// ngan rtog rjes phyir 'brengs pa'i sems can zhes// ming ma grags kyang babs kyis de ltar byung// de tshe sangs rgyas thugs brtses ma bzod nas// 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don// bsams shing srid par skye ba'i tshul bzung nas// kun las khyad 'phags mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul bstan// rgyu rkyen ji bzhin rtogs tshe las 'bras ni// thabs mkhas dge sdig spang blang tshul rnams dang*// de las nyer 'phros chos 'khor rim gyis bskor// rjes 'jug sras la gdams pa'i bka' rnams gtad// 'di don bkral las bstan bcos rnams kyang byung// de dag rnams kyang ci bshad nyams blangs na// 'bras bu bslu med nga yi sar phyin to// 'on kyang snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung zhing*// mngal sgrib nyon mongs bag chag rgyud 'jags pas// yang yang 'khor te 'gyangs par 'gyur snyam na// tshe 'di nyid la ngo bo gdeng ldan phyir// kun byed rgyal po nga yis 'di skad bshad// phyi yul nyon mongs spang bya rang gi sems// 'gegs byed dam chos sdom pa rang gi sems// spang gnyen dgag sgrub sdom pa rang gi sems// bral 'bras sprul sku sangs rgyas rang gi sems// so thar bslab bya sems las gzhan ma 'tshol// shes par mdzod cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// sdug bsngal sems can mar shes rang gi sems// nyan lam zil gnon sems bskyed rang gi sems// kun snyoms byang chub sgrub byed rang gi sems// 'bras bu longs sku rnam snang rang gi sems// byang sems bslab bya sems las gzhan ma 'tshol// shes par mdzod cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// snod bcud gzhal yas lhar snang rang gi sems// dug lnga ye shes gnas gyur rang gi sems// gzhan don las bzhis 'dul ba rang gi sems// 'bras bu chos sku dpal chen rang gi sems// gsang sngags lam mchog sems las gzhan ma 'tshol// shes par mdzod ===/

rigs 'gre// de ltar bslab gsum sdom pa sems dang bcas// bsrung dang gtong thob 'dun pa sems su gcig /de rnams nyams len gdams par bstan pa ni// dam chos lnga ru 'dus so bu mchog kye// de yang rtsa ba chig chog rgyal po sems// thams cad 'di yi g.yos yin shes par mdzod// byams snying byang sems gdung ba'i 'bral med yid// chu lbur lus la gtad med dran pa'i rgyun// 'char byed sems las dngos po'i chos gzhan med// shes par mdzod ===// gsal stong 'dzin med rang shar lha yi sku// 'gag med grags stong rang sgra sngags kyi sgra// rang bzhin khyab gdal lhun grub rdo rje'i thugs// bcos med sems las gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs med// shes par mdzod ===// gtad med yul mdzin ngo bo chos kyi sku// kun rtog gcig tu 'dus pa longs spyod rdzogs// gsal la sna tshogs 'phro ba sprul pa'i sku// ming brjod kun gzhi nga las bla ma med// shes par mdzod ===// ma bcos rnal ma'i 'dug tshul lus kyi gnad// rtag chad dbus 'dzin bral ba lta ba'i yul// ched bcos dgag sgrub med pa sgom pa'i gnad// spang blang re dogs bral ba'i spyod pa ste// rang gnas 'di las phyag rgya chen po med// shes par mdzod ===// bsngo ba'i mthar thug chos dbyings zag pa med// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs gter zab mo ste// rang byung 'di las gzhan pa'i bsngo ba ni// bsngo bya bsngo byed bsngo ba ma mthong te// dmigs med bsngo ba 'di ni bsngo ba'i mchog /shes par mdzod ===// de ltar gdams pa'i man ngag lnga po 'di// rang la rang chas yod pas phyir ma 'tshol// gzhan la btsal na don med ngal ba'i rgyu// nor gol gegs sel 'khri ba rang sar chod// shes par mdzod ===// mdo ru bsdus na sngon chad byas bsags chos// med pa yod sprul rang nyid rang gis bcings// yod pa med bsgrub rang nor rang gis brlag

/gnyis med bar gzung gti mug mun pas bsgribs// de rnams rang byed nyid du go bgyis la// shes ldan bu khyod bstan pa'i rang so gzung*// bstan pa'i rang so gzung ba gang zhe na// bzang por 'dod pa'i lta bas phan mi thogs// 'dod pas bsgrubs pa'i sgom pas lam mi bgrod// rtsol bcas bsgrubs pa'i spyod pa tshul 'chos gol// de bas rnal ma'i lta sgom spyod la rol// shes par mdzod ===// rnal ma'i nyams len rnam gsum gang zhe na// gtad med rig pa gcer bu lta ba'i rgyal// gsum 'dzin ye nas dri bral sgom pa'i ngang*// byar med yan pa 'gag med spyod pa 'di// kun tu 'bral med rang so'i gnas tshul yin// 'di la gnas na lam rnams kun 'dus pas// gegs sel gnyen po'i bar chad rtsa ba chod// rnal 'byor che chung sa lam rtsis gdab kun// blo byas mdud pa yin pas rang sar grol// sangs rgyas rang du go bas sgrub ngal med// gzhom gzhig bral ba'i lus la blo thag chod// sprul pa bye ba'i snang brnyan rang la tshang*// phan byed dge ba'i tshig la nye ring med// skad brgyar kun tu smra ba'i spobs par ldan// bskal brgya ting 'dzin gcig gis bgrod pa dang*// gang 'dul ting 'dzin ston pa'i yid can de// mi zad 'khor lo'i yon tan bye ba ni// grangs med du mas phyug pa'i bdag po nyid// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'phrin las byed pa ni// brjod pa'i mtha' yis rtogs par yongs mi 'gyur// 'di rnams babs kyi byung tshul bstan pa ste// kun byed rgyal po nga ni 'khrul ma myong*// rang bstod gzhan smod bgyis na kun byed nyams// de ltar rang shar dbyings nas bsgrags pa'i gtam// rtsa ba chig chod gcig chog rang gdangs 'di// skal ldan rnams kyi blo la bdud rtsi ste// skal med log lta can rnams khrag bskyugs pas// sman chen 'di ni kun byed rgyal po smra// 'di don go na nga dang dbyer med yin// kun byed rgyal po nga ni 'di lta ste// rgyu yis ma byas rkyen gyis ma skyed pa'i// nam mkha' 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// brtan dang g.yo ba'i bya ba kun byed pa'i// rlung chen 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// gsal dang rgyas pa'i las rnams byed pa yi// byin za 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// kun gyi gzhi dang brten du byed pa yi// 'dzin ma 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// bde rgyas dga' bde la ni spyod pa yi// lha dbang 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// bde sdug mtho dman kun tu snang ba yi// mi yi skye ba kun byed rgyal po nga*// 'dod can bkres pas nyen par gyur pa yi// yi dwags skye ba kun byed rgyal po nga*// sdang can 'tshe bas nyen par snang ba yi// dmyal ba'i skye ba kun byed rgyal po nga*// 'khrul pa ye sangs yon tan kun rgyas pas// sangs rgyas 'di ni kun byed rgyal po nga*// mdor na kun tu snang zhing kun ston pa// thams cad kun byed rgyal po nga nyid de// nga la chags dang sdang dang nye ring med// kun byed rgyal po nga la dbyer med do// nga la 'dor dang blang ba'i 'khrul pa med// kun byed nga yang nga zhes bya ba yi// brjod bya rjod byed tha snyad klong du thim// de ltar shes na kun byed nga nyid de// bu khyed 'bral med gnas pa'i don mchog mthong*// shes par mdzod cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje dpal 'bar zhes bya bas bskul ba las// 'bri gung phyogs kyi shākya'i ban de sna tshogs rang grol gyis 'tshe'u khar bris pa'o/

kha)dus ngan tha ma'i spyod tshul ring mo'ang zer// ming gzhan sdug thug yid chad kyi kha glu ring mo/ dpal ldan bla ma 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// rje btsun kun dga'i thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzung*// skye bo bdag gi las ngan rlung po'i sde// sdug bsngal ma lus zad par byin gyis rlobs// sngon las dbang gis bzang sems ngan du song*// phan par bsams kyang phyin ci log tu song*// brtse ba'i gtam la zur za tsam du go /kye ma kho bo'i sngon las ci 'dra zhig /rnam gsum phan par bskyangs pa'i bu slob kyang*// ji zhig tsam na long g.yog bzhin du blta// brtse bar byas kyang 'khor g.yog nye ba nyung*// kye ma kho bo'i sngon las ci 'dra zhig /'phral phugs yun du phan par bsgrub snyam yang*// slar yang gnod pa'i dgra chen lta bur song*// ji ltar byas kyang bcos pa'i thabs med pa// rigs 'gre// kye ma=// dbang bshad sgom pa'i chos kyis bskyangs na yang*// gtsang rong dpag shi'i bshad pa lta bur song*// dam tshig zer ba gar yod cha yang med// kye ma=// phan par smras tshad slar yang lkog song 'bar// cung zad yid 'gal rgyang ring gnas su 'dug /'dra 'dra bsgrigs nas gzhi med tshig ngan smra// kye ma=// sos dal skyed drag byung na drung du bsnyag /cung zad dka' bar byung na phyi nang mtshams// khag ngan byung dogs zer nas zur la 'bud// kye ma=// yon tan shes kyang bstan pa'i khal khur med// dal bar btang snyoms gnas na dga' zhes sgrog gting nas phyis byus bsam pa'i bu slob dkon// kye ma=// g.yog tsam bcol na g.yul chen bzlog pa tsam// phar phan byas na tshur la drin chen 'dren// brtse ba'i ngag la rna ba phug tu gzur// kye ma=// bsams shing cis kyang phan pa med par go// bsam thog mi 'bab don med dbang du 'gro// smras bzhin mi nyan log kyog byed pa mang*// kye ma =// kho bo sems kha chung bas khog chud byed// gsong por smras pa'i gtam la ched 'dzin med// blo kha yangs la gting nas brnyas par byed// de lta bu'ang kho bo'i sngon las yin// da ni cis kyang gang bde ring mo bsgrub// grogs kyang gang byung cis kyang chog par bya// gtsang mdzes 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa'i bya ba dka'// de ltar mthong nas gzim khang mtshe'u khar// phyogs med 'grims pa'i rat+na'i ming 'dzin gyis// kun la yid chad sems la ma shor bar// gsum pa'i tshes la yi ger bris pa'o//

༈ ga)khri thog dus zhen pa spong bar rang nyid la bskul ba/ ༈ na mo gu ru// yon tan rin chen dpal gyi lham me ba// lha dang bcas pa 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs// dran pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal kun sel ba// rgyal dbang de yis zhabs pad spyi bos bsten// bag chags rten gyur kun gzhi'i sa gzhi la// las kyi sa bon sna tshogs btab pa las// snang ba sgyu ma'i lo tog gang yang skye// 'khrul snang dbyings su dag par byin gyis rlobs// 'jig rten snang ba zang zing rmi lam 'dra// bden pa med kyang bde sdug du ma'i rgyu// gang shar a 'thas rjes su mi 'brang bar// zhen pa nang nas spongs shig ldom bu pa// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po ma mthong zhing*// byas chos zin med dril ma'i lu gu rgyud// 'bad pa byas kyang mgu bar mi nus pas// mi dang mthun 'jug ma lta snyoms las pa// go 'phang thob na nga rgyal lhag par 'phel// dman par gyur na kun gyis smod par byed// bar pa tsam yang phrag dog skye ba'i rgyu// byas chos snying po soms shig snyoms las pa// drang por byas na phal cher dgra ru ldang*// yon por spyad na sems la rnam smin lci// sna tshogs spyad na gtad so med par gleng*// byas pa'i 'bras bu ltos dang snyoms las pa// mang du smras na bcol chung 'dzem med po// ci yang ma smras nag po gti mug zer// spel mar smras na mu cor tho co can// smra ba'i snying po soms dang rat+na'i ming*// kun dang bstun na ma bcol rtog 'dod can// 'dris med byas na thos med nga rgyal can// 'dres par spyad na khams 'dus langs par brtsi// spyod pa'i nyams don sems dang rat+na'i ming*// gos bzang gyon na mdzod phugs rgyab khur po// hrul po gyon na bzhad bgad byed pa'i gnas// sna tshogs spyad na de bas gleng brjod mang*// byas pa'i gnas lugs soms shig rat+na'i ming*// snyan par smras na mi chos kha bsags can// rtsub por smras na don med dgra ru ldang*// kha rog sdad na nag po brda mi 'phrod// tshig gi 'bras bu soms shig rat+na'i ming*// gcig pur 'dug na gzhan don spang pa skad// kun tu song na dred po lcags rkang lo// slob 'khor mang na 'du 'dzis khyer bar sems// 'dus byas chos la soms dang rat+na'i ming*// dben par sdad na mjal kha dog ces zer// g.yeng ba byas na dge sbyor med par gleng*// sna tshogs spyad na blo sna mang bar brjod// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin soms dang rat+na'i ming*// 'khor la legs par bshad tshe don gnyer med// mnyam gzhag 'dug dus 'dod chos gnyer ba mang*// de don bsgrubs na sems la 'jog pa nyung*// don du gang 'gyur rtog dang rat+na'i ming*// ma bcos 'khor g.yog spyod ngan ci yang byed// yang yang gros 'debs byas na dgra bzhin lta// 'gyod med bskyangs pa'i drin lan gnod pas 'jal// 'khor gyi gnas lugs soms dang rat+na'i ming*// 'khor la gcig char phan pa'i nus pa med// gang byams byas na 'ga' zhig dgra ru ldang*// btang snyoms bzhag na 'khang ra 'ba' zhig 'debs// dus ngan 'khor gyis ci byed rat+na'i ming*// byas pa med pa'i yus kyi khog pa brgyangs// rang don ma grub ci yang mgu dus med// chos dang sbyar na gnod pa'i las su mthong*// mi dang 'grogs pas ci byed rat+na'i ming*// drang po zangs thal byas na 'khrug pa'i rgyu// sna tshogs thabs mkhas byas na g.yo sgyur go// sems la snyad med byas na mi mi mgu// 'du 'dzis skyo ba med dam rat+na'i ming*// 'brel pa'i zhen pa ma spangs rtag tu sdug

/'khri ba bcad na snying rje med pa skad// gang la bltas na snying po mi rnyed bzhin// ha cang blo sna rings po rat+na'i ming*// rnam thar re re bskyangs na phyogs zhen can// mang du bskyangs na grub mtha' 'chol ba skad// dgag sgrub byas na dge 'dun dgra ru ldang*// dus ngan dgon sdes ci byed rat+na'i ming*// chos tshul gnas tshul bcas na dang len med// kha rog bsdad na mgo btsun bla med do// yan por bzhag na bag med spyod pa yi// dus ngan sde ris ci byed rat+na'i ming*// longs spyod med na lam bar rdo bar gzung*// longs spyod gzung na gsog 'jog ser sna ba// dran par gzung na mi chos rab mkhas so// 'jig rten snying po soms dang rat+na'i ming*// phangs med lhug par byas na rtsings pa skad// ci yang ma byin sbar 'thams 'brel med zer// mtshams par spyad na chos brgyad sgrog bcing smra// don med 'brel pas ci byed rat+na'i ming*// dpon g.yog yon mchod nye 'khor bcas pa kun// 'brel pa mang pos phan tshun bcing pa'i rgyu// gcig la gcig brten sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad// 'khor ba'i gnas lugs soms dang rat+na'i ming*// de ltar snying po med pa 'khor ba'i chos// sgrub dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog yun tsam// 'bad pa zin med 'khor ba'i yo lang gis// 'chi tshe cis phan soms dang rat+na'i ming*// bdag nyid gcig pu 'chi ba'i lam du zhugs// nye 'brel 'khor gyis mal gyi mtha' ma bskor// mnar gcod du khaḥbasran tshugs med pa der// chos las phan pa med do rat+na'i ming*// 'byung ba 'dus pa las kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi// sa rlung chu la thim pas ldang mi 'gyur// du ba 'tshub pa'i snang ba shar ba na// chos las phan pa'i mgon med rat+na'i ming*// yang cig chu rlung nus pa me la thim/ kha sna bskams shing so gtsigs mchu yang brdzes// 'jigs rung chu bos khyer ba'i snang ba 'char// de tshe chos min skyabs med rat+na'i ming*// yang cig me rlung nus pa rlung la zhugs// lus kyi drod yal me lce 'khor ba'i tshe// 'jigs snang bzod thabs med pa 'char bas na// chos min cis phan soms dang rat+na'i ming*// 'jig rten 'di yang snang ba dbang med nub// pha rol 'jigs rung gshin rje'i snang ba 'char// ci bya brtol med nyams thag gyur pa na// chos las gzhan pa'i dpung med rat+na ba// mal gyi tha mar 'chi bar gyur tsam na// dbugs kyi lus kun khyab pa'i nus pa med// gre ba ngar ngar sgra rgyun sbreng ba'i tshe// chos las gzhan gyis mi sleb rat+na ba// nang gi gnad gcod sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// mig gnyis gyen la ldog cing srog kyang 'dor// bar do'i 'jigs snang ci yang 'char ba na// chos las gzhan gyis mi sleb rat+na ba// mi rtag 'jigs pas 'du shes ring dor nas// sang byed gnang byed chos kyis phan dus med// 'chi bdag dus kyi gtugs tshe 'gyod par zad// 'khor ba'i yid 'byung soms dang rat+na ba// 'on kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin las// bzang ngan chags sdang dge sdig spang blang kun// rang byung lhan skyes bde chen rol pa'i rtsal// sna tshogs 'dzin rtog snang cha'i 'khrul 'khor kun// bkag med 'gyu bral dbyings su khra la la// gang shar nyams yan spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// ar sangs rang grol ngo bor cha la la// 'di phyi bar do 'khrul pa'i ri mo 'di// lhun grub ye dbyings chen por muḥdha thim// de ltar mchis gyur lhan skyes rang gi sems// rang ngo rang shes bde chen 'bral med 'dir// gtugs kyi thug na mi bde ma mchis pas// srang mda'i skye bo 'ga' zhig ka ru ṇa//

༈ nga)rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bkra shis rgya mtsho la skabs shig tu tshigs su bcad pa/ ༈ /bde gshegs dgongs dbyings zab gsal bsgom pa'i dus// rang dang bla ma tha dad yin tshul gyi// gdung ba'i yid kyis gdung bar gyur pa ni// bla ma nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar gsal 'dzin med// rang blo'i snang ba bla mar shar ba las// bla ma bla ma nyid kyi ngo bos stong*// de ltar bla ma rang gi sems su nges// gdung ba'i yid kyi 'khri ba de ru chod// ces phul ba lags// ༈ ca)lag dal du bgyis pa/ ༈ e ma ho// brten med rig pa'i mkha' dbyings su// rang shar gyi bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// 'gag med du snang ba'i skur bstan te// rang grol du bdag la zhal bstan 'tshal// snyoms las kyi sprang bo rat+na nga*// rkyen snang gi bskul mas mtshams sbyar te// drin can gyi bla ma bcu phrag bsten// de gsung gi gdams pa'i bcud bsdus pa// sprang bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar// 'khor ba'i btson dong 'di dam par mthong*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'di ya re nga*// sdig pa'i pho nya 'di bslu re mkhas// ngan song gi g.yang du bskyur bskyur 'dra// dal 'byor gyi lus 'di rnyed par dka'// 'jigs pa ru sla ba chu sbur 'dra// rtag gtan du sdod pa'i blo yod kyang*// sang tshun gyi khag theg ngas ma mthong*// 'chi ba'i dmag dpung khos sleb tsa na// gces pa ru bskyangs pa'i lus sems 'bral// 'bral med yid chags kyi gnyen 'dun bskyur// sdug khur dka' bsags kyi zas nor bzhag /rgyus med gnyen bral gyi bar do 'grim// byas bsags sdig pa'i khres po khur// skyabs med shun pa'i gos dang bral// sgren mo lag stong du 'gro ba soms// de la phan nges kyi dam pa'i chos// da res kyi rten 'dir ma sgrubs na// 'di phyi'i mdun ma rlung la bskur// de la soms la blo sna chos la bstungs// 'on kyang nges don 'di go bas// 'chi bas 'jigs med kyi mkhar zhig rtsigs// kun gzhi khyab gdal gyi sa gzhi la// so thar byang sems kyi ra bas bskor// gsang sngags rdo rje yi pho brang la// phyogs bral dbu ma yi skar khra gsal// snying po phyag chen gyi khang thog la// blo 'das rdzogs chen gyi kha bad can// de 'dra'i rdzong btsan gyi nang gnas pas// skye 'chi'i dmag dpung la nyam mi nga*// 'thab 'dzing mi dgos te sos re dal// mi bde ma mchis te bde mor 'dug

/der yang ma zad kyi go cig bgos// 'dzin med lta ba'i ma khrab la// stong gsal byar med kyi lag gis brgyan// rtsal chen yongs rdzogs kyi rmog mo la// ye shes kun snang gi 'phru yis spud// blang dor ma 'dres kyi mda' mo dang*// bdag med brjod bral gyi gzhu ru sbyar// thabs shes ngar snyoms kyi ral gri dang*// rtag 'dzin dngos 'bigs kyi mdung rnon thogs// de lta'i go mtshon can dpa' bo ngas// nyon mongs 'khor ba 'di 'joms 'joms 'dra// 'joms pa ru ma zad choms pa 'dra// der yang ma zad kyi chos shig byed// nga la rigs drug gi ming med pas// 'khor ba ru 'khyams pa'i brjod cha med// nga la sdig pa yis ma gos pas// dge ba yang sgrub rgyu ngas ma mthong*// thog mar skyes pa'i khungs med pas// tha mar 'chi rgyu ni nga la med// sngon chad gzugs dbyibs su ma grub pas// da ni skye ba yi dogs pa bral// bsgom bya sgom byed kho rang go// sgrub byed dam chos ni gzhan ma rnyed// sangs rgyas zhes bzang bar sems pa dang*// sems can zhes ngan par rtog pa 'di// gnyis med kho rang gis byed par 'dug /'bras bu la logs su re ba med// blo thag gting chod kyi bya btang cig lags// 'on kyang rgyal ba'i thugs rje zab// rten 'brel gshis kyi rang nyams 'di// bu rjes 'jug rnams la gdams lags pas// ka snying nas mi btang gces par gzung*// zhes pa 'di yang lag dal du gnam lcags me 'bar gyis bkod pa'o/ ༈ cha)lta sgom spyod pa sku gsum sogs la bstod pa/ ༈ /kun gzhi rang bzhin ka dag rdo rje 'chang*// gnas lugs gdod ma'i mgon po bde bar gshegs// dbyer med 'khor 'das bde chen lhun grub dngos// brjod bral lta ba gzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// khyab gdal klong chen 'od gsal dkyil 'khor las// sna tshogs snang cha'i rang gdangs kun gsal zhing*// yid bral 'char sgo skad cig dbyings zhi ba'i// gzhir gnas mngon gyur sgom pa lam la 'dud// gnyug ma dbyings stong rang grol mtha' bral gang*// snang srid phyag rgya'i chos la dbang bsgyur zhing*// 'khor 'das 'byor pa'i tshogs la longs spyod pa'i// sku gsum 'bras bu'i ming 'dzin la phyag 'tshal// 'gyur med blo 'das kun gsal chos kyi sku// 'gag med khams gsum rgyan spras longs spyod rdzogs// gang 'dul der snang 'char ba sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum ngo bo sems nyid de la 'dud// chos dbyings gdal chen ye shes mi bskyod pa// ma 'dres me long ye shes snang mdzad mgon// de nyid sor rtog ye shes 'od dpag med// de don bya grub ye shes rdo rje rgyal// kun gzhi mnyam nyid ye shes rin 'byung ste// gzhir gnas rigs lnga mgon po la phyag 'tshal// gzhir gnas gti mug rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// rgyas dang dbang gyur chags dngos 'jam dpal dbyangs// drag 'dul zhe sdang rdo rje badz+ra dh+rika

/dus gsum rig dngos khyab bdag gsum la 'dud/ ༈ ja)mi rtag par bskul ba/ ༈ na mo gu ru ye// g.yung drung 'gyur med 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings// don dam bla ma bde chen zhi ba'i sku// 'khor 'das srid zhi'i don la dbang bsgyur ba'i// rje btsun kun dga'i mgon gyis bdag cag skyongs// yang cig snyoms las sprang po rat+na ngas// phyi nang snod bcud rten g.yo kun la brtags// thams cad mi rtag ston pa'i bla mar go /rang la snying rje yod rnams bsam par rigs// rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po las// gling bzhi ri rab zhing khams kun snang na// rtag brtan 'gyur med 'pho 'gyur bral snyam yang*// me chu rlung gi 'jigs pas mi rtag ston// de bzhin rang lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa las// sgyu lus byis pa dar ma rgan po'i gzugs// da dung 'chi ba yong snyam mi gda' ste// 'byung ba thim rim shar tshe mi rtag ston// snod kyi 'jig rten byed po grub med pas// dus gnad cig la 'gyur ba med snyam yang*// dbyar dgun ston dpyid nam zla dus bzhi sogs/ ༈ gter sgrom rmu zam stong khar dpe don rang nyams smras pa/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ /pha drin can bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// sprang 'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs// bu gsol ba 'debs so thugs brtses gzung*// blo dred po'i snang ba chos la bstungs// snyoms las kyi sprang po rat+na ba// zin med kyi bya ba skyung re ran// yongs nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings rum nas// rkyen glo bur sna 'dzings sprin tshogs 'khrugs// de skad cig sngar bzhin da mi gnas// 'di bsams kyin mi rtag brda ru go /dpe 'di la soms 'chi chos byed re ran// de ran pa ru ma zad 'phyis 'phyis tsam// dog sa gzhi rtsa mchog 'dab ma la// rkyen char zim bab pa'i zil pa 'di// 'od nyi mas phog pa'i yal lugs sam// 'di bsams kyin mi rtag brda ru go

/dpe 'di la soms 'chi chos byed re ran// de ran pa ru ma zad 'phyis 'phyis tsam// klung gtsang chab sngon mo'i rgyun 'bab 'di// dus dbyar dgun nam zlas skye 'bri ston// de skad cig mi sdod myur du brgyug /'di bsams kyin mi rtag brda ru go /dpe 'di la soms 'chi chos byed re ran// de ran pa ru ma zad 'phyis 'phyis tsam// lus gzhon dregs brgyags pa'i khye'u chung yang*// nad glo bur langs pa'i 'chi dus tshe// yun skad cig gnas pa'i dbang ma mchis// 'di bsams kyin mi rtag brda ru go /dpe 'di la soms 'chi chos byed re ran// de ran pa ru ma zad 'phyis 'phyis tsam// drin pha mas bskyangs pa'i sgyu lus 'di// tshe nges med 'di thub gdeng ma mchis// rkyen 'chi bdag nam yong ma nges pas// 'di bsams kyin mi rtag snying nas dran// dpe mtshon pas don la gsal cig 'debs// gsal 'debs par ma zad snying la soms// 'on lags kyang sprang ban rat+na ngas// rje mtshan ldan bla ma nyid dang mjal// chos phyag rgya che la nyams len gyis// de logs nas skyabs gnas 'tshol ma dgos// don des kyang blo thag gting nas chod// sprang dgos dgu rang rnyed rnal 'byor lags// gzhi 'khrul pa'i bag chags ming ma mthong*// nang sgrib gsum nyon mongs btsal ma rnyed// 'bras sku gsum re smon bya mi dgos// de gcig tu shes pas sos re dal// don 'dis kyang blo thag gting nas chod// sprang dgos dgu rang tshang rnal 'byor lags// gzhi lta ba'i blo yul 'dzin pa bor// lam bsgom pa'i mnyam rjes thun mtshams 'das// 'bras sgrub med spyod pa shugs 'byung ngang*// de bya rtsol bral ba'i rang byung gshis// don 'dis kyang blo thag gting nas chod// sprang bya byed spangs pa'i rnal 'byaur lags// don 'khor 'das rig pa'i cho 'phrul shar// gzhi mnyam yangs rang gdangs shes pa'i dbyings// lam rtsol med dgag sgrub bral ba'i ngang*// 'bras spyod byed spyod yul dbyer med gshis// don 'dis kyang 'chug med pha yul zin// sprang 'khor 'das yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor lags// dpe don rang nyams dbyangs chung 'di// gnas gter sgrom brag gi dben gnas su// grogs snyan pa'i tshig gis bskul te sbyar// dge 'dis kyang khams gsum don rtogs shog
/'grig la legs pa'i sdebs sbyor ma mchis kyang*// sprang po'i nyams la shar ba'i gang dran yin// mkhas dang grub pas thugs khrel ma zhugs lags// 'on kyang pan+da ?pan+ḍi ba las lhag pa 'dra// zhes

pa 'di yang gnas chen gter sgrom du shing mo lug lo la sbyar ba'o/ ༈ ta)khams su rdzogs chen pa so sa chos dar la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī hrīḥhūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho// rang rig ka dag bde chen mkha' yi klong*// ye shes lhun rdzogs bya bral chos kyi sku// 'khor 'das dbyer med rang grol ngo bo nyid// kun 'dus rgyal po de la gdeng bca'o// thog med dus med mtha' ma'i mtha' bral zhing*// gzung 'dzin rang stong mtha' bral yangs pa che// rig pa'i rgyal po 'gyur med gdangs can la// dus kun 'bral med 'di ni rang la gnas// bcos bral lta ba 'dzin med sgom pa'i ngang*// spang blang rtsol spang spyod pa'i rgyal po nyid// thog med kun bzang rang rig thig ler gsal// zhes pa 'di rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa so sa chos dar gyis bskul ba las// dpal bde stengs kyi sgar du// 'bri gung rat+na'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ ༈ tha)'gro mgon nyang po kun dga' la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud// rkyen ngan 'khrul 'khor lam du blang ba la// 'di phyi'i rtsis gdab gnyen po mi gda' ste// 'khor 'das rang gshis gang shar phyag rgya che// bde sdug spang blang rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*// de nyid mi g.yo mi 'gag de bzhin nyid// kun bzang ngo bo las ni mi gzhan pa// de ltar lags so skal ldan skyes bu dgongs// tshe 'dir nga dang 'phrad 'dra phreng gsum 'di// lam 'dir mos shing sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs ldan// 'gro mgon kun dga'i mtshan gyis bskul te bris// dge des rang gsal gdod ma'i gzhir e waṃ/ ༈ da)rang la bskul ba'i gros 'debs/ ༈ na mo gu ru// bka' drin gsum ldan rje btsun bla ma mchog /sprang po'i spyi gtsug mi 'bral rgyan du shog /chos dred g.yeng khyer long yod sgyid lug pa'i// ngang rings can gyi blo sna chos la bstungs// mtshan ldan mgon gcig rje btsun gung la gshegs// chos ldan grogs kyis bskul ba'i gnas skabs dka'// de tshe rang la rang gros ma thebs na// khyed la yun ring sdod pa'i dbang yod dam// 'chi bdag bdud 'di dgong kha'i grib so 'dra// phar phar mi 'gro tshur tshur khad kyi nye// nam yong cha med rang la rang bsam thong*// 'chi grabs dam chos btsan sa 'dzin re che// mi tshe mi sdod gsod kha'i dud 'gro 'dra// gom gang song yang tshe zad 'chi bar nye// myur du yong ngo rang la rang bsam thong*// mi tshe song ngo dam chos sgrub re ran// srog gi dbang po chu yi chu sbur 'dra// da lta yod kyang da lta 'jig pa mthong*// mi rtag ston no rang la rang bsam thong*// myur du 'chi bas sgrub pa byed re ran// gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog tshong 'dus 'gron po

'dra// da lta yod kyang da lta 'bral ba mang*// nye dus mi phan rang la rang bsam thong*// 'grogs long med do dben pa bsten re ran// zas nor mi rtag sbrang mas rtsi sogs 'dra// rang gi bsags kyang longs spyod gzhan gyis byed// 'chi ba nor gyi mi lhus rang bsam thong*// chog shes gyi na tsam la brten re ran// las 'bras mi bslu nam mkha'i bya grib 'dra// mi 'phrad snyam yang nam zhig gcig tu 'dzom// de la byor zur bros kyang thar ba med// 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam cig sgrub re ran// sang bya gnangs bya'i bya mang ngang ring 'di// dgra yis bslus pa'i gros la blo gtod 'dra// dgos dus phan pa'i don de sgrub par dka'// blo sna myur du stungs shig rat+na ba// 'di ltar bdag 'dra'i 'khor bar sun med rnams// rang gis rang la bskul ma byed re ran// mi tshe yud tsam 'di la chos med na// phyis nas dal 'byor thob pa dka' mor gda'// zhes pa'i rang la bskul ma'i gros 'di yang*// 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi gnas tshul la shin tu skyo ba'i yid kyis gter sgrom gyi ri khrod du bris pa'o/ ༈ na)bya gtang rin bkras la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru// skye 'gag 'gyur med spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// rang bzhin kun khyab der snang skur ston pa'i// rje btsun bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams// mi 'bral thig le'i ngang du phyag 'tshal bstod// 'khor ba'i gnas lugs mi rtag chu sbur 'dra// 'di la rtag brtan snying por sus 'dzin pa// changs pa stong pas byis pa 'brid dang mtshungs// snying la chongs la dam pa'i chos la 'bungs// bslab brgya'i yon tan khas nyen skyel ma 'dra// kun rdzob chos la blo gtad sus byed pa// yong yong 'dra yang dgos dus phan pa med// yid la zhog cig rat+na maṅga laṃ// 'chi dus phan pa'i gnas lugs rang 'gros 'di// phyug po'i bang mdzod bu lon bkye ba 'dra// 'di gtad med kyang dgos khar phan par nges// sgrub pa snying por bgyis shig 'bad par rigs// skabs dus bab pa'i bzhag thabs go tshul zhig

/da lta'i nyams myong sa mtshams 'di nyid la// smra bar bya yis 'thad na bsnyen par rigs// zhi gnas nyams kyi zhen pa'i 'ching ba grol// stong dang had po bzo med 'gyu tshogs dngas// ngos gzung ming med mtha' bral rang shugs can// 'di la bzhag dang ma bzhag khyad par med// bzhag sems mnyam pa 'ching ba'i bdud chen te// rang babs rgya yan lhug pa 'gag med rtsal// ma bcos khong glod yan pa gshis kyi dang*// 'di la su zhig bcos bslad byed pa de// rang gis rang nyid 'ching ba'i zhags pas bcings// med pa yod bsgoms 'jur bu'i blo yis bsdams// re ba'i btson gzung dogs pa'i ra bar tshud// ji srid rtsol sems de dang ma bral bar// rang babs gshis kyi rang zhal mthong dka' bas// sgom nyams yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i dri 'di spongs// rang shar thabs chen ye dag stong gshis dang*// shes rab mos gus rgyu 'bras dran par bya// 'di bzhin bstan de'i don de nyams len na// rang bzhin babs chen ngang der rang phyin te// 'dzin byed phyogs zhen mthar phyin dbyings su 'gyur// zhes pa gang 'di bya btang rin bkras la// rang gi myong ba'i sgo nas smras pa te// yang dag don dang 'gal na bzod par gsol/ ༈ pa)gtsang se brag bla ma la gdams pa/ ༈ /rgya chen chos kyi chu gter las 'thon zhing*// dman brtse lhag bsam dag pa'i lo 'dab can/ khrims gsum rab dkar sdong bu brtan gyur pa'i/ nyes pa'i dri bral pad dkar lta bu nyid// gang gi gdams pa'i gsang 'di 'dzin par rigs// chos kun rtsa ba rnam dag lhag pa'i khrims// so thar byang sems gsang sngags bslab bya kun// dus su bab pa'i sgo gsum spyod pa spyad// sngon 'gro dal 'byor thob dka' mi rtag dang*// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs las 'bras bden par des// dngos gzhi g.yeng spangs rnam dag lhag bsam bskyed// re dogs med pa'i rang shar 'dzin bral ba// grims lhod bral ba'i yang dag don la bzhag

/yod med phyogs zhen 'dzin pa'i mtha' bral ba'i// rang gshis lta ba rtogs pa'i don dang ldan// chu bo'i rgyun ltar mnyam gzhag dri med la// goms pa'i ngang la gnas na sku gcig nas// bgrang gi mi lang sku gsung thugs yon tan// 'phrin las mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub// ces pa'i nyams len gnad dril nyung bsdus 'di// g.yeng bas bskul te zhib par ma gyur kyang*// cung zhig brjod pa'i dge 'dis rab mtshon te// 'gro kun dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// bla med byang chub snying po thob phyir bsngo// bral bzhi ma zhes bya ba se brag bla ma nam mkha' blo ldan rdo rjes bskul ba las// bya bral ba rat+na'i ming can gyis stong lung sna mo nang gi sgar du bris pa'o/ ༈ pha)gter sgrom 'brong ngur gyi gnas bstod/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ drin mtshan ldan rje btsun bla ma dang*// don dngos grub rtsol ba'i yi dam lha// rkyen bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong la// sprang gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gnas byin chen gter sgrom brag dkar 'di// sngon grub thob rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs// ma zhing skyong mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing*// rigs mchog gyur skal ldan sgrub pa'i gnas// de phal dang phal gyis bgrod dka' ste// brag dkar po nam mkhar snyogs pa 'dra// rdza lhud mo mkhar du brtsigs pa 'dra// chu drag po rngam pa'i sgra skad sgrog /nags rtsi shing du ma mtshon cha'i tshul// rmugs na bun go ru gyon pa 'dra// bya ri dwags mi min dmag tshogs 'dra// phyogs 'khor ma'i ri rnams khro tshul can// phu gsum gyi ri la yar bltas tsa// spang gcan gzan tshogs kyi rgyu srang 'dra// mda' smad gsum gyi mdo la phyir bltas tsa// brag 'phrang gi sgo mo bcad pa 'dra// yul de ltar 'jigs pa'i gnas chen de// byang drag po'i gnas chen yin pa'i rtags// gnas 'dir ni skal ldan re re la// byin phal gyi mi chags snang ba skyo// don 'di ltar ldan no skal ldan rnams// brag dkar po nam mkhar snyegs 'dra de// don skye med dbyings su snyeg pa'i brda// rdza lhud mo mkhar du rtsigs 'dra de// sgrub snying po lhur len gnas pa'i rtags// chu rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog pa de// ma gsang sngags chos sgra sgrog pa'i rtags// nags rtsi shing mtshon cha'i tshul can de// mi mi min bar chad bsrung ba'i rtags// smugs na bun gos ltar gyon pa ni// der gnas kyi tshe srog bsrung ba'i rtags// bya ri dwags mi min tshogs 'dra de// kun dbang du 'du zhing 'dud pa'i rtags// phyogs 'khor mo'i ri kun khro tshul de// skal med kyi tshe srog 'phrog pa'i rtags// phu gsum gsang chen la so 'di// las skal ldan thar lam mtshon pa'i rtags// mda' brag 'phrang sgo mo bcad 'dra 'di// las ngan song sgo mo gcod pa'i rtags// bu snying nas byang chub sgrub 'dod rnams// gnas gter sgrom dben pa'i brag dkar 'dir// bu byang chub sgrub la snying rus mdzod// sgos khyad 'phags dben gnas 'brong ngur 'di// spyir gnas chen tshogs khang mdun gyi cha// sgos rgyab ri rin chen 'bar ba 'dra// g.yas lha btsan drag po'i pho brang rngam// g.yon brag dkar ze mthon skyor ba'i tshul// mdun bka' brgyud pho brang bris ltar bkra// mdo sgo srung drag po sbrul mgo can// g.yas g.yon nas chu rgyun bar med 'bab// yul khyad 'phags bhaṃ ga'i dur khrod 'di// skye sngon nas smon pas bsgrubs pa'i mthus// gnas byin can g.ya' yi spyil bu 'dir// bdag snying nas byang chub sgrub par smon// smon ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig

༈ ba)cham kha dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal po la gdams pa/ ༈ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mchog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol ba'i// rje btsun bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud// gzhon nu rab byung bslab gsum rgyan gyis spras// thaus bsam bya ba'i 'khor los rgyud bkang te// ting 'dzin yang dag 'jog la gzhol gyur pa'i// dge slong bud+dha rā dzā gang de yis// lta sgom spyod 'bras rnal 'byor bzhi rim kun// sdoms te sgril ba'i nyams len bya lugs shig /smra bar byos zhes gsung gis bskul ba na// sems med rnga la dbyug gus bsnun pa'i tshe// ngo mtshar sgra brnyan ci yang 'byung ba ltar// sprang po rat+na'i ming can 'di skad smra// rje btsun mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// zab lam gdams pa ji ltar thob pa la// khyad gzhi khyad chos nyams len ji lta'i tshul// san da bdag gis 'di ltar go 'o kye// gzhi ni kun gzhi ma bcos gdal ba che// byas med bcos bral rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// kun nas dbyer med gdangs kun yongs rdzogs gsal// 'ching ba'i gzhi med stong chen rab 'byams dbyings// lam du rtsal snang du ma'i 'char tshul las// bde sdug legs nyes spang blang mtshan 'dzin can// rgyar chad phyogs lhung chags sdang gzung ba'i yul// gzhi rtsa ma chod de dang der gzung sems// gnyis su snang ba lam gyi 'char tshul lo// 'bras bu ngo bo chos skur ka nas dag /kun rdzob snang ba'i rten 'brel 'khor lo las// 'khor dang myang 'das sna tshogs cho 'phrul 'char// shar yang rang rig mi 'gyur de bzhin nyid// mdor na kun gzhi snying po chos kyi sku// mi pho rang gdangs kun gsal longs spyod rdzogs// bya ba sna tshogs kun snang sprul pa'i sku// gzhi lam 'bras gsum sku gsum ngo bor gnas// de ltar rtogs pa mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// rang bzhin de las ma bcos lta ba'i yul// de nyid ngang las mi 'chos sgom pa'i gnad// bcos ma'i skyon bral rang lugs spyod pa yi// rnal ma 'pho 'gyur med pa'i nyams len lags// de ltar nyams blang 'bras bu'i 'byung tshul ni// nyams myong rtogs pa shes pa'i ming gdags gzhi// tshor drug snang cha'i 'char sgo gsal mi gsal// gang ltar byung yang rang bzhin ngang la gnas// snod dngas chus mtshon zhi gnas zhes su 'dog

/de nyid ting 'dzin ngo bor gnas shes shing*// rang gdangs kun gsal spyod shes rig gdangs can// zhi gnas ngo bo lhag gis mthong bas na// lhag mthong mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab zer// de las stong nyams har gsal shugs dang bcas// bde ba'i nyams chen zhi ba'i 'dzin pa can// rang gsal zhi bar 'du shes kun ldan la// ting 'dzin 'du shes don ni rtse gcig nyams// de lta'i nyams la zhen med rang 'gros su// bskyangs las chos kun rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*// bya rtsol kun bral rgyar yang chal ma chol// 'dzin pa'i sems med gzung ba'i ting 'dzin bral// stong chen bya bral spros dang bral bar myong*// 'khor 'das chos rnams snang yang rang bzhin stong*// stong las sna tshogs cho 'phrul ci shar yang*// brjod bral yang dag don las mi 'da' ba// du ma ro gcig nyid du rtogs pa'o// chos kun 'char byed rang sems rig pa'i rgyal// gzung yul snang ba'i dngos kun dri ma med// mkha' la nyi bzhin ma bcos de bzhin nyid// sgom bya bsgom pa'i 'ching ba rang grol ba// bde chen chos sku 'pho med mi 'gyur ba// sgom med rnal 'byor chen por mngon phyin te// pha rjes bus zin 'khor ba'i 'dam las brgal// rang don kun rdzogs gzhan don lhun gyis grub// de ltar rnal 'byor rnam bzhi mthar phyin la// rjes shes 'di dag mi 'byung ka thabs med// rtse gcig rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes tsam na// 'khor bar blo ldog dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel// spros bral rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa na// nor rdzas gnyen 'brel 'khri ba btsan thabs chod// ro gcig rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa de// rgyu 'bras chos la phra zhib nyams su len// sgom med rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa de// bdag gzhan kun snyoms ma 'dres chos kun mkhas// rjes shes 'di rnams mi ldan kha lta can// bstan pa'i chom rkun zog chos bslu brid mkhan// chos ltar bcos pa'i tshul can mdzes spyod kyang*// chu skyar dang ni byi la ji bzhin mtshungs// don rtags 'di rnams ldan pa'i gang zag ni// tshul rtags ji dang ji lta'i tshul gnas kyang*// bka' brgyud gdams pa'i snying po yid la thebs// skal ldan 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam par go

/gzhi lam 'bras las lta sgom spyod gsum du// nyams len bya ba'i rim pa 'di lta ste// dang po mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa gces// de las bsag sbyang sngon 'gro'i nyams khrid kyis// tshogs bsag sgrib sbyang lam gyi rtsa ba'i bzhi// de nas zhi lhag zung 'brel gdams pa ni// ma zin zin dang zin pa brtan byed cing*// brtan pa bogs dbyung dmigs rim nyid la 'khrid// de ni thog mar gces pa'i nyams len tshul// rjes ni 'khor gsum mi dmigs bsngo ba yis// 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba kun// chud mi za bar byang chub nyid du 'gyur// rgyun du nyams blangs dge sbyong spangs rtogs ni// gang ltar mtshams pa'i bskyang thabs man ngag gces// zhes pa 'di ni gter sgrom dben gnas su// 'bri gung snyoms las rat+na'i ming gis smras// dge des 'gro kun rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes pa 'di yang gter sgrom 'brong ngur du'o/ ༈ ma)'bri gung mthil du yum drung la phul ba/ ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ rang bzhin brjod bral shes dang shes bya'i dbyings// 'khrul 'dzin rtag pa'i dri bral stong nyid don// ji bzhin mkhyen gzigs yum chen pha rol phyin// don gnyis mthar son khyed la gus pas 'bul// dus mtha'i sprang po ming mang lus mang po// smra ba mang po'i gzhir gyur bdag nyid kyang*// cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes kyi dga' ba nas// rat+na'i ming can dben par mtshams mal bcad// mnyam rjes 'dzin pa'i dri ma bral lo skad// gnam lcags me 'bar mal dro'i rdzong du phyin// 'byung bzhi 'du ba'i nad dang bral lo skad// sna tshogs rang grol gter sgrom brag la 'phyo// gsang sngags rgyud sde'i gdams pa len no skad// rat+na drag rtsal jo shaka mjal du phyin// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub brnyes so skad// mkha' grol klong yangs bsam yas skor du song*// zab gter dgongs pa rang grol thon no skad// kun tu rgyu chu ka bzhir sdad pa na// sna tshogs skad cha'i bye brag thos so skad// col chung po tsho so sor nga bden zer// 'khrul med rnams kyang cung zad 'khrul lo skad// 'khrul par bden 'dzin ban skye mang po yang*// sna tshogs ca co'i ga zha sgrog go skad// de sogs rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i ri mo la// mi 'byung bya ba'i dpe ni med bzhin du// de tshul 'di na mngon sum gyur pa la// kho bo cag ni bcos med lhun grub pas// gang ltar bshad kyang nga rang nyid du shes// gang ltar smras kyang brag cha lhang lhang po// mthon por bstod kyang sil snyan rol mo'i sgra// ngan par smras kyang khyi rgan rang skad 'byin// gang ltar myong yang chu bo rgyun 'bab klong*// de la de yin des min ngas ma go

/yang ni kun tu rgyu de 'di skad lo// phyogs gzhan song ba rnams ni ngas ma go /byis chung bdag ni gang du'ang ma song zhing*// lcam gang bde ba can du gnas bcas te// thun mtshams khrigs kyi spros pa ma bsgrubs shing*// rang babs gshis kyi ngang gi 'dug pa la// ka pā la ltar stong par 'dug snyam te// kha ru dka' thub bza' ba ster bar sems// ga lu 'jab bus rna ba bklags te mnyan// nga bden kho bden skad cha'i bye brag rnams// ca co bar med sgrog la brtson pa ni// cha lang rnga dang dung gi sgra ltar sbir// ja bzhur ldud pa'i 'phro yang gcod la zhugs// nya mo lta bu'i khog pa dang sang ngo*// ta thā ga ta'i lus gnad bsrangs te gnas// tha ro tho ro'i bla bo ma smras pas// da de nang 'dir mi 'dug ces pa ni// na ba'i khun pa lta bur nyin mtshan sgrog /pa sor 'dod pa'i shes ldan kha cig kyang*// pha rol ngag gi tshig rjes rab bsnyags te// ba glang lta bur khyu rjes 'breng byed cing*// ma lus 'tshang du mnyam nas sgrog pa'ang thos// tsa na ka tsam rang la mi rtog par// tsha zer lta bur kun la gdung ba bskyed// dza lang spyod 'gros skyong ba'i byis pa kun// wa mo lta bur nam zhig mi 'gyur ram// zha mo lta bur spyi bor 'khur dka' yang*// za ma lta bur rang 'tsho bstan pa dang*// 'a lo 'o lor bskyur ba mi rigs zhes// ya rabs rnams kyi spyod yul yin zhes thos// ra ltar rang la mthu stobs ma mchis kyang*// la ba pa sogs grub thob brgyud pa 'dzin// sha za lta bur gzhan la gnod pa spong*// sa stengs rgyal ba'i bstan la mos tsam 'dis// ha cang myur ba'i byang chub ma thob kyang*// a ma drin can rnams la nga mkho snyam// ku re kyal kha'i rdzun bris ring mo 'di// ma cig yum chen drung du yus kyis 'bul// bar der dam bcas zhu lan 'bul bar spangs// de bas dgyes phyir rol mo mchod par bzhes// lar tshes bcu'i dbang bka' de ma byung na// nga rgya gar yul tsam du phyin la che/

ha ha /a cang sku khams la thugs gzab zhu// rmi ltas kyang cung zad 'grig par byung bas// sang steng du yang skor gcig mjal// ngag mtshams de grol bar yod lags/ ༈ tsa)'brong ngur gyi g.yam spyil du smras pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ tshe rabs sngon nas rjes gzung ba'i// drin can rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams// sgo gsum dang bas spyi bos 'dud// sprang po'i lam sna chos la drongs// 'dir tshogs mched grogs gsung na re// khyod kyi spyod tshul 'di lta bu// ji ltar yin zhes gsung gsung nas// sprang po'i gnas tshul cung zhig brjod// smon lam mtshams sbyor zab zab nas// da' 'byor skyu ra'i rigs skyes kyang*// sngon las rnam smin bdas bdas nas// lo lnga lon nas mi yul 'khyar// bag chags sdig sgrib chung chung nas// mtshan ldan bla ma rnams dang mjal// rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul mar shar// sangs rgyas bstan la mos pa'i mthus// lo brgyad lon nas rab tu byung*// sgo gsum snyoms las ma byas par/ thos bsam sgom la 'bad pa bskyed// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje yis// bcu drug lo la rang yul 'khor// mtshungs med rje yis yongs su gzung*// bka' brgyud gdams pa'i snying phur thebs// chos las chog shes blo chung bas// mtshan ldan bla ma mang du bsten// sngon sbyangs las 'phro cung zhig sad// snang bzhi'i nyams len ngo shes kyang*// da dung chos brgyad 'khri bas bcings// gdan sa'i ming yang lo 'ga' byas// rang gzhan kun la bltas bltas pas// chos gzung bslu byed gshed mar go /des kyang rang la yid ma ches// rgyal ba'i bka' dang ma mthun zhing*// grub thob phyi rjes cung ma rnyogs// snying nas chos byed min par go /da ni zhe 'khris 'ching ba gcod// chags zhen 'ching ba'i gcod lugs ni// mtshan ldan rje la yar bltas tsa// skal ldan dad pa'i rjes 'brang 'dra// gzhi gcig brtan par ngas ma go /da ni dgon gnas 'khri ba gcod// bka' brgyud gdams par phar bltas tsa// nyams len brtson 'grus gang che 'dra// mkhas grub zer lor ngas ma mthong*// da ni chos bshad 'khri ba gcod// bu slob rnams la phar bltas na// chos las 'jig rten gtso bor 'don// tshul bzhin ldan pa ngas ma go

/da ni grwa slob 'khri ba gcod// sde dpon rnams la phar bltas pas// ngan song gting mtha' 'tshol ba 'dra// gzur gnas bde sgrub ngas ma mthong*// da ni bla dpon 'khri ba gcod// 'khor dang 'bangs la bltas na yang*// nam bzhug la kha'i 'bu sbrang 'dra// tshe bsod ldan par ngas ma go /da ni nye 'khor 'khri ba gcod// yul mkhar khyim la phar ltas tsa// dgra gnyen so mtshams mkhar dang 'dra// yun du sus 'dzin ngas ma go /da ni yul mkhar 'khri ba gcod// nor dang rdzas la phar bltas tsa// 'ja' tshon na bun 'dra'o kye// de sogs dpe don bgrang 'das par// go bas zhen 'khris snying nas bcad// sgyu lus g.yar po'i byi'u chung 'di// gar 'gro 'dir 'dug nges pa med// de bas mched grogs thams cad kyang*// 'gro sdod gnyis ka'i grabs re mdzod// 'gro 'gro 'dra la sdod pa'ang srid// sdod sdod 'dra yang 'gro srid pas// ci zer ma gsan ci byed gzigs// de ltar lags so thugs la bzhog ༈ tsha)rang sems chos nyid ma/ ༈ na mo gu ru de wa ḍāki nī ye// rang sems chos nyid ky-i bla ma// 'gag med yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor// rang rtsal mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs// rtsa gsum rang rig tu rdzogs pa'i// sprang po rat+na nga'i dga' ba// sna tshogs rang grol nga'i skyid pa// pha yul 'dzin pa ru bral yang*// gar song gnyug ma y-i gtan yul// snang grags 'khor 'das kyi bdag po// chags sdang chos brgyad kyis dben pa'i// sprang po rat+na nga'i dga' ba// mi bskyod rdo rje nga'i skyid pa// sgo gsum bya byed dang bral yang*// dam chos rang sems su shar bas// dgag sgrub spang blang du ma dgos// ci byas chos nyid kyi rol pa// sprang po rat+na nga'i dga' ba// mkha' grol klong yangs nga'i skyid pa// 'khor ba myang 'das su med pas// bzang ngan re dogs dang bral zhing*// rang snang rang rtsal du go bas// snang rig rgya yan gyis chog pa'i// sprang po rat+na nga'i dga' ba// gnam lcags me 'bar nga'i skyid pa// dgos dgu rang tshang du 'byor bas// bya rtsol rnam g.yeng cig ma dgos/

'bad med rang gshis su grub pas// kun khyab 'dod bskong cig byung ngo*// sprang po rat+na nga'i dga' ba// rat+na drag rtsal nga'i skyid pa// 'di yang 'brong ngur du'o/ ༈ dza)phyag chen ma bcos rig pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba// ma bcos rig pa'i ngo bo yin// bcos slad dgag sgrub bral ba de// lam du byed pa'i gdams ngag yin// re dogs bral ba'i 'bras bu de// ye sangs rgyas pa gcer bud yin// rang gdangs 'gag med rang rtsal 'di// 'khor 'das dbyer med 'phrin las so// de ltar yin lugs gting rtogs na// 'di las rgyal bas gzhan ma bstan// ma rtogs na yang de ka yin// sprang po gu yangs blo bde yis// lag dal ri mor bris pa lags// zhes pa 'di yang stod lung bde chen gzhis kar lag dal du bris pa'o/ ༈ wa)nyams dga' bya bral du shar ba zhes bya/ ༈ e ma hoḥ 'di ltar nyams re dga'// nyams dga'i snang ba cir yang 'char// mi gzhan pa dam chos byed pa dang*// sprang po nga 'ch-i chos byed pa gnyis// phugs byang chub thob par gcig mod kyang*// 'phral nyams len bya lugs cung ma mthun// mi gzhan pa gtso bor lus ngag 'dul// sprang rang sems btul bas lus ngag dul// mtshan bcas kyi spang bya rang sar dengs// bcos min gyi gnyen po rang gshis thal// ka des kyang byed chos gtor ba cig lags so// don des kyang bya rgyu ma rnyed pa lags so// mi gzhan pa mdo sde mnyan bshad byed// sprang pa nga rig pa'i gdar sha bcad// rtag chad dang yod med gnyis 'dzin stong*// don pha rol phyin par rang rgyud thal// ka des kyang byed chos ===// don des kyang bya rgyu ===// mi gzhan pa mngon pa'i sde snod bltar// sprang po nga snang sems rang rtsal sbyong*// phyi snod nang bcud rang 'tshang go /snang ba 'di rig pa'i cho 'phrul shar// ka des kyang ===// don des kyang ===// mi gzhan pa spang bya gnyen pos bsrung*// sprang po nga spang blang ri mo yal// mtshan ma'i sdom pas rang 'ching rgyu// rang rtsal gyi 'char sgo dgag sgrub bral// ka des kyang khrims sdom zhig pa cig lags so// don des kyang ===// mi gzhan pa sems can pha mar sgom// sprang po nga dgra gnyen gyi a 'thas zhig

/kun snyoms kyi shes pa chal le ba// bskyed bya dang skyed byed mtshan mas dor// ka des kyang sems bskyed ma grub pa lags so// don des kyang===// mi gzhan pa gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs bsgom// sprang po nga bskyed rdzogs mtshan mas sun// bya byed sprul bsgyur rdzun pa'i chos// stong gsal gyi rig pa 'pho 'gyur med// ka des kyang bskyed rdzogs ma sgoms pa lags so// don des kyang ===// mi gzhan pa rtsa rlung mngon shes sgrub// sprang po nga zhe 'dod kyi rtsol sems bral// 'khor 'das kyi rten 'brel mthong ba'i tshe// rtsol sems kyang rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu// ka des kyang brtson 'grus zhan pa cig lags so// don des kyang ===/ mi gzhan pa mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin byed// sprang po nga gang shar rgya yan skyongs// mnyam rjes su 'dzin pa rang sar grol// spangs thob kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ka des kyang gu yangs bgyid pa 'di dga'o// don des kyang rang yan smyon pa nga skyid do// zhes pa 'di stod lung bde chen gzhis kar mtha' dmag la dmigs pa'i sgrub pa zhig bgyis tshe// sa mo phag lo zla ba drug pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin bris pa'o/ ༈ zha)sems nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas/ ༈ yang smras pa// 'das pa'i rgyal ba ji snyed pa// rang rtog snga ma 'gags zin te// gsol ba 'debs yul 'debs byed bral// ma 'ongs rgyal ba ji snyed kun// slad kyi rtog tshogs 'char ba'i rgyu// lo bskal bgrang ba'i rtsis ma dgos// kun byed kun 'dzin da lta'i rig /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo ste// shes na 'di las gzhan gyur pa'i// ston chos 'khor gnas dus nyams len// gang yang ma dgos phu thag chod// sems nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas su bstan pa zhes bya ba ste pho tshod med pa'i nyams dga' lags so/ ༈ za)'dra chos nyer lnga/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ mtshan ldan bla ma rje btsun rnams la 'dud// sprang po'i rang snang gtad med yan pa'i tshe// rang gdangs lhug pa'i 'od la 'di ltar shar// mi lus rin chen lo 'bras smin legs 'dra// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po tshogs par go

/mi tshe yud tsam chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ da lta yod pa da lta med par go /dkar nag las 'bras rang grib rjes 'brang 'dra// skad cig yud tsam dor ba med par go /'khor ba'i gnas 'di btson khang sgo med 'dra// bde dang thar med khor yug yin par go /gnyen dang nye 'brel btson srung gshed ma 'dra// gzhan 'gro'i dbang med de ru 'khrid par go /sdug bsags zas nor bsha' lug sha khrag 'dra// rang la yod kyang gzhan gyis spyod par go /gzugs byad skye 'bras nam gzhug me tog 'dra// 'chi bdag ba mos skad cig yal bar go /de shes dam chos mi byed mig btsums 'dra// rang la gces med g.yang la mchong bar go /dam chos dran pa ri dwags khyis ded 'dra// 'di ltar dgongs na 'gal ba yod par go /rtsa ba'i bla ma srog gi rnam shes 'dra// de nyid spangs na mi ro gsor med go /brgyud pa'i bla ma kha zas btung ba 'dra// de la ma rten srog 'tsho med par go /'dren pa'i bla ma gnyan pa gru ldan 'dra// pha rol phyin pa de yis sgrol bar go /bla ma rnam gsum mgar gyi lag cha 'dra// gcig ma tshogs na shor ke 'byung bar go /des bstan dam chos shing rta'i 'khor lo 'dra// bslab bya rnam bzhi'i bgrod pas 'gro bar go /mchog gsum skyabs 'gro dmag gi go rtags 'dra// phyi nang khyad par 'di la ran par go /so sor thar sdom srang mda'i mtho dman 'dra// spang bya gar byung gnyen po dgos par go /byang chub sems mchog ma bzang bu skyong 'dra// rang bde spangs nas gzhan phan bya bar go /gsang sngags mchog ni rgyal po'i dkor mdzod 'dra// mdor len mi dgos gang mkho spyod par go /thams cad brgyud ldan lam mkhan rgyus yod 'dra// nye ring ji ltar bgrod tshul shes par go /so sor chog 'dzin sman pa shes chung 'dra// spang gnyen phra rags 'doms tshe rmongs par go /thos can 'ga' zhig gna' gtam 'chad mkhas 'dra// so sor ma 'dres kun nas 'thad par go

/de nyid bsam pa sman dug sbrul gso 'dra// gcig phan gcig gnod 'gal 'dum med par go /sgom pa 'ga' zhig sngon med zas zos 'dra// ming 'dogs med kyang de la sred par go /de tshe lam 'jug 'dod can nor mthong 'dra// re res smon yang re res dben par go /yengs yengs 'gro 'dod spre'u'i spyod pa 'dra// tshe 'di don med stong log byed par go /de ltar 'dra chos nyer lnga nyer mthong te// go tshul nyer lnga'i shar tshul 'di mthong bas// de tshe bdag nyid ci bya'i rtol ma rnyed// rang gis rang la rang gros 'dri ba la// rang rig bla ma des ni 'di skad lo// dal 'byor bsod nams stobs su go lags na// da re tsam min yang yang rnyed par dka'// tshe 'di chu sbur lta bur go lags na// rang gdangs bslu med 'char bas sdig la 'dzoms// 'khor ba btson khang lta bur go lags na// de las thar thabs dam pa'i chos las med// gnyen 'khor btson bsrung gshed mar go lags na// thog mar 'jig rten zhen pa'i 'phreng thag chod// zas nor sha khrag lta bur go lags na// sdug sogs ham pa jag chom rtsol sgrub shol// byad gzugs nam gzhug me tog 'drar go na// mtshar 'dod gces spras byi dor btang snyoms mdzod// chos med mig ldan g.yang mchong 'dra lags na// gzhan la ma blta rang la rang bsam thong*// chos dran ri dwags khyis ded go lags na// ci drag yin no mig rtsa hril gyi sgrims// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam shes 'drar go na// srog gi dngas ma yin no ma bskyur mdzod// brgyud pa'i bla ma zas skom 'drar mthong na// de las rten sa med do gces par gzung*// 'dren pa'i bla ma mnyan pa grur mthong na// srid mtsho 'di las sgrol ba med do kye// de lta'i gsum ldan bla ma ma rnyed na// rna thos bla ma'i khengs pas phung ngo bu// dam chos shing rta'i 'khor lo 'drar mthong na// thams cad dgos pa yin no blo yangs bskyed// mchog gsum mi 'bral skyabs su gsol ba ni// bstan pa'i dgos pa yin no ma nor mdzod// so so thar sdom spang gnyen dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems kyis rtsis bsgyur sdom par gsungs// de dang 'brel ba'i gsang sngags mchog gi lam// phyi nang gsang dang yang gsang de kho na'o// sdom pa'i gnad kyi sdom min sdom pa'i mchog

/gang 'khor spyod pa pha yi khyad chos yin// thams cad brgyud ldan lam mkhan 'drar mthong na// thams cad mkhyen pa zhes ni de la bya// phyogs 'dzin rmongs pa nga rgyal khengs rlom lta// des ni sdom gsum nyams len ji ltar nus// thos chos lde'u sgrung lta bur go ba dang*// bsam pa'i dug dang gnyen po'i sbrul gsor mtshungs// sgom pa'i nyams len ro zhen sred pa dang*// nyams len ma shes bya byed mang ba ni// nges don snying po rtogs 'dod ring ba ste// chus khyer skom gyi gdung bas nyen dang mtshungs// bsags rag rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa kun// bka' dang bstan bcos gdams ngag ji snyed las// thos pa'i chos rnams ma 'dres gzhi lam 'bras// legs par phyed pa thos pa'i dgos pa ste// bsams pas nang 'gal spong len med par gzhig /de nyid bsrangs gzhug sgom pa'i 'bras bur bcas// 'chug med sgrub la mkhas pa'i nyams len lugs// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can ljongs rnams kyis// skyes chen du ma'i rnam thar mdzad pa mchog /dbang rab cho ga rgyas pa dgos dang mtshungs// mchog tu 'gyur ro snying nas rjes yi rang*/ ༈ 'a)nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len/ ༈ na mo gu ru we// kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs// 'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs// dad dang ldan pa'i bu rnams la// thugs rje'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol// kye ma skal ldan skyes bu kun// rgyal ba'i bstan la rab mos shing*// thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs te// dal 'byor snying po blang 'dod la// gdams pa'i tshig 'di thugs la gsol// chags sdang spel ba'i pha yul dang*// shin tu g.yeng ba'i bdag 'dzin gnas/ rgyal bas smad pa spang bar bya// byin ldan bkra shis dben pa'i sa// bag gro khams dngas g.yeng ba chung*// gong mas bsngags pas bsten par bya// gnyen 'khor yon bdag dug lnga can// mang ngam yang na nyung yang rung*// gshed ma lta bur spang bar bya// de lta bu yi sgrub gnas su// sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po yis// sgo gsum snyoms las sgyid lug spang*// bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bsrang*// tho rangs dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing*// de nyid mi rtag 'chi ba dang*// las 'bras mi bslu'i rgyu 'bras bcas// pha ma sems can thams cad la// byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgom// de las skyes pa'i yi dam lha// rtsa 'khor gsal btab bla ma las// dbang blang dbyer med gtum mo yis// rnal 'byor gsal bas rtsol bcas dang*// rtsol med rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor 'bad// thun mtshams ngal gso rang nyams bskyang// nyi shar tshe sgrub bsrung 'khor sogs// mngon sum nyams len gnad dang bsre// thun bar snang cha'i ma 'gags rtsal// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ma gyur bar// sgyu ma rmi lam nyid du sbyangs// nyin gung ngag sgrigs chos spyod dang*// 'dus byas dge ba grub tshad kyis// khams bsang gti mug 'khri ba gcod// dgong kha rig pa dngas pa'i dus// skyo shas nges 'byung lcag gis brab// g.yeng spangs mtshan med gtso bor bya// srod dus rtsa gsum gsum lha tshogs la// gtor ma 'bul zhing bsnyen pa bya// rig rtsal sbyang zhing bsngo bar 'bad// nam gung 'od gsal rmi lam gyi// mtshan bcas mtshan med bzhag thabs bya// thum 'phras 'du shes ldan par nyal// thun mgo'i rim pa thams cad du// rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma la// g.yo med gsol btab rang la bstim// de ltar nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu// nyams len bya ba'i rim pa 'dams// sgo gsum 'chal par mi 'gyur zhing*// nyams len gdams pa'i bya lugs shes// zhes 'di lung rtogs kyis phyug pa'i// shākya'i mtshan can gyis bskul te// 'bri gung bya bral rat+na yis// snye mo phun tshogs rab brtan du// bris pas 'gro kun lam bgrod shog

༈ ya)bdag mo snye mo ba la gdams pa/ ༈ gnas rang bzhin chos dbyings pho brang nas// rje drin chen rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams// sprang bdag sogs gsol 'debs gang zag la// thugs brtse bas rjes gzung byin gyis rlobs// sngon bsags sbyangs smon pas mtshams sbyar te// gzhi mngon mtho'i rigs su nges 'khrungs shing*// chos theg pa chen po'i don rtogs pa'i// rten dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su gzung*// 'bangs kun gyis thod bzhin spyi bor bkur// dpal kun dga' rab brtan rgyal mo zhes// mtshan rjes mthun don dang ldan pa 'di// skal mchog tu gyur snyams kho bo sems// gtan zin med 'khor ba'i bya ba 'di// 'phral 'grub dka' phugs kyi gtad so chung*// tshe 'di phyir phan pa dam pa'i chos// sgos dus gsum spangs blang gang 'grub 'tshal// tshe yun thung 'tsho ba'i gnod pa mang*// lo 'di thub nges gdengs ma mchis pas// gnad gsang chen 'chi med rdo rje'i don// lam phyag chen zung 'jug ston kyang 'tshal// dus thun mtshams spyod lam thams cad du// yar bla ma dkon mchog mchod yul la// g.yo sgyu yi dri ma bral bas bsten// bar sdai rigs gnyen grogs thams cad la// yid spang gyur bzang po'i rgyun gyis 'tsho// mar 'khor 'bangs ltos pa'i sems can la// 'phral yun du bde ba'i thabs kyis bskyangs// ngo lkog du 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs kyi// mgo yan par mi btang thabs kyis 'dul// don skabs su bab pa phan pa'i gtam// lugs chos dang srid kyi dpal 'tsho'i gzhi// dpal mi pham rgyal mo nyid la 'bul// dge 'dis kyang 'gro kun bde la spyod// yongs sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ ༈ ra)bla ma mgon po rgya mtsho la gdams pa/ ༈ gang zhig snying po'i don la mngon phyogs shing*// yang dag sgrub pa'i lam brtson brtul zhugs bzang*// skal ldan skyes bu nā tha sā ga ras// snyan tshig bstod 'phreng skyes bzang rten bcas te// 'jig rten tshe 'di blo yis btang tshul dang*// mtshan ldan bla ma ji ltar bsten pa dang*// des gsungs gdams pa'i bcud kyi blangs thabs dang*// sdom gsum nyams len ji ltar bya tshul dang*// dben gnas ri khrod bas mtha' bsten tshul dang*// dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul ji lta bu// de nyid nyams len bya ba'i tshul lugs gang*// bar do'i gnas skabs ngos 'dzin bya lugs dang*// chos rnams kun gyi nang nas gang zab khyad// sangs rgyas ba la lam gyi myur bul gang*// de ltar don bcu'i mdor dril mdo don zhig

/smra bar bskul tshe rang blo'i spyod yul ltar// 'bri bar bya yis rigs na bsten par 'tshal// rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus 'di lon tshe// slu 'brid zang zing 'jig rten 'khri ba kun// gtan ma spongs na lam gyi rtsa ba 'phyug /de bas 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa bcad// shes rab snying rje ldan zhing tshe 'di la// ltos med gsum ldan bla ma khong snying ltar// gces par ma gzung srog med lus 'dra ba// sgo gsum gus pas dam tshig rtsa ba brtan// des gsungs bka' lung mdo rgyud man ngag gnad// rgyar nyan don bsams 'dres phye 'khrug bsres gces// so sor phye na chu snod mang rtog 'dra// don du 'khor ba'i gdung sel bdud rtsir gzung*// sdom gsum bstan rtsa yin te so thar lus// gsang sngags nyams len byang sems sems bskyed mchog /ya bral bza' btung gos kyi dpe 'dra bas// gang rung med kyang med du mi rung bstan// tha ma 'du 'dzi 'jig rten g.yeng ba'i gnas// dang po'i las can ting 'dzin 'phrog pa'i bdud// dper na tshong 'dus ltad mor yengs dang mtshungs// de bas dben gnas ri khrod bas mthar gnas// dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul ngo bos stong*// rang bzhin gsal ba skye 'gag 'char nub bral// dpe ni nam mkha' kun gyi go 'byed 'dra// snang stong zung 'jug lta ba'i gdeng chen gzung*// de nyid ngang las ma bcos dran pa'i gshis// bcing dang grol ba'i mtha' gnyis rab spangs kyang*// dpe ni rnga mong thag pas bcings grol 'dra// rang babs gtad med lhug pa'i bzhag thabs gces// de ltar nyams blangs 'od gsal chos sku 'char// skye 'dir rab grol dbang 'bring tha ma dor// 'od gsal ma bu zung 'jug chu 'dres ltar// de nyid ngang la rgyun gnas chos sku thob// chos rnams kun gyi nang nas gzhan phan mchog /'bad pa'i go cha brtson pa'i shugs ldan pa// chu bo'i rgyun ltar bar med rab ston pa'i// byang chub sems mchog zab pa'i snying po zung*// bskal mang rnyed dka'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab la// skabs su gang bab zab cing khyad par 'phags// 'du ba'i nad la sman gyis 'tsho ba 'dra// 'on kyang brtson ldan gsang sngags lam myur 'phags// de ltar dpe don gnad 'dril sho lo ka

/phyogs kyi grags ldan dag tu dril ba 'di// rgyal ba'i bstan zhugs sgrub pa'i ring lugs pa// gnyis med ye shes rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mchog /gang de'i yid kyi re ba skong ba'i phyir// ris med kun tu rgyu ba'i spyod pa can// 'bri gung bya bral sna tshogs rang grol ngas// chos sgra yangs pa can grwa chen po'i zhol du bris pa dge /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ ༈ la)rtogs ldan rdor dpal la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye// mtshan ldan bla ma

tshul bzhin bsten gyur cing*// 'jig rten bya ba'i chos kun ring dor nas// snying po sgrub pa'i lam la rab bzhugs pa'i// bya btang rnal 'byor rdo rje dpal 'bar gyis// shing lo'i btung ba bca' ba'i gza' bar bcas// 'phrin gyi ngag tshig ma nyams pho nyas 'byor// slad nas 'khor 'das 'khrul pa'i snang cha kun// rmi lam 'khrul 'khor 'dra ste yid ma gtan// bla ma lha dang zab lam gdams pa rnams// rang rig gdod ma'i mgon der sems thag chod// rang nyams rgya yan lhug pa'i gzhi rtsal kun// spang blang bya rtsol bral bar la yang zlos// re dogs bral ba'i lhun grub 'bras bu las// sgrub bya sgrub byed zhen pa'i 'phreng thag chod// ces pa'i rang nyams gang bde blo chod 'di// 'bri gung bya bral rat+nas bris pa dge/ sha)snye mo dar rgyas chos mdzad ma la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo ma hā gu ra we/ byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro'i sde// rtsa ba gsum la gus pas 'dud// da lta dus ngan snyigs ma 'di// lta ba grub mtha'i bye brag mang*// nyams len snying po'i gdams pa la'ang*// dbu ma pa dang phyag rgya che// rdzogs pa che zhes so sor zhen// rang rang rtog pa'i 'ching bas dkris// sprang po gtad med smyon pa ngas// bltas tshe rang 'khris grub mtha' rnams// dbyings chen ye klong la phyin na// dgongs don snying po ye ji bzhin// tshad du phyin par ma mthong ngo*// de yang phyogs mtha' kun bral gyi// ngo nas ltas na dbu mar go// 'phro gnas dran rig cir snang yang*// don las mi 'da' phyag rgya che// snang rig 'khor 'das chos sna tshogs// rig par 'dus pas rdzogs pa che// mnyam rjes med pa'i gdengs ldan na// lam dang dam tshig yongs su rdzogs// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// mi zad 'khor lo rang la rnyed// 'di ni rje btsun dam pa'i drin// mchod par 'bul lo gu ru rje// dgyes par mdzod cig mched grogs lcam// zhes pa 'di yang mkhar dar rgyas pa'i chos mdzad mas bskul ba las// snyoms las pa rat+nas gdams pa'o/

sa)khro phu lo tsā ba'i gdung rigs phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ skal ldan skyes bu dal dang 'byor ldan pas// smin grol lam zhugs gsang sngags theg pa la// nyams su len tshul rang gzhung ji bzhin du// mdo don dril ba'i snying po 'di lta ste// bdag gzhan gzugs snang sgyu lus lha yi sku// sgrar grags sna tshogs dbyangs gsal sngags kyi sgra// dran rig 'khor 'das chos tshul ye shes dbyings// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khaur lhun grub la// bcos bslad dgag sgrub bral bas phyag rgya che// phyogs dang ris su ma chad dbu ma'i don// chos kun ma lus gsal bas rdzogs pa che// tha snyad tshig brjod bral ba lta ba'i rgyal// dmigs gtad mtshan ma spangs pa sgom pa'i rgyun// spang blang re dogs med pa spyod pa mchog /sku dang ye shes mthar phyin rang rdzogs 'bras// mthar phyin ye shes snying po 'di nyid las// kho baus ma rnyed de bas shes ldan kun// tshul 'dir mos na lam 'dir 'jug par 'tshal// dge des 'khor 'das mnyam yangs lhun rdzogs shog /ces pa 'di yang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ 'bri gung rat+na'i ming can gyis gdams pa'o/ ha)stod lung snang rtse pa la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ra we/ dkon mchog rin chen ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gtso// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// rje btsun rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud// da lta'i dus dang bstan pa'i snyigs ma 'dir// rgyal ba'i thugs rjes dbri bkol mi mnga' yang*// chos pa rnams ni chags sdang nga che 'gran// lung gi chos rnams brag cha lta bur gyur// rtogs pa'i chos kun kha lta 'ud shob gcod// thos bsam sgrub pa'i bya ba ring du bor// rang spyod logs pas rgyal ba'i thugs rgyang bsrings// ma bslabs shes dang ma sgrubs grub pa yi// 'bras bu thob 'dod chos ni rang bzor ston// rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag tshogs// kun dang mi mthun chos logs rnam smin mthus// 'di dang phyi mar sdug bsngal duḥkha spyod// de ltar spyod pa'i rnam smin rang las su// sems par mi byed dkon mchog chos srung la// yus med 'khangs kyi lta ba log pa yis// bslab bya'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad// de 'dra'i chos pa 'khor ba'i gting rdo rnams// thugs rje gzung zhig rje btsun snying rje'i stobs// dal 'byor lus ldan sa chen skyong ba yi// 'jig rten dbang 'byor sde 'bangs bcas pa yang*// ya rabs gong ma'i spyod la mi 'gran par// da dus rang bas mtho la phrag dog cing*// bar pa la ni chags sdang bsam ngan sgom// 'og ma dag ni btsan 'phrog dbang du byed// mchod yul bla ma dkon mchog rgyang du bsring*// thar lam sangs rgyas bstan la ris su 'byed// sbyin gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bran khol bkol// dben gnas chos grwa 'joms shing dkor rnams 'phrog

/khrel gzhung ngo tsha bor nas khrel med spyod// 'bangs rnams rje yis blo gtad mi thub cing*// 'og 'bru g.yo khram ngan sbyor rgyal khrims dbrol// gcig gis gcig 'joms bsam ngan khor yug sgom// 'di 'dra'i dus ngan rje blon 'bangs rnams la// thugs rjes gzung zhig rje btsun smra ba'i rgyal// khyad par gsang sngags bstan la mos tshul can// bsag sbyang bsags pas dben pa'i nyams chung bdag /'du 'dzi spang bar 'dod kyang g.yeng ba'i ngang*// rang yul spang bar 'dod kyang gzhan dbang btsan// yun du gzhi gcig gnas na chags sdang rgyu// dam chos sgrub la brtson tshe gzhan don tshul// sgo gsum tha mal dbang gyur bdag 'dra la// brtse bas gzigs shig gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// byin gyis rlobs zhig rje btsun dam pa rnams// de ltar kun spyod mthong zhing bdag nyid la'ang*// zhe blo gting nas ma bde'i bya bral la// thugs la phan pa'i gdams pa ma mchis kyang*// bskul zhes gsungs pas ji ltar phul don 'dir// mkhyen yangs can gyis legs par spyod 'tshal te// ji ltar srog 'phrog bi sha nag po ni// lus can phal gyi srog la bar gcod kyang*// ngo ma shes na spang byar mi 'gyur ltar// 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag chos tshul la// blang dor sgron me'i spyan gyis dri spang zhing*// lugs gnyis dam pa'i spyod pa rnam dag dang*// phyogs lhung mthar 'dzin bral ba'i sgom pa mchog /zung 'jug mnyam yangs rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*// nam du'ang mi 'bral thugs kyi dpal be'ur bcangs// bdag gzhan don bzang 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pa 'di yang bya bral rat+na yis// spro lung pho brang rtse nas bris pa dge/ ༈ a)legs drug dang tshigs gsum gnad dril/ ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kye ma dal 'byor rnyed pa'i dus// sangs rgyas bstan la zhugs na legs// mi rtag snying rje byang sems la// nges shes gting nas skyes na legs// so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi// sdom pa dam tshig bsrungs na legs// lus ni snang stong lha sku la// sgrar grag sngags su shes na legs// sems ni rig stong chos kyi sku// yengs med grub mtha' snyogs pa legs// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa la// 'khor gsum bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs legs// legs pa drug gi bstan bcos 'di// bya bral rat+na'i ming 'dzin pas// glog la mun pa'i gsal 'debs lags// yang smras pa/

spros med gnad kyi nyams len ni// ye nas ma bcos phyag rgya che// phyogs lhung bral ba dbu ma'i lam// 'khor 'das mi gnas rdzogs pa che// tshig gsum gnad dril snying phur 'di// mched grogs dam pa'i thugs dam 'tshal/ zhes pa 'di ni sbas yul 'bras mo bshongs la 'gro ba'i rig 'dzin chen po'i phyag phyi ba bya bral kun bzang rgya mtshos bskul ba la/ rat+na'i ming can gyis gdams pa'o/ ki)'phyong rgyas pa tshe dbang phun tshogs la gdams pa/ ༈ rje btsun drin che rtsa rgyud bla ma// sprang po bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug rum// 'bral med rtag par rgyan du bzhugs te// bdag sogs 'gro kun thugs rjes gzung zhig /gsan dang mched grogs dam ldan khyed kyis// nan gyis bskul bas rang skyon sbas nas// dad ldan khyed la gnad du gdams so// dam pa rje gcig mtshan ldan bla ma// mnyam du 'grogs pa'i dus skabs de ru// lung rtogs chos kyi sgro 'dogs chod cig /phyis nas 'gyod tshe 'phyis par gda' 'o// mthun rkyen dang bcas chos mthun 'grogs tshe// thos bsam sgom la nyams len 'bod cig /le lo snyoms las bar chad bdud do// bstan rtsa dam chos so sor thar pa// ji ltar bshad bzhin rtags tshul gzung zhig /rtsing hral spyod pa bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren// rang 'dod spangs pa'i dgra gnyen ris med// byang chub sems dpa'i thugs skyed sbyongs shig /rang 'dod zhen pas 'khor bar 'ching ngo*// gsang sngags nyams len bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug /bla mas gang bstan skabs su phog pas// ji ltar bstan zhing nyams su longs shig /mthar thug lta ba bzang ngan med pas// ltar med lta ba'i rgyal sa gzung la// grub mtha' kun la bzang ngan spongs shig /gang shar 'dzin med sgom pa 'di la// grims lhod med pa'i rang 'gros
