skyongs la// 'grus bsgril had lhod 'di yis phung ngo*// nam zhig 'khor 'das rdzun phugs brdib tshe// bza' gtad med pa'i spyod pa 'char te// blang dor bral ba'i spyod pa yin no// 'di yin 'dzin bral rang gzhi zin pas// 'khor dang myang 'das dmigs su med pa'i// rgyal ba kun bzang rdo rje 'chang 'gyur// 'di ltar bstan bzhin g.yo med gzung na// rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus kun 'chang*// rang gzhan dge legs rgyal ba'i gdung tshob// 'brel tshad don ldan rnal 'byor lags so// dge 'dis bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus// phyams cig sangs rgyas myur 'grub gyur cig

/ces 'phyong rgyas ring mo la gdams pa'o/ khi)mtshams mal bcad rgya'i dus bla ma gtsang pa la gdams pa/ ༈ e ma ho/ chos byed dang gnyen med nad pa gsum// 'di gsum zaug po nga'i mched grogs yin// mched grogs 'di gsum la dgyes na zla la bzhugs// dpe cha dang lha rten mchod cha gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i skam spyad yin// skam spyad 'di gsum gyi mi brel na zla la bzhugs// mi rgan dang rta rgan khyi rgan gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i gso rgyu yin// gso rgyu 'di gsum gyi mi g.yeng na zla la bzhugs// gang bde dang gang byung drin yod gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i dgra bo yin// dgra bo 'di gsum la mi 'jigs na zla la bzhugs// cha med dang rgyus med gar sleb gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i pha yul yin// pha yul 'di gsum gyis chog na zla la bzhugs// dad can dang dam can zol med gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i gnyen grogs yin// gnyen grogs 'di gsum gyis chog na zla la bzhugs// gang byung dang gang dran gang bde gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i spyod pa yin// spyod pa 'di gsum gyi mi lad na zla la bzhugs// gtad med dang thun med byar med gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i sgom pa yin// sgom pa 'di 'dra la mos na zla la bzhugs// mnyam yangs dang lhun grub khyab gdal gsum// 'di gsum zog po nga'i lta ba yin// lta ba 'di 'dra yis chog na zla la bzhugs// he he 'di 'dra zhig byon byung zhes sam+bho ṭa'i ngos la bris nas bug sgor bsrings pa'o/ gi)bya gtang 'brug smyon la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ 'di phyir mi bslu 'dren pa rje// blo phugs o rgyan pad+mar gtod// kun dang mi 'gal nyams len mchog /lus ngag yid gsum chos dang bstun// thos bsam byas pa'i snying po de// sgrub pa nyams len mchog la dril// chu rgyun rnal 'byaur ma goms bar// chags sdang dug lngar 'bur 'joms gcais// spang blang re dogs dang bral ba'i// ngang gnas mnyam gzhag gtso bor 'don// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dges// srid gsum byang chub thob phyir bsngo// zhes bya btang o rgyan dpal 'byor la'o/

ngi)dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i don de bzhin nyid kyi gtam glur brjod pa/ ༈ na mas+sa man+t+ra bha dra ya/ e ma ho/ rang rig stong gdangs 'gag med kun tu bzang*// don dam 'gyur med ka dag kun bzang mo// gdod nas zung 'jug 'bral med lhan cig skyes// rang rig rje btsun pad+ma ka rar 'dud// dus mtha'i zog po sna tshogs rang grol nga*// rtsa gsum byin rlabs snying gi dbus su sad// dam chos rdzogs chen zab don kho na shar// da ni bya rtsol 'das pa zab mo'i don// phyogs tsam bshad kyi lam 'dir gus dag gsan// rang rig snying po ka nas dag pa ru// gdod nas gnas pas logs su sbyang ma dgos// nyon mongs spong bsgyur byed pa'i do zla min// rang rig ye shes gting gsal 'gag med du// ye nas gsal bas gzhan nas sgrub ma dgos// lha sngags ting 'dzin sgom pa'i do zla min// rang rig ming 'dogs bral ba'i brjod med du// ye nas bzhugs pas brtag dpyad bya ma dgos// lta ba dgag sgrub byed pa'i do zla min// rang rig bde gshegs sku lngar ye rdzogs su// dus kun gnas pas yid byed sgom ma dgos// sgom pa thun 'jog byed pa'i do zla min// rang rig bcos bslad bral ba'i gshis spyod las// dus kun mi 'da' blang dor bya ma dgos// tshul 'chos tho co byed pa'i do zla min// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i byed chos kun// rang rig rdzogs chen thig le nyag gcig tu// rtogs pa'i don las mi 'da' dam tshig rdzogs// rdo rje snying po don dam bde ba'i sku// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid sgyu ma che// kho bo cag gis ngo bo'i gsang 'di rnyed// da ni bya rtsol zad pas sos re dal// lus kyi spyod pa 'khrul 'khor bde ba'i gar// ngag gi smra tshig grags stong rdo rje'i glu// sems kyi rtog tshogs ting 'dzin rol pa'i 'phrul// gu yangs khyab gdal chen por ngang gis spyod// ces pa 'di yang stod lung snang rtse ba nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis bskul ba las/

bya bral ba rat+nas rdzogs pa chen po sems sde klong sde man ngag gi sde ste rang rig chig rdzogs su bstan pa'i don las brtsams te/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung gi bla brang khang gsar yang dgon 'og min du bris pa'o/ ci)yar stod chos mdzad rin chen nyi ma la gdams pa/ ༈ rje btsun mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma// yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs pad mchog la// sprang po mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis// lan gcig min par dus kun 'dud do// sngon gyi las 'phro smon lam dbang gis// dal dang 'byor pa'i chos kyis phyug cing*// sangs rgyas bstan las snying po'i don la// yang dag mos pa'i shugs dang rab ldan// gzhon nu rab byung bslab gsum rgyan spras// chos mdzad rin chen nyi ma gang gis// da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir// grub pa mchog gi bstan pa'i lam bzang*// nyams su len pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don// mthar thug 'bras bu'i sa lam bgrod tshul// nyams myong gdams pa yi ger bkod pa'i// tshigs su bcad pa dgos zhes gsung la// chos ltar bcos pa'i rnam g.yeng dbang gis// cung zad 'gyangs pa bzod par mdzod cig /gsan dang chos mdzad rat+na surma// da dus bsags chung snyigs ma'i dus 'dir// bdag gzhan bzang ngan rkyen gyis bskul ba'i// chos sgor 'jug pa mang bar 'dug kyang*// skyid sdug theg pa'i chos pa dkon mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// mtho dman skyid sdug ji ltar byung yang*// re dogs spang blang ro snyoms 'tshal lo// gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga' zhig /thos chung tshig res chog par gzung ste// phyogs re'i grub mthar rang gzhan kun sbyor// zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam la sgrib mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las// rgyud 'grel gzhung lugs thos rgya bskyaid cig /gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga' zhig

/da lta'i chos spyod 'ga' zhig gis ni// thos don bsam pas gzhig par bya rgyu// lo 'dod grongs rtsis chos brgyad sgrub las// bsam don rgyu rgyud ??la sbyor ba dkon mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// sde snod rgyud bzhi'i man ngag mnyan bshad// nang 'gal spong len med par gnad gzung*// gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga' zhig /da dus chos spyod rlom pa 'ga' ni// thos bsam sgom pa'i lam la gnas kyang*// nga mkhas nga grub chags sdang 'di las// nyon mongs 'dul ba'i chos pa dkon mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// chags sdang gdug pa'i dug chen gnyen por// dam chos bdud rtsi bsten par mdzod cig /gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da lta'i rtogs ldan ming btags kha cig /gtad med lta ba'i gdengs ldan med par// kha lta skam po'i tshig phyir 'breng te// rang gi nyams myong go yul la byed// nyams myong yang dag lta bas dben mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// phyogs su lhung dang ris su phye ba'i// khas len bral ba'i lta ba gces so// gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da lta'i rtogs ldan bzhed pa 'ga' zhig /sgrub long med par grub pa thob 'dod// lo zla zhag gi grangs yus cher byed// sgom pa'i rnal 'byaur lhur len dkon mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// mthong thos glo bur brtson pa spangs te// chu bo'i rgyun ltar sgrub la 'bungs shig /gsan dang da dus chaus sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da dus sgom chen 'ga' zhig gis ni// bde gsal mi rtog nyams la zhen te// snang med 'od gsal mchog gi myong bar// yid gnyis the tshom dra bas bcings mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// skyon med ming rtags ting 'dzin gsum la'ang*// chags sdang 'dzin pa'i spang blang dor cig /gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da dus bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gang dag

/rgyu 'bras stong pa nyid la zhugs tshe// gzhi lam 'bras bu stong lta had pos// rten 'brel rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// chos dbyings rang bzhin stong pa'i gzhi las// lhun grub rang shar rang 'gros bskyang 'tshal// gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da dus rnal 'byor spyod pa 'ga' zhig /nyams kyi dran rtsi brtsis gdab bral yang*// myong ba'i ro la mchog 'dzin dri mas// dri med ye shes sku mchog sgrib mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// nyams myong rtogs tsam rtogs pa'i 'dzin pa// brjed med zang thal chen por la zlos// gsan dang da dus chos sgor zhugs pa 'ga'// da dus chos ltar spyod pa la la// sdom gsum khrims kyi spyod la gnas rgyu// don g.yel tshul chos byi la'i spyod pas// rang gzhan kun gyi mgo bo bskor mthong*// de bas mched grogs dam pa khyed ni// ngo lkog med pa'i rang sems dpang tshugs// dam pa'i chos la gnas par mdzod cig /gsan dang chos mdzad rat+na surma// de ltar 'khrul med lta sgom spyod pa// rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis gshegs shul// lam zab la ni rab 'bad goms pas// gnas skabs lam du gegs sel bogs thon// nyon mongs kun sangs ye shes yongs rgyas// sku lnga'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir 'grub pa// rdo rje theg pa'i gsang chen gnad do// gang zhig dngas pa'i me long ngos la// bzhin ras bstan pas dri ma'i skyon mthong*// de dag 'bad pas byi daur la brtson// de bzhin gzhan skyon dri ma mthong tshe// rang rgyud bag chags rgyun la goms pas// sgo gsum nyes pas sgribs so 'tshal lo// de spangs gnyen po'i me long 'di gsung*// gang gi blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkhar// rnam dpyod lang tsho mchog gi dkyil 'khor// lung rtogs tsha zer 'od zer 'phro ba'i// rin chen chos kyi nyi ma gang la// gsal byed tshul du 'di ni springs so// dge bas 'gro kun gnyis med ye shes// sgrib med chos sku 'grub par gyur cig

chi)kun bsam la gdams pa/ ༈ rang rig mtha' bral 'dus ma byas// bcos bslad bral ba'i de bzhin nyid// brjod med bsam 'das bde ba che// lta ba'i phugs su gting thag chod// ye shes mtshan ma'i dri ma bral// blos byas thun sgom dran 'dzin ster// mnyam rjes zung 'jug yangs pa che// sgom pa'i chos su gdams par bzung*// re dogs spangs blang dgag sgrub zhi// tshul 'chos dran gzhig bya byed bor// bcos med lhug pa rang babs bu// spyod pa'i rgyun la gnas par 'tshal// /cais pa lta sgom spyod pa'i tshul// chen gsum 'dzin pa las 'das 'di// rnal 'byor kun dga' bsam gtan gyis// bskul te bris bzhin mngon gyur cig ༈ ji)stod lung snang rtse ba la gdams pa/ ka nas ???dag pa'i chos sku dri ma med/ kha dog cir yang 'char ba'i longs spyod rdzogs// ga zha'i skyon bral 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku// nga bdag 'joms mdzad ngo bo nyid skur 'dud// ca cor smra ba'i khams gsum 'khor ba pa// cha lugs rgyan gyi bye brag sna tshogs dang*// ja chang 'dod yon ro la sred pa kun// nya mo lcags kyus zin 'dra ma shes sam// ta la'i nags sogs dben pa'i ri khrod du// tha dad g.yeng ba'i 'du 'dzi ring dor te// da lta sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas dus 'dir// na tsha khyad bsad dam chos sgrubs na legs// pa sangs lta bur dkar ba'i dge tshogs bskrun// pha rol sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i sdig pa spongs// ba mo nyi bzhin gnyen po'i dpung bskyed la// ma lus 'gro ba'i don du smon lam thob// tsa ri tra sogs byin can gnas mchog tu// tsha grang khyad bsad snying po'i don bsgoms na// dza yan+tu zhes sngags pa brjod byed cing*// wa skyes lta bu'i bdud rigs zil gyis gnon// zha la'i ngos su bris pa'i lha mchod na// za byed 'jigs sgrol myang 'das 'god ce na// 'a cag kun sems bde gshegs snying po 'di// ya mtshan 'bral med rang zhal lta ba mchog

/ra bar 'khor ba'i rigs drug sems can kun// la la tsam zhig thar bar nye na yang*// sha ba ri ltar brtul zhugs mi 'grub pa// sa phyogs nga bdag chags chen 'ching bas nongs// ha ha'i gad rgyangs yi ge'i phyi mo las// a hi zag med bde chen lam mtshon pa'i// gsal byed mchog 'di sna tshogs rang grol gyis// tsa ma rī'i gnas nas bris pa dge/ nyi)lugs ldog yi ge'i phyi mo/ ༈ a la la ngo mtshar gshis kyi rtsal// ha ha 'khor 'das 'di lta mor che// sa lam spang gnyen gyi ci zhig bya// sha za sangs rgyas kyi bzang ngan stor// la dor lam stong gi nyams len rdzun// ra ba dra gur gyi bsrung mtshams ci// ya rabs ma rabs kyi spyod pa gang*// 'a 'bu yi snang ngor mnyam pa nyid// za 'dre phung shig la ci phyir mdzangs// zha chos kyi phan dang gnod pa gang*// wa dmar gyi khong sran sdug bsngal rgyu// dza lang dang mdzes tshul bcos ma'i spyod// tsha zer gyi reg pa'i ba mo 'dra// tsa na ka'i 'bru tsam snying pos dben// ma lus kyi snang srid rang rtsal gong*// ba lang gi khyu 'dra'i tshogs rnams kun// pha ma'i ngo bor thams cad mnyam// pa sangs ltar dkar ba'i bde gshegs snying*// na ba dang tsha med rig pa'i gshis// da lta'i rig gshis 'di ka las// tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs du ma ni// ta ra'i grangs kyi rnyed par dka'// nya gang gi mdangs 'dra stong gsal mdangs// ja la yi 'gros ltar kun bskor yang*// cha mthun gyi dbyibs tsam shes dka' bas// ca re nyal 'khor 'das mthong bar 'gyur// nga nyid kyis rtsol grub sgom spangs shing*// ga lu'i mdzes tshul ma bgyis kyang*// kha dog ma sgribs rang ngo 'di// ka dag gi ngang du rang rtsal rdzogs/ lugs bzlog gi yi ge'i phyi mo la// sbyar ba'i col chung las sla 'di// skya min dang ser min rat+na ngas// dben gnas 'brong ngur du sbyar ba dge ti)rang gshis rnyog med/ a hūm̐ phaṭa/

steng mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum na// rje mnyam med bla ma bzhugs so skad// bar dag pa mkha' spyod gzhal yas na// mchog gsum dang sku yi dkyil 'khor lha// phyogs rab 'byams dur khrod gnas rnams su// rigs drug gi srid 'khor gnas so skad// don rang sems stong pa'i dkyil 'khor na// gdangs kun gsal snang srid snyan gson cig /chos med kyi sprang po rat+na nga*// mi rnams kyang skya min ser min zer// nga rang yang skya min ser min snyam// skya min ser min gyi glu zhig len// skya min de 'khor ba'i khyu nas don// ser min de myang 'das kyi khyu nas don// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings// byed spyod kyi 'khrul snang 'gag med kyi rtsal// snang stong dbyer med gyi ngo bor rtogs// duḥkha'i 'khor bar 'jigs ma dgos// a mthas 'dzin can dang nga ma mtshungs// don de phyir 'khor ba'i khyu nas don// sngon rang ngo ma shes myang 'das bsgrubs// bya rtsol sgrub blo'i ra bar tshud// sdom gsum gyi sgrog gis rab tu bcings// da don brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// sprang rang gshis don dam bden pa'i mthus// dus 'dir ni rten 'brel mngon sum snang*// gzhi rang bzhin ka dag ming bral dang*// gdangs kun gsal 'khor ba myang 'das gnyis// don dbyer med zung 'jug ro gcig shar// rtsal snang srid sprul pa'i zhing khams la// gzhi so sor thar sdom bsrung sdom 'bul// sgo ma 'gags longs sku'i dkyil 'khor la// lam rtsol sems can gyi sems bskyed 'bul// dbyings rang bzhin stong pa'i chos sku la// gnad gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs dam tshig 'bul// sprang de ltar ser mo'i khyu nas don// khyu don gyi ngang 'dir rang byung gshis// rang gshis 'di rnyog med chos kyi sku// brjod med du gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs su snang ba sprul pa'i sku// gzung 'dzin gyi rtog tshogs phar 'bul bas// bde chen gyi dkyil 'khor rang la rdzogs// 'bul ba yang 'di las bzang ba med// gnang byin yang 'di las bzang ba med// phyis 'byung gi khyu bud thams cad kun// 'di ltar du shes na 'di bzhin dgongs// ji ltar du byas kyang gtad med po// gang ltar du byas kyang chal ma chol// rang gshis kyi rang 'gros bde mor gda'// khyed bde bar 'dod pa kun de ltar mdzod// tshig phyi la ma 'breng don phur thob// don phur gyi snying gzer cig thebs pa na// tshig kha nas ma brjod rang gshis 'char// rang shar gyi ngo bo ni rang 'gros bskyong*// rang 'gros la gnyen po bya rgyu med/

khong rang gi rnam pa khong rang klong*// zung 'jug gi gnad cig de ru gda'// zhes pa 'di yang lag dal kha 'jams su bris so dge'o/ thi)gzhis ka khri khang rtser rang la bskul ba/ ༈ kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// 'khor ba'i bya brel blo yis dor te// dam pa'i chos las gzhan mi sems rgyu// da dung 'jig rten bya ba'i tshul la// rtog 'jug g.yeng ba'i che lugs 'di yis// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung nyen gda'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// gnyen bshes gdung ba'i chags sdang spangs te// mtshan ldan rje la gsol ba gdab rgyu// da dung dgra gnyen 'dzin pa 'di la// sangs med tsher ma'i rtsub lugs 'di yis// byin rlabs dngos grub yal nyen gda'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu'i rtsa ba// bsrung med bsrung ba'i dam sdom 'dzin rgyu// bzang 'dod tshul 'chos mdzes spyod 'di yis// rang gis rang nyid bcings nyen gda' 'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// lta ba rtogs par ma ldan bar du// thum 'phras tsam las gti mug spangs te// sgo gsum dge sbyor bsrangs su gzhug rgyu// nyin mtshan 'khor ma'i gnyis rgyun 'di yis// gdams pa'i nyams len ster nyen 'da'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// gang byung bgo ba stan dang bcas te// yon tan kun 'byung lus gnad bca' rgyu// nyal snyes kha sbub 'gro 'dug mang 'dis// lto 'gro rkang mangs sgrub nyen gda' 'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// cal col mang po'i smra ba bcad de// snying po sngags kyi nges gsang sgrub rgyu// nyes gzhi skyed pa'i long gtam mang 'dis// brjod bral snying po stor nyen gda'o// kho de sprang po sna tshogs rang grol// yid byed 'dzin pa'i re dogs bral te// rig pa mchog gi dbyings su lta rgyu// mig btsums 'og 'gyu'i 'phreng ba 'di yis// rnyog bral ting 'dzin sgrib gnyen gda'o/

di)yang snang rtse ba la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru we/ bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la// rab gus dang bas spyi bos 'dud do// 'khrul pa'i nga bdag 'ching ba grol te// rang byung sangs rgyas mngon du gyur cig /rigs rus cho 'brang dpal gyis brjid cing*// snying po'i bstan la mos pa'i stobs 'chang*// mnga' 'bangs 'gro la lhag par brtse ldan// mi bdag nam mkha'i mtshan can gang gis// khams gsum 'khor las yongs su 'da' zhing*// mdo dang rgyud sde'i snying po bsdus pa'i// nges gsang spros med ye nas ji bzhin// ma sgribs gsal bar mngon du ston pa'i// rang nyams gang shar glu ru long zhes// gsung gi gdangs snyan rgyang nas gsal lo// kho bo skyes sbyangs gu ṇa ma mchis// sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs go cha zhan pas// nyams rtogs mgur ma'i spobs pas dben kyang*// mtshan ldan rje rnams bka' yi drin las// go yul cung zad bsdus te 'bul lo// skyes chen 'ga' zhig 'khor bas skyo na// nyon mongs lnga yi zhen chags rgyu 'tshal// bstan pa'i gzhi ma so sor thar sdom// lam rnams kun gyi gzhi mar 'dzin 'tshal// byang sems gzhan don mchog gi bslab bya// nyams len kun gyi rgyal po gzung 'tshal// gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs snying po'i dam tshig /khong gi snying ltar rtsa bar bgyid 'tshal// byin rlabs kun 'byung dpal ldan bla mar// yengs med rgyun du gsol ba gdab 'tshal// dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha la// rdo rje gsum gyi sgyu rtsal sbyang 'tshal// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro chos skyong*// mchod cing bstod la 'phrin las bcol 'tshal// bskyed rim lha yi sku ru sgom tshe// chu zla bzhin du snang stong 'tshal lo// sgrar grags sngags kyi sgra tshogs ji snyed// brag cha lta bur grag stong 'tshal lo// rtog 'dzin yid kyi 'gyu tshogs ji snyed// chu sbur lta bur rig stong 'tshal lo// gzhi dngos ngo bo nyid nas dag pas// lam du sgrib byed glo bur lags so// bla ma'i gdams ngag gnad du thebs pas// 'bras bu dri med zangs thal brnyes so// de ltar rtogs na 'khor dang myang 'das// kho las mi 'da' phyag chen lags so// phyogs dang mtha' 'dzin phyogs lhung bral bas// dmigs bral spyod 'das dbu ma lags so// 'khor dang myang 'das chos kun rdzogs pas// rdzogs chen bya bral mthar phyin lags so// rang bzhin stong pa'i chos dbyings brnyes pa// chos kyi sku yi rang don 'grub bo// ma 'gags rtsal snang spang blang bral bas// gzugs sku gnyis kyis gzhan don byed do// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las// mi zad 'khor lo'i 'bras bu brnyes so// de ltar rje btsun bla ma'i drin las// rnyed pa'i rin chen nor bu'i 'phreng ba// rang gzhan kun la phan bde'i 'bras stsol// mdzes pa'i gtsug rgyan lan tshar 'di ni// rab brtse'i yid kyis ring nas springs so// dge bas rang gzhan 'gro ba ma lus// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur 'grub gyur cig

/ces pa'i lam rim gnad 'gag du dril ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni skyes sbyangs kyi ba rag rangs rab tu sad par gyur pa/ nam mkha' tshe brtan gyis bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa bya bral ba sna tshogs rang grol gyis dbu ru ka tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa'o/

༈ ni)yi ge'i phyi mo spro lung du sbyar ba/ ༈ e ma ho a la la ho/ ka nas dag pa'i chos sku'i gnas lugs ni/ kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du'ang ma grub pas// ga nas bltas kyang brjod dang bral ba 'di// nga yi chos sku lags sam kun la yod// ca co sgrog pa'i tshig gi sgra tshogs dang*// cha lugs rnam par 'gyur ba ci bstan yang*// ja chang bza' btung longs spyod g.yeng bsten kyang*// nya rgyas zla ltar bri gang med 'di mtshar// ta thā ga ta'i bde gshegs thugs rgyud dang*// tha dad ces pa'i sems can khams rgyud la// da ni don du dbye ba mi gda' na// na tsha sdug bsngal cho 'phrul min nam ci// pa wa sangs ltar dkar ba'i dge sems dang*// pha rol zhe la brnag pa'i gdug sems gnyis// ba gzhon lta bur ngo bo dbyer med ni// ma lus nges pa'i gsang 'di rtogs sam kye// tsa ma ri phyogs gnas pa'i gdong lnga dag /tsha hrags 'khor 'bangs dpung dang mi ldan kyang*// dza lang bcos bslad bral ba'i rang 'gros 'di// wa skyes zil gyis mnon pa'i seng ge 'dra// zhwa mo lta bur spyi bor khur tshul dang*// za 'dod wa spyang lta bu'i 'jab 'gros 'di// 'a 'bus ji ltar gzab kyang 'grub dka' bas// ya rabs sgrigs ma rnams kyis bka' ma skyon// ra ltar drung 'dir 'khod pa'i dad 'dus rnams// la 'phrang bgrod pa'i yus chen ma mdzad cig /sha za lta bur zas snang ma che bar// sa steng 'di na smra ba'i thugs dam mdzod// ha le ho ler bris pa'i yi ge la// a ka kha'i 'phya lad ma mdzad cig /nyams dga'i tshigs bcad yi ge'i phyi mo 'di// gtad med nam mkha'i dbyings su e waṃ rgyaḥ ༈ pi)rtogs brjod kyi gtam/ ༈ na mo gu ru// bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun bla ma rnams// mi 'bral bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du gsal// kye ma 'dir ni rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam// don du 'gal ba mchis na bzod par gsol// 'khor 'das gang du'ang mi gnas kun gyi gzhi// don dam ma bcos 'gyur med rig pa'i dngos// ma yengs mi 'da'i lam la goms pa na// sprang po bdag gi nyams su 'di ltar shar// stong gsal 'gag med rig pa'i rgyal po 'di// mtha' dang dbus med phyogs 'dzin kun dang bral// ma phye mi 'byed 'byed sa med pa'i dngos// gdod nas rnam dag don la 'dus ma byas// chos sku zang thal lta ba'i don 'di la// lta byed bral ba'i rang rig rgyal sa zin// da ni 'khor 'das spro 'am rang dbang chod// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin sgom lam 'di// ming du btags nas ci yang mi 'gal la// nga yis 'dzin na brjod pa'i yul 'das pas// zab gsal ye shes rdo rje dri ma med// ming du btags na snang grags stong zung 'jug

/ngang la nam yang mi 'da' sgom nyams tsam// rgyu dus sems can 'bras dus sangs rgyas zhes// mkhas rnams rab tu dbye ba mang mthong yang*// kho bo'i ngo la bde gshegs snying po las// bsgoms pas khyad par bzang du ma mthong bar// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sprin can sprin med ltar// bsgribs dang sgrib bral tshul 'di snang ba tsam// don du 'gyur med rang rig bde ba che// sku gsum dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la rdzogs// 'bras bu logs su mi 'tshol gdeng ldan yin// zhes pa 'di yang rnam dpyod ldan pa gang*// spro ba bskyed phyir kha lta'i ri mo 'di// 'bri gung sa yi cha nas bris pa dge ༈ phi)bla ma la bstod pa shākya gdams pa/ ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i// drin chen rtsa rgyud bla ma la// sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis 'dud// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// mnyam med shākya'i bstan pa la// yang zab rdo rje theg pa'i chos// rgyud don gdams pa'i bcud 'dus pa// skal ldan don du snang ba las// yang snying bka' gter gdams pa yis// smin cing grol ba'i skyes can zhabs// gang gi zhabs pad rab bzung nas// snying po'i lam bzang la zhugs te// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i don brtson pa// shākya'i mtshan can gang gis ni// phyogs mthar gnas pa'i snyoms las pa// rat+na'i ming la 'dri ba'i tshul// lan ldon spobs par ldan pa yi// spangs rtog mchog gi ye shes dang*// mkhyen pa'i byin rlabs thugs rje yis// dben par gyur pa bdag lta dang*// mjal bar gyur kyang lung ston pa'i// spobs pa bdag la ma mchis pas// yongs 'dzin dam pa gang rnams kyis// gsung chos gdams pa rab gzung ste// bdag dang gzhan don rgya chen po// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par 'tshal// ces pa 'di ni thos bsam dang*// sgom pas dben pa'i snyoms las pa// rat+na'i ming gis bris pa lags/ ༈ bi)snang rtse ba nam mkha' tshe brtan la gdams pa/

༈ na mo gu ru we/ sngon bsags tshogs gnyis nam mkha'i khyon yangs por// legs byas tshe dbang dpal gyi ri bong 'dzin// 'khor 'bangs brtan pa'i rgyu skar dbus gnas par// mtshan mo'i mgon po gang de'i 'od dkar ni// phyogs 'di'i ku mud tshal du son pa na// spros med don dam mthar thug nges pa'i gsang*// nyams su blangs na 'khor ba sgrol nus pa'i// gdams pa'i don cig bri bar bgyis zhes bskul// skyes stobs shes rab chu bos ring dor zhing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i sdong bu mi ldan kyang*// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la dad pa'i brlan// cung zad tsam gyis bskrun pa'i 'dab ldan gyis// rje btsun dam pa rnams kyis chos char drin// skra rtse'i shas tsam gnas pa'i bcud 'di yang*// gang gi thugs nyams bzhes par gyur pa na// 'di phyi kun tu mngon mtho nges legs kyi// myang 'das bdud rtsi'i mchog la reg par nges// rgyal gsung mdo dang rgyud sde'i don bsdus pa// nyams len sbyor dngos rjes gsum lam rim du// bstan pa 'di ni bka' brgyud gdams pa lags// sngon bsags rgyu las bskrun pa'i dal 'byor lus// rnyed dka' 'jig sla dbul po'i gter mtshungs 'di// da res thob pa don med mi bgyid par// rgyal ba'i bstan la mos pa sbyang 'tshal lo// srid 'dir yang yang nying mtshams sbyar ba'i tshe// 'khor med drin gyis bskyangs pa'i brtse ldan ma// 'gro ba drug gi g.yang sar lhung rnams la// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bral 'dod snying rje dang*// bde ba rgyu bcas la 'god byams pa'i sems// bla med sangs rgyas thob 'dod smon pa dang*// de phyir sgo gsum tshul khrims rnam gsum la// ji tsam bkol btub 'bad pas 'jug pa ste// gzung 'dzin bral ba'i don dam byang sems bcas// sngon 'gro'i chos te mkhar gyi rmang ltar gces// de nyid ngang las snang stong lha yi sku// grag stong dbyer med zab mo sngags kyi sgra// 'dus byas rtogs sgom bral ba'i rig stong thugs// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor don la sbyang*// rang rig rgyal po 'gyur med chos kyi sku// 'khor 'das rgyan spras longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal// sems can mkha' khyab 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku// dus gsum 'bral med ngo bo'i bla ma bsgom// bcings dang grol bral 'khor 'das phyag rgya'i klong*// mtha' dbus gang du'ang mi gnas dbu ma'i lam// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bdag nyid rdzogs pa che// tha dad btags kyang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i// bde chen rnam kun mchog ldan rang rig 'di// dpyad pa'i yul med gzhan gyi ngo bos stong*// dpyod pa'i byed po nyid ni rang stong ste// bsams pas mi spobs 'di sgom gtad bral ba// ngo bo brjod bral dbyings su dang sang nge*// rang bzhin stong gsal chen por gdal cham me// 'khor 'das gang du'ang mi gnas zang thal le// bkag pas mi khegs btang yang 'phro byed stor// bzhag kyang mi sdod gnyen po zad gyur pa// kun shes kun rig kun gyis dris ma gos// 'khor 'das rdzun gyi 'khrul 'khor gzhom pa yi// chos sku dri med nyid du la zla'i chos// theg dgu rgyud sde'i snying por gdams so kye// 'on kyang bsags rab mchog tu ma gyur pas// nges gsang 'di la ma rtogs log rtog dang*// the tshom rtog pa'i dri nga 'byung srid pas// ji srid brtan pa ma thob de srid du// gegs dang 'phrang sel bogs 'don nyams len gces// thog mar drin ldan bla ma spyi bor bsten// khams gsum 'khor ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon mtshungs// des bstan man ngag snying gi nor ltar gzung*// thar par bgrod pa'i gru chen 'di bas med// rnal 'byor lta ba yangs pa'i kham ma chung*// 'khor ba snang stong 'khrul 'khor cir yang 'char// phur bu'i dbal ltar phyogs re'i gdeng mi thob// zung 'jug ye shes 'khor lo mkhyen par 'tshal// rnal 'byor spyod pa kha lta'i phyi ma shor// dus tshod dang 'brel spyod pa bya bar gsungs// lta ba ma rtogs spyod pa kham ches na// mi rgan dpa' bor khas len don btul mtshungs// rgyal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs gyur kyang*// bsags sbyang lam la kun dang mthun par 'jug

/snying po nyams len don la 'bad pa na// lta ba'i don ldan rtogs pa shugs la 'char// rgyu 'bras chos kun ngo bo stong shes pas// snang zhen gegs sel kun rdzob 'khrul pa 'joms// stong bzhin 'gag med snying rje mos gus dang*// gtong ba'i spyod pa rgya chen tshogs spyod pas// des na stong pa'i gegs sel zung du chud// da dung bod yul chos kyi sde ris mang*// rang gzhung mi spyod gzhan gyi grub mtha' 'gegs// de'i lan des gzhal bstan pa phung ba'i bdud// sngon dus rgyal bas gsungs pa ji bzhin du// seng ge'i khog pa 'bu yis gzhig mtshungs pa'i// tshul 'di mthong ba rang gzhan yi ga gcu// de bas spyod ldan dam pa rnams kyis kyang*// don la gnyis med lta ba'i don dgongs te// chos rnams kun la dad pas phyogs ris spongs// rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan bla ma'i lung*// thos pa'i chos la ngom med bsten par 'tshal// rtogs don lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan na yang*// gegs sel bogs 'don dam pa rje la zhus// rang la nyams rtogs yon tan ci skyes kyang*// mu cor mi smra kun la gsang ba gces// rang rgyud ma dag gzhan snang mi 'byongs pas// gzhan skyon mi rtog rang gi skyon tshang dbyung*// mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan phul byung kyang*// dman pa'i cha 'dzin nga rgyal khengs grags bskyung*// gnas skabs bde ba don du mi gnyer zhing*// sdug bsngal gyur la'ang ched du yong sems dor// shugs 'byung 'gag med ro snyoms ngang du spyad// ltar rjes kyi gegs sel bogs 'don bcas// rang gzhan dus gsum bsags yod dge ba rnams// bdag gzhan sems can don du ltos med bsngo// 'di ni gzhan la ma ltos ma sbas pa'i// lam gyi mchog 'di pha rol phyin pa'i mdo// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud kun bsdus pa'i bcud// gang gis nyams su blangs na rang gzhan don// mthar phyin sangs rgyas go 'phang bgrod pa'i tshul// mtshan ldan rje btsun dharma kirti sogs// dam pa rnams kyis gsung gi bdud rtsi yis// legs par bskyangs pa'i rat+na lak+ṣa mis// dbu ru gzho yi bar tshigs sa yi thig

/spro lung dben pa'i skyed tshal ra ba nas// thun mtshams sor mo'i 'du byed bskyod pa'i dges// bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig /gnas skabs ji srid nam mkha' gnas gyur pa// mi bdag 'di yi sku tshe chab srid rnams// nyams pa med cing rab tu brtan pa dang*// dpal ldan mchog gi rdo rje 'grub gyur cig ༈ mi)༈ /bla ma la bstod pa la yi ge'i phyi mo/ ༈ ka lha sa'i yul ltar thag ring nas/ kha bsags g.yo rgyu dang bral 'bad rtsol gyis// ga lu snyoms las le lo ma mchis par// nga yi mdun du byon pa ya mtshan che// ca co mang po smra bas yid thang chad// cha lugs cir yang bsgyur ba'i zog po dang*// ja chang sred pa'i gdung ba kun dor te// nya mo mtsho mtha' skor bzhin 'phyo bar smon// ta thā ga ta'i bka' dang rgyal ba'i lung*// tha dad mos pa'i gdul bya'i snang ba las// da lta bdag gi nyams len zab zab po// na ba'i sman bzhin logs su mi gda'o// pa por rlom pa'i rdzogs chen lta ba dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa'i bye brag sogs// ba mo'i 'o ma ji bzhin dngar bar mtshungs// ma lus 'gro ba'i don du gdams par go// tsa na ka mtshungs thig le thig phran ni// tsha zer 'od zer ji bzhin kun nas gsal// dza byed ye shes rlung gnad mngon gyur na// wa le khyug ge 'ja' lus zag med 'grub// zha gos chags sdang sgo gsum mi g.yeng zhing*// za 'thung nyal gnyid le lo rab spangs te// 'a cag sgrub la bar chad ma gyur na// ya mtshan pad+ma rgyal pos mi bslur nges// ra bsgreng la sogs byin brlabs gnas mchog tu// la lung dka' ba'i sdug bsngal khyad bsad de// sha ka ra tsam rlung gi kha gnon bcas// sa steng dkon pa'i sgyu lus don ldan 'tshal// ha hūm̐ sgrog pa'i khro bo khro mo yi// a la la mchog rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces// srid pa gsum du snyan pa'i sgras bkang te// ma lus 'gro ba sgrol ba'i mgon por 'gyur/

tsi)a stag bla ma kun dga'i dris lan ma 'ongs lung bstan/ ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ rje btsun rtsa rgyud bla ma gtsug na bsten// mos pa'i bu la 'di phyi'i bde 'bras stsol// snang srid 'khor 'das chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar// kun shes kun rig yongs grol gang de yi// 'khor 'das byed po'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shes// rmongs pa bdag la de lta'i gdeng med pas// lung ston dbugs dbyung gzengs stod spobs pas dben// de lta bas na zhus pa'i lan 'gyangs so// slar yang nan du bskul tshe 'di skad ces// 'khor 'das rdzun du shar des 'di skad smra// skye sngon bdag dang chos nor gnyen 'dun du// 'brel pa spyir du bgrangs kyis gar lang kyang*// skye ba gsum du nye bar 'brel pa zab// da lta phyag rdzogs snying po sgrub pa'i lam// 'jam dpal zhi drag bar chad sel ba'i lha// sngon nas bsnyen pa'i lha yin 'grub par snyam// sgyu lus tshe tshad brgyad cur grangs 'tsho ste// bar chad dam sel gdon grib 'tshe ba rtsub// gcig tu ma nges nyen che mang tsam go// de dag sel thabs rgyab rlung btsan thabs sbyor// sgrub gnas dben ri 'bri gung nyid bzang ste// phyi nang g.yeng ba'i dbang gis mi sgrib 'tshal// snying po'i bstan la cung zad phan 'gyur yang*// phyed bstod phyed smod kun 'dun byed pa nyung*// 'on kyang sems bskyed zin cing dman 'dzin gces// tshe 'dir sgrub brtson rang 'khris bya skyungs na// bar dor mchog thob rnam smin skye ba 'dor// gal te 'jig rten bya bas g.yengs gyur na// skye ba gsum du mi lus brgyud pa nas// mchog gi nges pa rdzogs chen snying pos ster// sprang po bdag kyang phyogs med ldom bu byed// bdag la ltos shing mos dang 'brel pa kun// sngon gyi rten 'brel smon lam mi bslu bas// 'di 'og ngan song mi ltung g.yar dam yin// lan cig slar yang sa phyogs 'di nyid du// 'bri yi mi bud dharma'i srid nyams thugs// de 'dra'i dus shig myur du 'byung ngam snyam// dam can kun ni nga yi phyi bzhin 'brangs// bla ma yi dam dbyings nas bdag zhal phyogs// phyogs 'di'i srid la 'jig rten skyong kun smod// de dus nga yi snying rjes mi bzod de// chos dang srid tshul 'dzin pas bstan zhabs skyong*// ces pa 'di yang snying gtam ji bzhin du// snying gi bu la dben pa'i tshal nas bskur// da lta kun gyi phyar khyer mchu rtse tsam// de dus snying nas nga la skyo ba 'byung*// e bden rim gyis gsal lo rdo rje'i mched// skye dang skye bar mi 'bral smon par 'tshal// yi ge 'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i rgya// dge des 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog

tshi)yang bla ma bstod pa shākya dpal gyi dris lan/ ༈ e ma gsan dang skyes bu mchog /shākya thub bstan pa gnas pa'i dus// dal dang 'byor pa'i dpal ldan zhing*// rje btsun mchog gi bla ma yis// rab mnyes brtse bas rjes gzung nas// thos bsam sgrub pa'i lam brtson zhing*// 'gro ba'i mgon du gyur pa ni// skal ba mi dman bzang bar mchis// sngon chad zhu lan phul ba la// yid gnyis co 'dri ma mchis kyang*// slad nas ji ltar stsal ba'i lan// nges pa'i don du 'di ltar zhu// nyams rtsi grol ba'i stong pa'i lta// had po bzo med ming 'dogs bral// dge sbyor yin min ngo mi shes// yin zhes ngo bo ngos gzung med// min zhes 'khrul pa'i zhen rtsi bral// 'di ni nyams kyi dag mtshams zer// spros bral chung ngur 'pho ba'i dus// de tshe nyams len bya tshul bral// rang babs rang grol bskyang ba las// 'bad dang sgrim pa mi 'tshal lo// de las dge sbyor byar med dbyings// rang gshis rnyog bral dri ma med// 'bad rtsol bral bar rgyun ldan na// spros dang bral bar ming 'dogs te// mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu ni// nam mkha' lta bur bogs dbyung zhing*// nam mkha'i ngang du la zla'o// re dogs byung na rnal 'byor min// rang nyid smin dang ma grol bar// gzhan don bya ba'i mthu med pas// bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i// thos bsam sgrub pas rang rgyud sbyang*// de tshe gzhan don bya snyam dang*// phyi rol g.yeng bas bar gcod na// nyon mongs lha bu'i bdud kyis zin// rang don mtha' ru phyin pa la// rgyal ba thabs mkhas byin che yang*// sngon gyi rgyu 'bras smon lam gces// tshogs bsag sgrib pa ma byang bar// byang chub thob par ma bshad pas// rang 'dod btugs btugs kha na med// yid gnyis som nyi 'khri ba chod// lam rtags yon tan sgrub pa la// thabs shes zung du 'brel pa yi// rgyu sgrub pa ni rab tu gces// bsags pa rab 'bring tha gsum gyi// lhag med bar do skye ba brgyud// rnam byang 'bras bu thob pa ni// rdo rje theg pa'i zab khyad lags// rang don mthar phyin skyes bu ni// mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba'i don// da lta'i bya rtsol brgya 'gyur bas// khyad par 'gro don cher bshad 'dug

/rang rgyud chos brgyad kyis dben cing*// byang chub mchog la dmigs pa yis// kun slong bzang po'i chos sbyin ni// gang 'grub sbyin pa'i mchog tu gsungs// de tshe chos bka' brgya stong phrag /bgrang gis gzhal du mi lang ba'i// bu slob dad 'dus tshogs dang bcas// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas// de yang rtsis gdab bral ba gces// sgrub brgyud bstan pa rin chen la// bshad dang sgrub pa'i lam bzang yod// bshad sgrub lam la ma brten pa'i// lhag med rdzogs chen rnyed pa'ang dka'// rang gis rang la mi khrel ba'i// snying po sgrub par mi g.yel zhing*// rang gi rang thag ma chod na// phyi rol lha dang bla ma yang*// rang snang rig pa'i cho 'phrul te// ci zer lung bstan nges tig bral// 'on kyang deng dus snyigs na'ang*// da dung dbus gtsang dag pa'i gzhir// dus gsum gzigs pa'i karmā pa// 'bri stag sa bka' rnying gsum sogs// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu ni// mkhas shing grub pa grangs las 'das// cis kyang lung bstan bzhes pa na// dam pa rnams las blang bar 'tshal// kho bo cag ni snyoms las pa// dus gsum mthong ba'i mig spu bral// ye shes rang 'od phyir mi gsal// khyed kyi bzhed pa bskong ba dka'// nga yi gter chos 'phran bu la// rang gis nyams su ma lon par// gzhan la bstan kyang the tshom che// rang nyid gdeng dang mi ldan pa'i// chos bshad byed pa yi re mug /thugs dam zab mo'i be'u bum 'di// bka' gter gdams pa'i khungs ldan zhing*// nyams len bde bar mthong lags kyang*// 'di'i nang bdag gis thob pa nyung*// de bas gsung rgyun ma mchis so// dza har rlung khrid gdams phran rnams// long yod bzhugs na gang nus 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyang*// phun tshogs lnga yi rten 'brel gces// de phyir gnas bzang rgyal bas bsngags// brtson 'grus chen po'i go ba de// dal brel med pa'i spyod pa mchog

/tshogs dang dben la khyad med cing*// 'gro 'dug za 'chag dus kun du// gshis su 'dre ??'dres na rnal 'byor yin// glo bur brtson 'grus rtsab rtsub 'di// 'dre gdon bar chad g.yab mo yin// rang babs rten 'brel ma 'grig na/ /sgo gsum rtab rtob kha na med// a cang bya btang chos rje pa// kho bo 'brog pa po btol kha// kha mdzes sgrigs ma mi shes pas// thugs la phog na bzod par gsol/ ༈ dze)lho brag chos mdzad la gdams pa'i yi ge ༈ dus gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa chos kyi rje// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs skyob cing*// gus par bsten la mchog thun 'bras rtsol ba// rje btsun rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'dir ni rang la yon tan med bzhin du// gzhan la kha ta bgyi bar 'os min kyang*// dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i gdams pa zhig /'bri bar bskul zhing ci nus spro bar bgyi// sngon bsags las grub dal 'byor dad ldan lus// pho mo skye ba'i khyad med sgrub rten bzang*// der rjes mtshan ldan bla ma las byung ba'i// lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la thos bsam gyis// so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa rnams// gnad du dril la sgo gsum 'bad pas gzung*// khyad par yang zab rdo rje theg pa'i don// bzhi pa'i ye shes nges don snying po la// grims lhod bral bar dge sbyor srang du gzud// thun bar dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// mdor na 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i chos// dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed kun// 'bad pas nyams blangs nam yang 'dor mi bya// nag phyogs mi dge'i rtsa ba ji snyed rnams// sgo gsum sor btsud sgrims te spang bar bya// de ltar nor gol med pa'i lam rim mchog /gang gis nyams su blangs na mchog thun gyi// 'bras bu 'di phyi bar do skye brgyud nas// mngon par mtho la nges par legs pa yi// 'khor dang myang 'das bde dge ma lus pa// 'byung ba'i rin chen gter mdzod 'di la spyod// ces pa 'di ni lho brag chos mdzad ma// ngag dbang phun tshogs dpal mo'i mtshan can gyis// bskul ba'i bzhed pa bskong phyir 'bri gung pa// rat+na'i ming gis bris pa'i dge ba des// log lam mi dge nyer 'tsho'i phyogs zhi zhing*// don gnyis mthar phyin chos sku mngon gyur shog

༈ wi)nges pa'i gsang tshig bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba dbon po a+yon la gdams pa/ ༈ rgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung ba'i tshe// 'dren byed kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can// rgyal ba mtshungs med dhar+m+mā kirti sogs// drin can rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// da lta'i dus 'dir sems can bsod nams dman// rnam dkar dge ba'i sems ldan shin tu dkon// rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gung du yal/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa nam mkhar grol// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha ni mthu stobs chung*// sdig la dga' ba'i 'dre ni mgo 'phang mtho// dge ba'i las 'bras mthong ba nyin skar tsam// sdig spyod skye bo chab srid yar la 'phel// 'di 'dra'i dus tshe rang re chos spyod kun// 'jig rten 'di yi chags sdang rab spangs te// bdag gzhan byang chub lam la 'jug pa gces// de tshe rang gis rang la gros gdab 'tshal// gzhan gyis bskul yang yid la bcags pa dkon/ kye ma mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur// rang nyid gzhan gyi 'dren par 'gyur bar nges// des gsungs thams cad spang blang med par sgrub// yon tan ma lus de las 'byung bar nges// sdom gsum dam tshig mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin par nges// kun la brtse zhing zhi des byams pa sgoms// lam rnams kun gyi sngon 'gro yin par nges// lhag pa'i bsam pa bdag gzhan dbyer med bskyed// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'di yis 'grub par nges// thos pa'i chos la phyogs ris med par nyon// mang du thos pas chos spong mi lhung nges// bsam pa'i don la nyin mtshan med par spyod// bzhed tshul mang yang ngo bo gcig par nges// dpyad bzhag ltar med lta bas phu thag bcad/ mtha' dbus khas blang bral de lta bar nges// lta ba'i don de bsam med rgyun du skyong*// yid byed bral ba de nyid sgom par nges// sdig spyod mi blang dge bcu mi dor ba// mthar thug spang blang bral ba'i spyod par nges// de nyid ngang las thabs shes zung 'jug chos// ma lus nyams blangs sku gsum 'grub par nges// byas bsags yod dge rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsngo// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'bras bur smin par nges// de ltar nges pa'i gsang tshig bcu gnyis 'di// rje btsun bla ma'i chos sras rigs kyi dbon// gang gis bskul ba'i bzhed pa skong bya'i phyir// phyogs kun rgyu ba'i 'bri gung bya bral bas// byang sems skal ldan shing rtas byin brlabs pa'i/

rgya ma'i gnas gzhi khri khang dag tu bris// dge des 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog zhi)yang de nyid la gdams pa/ ka nas dag pa'i rang sems dri med 'di/ kha dog dbyibs gzugs ming 'dogs kun dang bral// ga nas bltas kyang 'gyur med chos kyi sku// nga yi dam chos dkar po chig thub la// ca co mang po'i thos bsam bya long med// cha lugs ji ltar gyur kyang gang byung bsten// ja chang 'dod yon sred la ma zhen par// nya mo chu la rgyu ltar nges med 'phyo// ta thā ga ta rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud las// tha dad gsungs tshul rnam pa grangs mang kyang*/ da ni ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa ste/ na rgas shi bar gyur kyang phyag chen bsgoms/ zhes pa 'di yang dbon po o rgyan la'o/ zi) nye gnas kun dga' rgyan 'phel la gdams pa/ ༈ rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag bde ba che// dpal ldan mchog tu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku// dus gsum skye 'jig bral ba bla ma'i zhabs/ rab gus dad pas kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor rin chen rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir// don med stong log byed du 'phangs pas na// da res gtan gyi mdun ma sgrub na legs// long yod sgyid skyur ma byed grogs dag kye// theg pa'i rim pa bye brag grangs mang yang*// yun gyi byang chub sgrub par bar chod mang*// de bas theg mchog gsang sngags 'grub thag nye// 'bras bu phyi dus ma bshol grogs dag kye// bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin// de'i bka' mnyan de mnyes bsgrub gyur na// rgyal kun mchod dang spangs na de mtshungs pas// dam tshig rtsa ba gzung cig grogs dag kye// snyigs dus sems can tshe thung rkyen mang tshe// tha snyad chos la thos bsam long med pas// 'chi khar mi 'tsher tsam gyi nges pa'i don// bstan pa'i snying po sgrubs shig grogs dag kye// bzang mtho'i lta ba rnam grangs mang gyur kyang*// blos byas lta ba thams cad rnam dag min// khas len 'dzin bral rang bzhin rnam dag

(52) la// ltar med lta phugs gzung cig grogs dag kye// rnal 'byor bzhi sogs rnam grangs mang gsungs kyang*// yid byed bral ba'i rang bgros ma gtogs pa// skyon bral ting 'dzin lam du 'gyur ba dka'// 'gyur med rig pa gzung cig grogs dag kye// byas pa'i chos kyis sangs rgyas sar mi 'gro// re dogs spang blang bral ba'i spyod pa la// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rgyun chags spyod pa yis// sangs rgyas yon tan rdzogs gyur grogs dag kye// de ltar brgyud pa gsum ldan gdams pa 'di// nye gnas kun dga' rgyan 'phel zhes bya yis// yang yang bskul ba'i re ba bskong ba'i phyir// rgya ma khri khang dag tu legs bris so/ ༈ 'i)nye gnas rgyan bkras la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ spyi gtsug rgyan mchog dpal ldan bla ma// 'bral med dus kun gsol ba 'debs so// zhabs sen dri med nor bu'i lan tshar// rab gus dad pa'i rol mtshor bzhugs shig /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs 'bring sgrub pa'i// nye gnas rgyan bkras zhes pa gang gis// yang yang bskul ba'i bzhed pa bskong phyir// cung zad tshig gi 'phreng ba bkod do// bdag 'dra 'jig rten chos ltar bcos pa'i// 'khor 'bangs 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba can gyis// gzhan la bslab bya'i go skabs med kyang*// go tshul cung zad spro bar bgyi na// rna ba'i dbang po gtad par 'tshal lo// dal 'byor yon tan ldan pa'i mi lus// sngon bsags 'bras bu da lta smin tshe// mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du mjal dus// rab gus dang ba'i 'dun pa dang ni// mched grogs spun la dag snang sbyang zhing*// dman pa'i go chas lus ngag yid sdom// dam pa'i chos la thos bsam 'tshal lo// des gsungs rgyun las ji ltar byung bzhin// so thar byang sems gsang sngags zab mo'i// spyod pa dam tshig sdom par gnas zhing*// yid spyod yid 'dzin rtsis gdab med pa'i// sgom bzang chu bo'i rgyun ltar nyams blang*// khas len lta bya lta byed bral ba'i// lta ba zung 'jug 'khor lo la zla// de ltar dus gsum bsags yod dge ba// thams cad byang chub thob phyir bsngo'o// de ltar tshe 'dir rnam dag lam zhugs// drin chen rje btsun bla ma bsten cing*// sgo gsum zol med lta sgom spyod la// yun du spyad na dus gsum dge ba'i// sangs rgyas byang chub myur du thob 'di// mched grogs gang la brtse bas smras so// dge ba cung zad mchis pa gang des// bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i 'dam las brgal te// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par gyur cig

༈ yi)nye gnas kun dga' mtha' yas la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ra wai/ rgyal ba kun las drin lhag thugs rje can// rje btsun mtshan ldan bla ma mchog rnams (53) la// da nas byang chub snying por mchis gyur kyang*// 'bral med gsol 'debs byin gyis brlab du gsol// bdag nyid skyes sbyangs shes rab spobs pas dben// chos ltar bcos pa'i 'jig rten g.yeng bas gtses// rnam dag khrims ldan thos bsam sgom pa'i chos// yid dpyod tsam las nyams len skal bas dben// de ltar gyur pas gzhan la phan pa'i gtam// smra ba'i spobs par ldan pa ma yin yang*// brag cha'i sgra ltar rkyen gyis skul 'di smra// ka dag chos sku'i gnas lugs rtogs bzhed na// kha dog dkar dmar tshig la ma zhen par/ ga ru gnas kyang chags sdang rtog pa spongs// nga yi mi bslu nges pa'i gsang tshig yin// ca co mang po'i klag cor smra ba bcad// cha lugs ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos tshul// ja chang kha zas sred pa rab spangs te// nya to pa ltar sgrub pa lhu ru blang*// ta ra'i grangs bzhin grangs med lus blangs tshe// tha dad gyur kyang yang yang drin ldan pa'i// da dung ma rnams ma grol bsgral ba'i phyir// na rgas shi bar gyur kyang dam chos bsgrubs// pa ri pi ri'i kha bshad chos rnams ni// pha rol rna ba'i dbang por snyan gyur kyang*// ba mos nyi bzhin nyon mongs mi thul bas// ma lus sangs rgyas thob pa'i dam chos bsgoms// tsa ri tra sogs dag pa'i gnas chen du// tsha grang du kha'i gdung ba kun bsad de// dza lang bag med spyod bral rang nyid la// wa dmar snying khong chug la dam chos mdzod// zha la can sogs khang pa'i skyid 'dod spongs// za sogs sdig dang ma 'dres kha zas bsten// 'a cag grub thob phyir rjes snyegs pa na// ya spyod 'jig rten bya ba rgyang bsring 'tshal// ra la ro la'i 'khor tshogs g.yeng ba'i rgyu// la spyil rtsa spyil tsam la gnas bcas te// sha khrag log 'tsho'i zang zing rnam g.yeng spang*// sa bka' rnying gsum lta ba'i gnas lugs bskyangs// ha cang kham ches bslab bya mang thal kyang*// a cang smyon tshig lags so dgongs par 'tshal// bla ma'i nye gnas kun dga' mtha' yas kyis// bskul bar gyur las 'bri gung rat+na yis// spro lung dben pa'i bskyed mos tshal du bris// dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob gyur cig

ri)rnal 'byor chos dbang la gdams pa/ rje btsun mtshan ldan bla ma rnams la// rab gus mos pas dus kun 'dud do// dus mtha'i sprang btsun rat+na bdag la// rnal 'byor chos dbang dag gis bskul ba'i// gegs sel bogs 'don gnad du bsdus pa// cung zad brjod kyis gsan par 'tshal lo// rang rig gdod ma'i ye shes 'di ni// 'gro 'ong gnas med mtha' dbus bral zhing*// gzhom gzhig bar gcod dus kun grol lo// rtog tshogs glo

(54) bur 'khrul pa'i dra ba// bag chags gzung 'dzin snang cha'i rtsal ni/ chu yi rlabs bzhin ji ltar snang yang*/ rang rtsal nyid las gzhan du mi lta// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin zhes pa'i// ngar 'dzin nyams myong rtsi can gang las// rang gshis nor bu rin chen dri med// sngar dang da lta phyis kyang mi 'gyur// 'di ni chos nyid don dam bden pa// kun gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po// rang bzhin rnam dag kun bzang dngos yin// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras gsum snying po// gcig tu dril ba'i gegs sel bogs 'don// 'chug med nyams len rtsol bral 'di ni// bris pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro kun// rtog tshogs 'ching ba'i dra ba bsal te// rang gzhan byang chub mngon gyur shog cig li)bla ma rin po che'i nye gnas btsun chung zhig la gdams pa/ na mo gu ra we/ sngon tshe bsod nams mi dman mthu yis// tshe 'dir dal 'byor lus dbang thob cing*// 'jig rten slu brid rgyang du bsrings te// mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs 'bring bgyid pa'i// bu chung khyod kyis ji ltar bskul don// skabs su bab pa cung zad smras so// na tshod lang tsho gzhon pa'i dus 'dir// yon tan gzhi rtsa 'bri klog sbyong zhing*// rang nus 'tsham pa'i bslab pa blangs la// mig khrid ngan pa'i spyod pa spangs te// zhi dul yid gzhungs spyod lam 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa'i drung du 'khod tshe// bag yod mdzes pa'i spyod pas mtshams sbyar// lus ngag yid kyis rang 'khris spangs pa'i// 'bad rtson ldan pas zhabs 'bring 'tshal lo// mched grogs rgan gzhon bar ma dag la// khro tshig 'khon 'dzin zur za bral bas// ka blo bde bas las khur bya zhing*// gong bkur bar 'grogs dman pa bskyang ngo*// dpon slob tshogs pa'i dbus su gnas tshe// log ltas smra mang rgyang du bsrings shing*// dag snang mos gus rtsol stabs bskyed la/ sgo gsum dge ba'i lam la 'khod cig

/dam pa'i chos la phyogs ris bral ba'i// thos bsam bya zhing snying por dril te// gcig pur 'dug tshe g.yeng ba spang zhing*// rtse gcig sgom la sa sde tshugs shing*// 'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas dge chos// ma rgan 'gro ba sems can don du// rang 'dod spangs pa'i byang chub chen por// yongs su bsngo ba'i chos la spyod cig /ces 'di tsa ma ri yi phyogs gnas// kun tu rgyu ba'i rat+na'i ming gis// go rim sgrigs spangs gang byung smras 'dir// dge ba gang mchis gzhan don bsngo'o// shi)bla ma snye lung pa'i grwa pa gcig la smras pa/ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor lus 'di mi rtag glog (55) dang 'dra// phyi ma gar skye nges pa ma mchis pas// da lta rang dbang dus 'dir chos la 'bad// phyi ma byang chub lam sna zin par nges/ si)rnam 'joms mgon po la gdams pa/ dus gsum skye 'jig bral ba chos kyi sku// 'khor 'das sna tshogs snang ba longs spyod rdzogs// dbyer med zung 'jug yangs pa sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum ye shes lnga rdzogs de la 'dud/ e ma 'dus byas rang bzhin mi rtag 'gyur ba can// skye rga na 'chi'i chu chen 'khor ba'i mtsho// gru chen rgyal po mtshan ldan bla ma rje// mi 'bral brjed med bka' drin gtsug tu bzhugs// des gsungs mdo rgyud dgongs don snying po'i chos// rang rig rgyal po rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur bral// zab gsal ye shes rang byung blo las 'das// phyogs su lhung dang ris su ma chad pas// rtag chad 'gro 'ong spros pa'i mtha' las grol// phyag rgya che dang dbu ma rdzogs pa che// sna tshogs ming can mtshan ma'i dris dben pa'i// skye dang 'jig bral 'chi med gsang ba'i sku// don gnyis mthar phyin 'di las ches zab pa'i// chos gzhan med do snying gi ga 'ur bcang*// dge bas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal te// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par nges/

hi)lta sgom spyod pa gcig tu dril ba'i nyams len gnad kyi yi ge zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ dus gsum bde gshegs thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// skye 'chi las 'das gzhom med rdo rje'i sku// gang 'dul der snang 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad// o rgyan rin po che la gus phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub thugs kyi rang rtsal mthar phyin pa// thams cad mkhyen pa mi pham lha yi lha// theg mchog dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro ba sgrol// rkang gnyis shākya'i gtso la gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum chen mo// 'gro ba kun la mchog tu brtse ba can// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa// bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lor la phyag 'tshal// 'di ltar phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan 'gro ba mar gyur sems can kun// gnas skabs mthar thug bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog thun 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob gyur cig /e ma ho/ 'khor dang myang 'das ngo bo chos kyi sku// sna tshogs cir snang rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// ma 'gags rol pa thugs rje sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum gdod nas gzhi yi bzhugs tshul yin// rtag pa ma yin nges gzung kun dang bral// chad pa ma yin 'khor 'das gang du'ang snang*// gnyis ka ma yin brjod pa'i tha snyad bral// gnyis med ma yin gzhi yi bzhugs tshul yin// 'gro ba ma yin mtshan ma'i yul las 'das/ (56) 'ong ba ma yin ye nas lhun gyis grub// gnas pa ma yin rten pa'i yul dang bral// 'di ni rang byung gzhi yi bzhugs tshul yin// 'khor ba ma yin nyes pa'i dri ma gos// 'das pa ma yin srid pa'i rgya mtshor rol// gnyis ka ma yin re dogs kun dang bral// gnyis med las 'das gzhi yi bzhugs tshul yin// snang ba ma yin rang gi ngo bos stong*// stong pa ma yin rig pa dbyings su gsal// gnyis ka ma yin mtshon pa'i dpe las 'das// gnyis med zung 'jug gzhi yi bzhugs tshul yin// yin pa ma yin 'di zhes dpyad du med// min pa ma yin the tshom kun dang bral// gnyis ka ma yin gzung 'dzin yul las 'das// gnyis med 'dzin bral lta ba gzhir bzhugs yin// yod pa ma yin ming gdags kun dang bral// med pa ma yin dngos rnams tshul du 'phro// gnyis ka ma yin 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das// gnyis med 'dzin bral gzhir gnas lta ba yin// gzugs su ma grub lta bya'i yul mi gnas// sgra ru ma grub tshor bya'i ngo bo stong*// dri ru ma grub mnam rgyu dmigs su med// rjen stong 'di ni gzhir gnas lta ba yin// ro ru mi bro myang bya'i yul las 'das// reg tu ma grub lus kyi dngos pos stong*// chos su mi gnas mkhan po'i gzhi bral ba// kun bral kun snang gzhir gnas lta ba yin// mang po ma yin gcig pu rang ga ma// gcig pu ma yin du mar snang ba'i gzugs// gnyis ka ma yin mang nyung brjod las 'das// gnyis med blo 'das gzhir gnas lta ba yin// sku ru ma grub mtshan ma'i gzugs las 'das// gsung du mi snang brjod pa'i sgra yis stong*// thugs su mi gnas mtshon dpe'i yul las 'das// dmigs med don ldan gzhir gnas lta ba yin// yon tan mi mnga' bgrang ba'i mtha' mi dpogs// 'phrin las mi zad rtog bral de bzhin nyid// rgyan gyi 'khor lo dus kun 'gag pa med// 'di ni rang sems gzhir gnas lta ba yin// e ma ho

ngo bo chos sku rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// 'gag med sprul sku yongs rdzogs ngo bo nyid// lam gyi brtan rtsa bla ma 'di yis chog /rang sems las gzhan bla ma btsal ma dgos// rtag chad gnyis 'dzin 'dzin bral mu bzhi rnams// rang gzhan dngos stong phyogs lhung 'ching ba'i rgyu// ye gnas gzhi la bcos bsgyur mi byed pas// lta ba'i gnas lugs rang gshis sgom pa yin// 'gro 'ong gnas bral rang rig ye shes 'di// brtag dpyad mkhan po rtsa stor gnyen po med// rtog dpyod byi dor rtsol sems bya mi dgos// rang dga' gzhir bzhag ma bcos sgom pa yin// 'khor dang myang 'das gnyis ka gnyis min pa'i// rang rig rgyal po (57) kun gsal chen po 'di// rgya ru ma chad ngos 'dzin kun bral bas// spang blang mi dgos rang gshis sgom pa yin// snang dang stong sogs gnyis ka gnyis min pa'i// phyogs su ma lhung rang sems dri med 'di// ye nas yin gyis bsgrubs pas byung ba min// ris gcod mi dgos gnas lugs sgom pa yin// yin dang min dang gnyis ka gnyis min zhes// 'dod zhen 'khris bral shugs 'byung lta ba 'di// brtsol sgrub mi dgos rang byung lhun grub ste// gdod nas gnas kyi 'di ka sgom pa yin// yod dang med dang gnyis ka gnyis min zhes// bzang ngan tha snyad rtsa bral lhug pa 'di// gnyug ma'i rig pa rang byung ye shes te// de la bcos med skyong ba sgom pa yin// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya snang grags chos// kun gyis ma gos go skabs 'byed pa'i dbyings// rang shes rig rgyal ma bcos lhun grub 'di// spang bsgyur sgrub med nyams len sgom pa yin// gcig dang du ma gnyis ka gnyis min pa'i// rtog dpyod rtog ges rtogs par dka' ba 'di// gzung 'dzin mtshan bral rang byung sangs rgyas te// dri med yin lugs skyong ba sgom pa yin// sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las mnga' bdag mchog

/mtshan 'dzin dri bral brjod pa'i dpe 'das 'dis// gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang gshis rtsal rdzogs te// re dogs med par 'jog pa sgom pa yin/ e ma ho/ rang rig gzhiraganas lta ba sku gsum rdzogs// don gnyis lhun grub rang sems bla ma sgom// 'du 'bral med pa spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu sku gsum 'grub pa e ma ho// rtag chad mtha' bral gzhir gnas lta ba 'di// bcos bslad bral bar nyams len sgom pa ste// de las mi 'da' spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu lta ba rang grol e ma ho// 'gro 'ong bral ba'i rang byung lta ba 'di// nyams len rang gar skyong ba sgom pa ste// rtog dpyod med pa spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu ma btsal rnyed pa e ma ho// 'khor 'das ris su ma chad lta ba 'di// spang blang bral ba rang gshis bsgom pa ste// rgyar chad med pas spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu 'khor 'das rang grol e ma ho// snang stong dbyer med gzhir gnas lta ba 'di// ris chad med par nyams len sgom pa ste// phyogs lhung med pa spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu don gnyis 'grub pa e ma ho// yin min med pa'i rang gshis lta ba 'di// zhen 'khris med par skyong ba sgom pa ste// phyogs su mi lhung spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu rang la rnyed pa e ma ho// yod med las 'das gzhir gnas lta ba 'di// bcos bslad med par skyong ba sgom pa ste// bzang ngan ming gdags spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu mtha' las grol ba e ma ho// dri mas ma (58) gos kun snang lta ba 'di// rtsol bsgyur spang blang med pa sgom pa ste// rang gshis skyong ba spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu gnyen po bral ba e ma ho// gcig dang du bral rang gshis lta ba 'di// yin lugs skyong ba mu dra'i sgom pa ste// gzung 'dzin mtshan bral spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa e ma ho// sku lnga ye rdzogs gzhir gnas lta ba 'di// re dogs mtshan bral 'jog pa sgom pa ste// gnas lugs mi 'chos spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// 'bras bu yon tan kun rdzogs e ma ho// a ho āsh+tsā rgyaṃ/

'khor 'das bdag po dpal ldan he ru ka// ris med ye mkhyen ston pa bcom ldan 'das// lta ba'i rigs bsdus drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// rang rig dngos bzhugs logs nas sgrub du med// 'di las lta ba'i rgyal po nges ma mthong*// bzang sgom can kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// phyag rdzogs dbu sogs lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'ga'// 'ga' zhig rtsol sems sgrims te sgom zhes dang*// 'ga' zhig rang grol rgya yan zhog ces sogs// sna tshogs brda thabs tshul lugs dpag med kyang*// gnyug ma'i shes pa dri med skyong ba yi// gzhir gnas lta ba'i don las sgom ma rnyed// rang gzhung mkhan rnams ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// mi dge mi blang dge ba mi spang zhes// spang blang med pa'i spyod par bzhed lags kyang*// de nyid spang blang spyod pa kho nar go// spang blang bral ba'i spyod pa skyong bzhed na// rang byung ye shes ma bcos skyong ba 'di// rlom sems med pa'i tshul spyod rnam dag ste// tshul rtog can rnams ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// de ltar lta sgom spyod lam gzhi lam 'bras// ye nas rang la rdzogs pa lta ma dgos// yin lugs de nyid skyong las sgom ma dgos// gnyen po logs su med pas spyod ma dgos// bya brtsol bral ba'i bya btang sos re dal// dgos dgu rang tshang rnal 'byor 'byor par ldan// nyam nga med pa'i rtogs ldan dpa' gdeng che// de ltar lags pa'i rang rig ye shes 'di// snang srid dag pa'i 'khor lo bum dbang rdzogs// lha sku bskyed bzlas logs su bya ma dgos// de gsung 'gag med gsang dbang ngo bor rdzogs// rtsa rlung gdams pas logs su sbyang ma dgos// rten gyi thig le gsum pa'i ngang du thim// byang sems bzlog dgram nyams len bya ma dgos// chos can chos nyid gzhir rtogs dbang bzhi rdzogs// dpe don ngo sprad sprad bya'i yul las 'das// rig pa'i ngo bo du mar ma grub pas// rtse gcig rnal 'byor bzhed na de la mdzod// rig pa'i ye shes dpe brjod las 'das pas// spros bral rnal 'byor bzhed na de la 'tshal// rig pa'i ngo bor chos rnams yongs 'du bas// ro gcig rnal 'byor dgyes na mdzad kyang chog

/rig pa'i (59) ye shes dmigs gtad kun bral nas// sgom med rnal 'byor ming du gdags kyang chog /rig pa'i ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa yin// chos dbyings ye shes zhes kyang de la bya// de yi dbyings la 'khor 'das kun 'char bas// sor rtog ye shes zhes kyang de la bya// 'gag med kun nas 'od gsal ltar mthong bas// me long ye shes zhes kyang de la bya// de ltar snang yang dbyings las mi gzhan pas// mnyam nyid ye shes zhes kyang de la bya// 'khor dang 'das sogs snang brnyan kun ston pas// bya grub ye shes zhes kyang de la bya// mdor na 'khor 'das snang zhing srid pa'i chos// spang rtogs yon tan bzang ngan legs nyes dang*// skyid sdug mtho dman bde sdug thams cad kun// ji ltar snang zhing shar yang ngo bo las// mi g.yo mi 'pho phyi rjes mi 'breng bar// lam du blangs pas gegs sel bogs thon te// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan g.yung drung sku// gzhom med rdo rje'i sa mchog mthar phyin te// de ltar rang shar nyams su myong ba'i chos// gdod ma'i mgon po mngon byang sgrub pa'i thabs// chig chog rgyal po gnad kyi yi ge 'di// smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar lak+ṣ+mīs// bskul ba'i re ba bskang phyir 'bri gung pa// rat+na'i ming can gang gis gzho smad cha// bde skyid smon pa thang gi sgar dbus su// chu stod zla ba'i rdzogs pa tha ma'i nyin// lha yi bla ma rgyal sar byon pa yi// 'grub pa'i sbyor bar thun mtshams bris pa 'dis// bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// rang rig gdod ma'i chos sku mngon gyur te// gzugs skus srid pa'i sems can don byed shog i)rgyal ba bkra shis la gdams pa/ ༈ /na mo rat+na gu ru/ rje btsun bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// dkon mchog rin chen gsum la gus phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'khor ba'i bya ba chu yi lbu ba 'dra// rtag brtan snying po nges gdeng ma mchis pas// zin med duḥkha 'khor ba'i bya ba skyungs// bslu med dam pa'i chos la 'bad 'tshal lo// thos bsam snying po sgrub pas len pa la// btang snyoms le lo lhan skyes bar chad bdud// bzang ngan rkyen gyi dbang du mi btang bar// gnas lugs lta ba'i rang 'gros bskyang 'tshal lo// pha ma rigs drug drin can sha stag ste// 'khor ba ngan song rgya mtshor bying ba la// mgon skyabs re sa gzhan du ma mchis pas// sems bskyed bsngo ba smon lam gdab 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di bya btang rgyal ba bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ba las// 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis la thun bde skyid smon pa thang gi sgar du bris pa'o/

(60) ku)mgar sprul sku la gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ra we/ dus gsum mnyam med bla ma rnams la 'dud// skye ba du mar smon lam bden pa'i mthus// yang yang skye ba'i rnam 'phrul du ma yis// ma rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru// mchog gi sprul sku gang gis bskul phyir bri// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin duḥkha nyid ma 'das// de res tsam zhig dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// bla med byang chub btsan sa ma zin na// phyis nas rnyed dka' snyoms las le lo spang*// bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar sdom ldan lus// chags sdang bral ba'i zhi des byang sems ngag /don gnyis 'grub pa'i bskyed rdzogs gsang sngags sems// bzhi pa'i nyams len brgyud pa'i snying po yin// bskyed rim mchog gsum mthar son gsal stong sku// nus pa tshad phyin grag stong mthu stobs phul// rdzogs rim rig stong zung 'jug nyams myong rnams// chog shes ngar 'dzin bral ba'i rang gshis bskyang*// phung lnga'i ngo bo 'dzin med rig rgyu dang*// nyon mongs spang gnyen bral ba'i ye dag gshis// 'gro kun nye ring kun snyoms bcos bral ba'i// 'chi med bdud bcom ye shes rgyal sa gzung*// de ni rang don mthar phyin chos sku 'grub// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar// gzhan don 'gag med longs spyod sprul pa'i skus// srid pa'i mtsho chen sgrol ba'i mchog 'gyur ro// zhes pa mnyam med mgar gyi rnam 'phrul pa// gang gis bskul phyir 'bri gung pa rat+nas// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i thang*// gang gi sa yi thig le'i sgar du bris/ khu)rin chen bzang po la gdams pa/ ༈ rat+na bha dra'i nyams myong skyes rim tshul// zhib cha yi ge ris su bkod pa son// da ltar dus snyigs bstan pa'i mar zhabs 'dir// chung nas rab byung ma nor lam zhugs te// sgrub brgyud snying po'i gzhung bzang nyams len pa// skal ba mi dman dal 'byor don ldan yin// de las bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun// ngoms med chog par mi 'dzin bsten pa ni// rgyal ba rnams dang dam pa rnams kyi spyod// nyams su blang ba'i nyams myong rtags kyi rim// 'gro ba'i blo yi bye brag mtha' yas pa// skye bo'i tshul lugs sna tshogs dpag yas pas// gcig tu ma nges de rnyed 'byung bar 'gyur// 'on kyang don dam bden pa snying po'i don// gcig las mi 'da' 'di ltar nges par 'tshal// bag chags mthu brtas lhan skyes ma rig pa// 'di nyid spong phyir zab lam nges don bstan// ji bzhin ma bcos grim lhod bral bskyangs pas// nyams gsum la sogs chu sna'i sbun pa 'dra// de nyid spang blang bral bar bskyangs pa las// ming 'dog bral kyang nyin mtshan myong ba'i rgyun// ngo shes skyong rgyu yod kyang sgrib ma bral// da lta'i rang rig stong gsal mtha' dbus bral// dran stong rjen pa smra bsam brjod bral ba// ston ka'i nam mkha' sprin bral dkyil lta bu// 'di ni sems kyi rang gshis dri med de// the tshom yid gnyis dri ma bya mi 'tshal// chos kyi phung po ji snyed thos bsam sgom// ji ltar byas kyang kho rang nyid du go

/shes rig rtogs te kun gyi go 'byed cing*// kun tu 'char zhing snang ba thams cad 'dud// 'di las rgyal bas gzhan du ma bstan pas// rtsa ba gcig chod 'di bogs 'don pa'i thabs// bzang ngan rkyen dang tshogs drug snang cha la// rang gdangs 'char sgo'i zhen med rtsal sbyong 'tshal// 'khor 'das snang srid chos la rtsal 'byongs na// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don 'grub pa'i rgyu// zung 'jug ye shes nyams len mchog yin no// zhes pa mdor bsdus thun bar bris pa'ang 'dis// rtogs pa'i ye shes mchog de mngon gyur shog gu)bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgongs don/ ༈ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi dngos// 'khor 'das srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun gyi gzhi// gang gzung der 'char sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul can// sems nyid rang byung mtha' yas de la 'dud// mnyam med 'dren mchog shākya'i bstan pa la// nges don snying po'i rgyal mtshan rab bsgreng ba// rang gzhan chos kyi khang bzang mdzes gyur pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gang des bskul ba'i don// bdag lta'i byis pas smra bar mi spobs na'ang*// nan gyis bskul phyir rang lugs mdo tsam brjod// rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdo rgyud man ngag rnams// lta sgom spyod gsum kha nar gda' bo zhes// bka' brgyud rin chen rnams kyi gsung las thos// de don nyams len rnal 'byor lam pa pos// nyams len go bde'i dbang gis mthar thug tshe// lta sgom spyod gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams// rnam dbye med par nyams su myong bas grub// de la gzhi yi gnas tshul lta ba ni// stong gsal kun khyab mi 'gyur kun snang zhing*// phan gnod rkyen bral 'khor 'das ngo bor gnas// 'byung gnas 'gro 'ong mtha' gsum 'dzin bdag med// sems nyid ngo bo 'di ni khas len bral// de nyid lam dus sgom pa'i nyams len 'di// mi rtag snying rje byams pas rgyud bskul te// byang sems gsang sngags smin grol lam zhugs nas// dngos gzhi rang sems dri med chos kyi sku// grim lhod mtshan ma'i thun sgom yid byed bral// dran dang dran bral gegs sel bogs 'don dang*// gang de'i ngang gis yun du bskyangs gyur na// bral thob med pa'i sgom pa klong du 'gyur// slad dus spyod pa dus tshod 'brel ba gces// de ltar lta sgom spyod pa yang dag lam// re dogs gzung 'dzin dri mas ma gos shing*// tshig tshogs go ba'i shes pas ma bkab na// mthong du med pa'i chos nyid lta ba ni// gong du bstan pa'i gnas lugs nyams su myong*// rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis la sogs pa// rgyal ba gong ma'i lam gyi ngal sor dgongs// yang dag don la bgrod bya bgrod byed med// mtha' bral yangs pa'i kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// zung 'jug kha sbyor chen po btsan sa zin// de ltar bka' brgyud rin chen dgongs pa'i don// rang gi go yul ji ltar shar ba'i tshul// 'di ltar phul la rnam dpyod blo gros kyis// brtags shing dpyad de thugs kyi dgongs par 'tshal// zhes pa me pho sprel lo'i zla ba ni// hor dus lnga pa'i yar tshes dge ba la// skyu ra'i rigs gyur rat+na'i ming 'dzin pas// gdong stod sgar du bris pa dge gyur cig

ngu)sprul sku ye shes khyung grags kyi gdung 'dzin puṇ+ya dh+wa tsha la gnang ba/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse 'dus pa'i sku// snyigs dus 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i mgon// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// rab gus 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs/ e ma ho// 'khor 'das sna tshogs snang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// rol pa chen po ye shes lha sngags sgra// bzang ngan spang blang bral ba'i rig stong thugs// yon tan 'phrin las bskyed rim yongs rdzogs yin// de nyid ngang las snang srid phyir ma lus// stong pa'i rang bzhin nang du ma lus pa'i// ye shes zung 'jug rang lus rdo rje gsum// rdzogs pa a nu yo gar lhun gyis grub// 'khor dang myang 'das srid zhi'i chos rnams kun// mnyam yang lhun 'byams ma bcos gdal ba che// du ma ro gcig sku lngar ye nas rdzogs// rang rig rdzogs pa chen por kho bo 'dod// 'thad dam mi 'thad lung rig man ngag gnad// tshad ldan theg pa rigs mthun dag tu gzigs// 'thad pa 'dug na bdag don 'dis 'grub cing*// gzhan don mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'gyur// dge 'dis bdag gzhan ma gyur 'gro ba rnams// 'khrul 'dzin glo bur rtogs tshogs rab bcom ste// gnyis med bde chen ye shes mngon gyur nas// phyams cig sangs rgyas kun gyis thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni pad+ma kā ra yis// lung bstan sprul sku ye shes khyung grags kyi// gdung 'dzin puṇ+ya dh+wa dzas bskul ba las// 'bri gung bya bral rat+nas bris pa dge cu)dad ldan gcig gis zhus pa'i lan/ dal 'byor lus 'di don ldan gyi// bya ba la ni 'jug 'dod pas// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags kyi// sdom dang dam tshig bsrung la 'bad// mi rtag snying rje byang sems sbyang*// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma la// mos gus gsol btab dbang blang bstim// bskyed rdzogs dbyer med don nyams blang*// dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsngo// gegs sel bogs 'don skabs dang sbyar// 'di yis bdag don mthar 'byin zhing*// gzhan don sku gnyis 'bras bu 'grub// ces pa 'di ni dad ldan gyis// bskul phyir 'bri gung rat+nas bris// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/

༈ chu)'phyong rgyas dbon po sang rdor ba la gdams pa/ ༈ rnal ma ma bcos lhug par bskyangs pa yis// ye shes gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon 'byor pa// dbon po bya btang bud+dha badz+ra gyis// bskul phyir yi ge'i 'du byed cung zad bsgyur// phyag rdzogs dbu sogs zab lam mang bshad kyang*// mdor bsdus snying po nyams len gcig dril ba// rten gyi gang zag byang chub thob 'dod rnams// rang rang grub mtha'i 'ching bor lam 'dir bsnyen// rgya chad phyogs bral yid byed spangs pa'i gshis// gnyug ma'i dngos po lhan skyes rang byung 'di// bcos bslad med par ji bzhin nyid du bskyangs// bskyang zhes bya ba'ang dgag sgrub bral bar bzhag /bzhag ces bya ba'ang tshig gi brjod bya ste// rig pa dri med kho na nyid las ni// bzang ngan bya rtsol byung na kun gyis 'ching*// byar med don la lta sgom spyod pa rdzogs// gegs kyang 'dis sel bogs kyang kho rang thon// sgrib pa rang sangs yon tan kun rgyas 'char// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'bras bu lhun gyis grub// de ltar bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// 'khor zhi yongs rdzogs byang chub nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'phreng bu'i mdun sa pho brang du// kun tu rgyu ba rat+na'i ming gis bris/ ༈ ju)mched grogs rnams la kha da'i tshul du smras pa/ ༈ rje btsun mi las// 'grangs ltog ran pa'i sgyu lus bde// gsung ba thugs bden/ chog shes mi la nor rdzas mi 'dod 'byung*// 'dod pa can la 'dzam gling dbang kyang 'tshol// rang khrel can gyis ltogs kyang lhag ma 'jog /ham dur can gyis gzhan gyi lhag ma'ang snyob// zhes pa ltar/ yod dus dkrigs se ba re byas tsam na/ med pa'i brel 'phongs mi dgos/ rang re ri khrod pa yin/ skyid zhag pa ni min/ longs spyod chung kyang ngo tsha rgyu med/ med dus bsgur tshugs pa cig byung na dang gcig yin te/ de rang dka' las che/

de bas/ da lta dbang byung dus snyoms po re byas tsa dga' ba yin/ nga rang gi ngos za 'thung byed ma phod pa rang min te/ rang re tshos/ g.yo brda tsam min pa dka' las ni cang ma byas/ za 'thung rgyu 'di rnyed gcig 'ong ba gda' ba 'di/ so sor rgyu sgrub pa'i tshe/ dka' las ci tsam re byed dgos yin gda'/ sde pa chen po yin kyang*/ rang re tshos skyid sdug med/ sha tsha med rang gi ngos/ phad phod byas na sdod pa ri khrod du byas kyang*/ rnam smin 'khor ba pa las lhag par bsag dgos 'dug go/ nga ni za za 'thung 'thung 'di la kyi g.ya'o// zhes pa 'di mched grogs rnams la kha lta'i tshul du smras pa yin/ ༈ nyu) sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po'i sras la gdams pa/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ byin rlabs rtsa ba drin chen bla ma dang*// mchog thun dngos grub gnyis stsol yi dam lha// 'phrin las kun sgrub ḍā ki bka' srung tshogs// rgyal ba'i sras kyi bzhed don dngos grub stsol// dam pa khyed nyid thugs dbyings dag pa'i khar// bdag lta'i lugs gnyis tshugs bor skar phran kyang*// mun 'joms nyi zla'i gzi ltar shar gyur pa// dngos kyi mthu min nyid kyi rtsal kho na// 'on kyang de lta'i snang tshul gzigs pa yang*// rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma gang gis gdung rigs mthus// nyid rang skye nas skye ba'i sbyangs stobs ky-is// rten 'brel rnam par dag pa'i stobs kho na// de bzhin 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ye shes rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la// bzang ngan spang blang gdod nas ma grub bzhin// dag pa rab 'byams bde chen chos dbyings su// e waṃ zung 'jug bde chen mchog gyur cig /zhes pa 'di ni chos rje rgyal ba'i sras po la gdams pa'o/ ༈ tu) gtsang rgyang rtse chos mdzad mchog grub rdo rje la gdams pa/ ༈ gzhon nu rab byung bslab gsum rgyan ldan pa'i// chos mdzad phun tshogs mchog grub rdo rje yis// ji ltar bskul ba'i bzhed don go yul tsam// 'dir na bkod gang 'thad na bsten par 'tshal// sems nyid ngo bo stong nyid zhi bar gnas// de yi rang gdangs kun gsal 'gyu rtog gnyis// ngo bo gcig kyang snang tshul ngos nas dbye// 'di ni sangs rgyas sar kyang spangs bzhag bral// de khyad rtogs dang ma rtogs tha snyad tsam// ma bcos rnal ma'i rig pa byang sems 'di// ye shes lnga dang sku sogs bgrang yas pa'i// chos sku yon tan zad med kho rang nyid// stong gsal ngang la shar ba'i 'od gsal gyi// 'od snang sku dang thig le lug rgyud sogs// stong zhing 'char ba zung 'jug de la zer// dben par nyams len spros pa bcas pa'i tshe// bla ma'i yon tan dran zhing gdung ba na// da lta bla mas ji ltar bstan pa'i don// rang rig bla ma'i ngo bor dbyer med bskyang*// de las gsol ba logs su gdab mi dgos// gzhan yang rtsa gsum bka' brgyad bsnyen pa'i thabs// pad+ma'i thugs gter bka' gtad rab 'byams las// ji ltar byung ba'i gdams pa snying khrag 'di// shin tu gsang bar gdams pas 'dir 'bad na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// bde gshegs

kun gyis rtsol bar the tshom med// ces 'di bla med theg mchog yangs pa'i thang*// cog bu'i brtul zhugs gnas pa'i dus su bris/ ༈ thu) yol mo ba rgyal sras rdo rje dpal 'bar la bla thang du gdams pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru we/ dus gsum kun tu drin gyis bskyangs pa'i// rtsa rgyud bla ma rje btsun pad+ma/ sprang po bdag sogs spyi gtsug brgyan du// 'du 'bral med par rtag tu gsol 'debs// mtshan ldan bla ma shākya'i gdung las// rab 'khrungs gsang sngags 'chang ba gang gis// rdzogs chen nyams len bya ba'i tshul lugs// mdo ru bsdus pa 'di ltar 'bul lo// yid byed bral ba'i rang rig lta ba// mtshan 'dzin dri bral sgom pa'i rgyal po// spang blang bral ba'i spyod pa bskyangs pas// 'khor 'das dri bral kun bzang 'grub po// de las rang gzhan sgo gsum grol phyir// bzhugs stangs rlung gnad rig dngos bstun te// yid byed spangs pa'i gnad du sgril bas// snang bzhi mthar phyin bdag gzhan don 'grub// zhes pa 'bri gung bya bral gang la// rgyal sras rdo rje dpal 'bar gang gis// bskul ba'i man ngag gnad bsdus 'di yang*// bla med thang gi sgar du bris so/ ༈ du) 'tsho byed ska ma la ku re'i tshigs bcad ka kha ma/ ༈ ka ba'i ngo la byis pa chags pa bzhin/ kha zas btung ba dag la sred min kyang*// ga lu mdzad nas mgyogs par mi 'byon pa// nga yi bla sman 'tsho byed skar ma yin// ca re bzhugs nas sman phrug mi skyong bar// cha lugs gang byung smyon pa'i spyod pa yis// ja sogs 'dod yon du ma'i bcud len par// nya bzhin thogs med bgrod pa'i gar mkhan po// ta thā ga ta sman pa'i rgyal po yis// tha dad nad la so sor sman bshad kyang*// da lta ma nu'i thang las mi sbyin par// na med de yis nad la cang phan nam// pa por 'dod pa'i pha ma'i gces phrug kun// pha rol drang nas drub du bsnyags pa rnams// ba lang khyu ltar yon tan mi slob par// ma lus bor ba khyed kyis cang phod dam// tsa na'i 'bru tsam ril chung gsum byin nas// tsha tsha rngam rngam bka' bkyon bgrang sher bcas// dza dza hūm̐ hūm̐ drag sngags sgrog pa 'di// wa dmar slob dpon su yi khyad chos yin// zha mo dbyar dgun med par dom ra gsol// za ma bzang ngan khyad med ro snyoms rol// 'a le 'a ler nad par brnyas bcos byed// ya rabs 'di 'dra'i sku spyod ngo mtshar che// rwa ltar gyong ba'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs// la phug sgog pa lta bur zhal dug tsha// sha za lta bur ham pas stong gsum bzhes// sa steng nor gyis khengs kyang chog shes bral// ha ha med kyang ku re rkyal ga'i tshul// a la la ba'i 'tsho byed skar ma la// 'khor zhag phyi nas 'gyangs pa'i gzhi len la// ka smad sum cu'i rnam thar gsol 'debs phul/
zhus shing dag go/ maṅga laṃ//

༈/ nu)chab shog gi skor las thog mar spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa dpal chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po la phul ba/ ༈ ༄// gang sku mtshan pes rab tu spras shing zhing khams rgya mtshor sprul sku snang brnyan mtha' dag ston mdzad cing*// gang gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan skal bzang 'gro la dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston spel mkhas pa'i// gang thugs stong nyid snying rje'i ye shes chen pos gdul bya so so'i khams la snyoms 'jug pa// gang de rgyal dbang mchog gi rnam 'phrul theg gsum lam gyi ston pa gcig pu'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// ces mchod par brjod de/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus pa kun gyi 'byung gnas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i zhabs kyi pad mo la/ dngos po kun gyi phyag byas te zhu ba/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang mchog gi nye lam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid rim sogs zab rgyas kyi chos char 'bebs par mdzad de skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag gi re ba yongs su bskong nas/ nye dus su phyi nang gzhan sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i ting 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs bzhin bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ 'di phyogs su'ang nyer 'tshe med ngos dbyar chos la/ dgongs gcig dang gzhi byes nyung bsdus la lnga ldan myong khrid du bshad cing*/ gtsug lag khang sku 'bum dang bcas pa'i zhig gsos phal cher grub pa tsam dang*/ thun mtshams su kha tas khyab par yang yod lags/ snron gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa'i tshes kyi lang tsho yongs su gsal ba la/ thog kha gser khang nas zhu yig ༈ pu)spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du zhu lan du phul ba/ ༈ gzhal du med pa'i tshogs gnyis rlabs chen mngon du gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// thugs rje chen pos mdzad 'phrin rnam par dkar ba'i 'od stong dra ba can// phan bde'i bsgrod pa bzang po skye dgu'i mkha' la rtag 'char ba'i// 'dren mchog nam mkha'i nor bu nyer 'tshe'i phyogs las rgyal gyur cig

/ces mchod par brjod nas/ lus can kun gyi dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa/ mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i zhabs kyi pad mo mchog tu yangs pa'i drung du/ lan gcig ma yin par gus pa chen pos zhu ba/ bka' shog rin po che 'di phyir phun tshogs mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dngul sku brkyang khru gang pa/ rin po che 'phra rgyan du mas spras pa'i sku byad lta bas mi ngoms pa'i bzo rigs khyad par du 'phags pas gtsos pa'i gnang sbyin dgu tshan gsum/ khra ma zur gsal dang bcas pa phebs pa bka' drin mchog tu bskyangs/ 'di na'ang snga gong mtshams kyi rnam pa zla sbrel byas pa bar chad med par grol nas/ da lta gzhi byes kha shas la 'dod chos byed bzhin par yod/ zhabs drung rin po ches thugs brtse ba kho na'i bka' lung ji ltar phebs pa rnams la yid dam du bgyid pa yod lags pa/ dgongs yul rin po cher bzhugs pa dang*/ slar yang thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyi brtse ba mi lhod pa dang*/ gang ci'i phebs 'os rim pas mkhyen/ da lan 'bul ba mdzes byed 'bul bar/ 'phrin las rgya mtsho grogs mched btang ba bzhin zhib cha ngag tu 'bul/ sa ga zla ba'i phyogs snga ba'i rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ thog kha gser khang nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig ༈ phu)rgya nag rgyal pos las ka gnang dus brda lan phul ba'i zhu zhig ༈ gong ma mi'i dbang po chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i drung du/ 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal pos/ lus ngag yid gsum phyag byas te/ spos bsregs te zhu ba/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal po mi yi bdag po rim pas gdan sa chen po gser gyi khri la bzhugs nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur ba nas gzung te/ rgyal rabs rim pa nas rim par rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa rlabs che zhing bsam gyis mi khyab/
