de yang spyir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i gus pa mnga' bas/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang gus pas mchod pa'i zhing du mdzad cing*/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'di nyid bde zhing*/ sems can thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis dang bde legs kyi phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang*/ khyad par nged 'bri gung pa'i mes po dang*/ khu bo rim pas bar ma chad par rten 'brel bzang po shugs kyis/ gong ma rta'i ming yun la chos kyi rgyal po gser gyi khri la zhabs bkod/ sku'i bsod nams gnam lta bur khyab/ thugs rje'i 'od zer nyi zla ltar gsal bas/ nged kyi yang mes po don grub rgyal po la/ kon ting hu'i tshi'i tsi kya'i ta'i gu'i shri'i las ka don bzang po shar ba'i 'ja' sa/ ka'u ming*/ gser gyi tham ka chen mo la sogs kyi phyi nang gi gnang sbyin gyi dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang*/ lung bzang po bsgrags shing*/ yang bdag gi mes po/ rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams la nan tan thugs la btags pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas/ chen ka'u wang gi 'ja' sa ka'u ming*/ dam ka dang thu shu phyi nang gi gnang sbyin sogs bka' drin gyis legs par bskyangs pa la tshad gzung ma mchis/ da lam/ bdag gi khu bo kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ gong gi las ka brgyud pas 'dzin cing shes pa 'os pa'i don gyis/ chen kya'u wang gi las ka'i 'ja' sa/ ka'u ming*/ de'i gnang sbyin dang bcas pa/ lung gi mngags pa'i gser yig pa/ cing shri ga yi'u phya'u g.yi rtsad po rgyal mtshan/ dhu shri du khang rin chen bzang po dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ mthon ti ljang khra yug cig yang mthon ti sngo khra yu sne tshang ba gcig gos sngon gser btags pa'i mdun rgyab khi ling gzugs yod pa'i yug cig gos pa'i ?sa'i dri ljang gu gser btags pa'i mdun rgyab khi ling gzugs yod pa'i yug gcig

go ta hun dmar po ri mo med pa'i yug gnyis/ gos lcags nag me tog med pa gnyis/ gos sa'i ljang gu ri mo med pa yug gnyis/ gos sol kha me tog med pa yug gnyis/ dar yug mu dmar po yug drug sngo skya yug bzhi/ snam sbyar dang gos zas bubs gcig sna bdun la/ gos ta'i hun gser btags pa'i gnam gyi me tog sprin rin po che brgyad spras gdan la nyi shu lnga ur la me tog yod pa'i snam sbyar/ ta'i hun gser btang ma'i phy-i gong ma sbyar ma gcig dmar skya ri mo yod pa'i sham mthu ma srin ma gcig zhin tha'u hun gyi sha 'gag sbyar ma gcig/ chen tha'u hun ther li man sna gcig ta'i hun gser btags pa'i phyam tshe sbyar ma gcig bar bar du gser btags pa'i ljang gu me tog yod pa'i spang khebs sbyar ma gcig ta'i hun ser po rte shabs phyi nang rten khebs gnyis/ gos lcags nag gi ska rags gcig lham 'bob rang sor ma gcig thang theb wa dang ma gcig chu shel 'phreng ba skor gcig ja phor gnyis/ ting shags cha gcig maṇ+ḍal gcig ban tshang ba ska rags/ rte shabs ma gnyis/ tsan dan sdum gcig rnams kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas pa 'dir phebs na'ang*/ bdag gi khu bo phag gi lo la zhing gzhan du gshegs/ de'i rjes su/ tsha bo rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po bdag yod pa la/ chu pho 'brug lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gcig gi nyin 'phrod pa thugs la btags/ lus sems dga' spro dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ lung la bkur ti chen po bgyis shing bsgrogs/ lhag par gus pas nyin mtshan du bka' drin bsams/ drin lan gyi sems bzang po nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu ma brjed pas/ sems can rnams byams pas bskyangs/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal po dgung lo khri tsho khri tsho zhabs brtan cing*/ rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa mtha' yas su rgyas pa la/ bar chad kyis mi rdzi ba'i smon lam bzang po 'debs pa la/ dkon mchog gsum dang/ khyad par du dge 'dun khri khrag gi grangs la bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa'i dge legs dang*/

lung bzang po gdan drangs pa'i gser yig pa rnams la/ bsu ba dang 'phral chas/ zhabs tog bkur sti sogs/ sngar bsrol gang 'dug khur du blangs te bsgrubs lags pas/ da yang*/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal pos thugs la btags na/ khu bo kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i las ka de dag bdag tsha bo/ rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po la spo bar 'os pa bzhin/ 'ja' sa dang*/ ka'u ming gsar du brje ba dang*/ 'dir yod pa'i lag rtags gzung mchog pa'i lung bzang po ji ltar thugs la 'dogs/ gong ma mi'i bdag po sa'i bdag po chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i sku'i bsod nams mkhyen/ ces pa'i don dang*/ da lam/ chen kya'u wang gi las ka phebs pa'i bka' drin gyi 'bul bar/ ston pa'i gser sku drug bde mchog gi sku gnyis/ tshe dpag med kyi sku gnyis gdung rten bal bzo ma bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel brgya phrag gcig ba so'i za ma tog dang bcas pa/ rigs lnga'i thang ka bse ru bzang ba che chung gnyis/ ngar sgong gnyis/ bag le bubs/ khyad ras dmar po bsgril ma/ snam bu skyer kha/ dmar po/ sum snam smug po dkar po/ srab mo ngur kha gnyis/ spos dkar ltang*/ gu gul ltang*/ ser tshur ltang*/ tsha la ltang*/ ral gri gnyis/ rmog gnyis/ khrab dom 'dzab ma gnyis rnams kyi gtsos pa 'bul zhing*/ nga rang lus kyi tshab du phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ slad nas gong du zhus pa'i don gyi/ lung gnang sbyin bzang po zhu bar/ 'bul dpon ston pa rgyal mtshan rgan gzhon gyi gtsos pa'i dpon g.yog brgya phrag gcig btang ba/ sngar bsrol ltar thugs la 'dogs pa/ gong ma lha mi'i dbang po chos kyi rgyal po'i sku'i bsod nams mkhyen/ sbrul lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes/ ༈ bu)dpon sa gong ma chen po la phul ba/ ༈ lha gzigs rin chen rigs las yongs grub bsod nams mngon par mtho ba'i ri dbang can// phun tshogs yon tan bdun ldan ri gling gis spras nges legs rol mtshos yongs bskor zhing*/

khrims gnyis 'od stong mchog tu rgyas pa'i nyi zlas rtag tu mdzes byed pa// gong ma sa 'dzin dbang po gang de nyer 'tshe'i rlung gi g.yo bar ma gyur cig ces shis pa brjod do// deng gi dus/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'phrin las bzang po'i mu khyud kyi mdzes shing*/ bka' khrims gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mnga' dbang chen pos/ phas rgol ngan pa'i brag ri phye mar gzhil la thogs pa med par bzhugs pa bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa lags/ 'di na'ang rim gnyis gong 'phel nas/ gzhan phan gang yong la brtson pa mi lhod par yod/ skabs bab du gsol ba/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde thabs su bskyangs nas/ mnga' 'bangs 'jam dar bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod chog pa'i bka' drin stsol/ ces zhib par ngag gi lam las 'bul/ dus tshes rnam par dge ba la phul ba chos 'byung du gyur cig ༈ mu)chos rje karma pa kong rta bar na bzhugs dus phul ba/ ༈ e ma srid gsum bde 'byung gi// gtsug na rol mkhas thugs rje'i cha// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin gangs can gyi// pad mo'i dpung gnyen gang de'i drung*// deng dus nyid sku'i cha shas gter// phrag dog lha min lag pa yis// nam yang sgrib pa med bzhin du// bsdu dngos rnam bzhi'i 'od zer gyis// mkhas mangs rgyu skar dang bcas pa// thub bstan mkha' la cher rgyas shing*// snyan grags kun nas 'phros pa spro// nged kyang 'byung ba cha snyoms shing*// 'phral du dge ba gang 'byor dang*// bstan la mos blo ma dor tsam// skabs der shar phyogs rgyal po che// sems pa'i sprul pa gang des kyang*// chos la dbang ba'i phyag rgya can// las ka'i bka' rtags gdan drangs pa'i// pho nya mang po mngags gyur te// lung dang mthun pa'i sri zhu yis// ma rmongs 'jig rten snang ngo ru// kho bo snyan grags khri la bkod// 'di yang thub bstan 'phel phyir bsngo// khyed sku gdul bya'i mig gcig po// yun du zhabs brtan 'phrin las kyi// sgo mo brgyad stong mang po 'di// mi 'phyol phyed par dang mdzad 'os// rmongs pa nges shes skyed gyur pa'i// sprul pa bye ba mtha' yas pa// sdom byed gang yin dbye byos mdzod// de ltar gyur na sor mo bcur/

mnyam du sbyar ba'i rol rtse ni// khyod zhabs gang du 'khod gyur la// bdag yid dad pa'i kun dgar spyod// phebs par smra dang yid bcug pa'i// zlos gar dang du len pa legs// tshig sbyor spangs pa'i zhu mchid kyi// pho nya bai dūr 'dzin ma la// spyan zur snang brnyan 'char rten du// rab dkar dri med mtha' gru mnyam// dang ba'i phyag rgyas spras tai phul// dpyid kyi dga' ba gsum pa la// mtshe'u kha nas phul ba dge/ ༈ tsu)rig 'dzin chen po mnga' ris ba la phul ba/ ༈ dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung tshig rdo rje'i bka'// tshe bdag che mchog sku dang lhan cig tu// sprang po'i spyi gtsug mi 'bral pad+mo'i rtser// rab son dga' ba'i 'dab ma phyogs kun g.yo// drin chen mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' byung tshe// sprang po'i gnas tshul cung zad mchid gsol na// ma hā gu ru'i thugs kyis mi khrel zhing*// gzhan la mi 'khyar bka' yi sgo dbye gsol// smon lam shugs dang ldan pa'i lha sras nga*// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal mthong gsung thos shing*// mnga' 'bangs chos kyi legs bskyangs smon lam mthus// bod yul dbus 'dir nying mtshams yang yang sbyar// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba cung zad bgyis// khyad par 'bri gung sa phyogs 'di nyid du// chos kyi brgyud 'dzin rat+na'i ming 'dzin pa// da res grangs su bgrangs pa gnyis su mchis// bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gsang sngags la// mos pa cung zad thob tshul de ltar lags// skye ba 'dir yang dam chos spyad bya zhing*// sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa'i thabs mthong na// lus srog ltos med bgyid pa'i blo mchis kyang*// chos pa rnams kyang rtags tsam 'dzin pa tsam// mi nag skye bo khrel med sdig la spyod// snying nas dam chos byed pa nyin skar tsam// bdag nyid chos spyod pa'ang bdud dbang gyur// 'di 'dra'i dus byung sprang po bya thabs zad// 'khor bar gnas tshul da lta phan gyis chog

/gzhan don mthong thos dran 'grongs smon lam bya// tshe lhag skye ba khams kyi phyogs su sbyong*// da lta zhus pa'i dam chos blangs byas te// 'dun pa 'di dag rdzogs par bya'am snyam// tshig gi tha mar yi ger bris pa lags// 'on kyang sngon gyi smon lam dbang btsan te// rje btsun nyid kyang bya bral bcud bzung zhing*// nyi ma nub khar na ning mtshe'u khar phebs// bdag gi dbang skal chos kyi bka' drin stsal// 'di don zhib par rgyal po bka' thang 'tshal// drin can rje yi dgongs pa de ltar lags// da ni slad nas zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul// rdo rje'i sku yang so bdun lo ru nye// 'di yang bdag sems snang ba cung ma mgu// mya ngan mi 'da' bka' yis bzhes pa dang*// rgyal po bka'i thang yig ji ltar bar// bdag gi dam chos dbang skal gang 'dug rnams// lo bdun nang tshun bdag la rtsol ba dang*// sbas yul dbye tshe bdag la bka' gnang ba'i// bka' yi zhal bzhes 'di gsum stsol ba na// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par spro// de bzhin byung na bdag kyang lung bstan bzhin// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'phrin las skra mi 'breg /lung bstan yod pa'i gnas gsum sgo mo 'byed// dam ldan 'dren cing dam med 'brel pa 'jog /khyad par drag po sngags kyi 'dul dus 'dir// bsnyen sgrub tshad 'byin las bzhi'i 'khor lo skor// rje btsun rnams dang 'bral med yid re dga'// dag pa'i zhing mchog rnams su gar yang bsgyur// zhes pa'i zhu tshig mdo gsum sgril ba 'di// mos pa'i yid kyi snying gtam ji lta'i tshul// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du 'bul// dgai des 'khor 'das mnyam nyid lhun rdzogs shog ༈ tshu)'brug pa dbon rin po che la zhu lan/ ༈ bcom ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje yi// rnal 'byor nā ro ta pa zhes// skye dgu'i dpal 'byor gcig pu pa'i// rigs bzang ring lugs mnga' dbang can// gang de'i chab shog legs bshad kyi// 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba ni// dar dkar mtha' gru la mnyam zhing*// sham kha dbyibs legs lta na sdug

/dri med ras dkar chung ring ba// ja bzang skyes dang bcas pa spro// bka' brgyud shing rta'i srol 'byed ni// grub brnyes gong ma'i ring lugs pa// bka' gsal ji ltar phebs pa bzhin// gus pa'i sti stang bgyi ba lags// da res skyes lan mdzes byed du// bkra shis kha btags dri med dang*// nre tra ma rgad mdangs ldan pa// shing lo'i ltung bar bcas te phul// slar yang don gzhan rlabs po che// phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du// dbyar gyi bkod ma'i chu bo bzhin// phan pa phun tshogs cher rgyas nas// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ni// rim pa bzhin du stsol bar 'tshal// da lta 'tsher nas bris pa dge ༈dzu)rgya ston chos rje nam mkha'i zhu lan/ ༈ rje btsun mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma rnams// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis mi 'bral bstod// dus mtha'i sprang po rat+na'i ming can la// mkhyen brtse'i spyan gyis yun du gzigs nas kyang*// bsam pa mthar phyin smon lam 'grub gyur cing*// bka' brgyud rin chen rigs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// rgya ston kun mkhyen rje yi rigs kyi dbon// bstan 'dzin chen po nam mkha'i mtshan 'chang bas// slad nas skul ba'i bka' mchid ngo ma chog /bdag nyid thos dang bsam pas rgyud dben zhing*// bsgom byung rtogs pa'i rtsal dang mi ldan pas// 'di lta'i nges pa 'bul bar mi spobs kyang*// 'khrul snang bden 'dzin mkhan des 'di skad lo// bdag ni skye ba 'di gong sgom pa zhes// rat+na'i ming yin nyid kyang 'di gong gi /mtshan ni gang ga nyid dang ldan par go /bdag ni skye ba 'di nyid sbas pa'i yul// 'bras mo gshongs su slebs nas mchog bsgrubs na// lus 'di mi 'jog 'od kyi sku ru yal// 'di la bar chad mang bar mchis gyur pas// bya bral brtul zhugs spyod cing gnas pa na// lnga bcu rtsa drug lo la bar chod tshe// de las rgal tshe bdud dbang ma gyur na// bod du sdod pa'i lo ni nga brgyad tshad// gter ston rten 'brel 'grig na bdun cur 'tsho// de las 'das nas mngon dga'i zhing khams su// rgyal ba klong yangs zhes pa sangs rgyas tshul// 'brel ba'i 'khor yang byang sems 'bum phrag gsum// nyid kyang sku tshe nga brgyad 'tsho tshod la// 'brug gi lo la bar chad shin tu che// de dus nyid la phul ba'i tshe sgrub dang*// gu ru pad+ma'i gsang sgrub dam par 'bad// srog blu la sogs dge phyogs dpag med bsgrub// de las sgrol na skag las yongs thar zhing*// sku tshe'i tshad las ring bar thub par mngon// 'di 'og myang 'das rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul// nyan thos chos la thos pa mchog mnga' zhing*// phyis nas gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bai bhu ti pa'i mtshan can nga brgyad 'tsho// 'di yang smon lam stobs kyi 'phros yin pas// bden rdzun mkhan des bshad pa thugs la gzung*// de nyid 'das nas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing*// der ni spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs kyang*// byang sems tshul 'dzin dgongs pa'i ngang du bzhugs// nyid kyi gcung ni dgung lo drug cu'i tshad// bar chad kyang ni skag thogs so sor yod// sku rim las kyang tshe yi sgrub pa gces// bsod nams ldan zhing rang dbang chod gyur na// lugs gnyis bstan pa'i bya ba 'dzin gyur yang*// nang mi mthun dang 'bangs kyi gyen log gi

/rten 'brel mchis pas drag sngags bsgrub pa gces// mos gus dran pa'i gsol 'debs bris pa'i rjes// bdag la bzang ngan gyur pa'i dug gi gtses// gter sgrom gnas khog rmu zam steng der ni// sgrub pa'i mtshams bcad rlung gi nyams len byas// zhag gsum steng der nad ni dud kha'i mdog /'ja' tshon 'khyil zhing snod kyang 'jig par gyur// de nas grol rjes rdo leb yi ge āḥ /brag gi logs la yig 'bru dmar po rnams// mthong ba da lta kun gyis mjal bar yod// shing mo lug lo hor zla gsum pa la// khams phyogs 'gro ba'i mdun pa byas pa'i tshe// mi nag seng gdong mang pos 'dud pa rmis// rim gyis bteg nas rong chung mdor sleb dus// rmi ltas 'tshub che lha rir tshong sa bcom// bdag cag rnams dang dmar tsha'i dmag dang thug /de dus drang srong ra hus zor ba thogs// nam mkha'i mthongs su brgyug pa yud tsam mthong*// de nas rim gyis rmir te 'chis lung brgyud// rgyal shod slebs tshe 'ja' dkar shar ba na// rmi ltas byung tshul shog dril zur du yod// zhes pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub 'ja' dkar shar ba mthong bas/ ci 'dra'i ltas yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom du gyur pa'i ngang nyid du gnyid pa'i 'khrul snang du/ bdag gi sgar ltag tu chos khri gsar du brtsegs pa'i steng du gnas snang pa'i 'khor du/ chos rgyal mtshan min pa'i ngo shes pa'i mi gang mi 'dug sa phyogs de'i mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i mi skya ser mang ba dang*/ dud 'gro dang bya'i mgo brnyan yod pa mang po tshogs snang ba'i tshe/ de rnams la bdag gi chos shig 'chad pa'i lugs su 'dug kyang*/ gdug rtsub che ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma byed par snang*/ de'i tshe nub phyogs nam mkha'i mthongs 'chil rong gi thad nas/ 'od zer dkar po 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par gsal ba zhig shar byung ba'i lam la brten/ bu mo lha rdzas kyi rgyan cha can dpon g.yog gi tshul du gsum byung bas/

bdag la g.yon phyogs na bskor ba gsum dang*/ mdun du mgo gug gug pa lan gsum byed par snang ba la/ khrom pa rnams ha las pa'i tshul du bsu ba dang*/ ldang ba gus phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ byin rlabs kyang zhu bar gnang*/ de nas bu mo che ba des/ bdag la shel dkar gyi mchod rten bang rim gsum pa/ bum pa'i dbus su kun nas gsol ba'i rang bsrel gyis spras pa zhig sbyin nas 'di skad gsung ngo*// e ma ho/ rdo rje gsum la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa'i// sngags kyi dbang phyug rgyal po 'dir byon nam// skyon bral lus la bslab gsum yongs rdzogs pa'i// 'dul 'dzin khrims kyi rgyal po 'dir byon nam// dgos dgu phun tshogs 'bras bu yongs rdzogs pa'i// dpag bsam shing gi rgyal po 'dir byon nam// zhes snyan pa'i ngag gis gsung ba la/ bdag gis 'di skad ces glur blangs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni hūm̐/ rang bzhin dbyings las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor shar/ thugs rje'i zer lam snang gsal la brgyud de// lha yi bu mo mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan ma// bran ldan mdzes pa'i snyan tshig gsung ba lags// nyam chung snying med mkhos zhan bya mang po// 'jig rten g.yeng chos dre bar chud pa'i mi// sprang chung rat+na'i ming yang 'dir mchis so// khyed cag yul phyogs gang nas byon pa yin// 'dir ni ji snyed zhib par brda khrol 'tshal// zhes smras pas/ ༈ wu)ri bo che nas ja 'dren dang gdan 'dren byung ba'i zhu lan sngo rgyal brag rtsa nas phul ba/ ༈ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni hrīḥhūm̐ sarba sidhi pha la hūm̐/ dus bzhi mnyam nyid bde chen mkha' klong las// ye shes rol pa'i gar gyi nyams dgur gsal// 'phrin las tsha zer dra ba'i 'od 'phro gang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma gang des bde legs stsol// zhes shis pa brjod de/ bka' brgyud bstan pa'i lha lam yangs par zab don rdo rje snying po mchog gi bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa rdzogs pa chen po'i rta bdun gyi dbang po/

log par rtog pa'i mun sprin gyi dri mas mi spyod pa'i/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha lam chas cher gsal bar mdzad pa gang de nyid kyis/ legs par bshad pa'i don bzang bcud kyis gdams pa'i skyes dang bcas pa/ bla ma bsod nams grub dpon slob kyis 'byor ba dang*/ deng gi dus rdo rje gsum gyi sku la nyer 'tshe'i dri bzhon gyi ser bu mi ldang zhing*/ khrims gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo 'bar bas phal gyi 'tshe ba du ma'i tshogs ring du 'byer bar mdzad cing*/ rang srid dkar po'i sde 'bangs su bcas pa rab tu rgyas par gyur zhes sgra dbyangs ring nas thos/ bdag kyang yid la dga' ba ches cher rgyas par gyur/ nged cag rnams kyang 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la mi mthun pa'i 'tshe ba med par/ khyad chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i yig sna rnams spar du bsgrub pa dang*/ gong ma rgyal po'i lung gi gnang sbyin la gzhi byas pa'i/ skyob pa nyid kyi rnam thar 'bur rkos grub pa rnams kyi yon la phan pa'i dge bskul la dmigs/ lho byang rnams su rim pas son pas/ slad nas zla rgya yan gyi dgon gnas rnams su ngos kyi slebs pa'i 'brel pa byas rim gyis 'gro bar yod pas/ slad ma yang bstan pa rin po spyi dang*/ bye brag gi bya ba la 'phel rgyas mdzad pa dang*/ snyoms las pa bdag da lta lan mjal bar rngo ma thogs pas/ skyon yon ngag gi lam nas gsal ba ltar/ slad nas mjal ba'i smon lam zhu zhing*/ skyes lan bkris kha btags cha mdzes skyer kha legs pa rgya 'byar mchis/ ༈ zhu)rngod stod gangs shongs nas rgya ston chos rje'i zhu lan/ ༈ rnam dkar dad pa'i nam mkha' khyon yangs nas// brtse phrin legs par bsnyen pa'i chab yig ni// pho nya'i lag gi rgyal mtshan ltar bsgrengs te// phyogs 'dir dpal dang bzang po'i mchid son pas// char 'dod dbyar gyi 'brug sgra thos pa bzhin// bdag blo'i pad mo dag kyang 'dzum pa skyes// de tshe bdag cag 'dus pa dang bcas nas// rta bdun 'gros bzhin gling bzhi'i mun pa bsal// bden gnyis smra ba'i nyin mor byas pa gang*// dus kyi 'khrug long rtsod pa rab zhi nas// byams chen bstan shar sngon gyi bskal bzang zhing*// dga' mgur spyod pa'i tshul la rab tu gnas// dbyar yang dbyar dus lo gsar 'dzum pa bzhin// ring por mi thogs ri bong 'dzin gzugs can// cha shas dbyings su cung zad gsal ba na// bsod nams rtsibs stong phan bde'i mu khyud can// bdag lus shing rta theg chen lam zhugs te// dal gyis shar phyogs gling der khad nye bar// bgrod par byed kyi khyod kyi rnam dkar gyi// dad pa'i gyad kyis bsnyen par bgyi zhes pa'ang*// dus dang gnas skabs pho nyas ngag sgo ltar// /rnam bkra mkhyen pa'i dpal gyis dpyod par mdzod// rngod stod gangs shod kyi sgar nas bris pa dge legs su gyur cig

༈ zu)sde stengs sgar du bzhugs dus rgya ston chos rje'i zhu lan/ ༈ gang gi gsung bris rnam par snyan sgrar ldan pa// don ldan tshig gi brjod pa dang bcas te// pho nya brtson pa'i 'dab rtsal bskyod bzhin du// bdag yid rol mtshor rab tu btsan par gyur// pha yul 'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs nas// mda'i grangs ldan pho nyas 'dir son tshe// 'dir 'khod skye bo 'dus pa thams cad kyi// dga' bas 'dur zhing ji ltar yod mnyam pas// yid gnyis the tshom bcas par gyur 'dug kyang*// ngag dang yi ge'i lam kun mthun gyur pas// yul byings bde zhing sgos kyang bde'o zhes// da lta'i lugs la skad cha 'jam par 'dug /zhib kyis gnas tshul bka' gros rim gyis byed// chos lung de ring dgongs nas 'bul bar byed// g.yo mi nus kyang rab rgyu'i cho 'phrul can// yid lus da lta'i 'phrul gyis zhabs de ni// mdangs nang bsnyun pa'i tshul gyis ma btses sam// drang po'i gsung gi snang bar rab stsol cig /nged kyi slob dpon dgong kha'i nyi ma de// zhag 'ga' sgar du bzhugs pa legs gyur pas// dbu phibs dang bcas phebs pa'i 'khos kyang 'tshal/ ༈ 'u)gdan sa chen po 'bri gung mthil gyi tshogs pa spyi la khams nas zhu lan/ ༈ oṃ swa sti sidham// spangs dang ye shes phun sum tshogs gyur pas// rang gzhan don rdzogs mnyam med lha yi lha// rab byung ston pa don dam mchog gi sku// skyob pa yab sras dad pa'i yid mtshor bsten// rgyal ba'i mdo dang rgyud sde du ma nas// lan gcig min par lung du bstan gyur pa'i// dpal ldan 'bri gung mthil ?thel zhes grags pa na// rim gnyis don la dbang bsgyur skyes chen dang*// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srol 'dzin dge ba'i bshes// zhing gi mchog gyur dge 'dun rgya mtsho la// sa mtha'i san ta rat+na'i ming 'dzin pas// rab tu dang ba'i yid kyis 'di skad springs// deng tshe 'dus pa rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams// rnam dkar dge ba'i rgyun gyi lha lam la// ring lugs bstan pa'i nyi 'od rab 'bar bas// nyes tshogs mun pa'i 'ching bas dben no zhes// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i ngang mo ni// sdebs legs tshig gis 'dab ma bskyod bzhin du// 'tshe bral nam mkhar bgrod par gyur ldan pas// bde chen steng zhes bya ba'i dben gnas su// son par gyur tshe yid kyi pad mo ni// dga' bas dri bzhon 'dab ma bskyod pa bzhin// spro ba'i yid kyi ge sar bgod par gyur// kho bo cag kyang 'dus par bcas pa kun// nyer 'tshes dben zhing bde bar rgyu bzhin du// rin chen bstan la mos blo ma dor tsam// sngon gyi grub chen du mas bsten pa'i gzhi// zla dgon dang ni gnas chen 'di rnams su// rim gyis 'byor tshe so sor rigs kyi dbon// chos kyi sras chen dam par gyur pa rnams// rang rang sde 'khor bcas pa kun gyis kyang*// dad pa'i 'dzin ma sbyin ma'i 'bras bu brgyan// dngos cag yid kyi bang mdzod rab tu gtams// smin grol lam gyi gdams pas mtshams sbyar te// gnas dus kun tu dge ba'i sa bon bzhag

/slad kyi mchid gsol 'di ltar 'bul gyis gson// kho bo nyam chung dus mtha'i ldom bu pa// lugs gnyis bya ba'i las kyi khur bor zhing*// nges med gnas dang gyi nas 'tsho ba la// lo zla'i yun gyis skrag pa ma mchis pas// nges nges gtan tshigs bdag la med na'ang*// myur du slebs par gyis zhes gsung gis bskul// snyom las pa'ang myur du slebs par smon// des na'ang rkyen dbang 'di yi kha bsgyur bas// dos khal ma rgan 'di rnams nyam chung zhing*// kun kyang pha rol lam chen bsnyeg par rings// myur gyis bgrod blo skabs kyi dben par go /de lta na yang 'bad pa'i lcag gis bskul// rim gyis bgrod de sleb par smon pa lags// skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta ste// sangs rgyas bstan rtsa sdom gsum gser gyi ri// nyes rul phung po nam yang mi gos gsol// bshad sgrub bstan pa thar pa'i lam po che// dus kun 'gag med yun du bgrod par gsol// lugs gnyis bstan khrims dge 'dun sde yi gzhi// nyams pa med cing 'tsho ba bston par gsol// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho bcas rnams kyis// 'dod don gsol ba'i bar chad kun zhi ba'i// bka' drin mchog de dus 'dir stsal du gsol// me pho spre'u lo zla ba bzhi pa yi// bzang po'i tshes la bde chen stengs nas dge ༈ yu)slon dpon legs pa'i mtshan can la/ ༈ gang gi rnam dkar dge ba'i ba dan ni// brtson 'grus mthun pa'i dri bzhon gyis bskul te// zhing 'di rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru bo che// ded dpon yid kyi 'dren pa can de rgyal// dbyangs 'char la sogs nor bu ri mo'i mchog /khyed thugs rgya mtsho che na gang gnas pa// bdag yid shing rtas drangs bar spro na yang*// zang zing g.yeng ba gu ṇa 'phrog pa'i bdud// gnas skabs mi bslu'i dbang gi brid pa bdag /dam pa khyed la 'brel pa de tsam las// sgyu lus 'di yi thob pa'i skabs ma mchis// 'on kyang rten 'brel sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di// mi bslu bden pa'i gshis kyis mtshams sbyar nas// dag pa'i zhing mchog rnams su mjal nas kyang*// theg chen chos kyi dga' ston bgyid par smon// gnas skabs nyid kyang sku'i 'tsho ba bzang*// rang gzhan don gyi 'bras bu rab rgyas shog

/ces 'dod gsol smon lam dang bcas pa 'di// slob dpon legs pa'i mtshan can la phul ba dge'o/ ༈ ru)zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa 'dzam gling rnam rgyal grags pa la phul ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa rgyal ba'i dbang po karma par grags pa/ khams gsum sems can rnams la dus las mi yol ba'i 'phrin las chen po'i snang bas 'dzin ma'i gzhi kun 'gengs/ khyad par snyigs dus 'jigs rung mi zad sdug bsngal 'jigs skyob zha yi brda ston grangs nges nyi shu gcig /srid gsum 'dren mchog zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'chang yongs su grags pa gang rnams rgyal gyur cig /chos dbyings 'gyur med bde chen ngang nyid las// longs spyod gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// sprul pa'i snang brnyan dkon mchog yan lag 'byung*// sku gsum dbyer med zhabs la gus par 'dud// 'dzam gling lha yi lam gyi khyon yangs par// rnam rgyal khang bzang rtse mo'i bar dag tu// grags pa'i rnga chen sgra yi bung ba'i dbyangs// zil gyis gnon pa'i rnga chen gang de rgyal// zhes gus pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba kun nas brgyan te/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i drung du/ gra 'bangs kyi tha chung gis rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis zhu ba/ nyid bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba'i cho 'phrul nye bar bzhes te// bdag sogs skye 'gro ma lus pa'i 'dren pa dam

par 'tsho zhing gzhes pa ni/ slad nas kyang bka' drin gyi snang ba chen pos yun du bskyangs par gyur lags/ mtshams kyi zhu bar/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku khyed lta bu ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mthu dang*/ rang gzhan ma lus pa'i don la thogs pa med pa'i stobs dang ldan pa nyid lags pa/ rang re dpon slob sku skye ba grangs du tsam nas da bar dpon slob kyi 'brel pa mchis/ da lta bdag lta bu las kyang*/ nges pa'i lam bzang gi sgo snang bar byed pa'i/ chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes par snang ba'i rten 'brel kyi sgo 'di yang ji lta bu/ da slad nas kyang 'di nas 'phos tshe/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du rgyal ba klong yangs su mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ slar sprul pa'i skyes mchog khyed nyid kyi bstan pa la bdag gi sprul pa'i zhabs 'bring sgrub par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel yod lags sam/ bdag kyang 'dir 'jig rten gyi g.yeng bas bar du mi gcod cing*/ rang yul sogs zhen 'khris dang ngo shes yul kun spangs nas/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu phyin te/ snying po'i gdams pa nyams len kho na bgyid na snyam pa 'di la bar chad 'byung ngam mi 'byung*/ yang na rang yul 'di nyid du dben par bgyid na/ bdag gzhan gyi tsher mar mi 'gyur zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi don ji ltar 'gyur/ bdag la tshe'i tshad ji tsam mchis/ de la bar chad yod med de rnams la/ bka' phebs shin tu gsal ba dang*/ sngon chad bla ma dang*/ lhag pa'i lha bka' srung gi gzigs snang*/ de rnams zhus pa yang lan du stsal ba sogs phebs pa rnams kyang bka' drin che/ da dung bdag cag rnams zhabs drung nas 'gro gdong tshun gsar du gang byung rnams kyang sba gsang med par bka' drin gyis brtse ba chen pos sngar kho na bzhin bskyang du gsol/ zhes pa 'di yang rat+na'i ming can bdag gis phul ba dge bar gyur cig ༈ lu)yangs pa can du sprul pa'i sku la phul ba/ ༈ rab yangs mkha' la spyod pa'i khri gdugs kyi// 'od zer kun nas 'phro bas reg gyur pas// brlan drod sa la skyes pa'i pad+mo dag

/bskrun zhing rgyas pa bung ba'i dga' ston ltar// rje btsun mchog gi gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul ni// mi zad 'khor lo'i snang byed rab 'phro bas// rmongs pa bdag lta'i yid mun kun bsal te// bstan la mos pa'i tshul 'di'ang khyed kyi drin// sngon yang skye ba du mar rjes gzung zhing*// da lta rten 'brel zab mos mtshams sbyar te// phyi nang srid zhi gang dang gang rnams su'ang*// rje btsun dam pa khyed dang mi 'bral smon// zhes pa'i dpe don smon pas mtshams sbyar te// slad kyi 'dod don cung zad gsol pa ni// rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma khyod nyid dang*// rmongs pa bdag cag sngon gyi gnas skabs su// dpon slob dag pa'i smon lam ji ltar 'brel// skye rabs 'phreng ba bka' gnang stsal du gsol/ khyad par snyigs dus log ltas g.yen bcos pa'i// dug lnga khong rgyas mi rnams the tshom can// mun sprul 'ching ba'i dbang du gyur gang dag /yid ches nges shes mtha' dag bskyed pa'i phyir// 'o skol dpon slob sku skye 'di yi gong*// ji ltar gyur pa'i sngon nas gsal ba zhig /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas bka' drin che// gser 'phyang hor zla lnga pa'i yar tshes la// rat+na'i ming can ldom bu pa yis zhus/ ༈ shu)karma pa 'bri gung du phebs dus ja 'dzin zhu yig phul ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzñā bhāḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje yi// 'phrin las cha shas ma lus yongs rdzogs shing*// rnam dkar dge ba'i 'od stong rab 'phro ba// dpal ldan rgyu skar bdag po de zhabs 'dud// tshogs gnyis lha yi lam la kun spyod cing*// don gnyis 'phrin las bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// skal bzang mun pa'i 'ching ba kun sel ba// 'dren mchog nyin mo'i mgon des gnang bar mdzod// bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub mngon gyur zhing*// bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms dpa' bo lha yi lha// sa gsum dregs ldan kun gyis spyis btud pa'i// rin chen thams cad mkhyen pa gang drung du// dus mtha'i btsun pa wang gis ming 'dzin pas// gcam bu min par sgo gsum dang ba yis// gus par ldan pa'i thal mo zung sbyar te// mos pa'i yid kyis zhu mchid 'di ltar 'bul/

khyed sku thugs rje'i nyi dkyil rab 'bar ba// nyer 'tshe chu 'dzin sgrib pas ring dben zhing*// shar phyogs kong yul ri bo'i spo las 'thon// grub pa'i sti gnas 'bri gung pad tshal sogs// rim par brgyud de dbus gtsang dag pa'i mkhar// snang bar 'gyur zhes ring nas snyan pa 'di// dbyar gyi rnga sgra ji bzhin rna bar son// de tshe phyogs su gnas pa'i ldom bu pa'ang*// rig pa'i khye'u chung 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan zh-ing*// myur ba'i gom pa gang gi zhing der ni// rab tu dga' ba'i gar byas son gyur te// deng dus rje btsun khyed ni srid zhi'i mgon// dus las mi yol thugs brtses nyer gzung ste// gdul bya gling bzhi'i mkha' la kun mdzes pa// bka' drin che zhes shis pa brjod par mnyam/ kho bo cag kyang kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i lus// 'byung bzhi g.yo ba'i nad 'tshe las dben zhing*// 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas nas rim gyis bteg /gar dbang mchog gi zhabs kyi bcags gyur cing*// chos 'khor skor te mya ngan 'das pa'i zhing*// bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa der// gtso bor dngul gdung rin chen mchod pa'i zhing*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bsod nams bsag yul der// mchod pa'i bye brag gyi na tsam gyis mchod// der 'dus tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dus pa la// dga' ston skyes kyi bya ba rnams kyang bsgrubs// slad nas stod lung bde chen skyed tshal du// mchog gi sprul sku rnam rgyal grags pa zhes// phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i gdul bya'i chu snod du// snang bar gyur pa'i nyin byed gang de la// gus pa'i phyag dang zang zing rdzas kyis mchod// slad nas rgyal ba'i bka' lung man ngag las// ji ltar thos pa'i gdams pa dbang lung khrid// cung zad 'bul bar dam bcas 'khod gyur pa// zhing der dngos su mjal bar ma gyur na'ang*// rten 'brel rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i smon lam gyis// myur du mjal zhing brtse bas bskyangs du gsol// zhes pa'i zhu don gsol bar pho nya bar// grags pa'i ming can mngags pa'i ngag dang ni// lag las rgyud de 'bul ba'i brda mtshon du// bcu tshan gsum gyi grangs yig logs gsal ltar// 'bul ba 'dis mtshon 'gro kun dge ba ni// byas dang byed 'gyur bgyid bzhin yod pa'i dge// 'gro kun rnam mkhyen thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// durmu kha zhes me pho spre'u'i lo// hor zla bcu gnyis pa yi yar tshes la// stod lung bde chen sgar nas phul bas dge

༈ su)yang chos rje karma pa la yangs pa can nas phul ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti sidham/ dus gsum mkhyen brtse'i lus stobs rab rgyas shing*// sa gsum gangs ri'i zhing 'dir spro ba can// bslab gsum drang nges chos kyi nga ro yis// dug gsum ri dwags skrag byed gdong lnga rgyal// skyabs mchog zla bral mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku// zab yangs chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs// gang de mchog ldan rgyal ba de yi drung*// byang phyogs gnas pa'i bya bral rat+na yis/ mos ldan gdung ba'i dbyangs kyang 'di ltar zhu// bka' yig don bzang skyes kyi gnang sbyin bcas// rim gyis phyogs 'dir phebs pa'i spro ba dang*// nyid sku rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas// zab gsal ting 'dzin ngang las mi g.yo zhing*// rgyal bas lung bstan tsa ma rī yi gnas// der 'khod mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya'i gzhir// gzugs sku'i sprin las dam chos char rtsal te// skal ldan dge ba'i 'bras tshogs rgyas zhes thos// kye ma rje btsun rnam 'dren rgyal kun rje// rang gzhan don rdzogs sku gsum bdag nyid mchog /khyod ni skye dgu'i dpal mgon dam pa ste// ji ltar bstan pa'i 'phrul la mos pa spro// zhing 'di'i phyogs su'ang mchog gi sprul pa nyid// sku khams 'tsho ba bzang zhing 'khor du bcas// phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i phyogs ni ring dor zhing*// lugs gnyis mnga' thang bri ba med par mngon// ngos cag bdag kyang 'byung bzhi 'khrugs las dben// dpon slob dad 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho la// rgyal dbang bzhi pa'i bka'i glegs baṃ sogs// lung khrid 'phran bu 'bul ba'i skabs su gnas// spu kyi 'dod don gus pas gsol ba ni// nyi zla'i zer la rgyu skar 'od 'gyed la// dbyar skyes rnga la bung ba'i sgras bsgrun ltar// kun mkhyen thugs la bskul ba'i rigs min kyang*// dus mtha'i sems can bsod nams bsags pa dman// las ngan rgyu 'bras nyi zhur grib bzhin 'brang*// phyi nang du kha'i gdung bas gtses rnams la// 'dren mchog dam pa khyed kyis mi skyob na// mgon med skyabs su gang zhig gyur par dgongs/

khyad par snyigs dus lung bstan ji bzhin du// mtha' dmag kha rgyal bod khams 'joms la thug /bod nang zhig cing khrims gnyis 'chol par spyod// 'dzam gling mchod rten jo shāka chab kyis nyen// phyi nang gsang gsum dus rtags kun 'dzom pas// 'di lta'i tshe na rje btsun khyed rnams kyis// thugs rje'i tsha zer mchog gi stobs ma dman// sdug bsngal chur bying ma rig ldongs pa yi// 'gro ba'i mtsho skems bde ba'i lam snang mdzod// gnas skabs bdag kyang myur du mjal smon kyang*// da dung zla sbrel bka' gnad ma grol bas// cung zhig drung du ma slebs gyur srid na// chos dbyings mkha' la ye shes spyan gsal bas// bdag blo'i pad tshal don la dgongs par 'tshal// gser 'phyang nag pa zla ba'i tshes bzang la// yangs pa can nas phul ba dge legs 'phel// zhes pa'i zhu yig stong pa min tsam du// bkra shis kha btags rtags kyis mtshan pa 'bul/ ༈ hu)chos rje karma pa la dgongs gcig gi dri ba/ ༈ gang gi mkhyen pa nam mkha'i nor bu yis// lung rtogs pad tshal bye ba'i gnyen gyur te// gdul bya rkang drug dga' ston stsol mkhas pa// rje btsun nyi ma'i mgon des snang bar mdzod// rgya gar 'phags yul mgon po klu sgrub ces// gangs can ljongs 'dir mnyam med 'bri gung pa// rat+na shrī zhes yongs su grags gang des// rgyal ba'i dam chos ji bzhin mdor bsdus na/ khyad chos dgongs pa gcig par 'du bzhed pa// ji ltar 'du don gshis babs gnas tshul zhes// rdo rje'i gsung gi gdams par gyur pa dag /gang zag lam pas nyams su blang ba'i chos// skabs brgyad phye ste rgyas par bshad pa la// nang 'gal spongs len med cing gegs sel dang*// bogs 'don gnad du gyur pa'i chos lngar bstan// der bshad rdo rje'i gsung 'ga'i dgongs gsal phyir// cung zad mchid gsol yid mun bsal du gsol// skyon can 'dzin bcas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i// ting 'dzin la ni gol sar kun bzhed na// skyon med dri bral chen gsum 'dzin grol ba'i// ting 'dzin de la 'khor ba'i rgyur bzhed pa// dgaungs don 'di la bzhed tshul ji ltar mchis// sdig pa blang med dge ba mi dor ba// tshul khrims pha rol phyin la bzhed mthun kyang*// spyod pa blang dor bral ba tshul khrims zhes/

khyad chos grags pa'i gsal byed gang dang gang*// mtshan nyid pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas grub ces gsung ba dang*// sngags dang mtshan nyid gang dang gang med kyang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mi 'gyur zhes// brjod bya tshig gi 'gal 'di ji ltar sdum// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med brjod bral ba// nam mkhas kun gyi go skabs 'byed mtshungs ltar// gnyis 'dres rang gsal kun khyab rtogs pa'i chos// 'di nyid nyan thos mngon rtogs yin pa na// de las gzhan pa'i mthar thug rtogs pa gang*// gdul bya dus la bab tshe ma nges pa'i// skye ba'i sprul pa du mas don mdzad tshul// bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la mi mthun med/ khyad chos shes bya srid tshad sangs rgyas kyi// bya ba byed par bzhes pa ji ltar lags// de ltar rdo rje'i gsung tshig lnga po nyid// nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ji ltar stsal ba zhig /rgyang ring gus pas gsol la 'bras mchis mdzod// gzhan yang bka' brgyud spyi 'di ji skad du// rnam rtog chos sku mi rtog chos sku dang*// nam rtogs chos sku rang bzhin chos sku sogs// bzhed srol rang 'grel bcas pa mang mthong na// rje yi bka' srol ji ltar bzhed pa'ang stsol// gnas skabs 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod dge// 'gro rnams kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i skur gyur cig ༈ u)gzhi ka rin spungs nas ja 'dren byung ba'i lan du sde pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal la gnang ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzñā bhāḥ srid gsum bde gter bla med dkon mchog dang*// dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam chos skyong bcas// rgyal ba'i bstan srung 'jig rten skyong rnams kyis// mi dbang mchog la yun du bde stsol cig /sa chen dga' ba'i dpal gyi skyong ba gang*// ngag gi dbang phyug rnam par rgyal ba zhes// phyogs kun grags par gyur pa gang de la// shis par brjod de snyan pa'i tshig gis springs// de tshe sku khams 'tsho ba'i ri dbang brtan/

rnam dkar dge ba'i rba rlabs cher g.yo ba'i// lugs bzang chab srid rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas zhes// phyogs 'dir pho nya sidhīr+tha zhes pa'i// lus kyi ngang mo brtson pa'i 'dab ma bskyod// chab shog snyan 'phreng sgra dbyangs sgrog bzhin du// lag gi 'dab brkyang gdung ba'i rkang pa g.yo// spro ba'i ge sar mchog tu bgod par gyur/ zhing 'dir 'dren mchog zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin// lnga par gyur pa'i sprul sku gang de ni// sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul mi dman zhing*// chab srid mnga' 'bangs dag tu bcas pa yang*// phyi nang 'tshe ba'i bar chad ma mchis par// lugs gnyis khrims kyi bde bar 'tsho zhing gzhes/ kho bo cag kyang 'byung bzhi'i nad las dben/ khams phyogs 'khor nas yun mi ring ba'i ngos// rje btsun gong ma'i bka' drin gso phyir lhags// na ning 'phro nas da lta bar dag tu// zhabs phyi 'dir 'khod dbang lung khrid sogs kyi// rang nyams gang yod dgongs pa bsgrub blor gnas// slad nas skabs su bab par brjod pa ni// rigs kun khyab bdag bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin chen gsum// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus pa'i// thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'chi med grub pa'i rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal// mgon po tshe dpag med dang lhag pa'i lha// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mthu stobs rmad byung bas// mi dbang mchog la tshe yi dngos grub stsol// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i// 'jam dpal zhi khro bka' srung dam can tshogs// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa yis// mi mthun gnod pa'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /ces gang shis brjod smon lam dag pa'i rten// bkra shis rtags ldan rab dkar rgyas pa'i gru// gan pa'i gon pa'i gos ni tshos gnyis bkra ba'i yug /rgyu bzang swa na srong gi thum bu la// mi shigs rgya ldan bkra bar bcas te phul// gser 'phyang hor zla bzhi pa'i yar ngo'i cha// dga' ba'i tshes la yangs pa can nas bris/

༈ ke)yangs pa can nas yum drung du phul ba/ ༈ ma bcos rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi sku// glo bur rtogs pa'i 'ching ba rab brgal te// gshis babs gnas lugs zab mo mngon gyur pa'i// bka' drin 'khor med yum chen nyid kyi drung*// phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i bya bral rat+na yis/ gus shing mos pa'i tshig gi zhu ba ni// bka' yi 'phrin yig don bzang skyes su bcas// pho nya bzhi sbrel dag gis son pa dang*// slar yang tshes bdun gnang ba'i bka' shog ni// bang chen gsum gyi bcu yi dgong dus phebs// de tshe sngon med dga' ba'i khyad par ni// dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i spro ba 'phel// 'di phyogs su'ang phyi nang 'tshe bas dben// sgos su chu sogs rkyen gyis ma gnod cing*// mtshams mal zhag bdun bcad rgya grol ba'i ngang*// mchog gi sprul sku gzi 'od rab 'bar zhing*// dpon slob dge 'dun 'dus pa grangs bcas la// chos drug gdams pa'i nyams khrid ras bud dang*// sku skye gong ma'i bka' 'bum rgyab chos bcas// slar yang rgyal dbang nyid ni gtsor gyur pa'i// gtsang gi bam som se brag bla ma rnams// rang rang 'khor bcas dge 'dun mang tshogs la// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i lung bshad dang*// zur khrid lugs sogs 'phran tshegs bgyid pa'i skabs// bdag cag 'dir son yun ring song gyur na'ang*// rje btsun gong ma'i bka' drin rjes dran te// mchog gi sprul sku'i bka' yi nan ma theg /zla sbrel yun du 'khor ba de ltar lags// slad nas phebs ltar dpon slob dgongs pa zhus// zhib cha'i rgyu mtshan bcas pa rjes su 'bul// zhag zung bar du sku'i 'tsho ba bzang*// rim gnyis ngang las nam yang mi 'da' 'tshal// zhes pa me bya hor zla gsum pa yi// nya gang zla ba rgyas pa'i dus der ni// bde chen yangs pa can nas phul ba dge ༈ khe)gse ma rab 'byams pa la yangs pa can nas gnang ba/ ༈ rab 'byams shes bya'i khyon la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi spobs pa dang ldan zhing*/

grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma'i zab don snying po mchog gi bcud kyis rang rgyud yongs su smin te/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig ltar kun tu brtse ba'i snying rje mchog gis bskul zhing*/ smin grol gdams pa'i lam bzang snang ba la mi 'jigs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shākya chos 'phel la springs pa/ deng dus khams kyi 'tsho ba bzang ngos/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las mi g.yel ba nas/ mos ldan rnams la chos char gyis tshim par yod ces snyan pa yang yang thos pas spro ba mchog tu 'phel/ phyogs 'dir yang*/ mchog gi sprul sku zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa sku'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsal ba'i zhabs phyir/ sgos su yang bde bar 'tsho ba las/ gsar rnying gi dbang lung khrid kyi rim pa mang zhig phul/ da lam de phyogs su slebs pa'i dgongs len zhus kyang ma grub/ zla sbrel gdod dgos pa'i bka' zhal phebs pas de ltar nges par 'tshal zhing*/ da lam ri mo'i rten bsrung mdud sngags mang du btab pa dang*/ ja'i thum bu la mu dras btab te mchis/ nyer gsum la dpal bde chen yangs pa can nas bris pa dge legs su gyur cig ༈ ge)dpon sa gong ma chen po la phul ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzñā bh+raḥ dus gsum mkha' mnyam 'dren pa chos kyi sku// ma 'gag rol pa'i dbang phyug longs spyod rdzogs// gang 'dul sna tshogs snang ba sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum mchog gi deng 'dir bde legs rtsol// dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug maṅga laṃ// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs rnams thams cad du// rnam par rgyal ba'i tog chen 'bar ba ni// sa rnams kun tu nyams med snang gyur cig /mi dbang chos kyi skyong ba'i bzhed pa gang*// 'jig rten skyong ba rang rang sde 'khor bcas// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga khas blangs bzhin// bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod// ces pa'i shis brjod tshig gi mtshams sbyar te// lugs gnyis drin gyis brtse bar bskyangs pas 'tsho// 'jig rten g.yeng ba'i bya ba bor gyur pa// tsa ma ri phyogs gnas pa'i mchid 'di gsol// deng dus sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni// nyer 'tshe ser bu'i rlung gis mi g.yo zhing*// chab srid 'bangs bcas nyams pa mi mnga' zhes// snyan pa'i sgra chen dbyar skyes rnga bzhin thos// yul phyogs 'dir yang phyi nang 'tshe bas dben// sgos su'ang 'byung bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor ma nyams shing*// sgo gsum log pa'i lam du ma gyur tsam// rgyal ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs bzhin gnas// da dus snyigs ma lnga ni cher bdo tshe// chos ma yin pa'i spyod pa shas che bas// dus 'khrug nad yams mtha' yi dmag dpung lhags// sems can kun kyang du khaḥspyod dus 'dir// gnas skabs dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad cig

/bgyi bar mos na'ang da bar g.yeng bas 'gyangs// nye dus sngon gyi bka' drin gsob pa'i phyir// dpal gyi bsam yas gtsug lag khang chen du// dkar me cung zad 'bul bar pho nya ba// sbrel po btang ba slan chad phar tshur du// bgrod pa bgyi ba gang la'ang 'tshe med pa'i// mi 'jigs bka' yi gnang ba stsal du gsol// zhes pa'i zhu rten bkra shis kha btags dang*// skye bdun bdud rtsi ril bu nyi shu gcig /swa na srang gang rgya dang ldan par phul// rnam 'phyang hor zla dang po'i dga' ba'i tshes// lang tsho gsar du mthong tshe phul ba dge ༈ nge)mchims phur dpon sa bdag mo la gnang ba/ ༈ byin rlabs gter gyur rje btsun bla ma dang*// dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bar chad kun sel chos skyong srung ma yi// bkra shis bde legs don gnyis grub par gsol// deng tshe sku khams 'tsho bar rab tu brtan// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi g.yo bar// rim gnyis zab mo'i ngang du bzhugs zhes pa'i// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs thos pas spro ba 'phel// snyoms las bdag kyang rnam g.yeng ma mchis shing*// sgo gsum log pa'i lam du ma gyur tsam// cung zad dben pa'i mtshams mal lugs su gnas// nye dus chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas su// dkar me'i mchod pa cung zad 'bul ba'i phyir// pho nya sbrel po phyogs der son pa la// sna bshan gtong gnyer gang 'os mchis gyur na// brtse ba'i thugs kyis skyo ngal med par skyongs// zhes pa'i rten du ja rdum kha tshas dang*// skye bdun bdud rtsi ril bu nyer gcig la// rtags 'byar rnam 'phyang hor zla dang po yi// dga' ba'i tshes la 'bri gung bla brang nas/ ༈ ce)skyor mo lung du bdag mo la gnang ba/ ༈ dpa' ldan sa chen kun tu skyong ba ni// rnam pa du ma'i rgyal thabs la mkhas shing*// skye dgu zhi bde'i dpal la 'byor mkhas pa// thos pas rna ba'i dbang po tshim par gyur// dus mtha'i bya bral bdag kyang rnam g.yeng dben// sgo gsum log pa'i lam du ma gyur tsam// skabs kyi don mchid da dus bstan pa'i zhabs// chos spyod nyung zhing mi dge'i dbang gyur pas// nad mtshon mtha' dmag du khas kun nas gtses// de lta'i dus 'dir dge tshogs cung zad cig

/sgrub par smon na'ang da bar g.yeng bas 'gyangs// nye dus pho nya rnams dang lhan cig par// bsam yas gtsug lag khang du dkar me zhig /'bul bar btang ba phar tshur lam bar dang*// gru tshugs rnams la 'tshe ba med pa zhig /'dod don 'tshal gyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pa'i rten du skye bdun bdud rtsi yi// ril bu rtsod bral nyer gcig 'bul bar mchis// rnam 'phyang gsar du shar ba'i dga' tshes la// 'bri gung dpal gyi bla brang rtse nas bris/ ༈ che)sding rgyal rdor 'dzin kun legs la zhu lan/ ༈ bla ma drung pa'i gsung tho gnang cha dang bcas pa 'byor/ mdang da nangs sku snyoms mus byung 'dug pa thugs la btags/ bdag tsho yang khams bde ba'i ngos nas/ chos bka' bzhin gang thob kyi mdun par mchis/ nye dus ma mjal nas rgyun ring*/ zhu lan bzhin byed 'dod che bar yod na'ang*/ sku khams kyi stobs kyi 'phrod ma byas pa yin/ zhu lan 'phral du 'bul dgos rgyu yin na'ang*/ zhib cha zhig 'bul bsam pas 'gyangs pa lags/ skabs don/ sngar gong gi nyams myong de thugs rgyud la gsal ba de yin/ kha sang de ring ni dge sbyor ngo bo ming 'dogs/ dge sbyor gyi 'dzin pa dang*/ sgom blo thams cad bral zhing*/ mnyam par gzhag bya dang*/ 'jog bya'i yul dang bral ba'i 'dzin pas kun nas dben zhing*/ kun khyab kun nas gsal ba'i/ rang gdangs dri ma'i ming gis kyang stong pa nyid kyi nyin mtshan dus rnams kun tu bri gang bsal bzhag med pa/ yang mtshan dus nyin par gyi 'char sgo'i rtsal snang rang las 'dzin pa'i ngo bo ma grub pa/ de nyid ngang las dkar nag rgyu 'bras/ lar na/ shes dang shes bya'i gnas kyang 'phra'u yi rgyu rkyen kyang 'di las 'di byung*/ shin tu grung zhing rtsa ba nas spu ris phyed pa/ de lta bu zhig byung ba 'di la/ skyong lugs kyi bslab bya dang*/ gnas skabs/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis la sbyar na/ sa mtshams kyi zhal gsal dang bcas pa gnang dgos/

sngon chad kyang gsung ba de rnams sems la 'phrod pa byung*/ da dung stsol zhig yang 'khur thum bu la rgya 'byar/ ༈ je)yang rdor 'dzin kun legs pa'i zhu lan du gnang ba/ ༈ bla ma'i drung gi zhu lan phebs// ci spyan ?sngar mjal ba'i smon lam yod// sngar yang sngon ma'i zhu lan 'phros// cud zad gsal bar zhu ba na// ngo bo gshis stong sna tshogs 'char sgo can// rang bzhin blo 'das brjod bral kun gzhir go /lam snang dris goms bzo med bskyangs pa'i mthus// yid dpyod blo 'dzin dri mas dben pa'i lam// de nyid bya rtsol yid byed bral ba las// snang srid 'khor 'das rang sems rig pa'i rtsal// kun 'char kun snang brjod bral dbyings su 'char// de nyid ngang las spros bral blo bral rang*// zung 'jug tsam gyis 'dzin pa ma dmigs so// mtshan snang dkar nag rgyu 'bras 'char sgo las// rten 'brel ji bzhin spu ris phyed pa snyam// 'char yang khengs dang shes snyam yid byed med// de las rkyen gyi 'char sgo gang shar yang*// der snang der 'dzin med pa'i rang gdangs ngang*// kun bde yongs gsal ting 'dzin chos kyi sgo// 'di las 'di zhes rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gshis// sa bon myu gu 'bras bu ji bzhin rtogs// de la brten de rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*// bka' dang bstan bcos rnam pa ji snyed las// gang shar kun kyang phyogs re phyogs re tsam// dgongs don zur tsam ston pa'i thabs su go// nyams myong ngo bo 'dzad med rgya mtsho ltar// snying nas shar bas sba gsang bya rgyu zad// nges shes thag chod bya lam rjes ltar snang*// rjes spyod thams cad de nyid klong du thim// rtsis gdab bya rtsol byas kyang 'ja' ltar yal// 'di don lags pas ji ltar rigs pa stsol// ngo bo 'chad na brjod bral las gzhan med// tshig mtshon tsam la 'di ltar phul ba lags// gzhan la gsang ba'i rgya chen snang bar 'tshal/ nye)bya bral bgyid khar drung pa snang gsal bar phul ba/

༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// dpal ldan bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can gyi// 'chi med tshe dpal ye shes dngos grub stsol// dpal ldan bkra shis lha dbang gtsug gi rgyan// bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab pa// mtshungs med rkang gnyis mchog gyur 'dren pa khyod// zhing 'dir mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol// bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshaugs gang mchis dang*// rang bzhin yod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// bla med byang chub go 'phang ma thob bar// rdo rje'i sku mchog g.yo bar ma gyur cig /ces pa 'di 'bri gung bya bral ba rat+nas gus pa'i gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzad du gsol/ bdag kyang bsam pa 'grub par 'dug pas shin tu skyid pa lags/ zhes rig 'dzin chen pos gnang ba'i tshe ril nyer gcig dang*/ brtan bzhugs rnams phul/ ༈ te)bya bral bgyid khar phag mor phul ba/ ༈ sku drung du zhu ba/ deng tshe sku gsung thugs gsang chen ye shes kyi rol pa las/ log pa'i bar du gcod pas mi g.yo zhing*/ lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang chen po mtha' gru yangs par bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ bya bral ba yang 'byung bzhis 'tshe ba las dben zhing*/ gnas chen khongs su chos lung gang yod du mchis lags/ nye dus 'dod gsol gyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ dus gsum 'dren mchog bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong bsrung mar bcas// dkar phyogs mos pa'i 'jig rten skyong gang gis// bsam dngos yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bka' drin stsol/ kho bo cag ni chung nas nges 'byung che// dam chos sgrub la snying nas mos gyur kyang*// gnas skabs chags sdang g.yen bcos bar bcad pas// mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan gang la bzod par gsol// bdag ni bsams shing mi rtag snying nas dran// shāka thub bstan pa'i mthar lhung snyigs dus 'dir// dam chos spyod pa phal cher gzugs brnyan tsam// chos bzhin gnas la kun gyis 'tshe ba mang*// dge ba'i chos gnas chos rgyal thugs yid zhum// bdud yid bcos pa'i skye bo 'khrug rtsod dga'// hor sogs 'jigs pa'i dmag gi mtha' nas bskor// 'dzam gling mchod sdong jo shāka chab kyis nyen// 'di lta'i dus 'dir sngon nas bstan gnyis bdag

/shākya seng ge o rgyan lung bstan bzhin// bzhi bcu kha ral dus ngan snyigs ma'i snyigs// tha ma'i tha mar gyur pa'i dus skabs 'dir// bdag lta'i sprang pos mchid gsol mi spobs kyang*// bstan dang sems can rnams kyi don phyir du// kun kyang dkar phyogs dge ba rgya bskyed 'tshal/ gtsug lag rnying gso rab gnas brtan bzhugs bskyar// lung nas zin pa'i sa gnad bstan rim 'bad// khyad par da lo sa khyi nas gzung ste// lcags khyi'i bar du sde 'khrug nang rtsod dang*// ri klungs gnas pa'i srog chags kun la yang*// mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa stsal du gsol// de ltar gyur na bod yul spyi bye brag /kun nas dge ba'i lung bstan gsal bar mthong*// ma grub bzhi gsum lo nas bod khams kun// sdug bsngal gyis gzir mtha' mis gnas gzhi 'joms// de sogs ya nga'i gnas 'ga' mthong ba las// 'jig rten chos brgyad 'dun pa'i dri bral zhing*// rang snying spang gtsugs lhag bsam 'di phul bas// bya bral bdag la lugs gnyis stobs ma mchis// 'on kyang zhu rten spyil phu'i bdag dbang gang*// phyag tu 'bul bzhes gong du gsol ba'i don// lugs gnyis dgongs la bka' bzang stsal du gsol// bdag kyang 'jig rten bya ba'i 'khri ba gcod// sde rigs kha bdag mi 'tshal dben gnas rnams// gang der gnas la bag yangs bka' stsal mkhyen// 'di don gnas tshul pho nya'i ngag nas 'bul// rnam 'phyang hor zla bzhi pa'i yar tshes la// dben ri 'brong ngur gnas nas phul bas dge the)mkhar thog tu dpon blon la gnang ba/ ༈ bya bral bdag la lugs gnyis stobs ma mchis/ yan gong bzhin la/ bya stobs gang yang grub pa'i mthus dben kyang*// zhu ba'i rten du lto skal dbang ba'i zhing*// lha khang khang gsar lho dang thel zhol bcas// bya ril 'tshe ru spyil mda' 'dom gad gang*// ko mo bka' rtsal bkris rnam rgyal bcas// brag mgo ga dang myang po'i dbang ris gang*// thog rur bcas te mdor na drung chen dang*// thel pa yum la gang phul ma gtogs pa// phyag tu 'bul bzhes gong du gsol don dang*// bdag gi gzhis gnyer byed dang khral yangs dang*// sa zhing sbyin pa'i yi ge gang 'dug la// brtse bas gzigs te byams pas bskyang ba dang*// bu tsha rnams kyang gang mos 'khod pa la// bka' yi nan tur sngar 'dra med par ni// lugs gnyis dgongs la brtse bas bskyang du gsol// bdag kyang 'jig rten bya ba'i 'khri ba gcod// ces pa phyin gong dang mthun no/

༈ de)mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po la phul ba/ ༈ rje btsun bka' drin mtshungs med dam pa'i drung*// gus tshig yid kyis gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs// bdag ni deng nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar// sgo gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'jug cing*// lus ngag yid kyi gang lcogs dge la 'bad// 'gro don gegs med yid bzhin 'gyur srid na// lus dang srog la 'phangs pa yong mi lta// chos 'phel gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba na// ngan skyugs gnas su 'ang sun pa'i blo spangs zhing*// sdig ldan log pa'i dbyen gtso'i gzhir gyur na// dben gtsang lha gnas lta bu 'ang rtsa bzhin mdor// mdor na chos mthun sgo gsum yi dam bca'// mi dge sdig pa'i dri las ci ring bgyid/ dus kun 'bral med rje btsun spyi bor bkur// skye nas skye bar rjes su gzung du gsol// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*// bdag gzhan ma lus tshogs sgrib sbyangs nas/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ ༈ ne)rgya ston dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan la zhu lan/ ༈ gang gi blo gros rab tu gsal ldan zhing*// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng la brtson gyur pa'i// rgya ston dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan gy-is// yi ge'i 'dod gsol bcas pa lag tu son// nyid kyi bla ma nam mkha' legs pa ni// tshe rabs du ma nyid nas bdag dang 'brel// dam pa'i chos kyis legs par bskyangs pa ste// skye rabs sku tshe'i rten 'brel la sogs pa// sngon du nyid nas phul zin 'dir ma 'khod// 'on kyang bas mtha' nges med bsten pa na// sku tshe ring zhing chos srid rgyas par mngon// 'jig rten bya ba'i 'phrin las cung zhig 'grib// lugs gnyis bstan pa'i srol 'byed 'di lta na// sku tshe la ni bar chad dum tsam yod// 'on kyang bar chad sel ba'i lhag pa'i lha// sngon dus nyid la phul bas nges par mdzod// dam pa'i chos kyi phan pa cung zhig chung*// rgya ston bstan pa 'jig rten phyogs nas rgyas// khyad par nyid rang rmi ltas sgrub blo na// dpal ldan mgon po ma hā ka la ni// phyag bzhi pa dang sbrel pa che bar mngon// 'phrin las gang dang gang rnams de yis mtshon// nged cag yab sras bdag la gsol btab pa'i// tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams nyams len mdzod// sku gsum ngo bo ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// gsung mchog dam chos ji snyed ston pa'i gsung*// thugs mchog mi g.yo rtag tu mnyam gzhag thugs// rje btsun rat+na'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i nam mkha' la// thugs rje'i tsha zer legs pa'i 'od zer 'phro// dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan nyin mo'i mgon// mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// sngon gyi smon lam bzang po'i dri bzhon gyi// 'bad med bde bar bgrod byed gru bo che// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son byed pa// dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// zhes pa'i rgya ston dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar/

yid mthun du bris pa dge'o/ ༈ pe)nang so rgya ston pa sku gzhon pa dpon slob khams la 'byon khar rgya ston chos rje la gnang ba/ ༈ rgya ston pa nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ zhib cha snga dus mdzad pa dang*/ kha sang nas ri mo mdzad pa rnams lag tu son zhing*/ ngos kyis gsung ba rnams yid yul du bcag par gyur na'ang*/ dus gnas spyi dang*/ bye brag khyad par nged tsho yang gzhi gcig tu ma rtag byes 'khor ma lta bur gyur pas/ sgos dmigs kyi mtshams sogs byed rgyu ma red pa de ltar yin lags/ de nas sku mched/ bdag cag dpon slob skye ba du mar 'brel tshul zab mo ji ltar gyur pa rnams yid la gang zin thungs ???pa ni/ sngon du phul ba ltar yin/ o rgyan rin po che'i dus/ nyid bsam yas kyi mthil 'dir skye ba bzhes 'dug kyang*/ sku na phra ba'i dus bsam yas bzhengs pa'i ar mi la bskul bas/ rgyal po dang yon mchod la ha cang ma dad pas/ chos mang ba rang gsan pa ni byung bar ma shes lags/ de nas kyi sku tshe'i bar bcad sel thabs phul ba rnams nyams len mdzad na/ shin tu phan par go ba bzhin nan tan mdzad par zhu/ ri bo che nas mkhar drung 'di gsang sngags kyi skyes bu smon lam gyi shugs can zhig yin par rtsod bral du 'dug kyang*/ rta dpon dang sngon nas dam sel gyi 'brel pa sku skye du mar byung ba 'dra bas da lta yang zhabs tog dang zhabs 'dren gyis 'brel pa 'byung ba de bzhin go/ ri bo che pa'i bstan pa 'di la gnas dus kyi rten 'drel gang zab ma mdzad na/ dar rgyas 'byung mi 'byung zhu spobs pa zhig mi snang*/ rgya ston bstan pa ni/ chos dang srid la phyi nang gi 'tshe rtsub cung zad re 'byung srid kyang nyams pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba ma shes lags/ nang so 'di pa bzhugs yun nyams thung tsam min/ da res sku gsod che nas song*/ khyed rang tshang la gang dgos kyi/ phyi nang bar gsum gyi 'brel pa rnams ma nyams shing*/

kun dang mthun pa'i bsam don yid bzhin grub yod lags/ zhib rgyas 'bul 'os 'dra byung na'ang*/ slad nas 'bul zhing*/ sring 'os rim par 'tshal khyad par bdag rang gi bya ba khag che ba sgrub rgyu zhig la/ nga rang gi dod mi mdzad kha med du snang ba thugs khur che ba zhig zhu/ ༈ phe)karma pa la phul ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i dpal las mngon par thon te/ mtha' yas pa'i skye 'gro thams cad kyi rnam par 'dren pa/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal ldan karma pa zhes/ sa gsum du grags pa'i ba dan kun tu g.yo ba las/ slar yang mkhas pa'i dbang po gang rnams kyi gtsug tu zhabs kyi pad mo bkra ba/ brgyad pa zhes grags pa de'i drung du/ bya bral gyis spyod pas 'tsho ba'i kun tu rgyus/ bka' yi glegs bam rin po che'i 'phreng ba bzang tshig gi srad bu 'byor pa du ma'i dpal yon gyis spras te/ 'phrin las sar mngags pa'i pho nya ba dag gi bgrod pa mi dman par phebs pa dang*/ nyid sku tsha zer bye ba'i gzi 'od kun tu lham mer gsal bzhin pa'i snang ba chen pos/ gdul bya blo gsal pad mo'i tshal chen la/ snying po'i drod kyi 'tsho bar mdzad de/ nyams myong rtogs pa'i ro bcud kyis kun nas yongs su gang

ba'i rkang thung gi tshogs dang bcas pa snang ba ches cher gsal bar gyur ro// zhes pa'i snyan grags kyi dri bzhon yi ge gsar bu phyogs 'dir son pas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur lags/ bya bral ba rnams kyang phyi nang gi 'tshe ba ma mchis pa nas/ rim par brgyud da lta mchog gi sprul sku'i drung du/ 'khod par mchis lags/ slad nas sku'i 'tsho bar rab tu brtan zhing*/ 'phrin las kyi 'od snang gis kun tu khyab par 'tshal zhing*/ thugs rje rta bdun dbang po'i 'phrul snang la/ 'gro blo'i chu 'dzin la sgrib pa ma mchis na/ bdag blo'i chu snod kyi gzhir yang*/ rgyu 'phrul gyis zlos gar snang bar 'tshal ces pa dang*/ slar yang bsgyur byed ces pa'i sa mo phag gi lo gsar du tshes pa nas gzung dge legs su gyur cig ces bkra shis pa'i kha btags kyi tshas la rgyas btab te hor zla dang po'i tshes kyi lang tsho gsar du shar ba la stod lung bde chen nas phul/ ༈ be)snye mo bdag mo gser khang ma la zhu lan/ ༈ kun dga'i chu gter las thon zhing*// bsod nams rab brtan tsha zer 'od 'phreng gis// kun mtsho'i rgyal mo ma pham pa la springs// khyed kyis bskyangs pa'i zhing kun dge gyur cig /gang gi gsung yig snyan dngags me tog 'phreng*// skyes bzang don gyi srad bu legs rgyus ste// pho nya ded dpon bgrod pa mi dman pas// phyogs 'dir son pas yid la spro ba 'phel// ji ltar dbyar skyes gang ba'i bkod ma bzhin// dngos gang 'bangs bcas chab srid nyams mi mnga'// bshad dang bsgrub pas bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs// legs mtsho'i gzhir gyur kun nas dge gyur pa// rna ba'i dbang por grags par gyur pa'i tshe// dbyar skyes rnga la rma bya ji bzhin mtshungs// tsa ma rī phyogs 'ongs pa'i kho bo cag /rgyal ba 'od dmar sprul sku 'khor bcas la// gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum la sogs phul// slar yang nges med kun tu rgyu ba yis// bka' gnang zhus kyang grub par ma gyur pas// de phyir bag phab phyogs 'dir bde bar 'tsho// skabs mchid dbon po shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis// ngag las brgyud pa'i bzhed pa de dag la// kho bo cag ni skyes sbyangs spobs pas dben// bshad dang bsgrub pa'i lam la mos tsam las// nyams su blangs dang gzhan la stsal ba yis// mthu ma mchis pas dben pa'i gnas rnams su// ci bder spyod cing bsgrub par bgyid snyam pas// gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab so// rang gis rang la nges pa'i gdeng ma rnyed// de bas phyogs der bdag cag son gyur kyang*// thugs bzhed bskong ba'i spobs pa ji ltar snyam// the tshom gnas las gzhan du ma gyur to// zhes pa'i rten 'dun dar chen yug la tshas// rtags kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu bkra bar mchis// sgyur byed hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bzang la// stod lung bde chen lcog bu'i grwa nas bris/

༈ me) chos sde bye mkhar ba'i gdan sa pa 'dzam gling rab 'byams pa la zhu lan/ ༈ rgyal ba'i gsung rab du ma la drang ba dang nges pa 'phyed par byed pa'i spobs pa du mas ma rmongs shing*/ mthar gyi nges pa mchog gi lam du gzhol te 'jug par bgyi ba'i sgo snang la// smra ba'i dbang po 'dzam gling rab 'byams pa nyid kyi ri mo tshig don bzang zhing skyes su bcas pa 'phrod pa dang*/ blo gsal gyi dbus su/ rnam g.yeng log pa'i 'tsho ba las ring zhing*/ bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas su yod ces lan gcig ma yin par thos pas/ yid la dga' ba du mas phyug par gyur to/ phyogs 'dir yang*/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gtsor gyur pa/ sku khams dngas shing thos sgrog gi dgongs len tsam du mchis/ slad nas khyed kyi ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin/ rgyal ba mchog gi bka' dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu du ma'i ngag gi bstan bcos ji snyed mchis pa'i don ma lus pa/ khas len dang bral ba'i lta ba dang*/ yid byed dang bral ba'i sgom pa/ blang dor dang bral ba'i spyod pa dag gis lam bsrang du bzud de/ rgyud la ston na/ zab gsal snying po mchog de/ bsal gzhag dang bri gang med par rig pa mchog gi ngang du rdzogs pa 'di/ sa kar rnying gsum gyi lam bzang gol sa med par go na/ 'di dag don la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin spyod par 'tshal ces 'bul zhing*/ bdag nyid skyes sbyangs kyi spobs pas dben pas na/ ngos kyis mjal kyang thugs kyi bzhed pa skong ba'i mthu ma mchis mod/ smon lam gyi dbang gi mjal te gsung gi gleng mo bgyi bar spro lags zhes pa'i rten dar chen gsum 'brel gyi tshas la rgya 'byar bar mchis/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun rjes ma la stod lung bde chen lcog sgar nas bris pa dge ༈ tse)'brug pa gcung khri thog pa'i zhu lan phul ba/ ༈ dpag bsam mngon par phyug las rgyal ba yi// bstan pa'i lo 'bras me tog phyogs kun tu/

khyab cing skye dgu'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs nas// thar mchog lam ston gang de'i snyan gsol ba// pho nya'i dri bzhon gsung bris rkang drug ldan pa dri bzang gi skyes dang bcas pa/ se brag bla mas 'phrod 'byor thugs rjes gzung*/ snga sor/ rin po che de nyid zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs pa phyogs pa de bzhin byung 'dug pa/ bka' brgyud spyi bre brag tu sems zhum pa'i gnas su song ba zhig byung na yang*/ deng sang*/ nyid sku rab yangs nam mkha'i khyon khebs pa'i chu khur bzhon pa las/ lugs gnyis kyi char cher bar med phab ste/ bstan pa'i lo thog mngon par yang rgyas pa'i snyan pa rim pas thos pa/ sems mi gtser ba dang ldan par gyur kho bo cag bya bral ba yang*/ 'byung ba ma 'khrugs tsam nas 'gro phan 'dra gang nus dang*/ chos gang dmar gyi 'dun par mchis/ da res zhib rgyas se brag pa la gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ de kha'i mos 'dun mi lhod tsam yod pa slar yang ngag rang du gsal zhes/ yid mtsho'i ngogs nas ri mo pad dkar gyi/ chu 'dzin bkra shis kha btags tshad ldan 'di// dpag bsam dbang po'i 'dabs su myur 'phur nas// dge legs thugs kyi pad dkar 'dzin gyur cig ༈ tshe)yang bdag mo gser khang ma la zhu lan/ ༈ nyid kyang sku'i 'tsho skyongs dang*/ rim gnyis zab mo'i don la mi g.yel zhing*/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi bya ba la thugs 'byung ba 'di rgyal sras du ma'i dgongs tshul yin mod na'ang*/ hril dril na/ chos kyi rtsa ba ni gnyug ma'i rang gshis ma bcos par skyong ba 'di khar 'dug 'di la ni rang ngo rang gis ma shes na/ bka' mdo rgyud man ngag mang po zhig la kha bton dang*/ go ba skyes kyang*/ nyams su myong ba dka' mor gda'/ rang gshis rang gis shes rig go na ni/ ji ltar byas kyang gang ltar 'dug kyang*/ mang por tshogs kyang*/ gcig pur 'dug kyang*/ 'gyur ba med cing*/ mi bslu ba'i rten 'brel rgyu 'bras kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pa 'di yid ches pas/

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa thams cad kyi bdag po rang gis byas chog pa zhig 'dug de las kyang snang grags 'khor 'das thams cad kyi chos can chos nyid ma lus pa rang rtsal du byas chog pa/ chog par ma zad yin yang yin pa 'di/ nga ni bde'am snyam/ de la nyams len bya lugs kyi rtsa ba ni/ byang chub kyi sems yin par gsungs kyang 'dug cing*/ 'di dgos kyang dgos par go/ 'di med na gol sa chen po zhig 'dug gang la zer na/ sems can blos mi 'dor ba 'di rang byang chub kyi sems su 'dug pas/ 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba phran bu la thugs mi 'byung ba/ spyi dang bye brag gi 'khor 'bangs sems can la dgongs te/ thugs sna rgyang rgyang ba mdzad 'tshal/ mdor bsdu na chos kyi rtsa ba rang gshis ma bcos pa'i de bzhin nyid/ nyams len byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di dang ma bral na/ khyed kyi bzhed don bde blag tu 'grub bam snyam pa 'di/ kho rang gis rtogs pas brjod pa yin/ yang kho bo rang gi shar tshul 'di ltar gda'i/ rang sems skye med dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ phyogs kun 'gag med snang ba'i gtso 'khor bcas// rol pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs gar ldan pa'i// snang srid rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgongs su gsol// rang bzhin brjod bral gdal chen kun khyab la// rtag chad spang blang mtshan ma'i 'dzin pas gzugs// ma bcos de nyid rang sa ma zin pa// kun gzhi yangs pa'i klong du bzod par gsol// rang snang 'gag med rig pa'i cho 'phrul la// bzang ngan dgag sgrub grub mtha'i 'ching bas dkris// gang shar shugs 'byung lam du ma shes pas// ma bcos sgom pa'i klong du bzod par gsol// sgo gsum spang blang bral ba'i rang gshis la// bsdam bya sdom byed rtogs pa'i dri mas bsgribs// res 'jog bral ba'i spyod par ma gnas pa// kun bzang bde chen lam la bzod par gsol// ye sangs rgyas pa'i rig pa byang chub la// spangs thob 'dod pa'i bya byed mun sprul gyi// bcos bslad bral ba'i rang sa ma zin pa// 'bras bu sku lnga'i dbyings su bzod par gsol// da ni deng phyin bdag dang rjes 'brang bcas// chags sdang 'khrul pa'i rjes phyir mi 'breng bar// snying po sgrub pa'i bdud rtsi bsten par 'tshal// sngon gyi rgyal sras mkhas grub du ma yis// gshis babs gnas lugs ji lta ji snyed rnams// legs dgongs bka' dang bstan bcos gdams pa kun// dpe dang don bcas mdzub mos zla mtshon bzhin// ma bcos rang rig rang stong zung 'jug don// ma rtogs rtogs dang rtogs pa brtan pa dang*// brtan pa bogs dbyung mthar gyis mngon chub phyir// rags dang 'phra dang shin tu phra ba'i tshul// spang gnyen lam dang dbyer med don gsungs pa'i// lam mchog 'di las kho bos cang ma mthong*// de phyir rang gshis drang po'i lam 'dir zhugs

/dpyad pas dpyad bya bral ba rang gi sems// brtag pas brtag mkhan stong ba rang gi sems// bsgrubs pas grub med grub pa rang gi sems// dgags pas khegs med snang ba rang gi sems// bzang po'i grub mtha' phan med rang gi sems// ngan pa'i lta bas bsgyur med rang gi sems// yod par gzung yang rtag med rang gi sems// med par gzung yang chad med rang gi sems// yin par sems kyang 'dzin med rang gi sems// min par sems kyang bor med rang gi sems// de ltar shes pas rig pa'i de kho na// 'di nyid ngang las bya rgyu ngas ma rnyed// de bas rang babs ngang la bcos med zhog /zhog ces bya ba'ang tshig gi ri mo tsam// 'khor 'das gdod ma'i dbyings la e waṃ phaṭaḥ /ces rang la bcag skyag ??gtad gang yang med pa'i bya bral ba gnam lcags me 'bar gyis/ stod lung bde chen nas bris pa phyogs kun tu dge legs yongs su rgyas par gyur cig ༈ dze)rab brtan ma'i dri lan/ ༈ rje dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gtso/ khams gsum 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab// dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ khyod zhabs pad mor phyag bgyi'o// bdag tha mal lus la dag pa'i rtsa// dpal dbu ma bde chen 'khor lo'i nang*/ khams dngas ma 'od gong dkar dmar gnyis// rlung dngas ma'i 'gros kyi 'dod rim sogs// chos zab mo bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gnang*// dus da nang skya rengs nas gzung nas// mkha' nyi 'od nub ṛr ma shar bar// gnad 'chug med rlung la sbyang ba byas// phyi sdos bcas yul gyi mgo bo na// nang 'dzin med sems la 'dzin cha bral// rlung 'byung 'jug bar du gnang ba la// sna g.yas g.yon gnyis la du ba 'dra'i// rlub 'tshub dkyil sngo bun 'gro ba snyam// dus da lta'i bar du sgrib med mthong*// dus da res rkang pa'i mthil gnyis nas// me che chung bya pho'i sgo nga tsam// rkang ngar brgyud lte ba'i bar dag tu// me g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyu ba la// lus lte bar me ni sgron me tsam// tsha reg reg me lce snying ga la// reg snyam nas tsha snang zhes rngangs 'char// sems rnal du phab kyang tsha zer gyis// lus stod la me yi rkyen yong snyam// zhed sngangs pa'i sems kyi dub pa 'di// bdud bar chad yin na bsal ba dang*// ltas bzang na ngo sprod gsal 'debs zhu// zhes pa la/

lan du/ thugs dam gyi rim pa gnang ba la brten/ gzigs snang gi rim pa mchog du gyur pa la 'di lta bu ni/ sngon gyi bsags pa mchog tu gyur pa dus 'dir sad byed kyi rkyen dang 'phrad par sngon la/ 'on kyang rgyu sngon du song nas 'bras bu dngos su 'byung ba rten 'brel rgyu 'bras yin pas nges gzung mi 'tshal zhing*/ khyad par bdag ltas gegs sel dang bogs 'don gyis gdams pa 'bul rgyu yod pa'i mtshan ma min yang*/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi rgyun ltar na/ dbu snyung ba de rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i snga ltas/ shangs bug gnyis kyi rlung sngo bun 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha'i rlung gi kha dog gzigs pa/ 'tshub cing 'khyil ba ni cung zad rtsubs pa yin nam snyam/ zhabs mthil nas me 'bar te lte ba'i bar dang*/ lte ba nas me 'bar te thugs kar reg reg pa sogs ni/ tsaṇ+ṭa li'i me 'bar ba'i zer du go bas/ bde drod kyi ting 'dzin gong 'phel du 'gyur ram snyam/ de las zur pa'i 'bul 'os blos chod par ma mchis/ de la bogs ni 'bar 'dzag gis dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'don dgos par go zhes pa'o/ ༈ we)yang stod lung bde chen nas snye mor gnang ba/ ༈ da res lha sar song bas/ lho rags kyi mgo nas bzung*/ rags 'dzug mjug ?yan la rab gnas bgyis pa'i dus mthong snang kyang legs tshogs yod pa dang*/ jo bo rin po che dang*/ bcu gcig zhal sogs la brtan bzhugs phul dus kyang ltas bzang gi snang ba shar/ de min sbar sbir mang po lab yin grags kyang*/ gter rnyed pa sogs cang ma byung*/ bdag gi gter skal kha yar yod 'dug kyang*/ da rang skye ba da res la stabs shig mi 'grigs pa 'dra snyam/ yi chad sgyid lug pa zhig kyang byung*/ 'on kyang rang sems skye med chos sku'i ston pas/ 'gag med rig pa'i 'khor la gsungs pa'am/ 'khor 'das snang grags kyi rgyud lung man ngag gi sgo mtha' yas pa'i/ sprul bsgyur snang stong zung 'jug gi gdams bskor 'di rnams kyi gter sgo 'di 'tshol ma dgos par rnyed pas/

gter sbed dam/ 'don nam/ spel lam/ gang bya rang dbang du chod pas sos dal la skyid par gda' lags so/ ༈ zhe)gtsang pa dge slong ngag dbang rin chen rnam rgyal la gnang ba/ ༈ rig sngags 'dzin pa'i rigs las rab byung zhing*// mdo sngags mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs bsten te// nges don snying po'i lam la zhugs gyur pa/ bhik+ṣu ngag gi dbang po'i ri mo son// snyigs dus rnam 'dren dam pa gang de'i drung*// sgo gsum yol med brtson pa'i shugs drag pos/ bka' yi glegs bam bri bar brtson par spro// bya bral ba yang zla sngon bdun phrag gsum// mtshams mal bcad rgya bgyis grol rgya ma ru// zhag brgyad bar phyin bla ma rin po che'i// sku rim la dmigs mang 'gyed dgon 'gyed dang*// chog mang la sogs brtson pas gang lcogs bsgrubs// yar lam khri khang rtse ru drung chen la*// phyag 'bul bgyid snyam lam du khrag rlung gis// stod gzer drag pos mnar te lcags zam gdong*/ zhag bar lcags dus drung chen tshur la phebs// mjal 'phrad dag kyang legs tshogs grub pa nas// yangs pa can pa dpon slob nang mtshams su// zhu lan 'bul mtshams gal mdor gya bya ?byung bas// bskor byang ma 'khor bar du 'dir bcags shing*// sang nas mtshams mal bcad rgya bdun phrag gnyis// 'di khar bgyid c-ing stod lung sa yi phyogs// 'gro ma dgos nas bka' rtsal ji bzhin du// yar bteg 'brong ngur mthil gnyis gang rigs su// mtshams rgyun sring ba'i mdun pa kho nar mchis// e ma ho/ snyigs ma'i sems can phan lan gnod pas 'jal// bzang byas ngan mthong mthun grub mgu ba dka'// nyon mongs rnam rtog phra rags tshan cher mthong*// de bas yid gnyis re dogs gnyis 'dzin spongs// log par ltas na lhas kyang rang srog gcod// snang ba zhig na dregs pas 'phrin las bsgrub// de bas ha cang rna gsang ma che bar/ khrims bsgrims bag phob smra ba nyung ba gces// nyan pa'i gtam la zad pa'i mtha' med pas// rang gi rang la dri rtog bsam mno thongs// nyes byas log pa'i rang 'khris bsgrubs pa na// mis ma smras kyang rnam smin rang sdig pas// zhe gnong 'gyod sems bshags sdom 'bad par gyis// 'gyod med zhe tshangs gnod pa ma mchis na// grags pa'i sgra skad rlung dang 'brug sgrar mtshungs// ched gnyer bdag 'dzin byas na gcong nad dngos// nyams len bogs su ston na e ma ho// gdod ma'i rang gshis chos dbyings ka dag las// rol pa'i rtsal chen 'char sgo 'gag med gsal// bdag tu 'dzin bral rig pa byang chub sems// kun tu bzang po bde chen 'dus pa rtsal// dbyings las rtsal snang 'char sgo bdag gzung bas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul mkhyen par mdzod// don du rang nyes yod na rang gnong yod// rang gnong med na ci zer gtad med cing*// gnas skabs 'khrul 'khor yin pas mkhyen par mdzod// slad nas bde gshegs rig 'dzin yongs 'dus ni// yongs rdzogs bri ba'i mdun pa mi g.yel 'tshal// bla ma kun she'i yig lan 'dir 'thus so// zhes pa'i rten du skra yi thum bu 'bul// lcags glang hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum la// spro lung gzhi ka'i lcang lo can nas dge

༈ ze)gnas nang nang so rdo rje snying po'i dris lan/ ༈ 'bri gung gi phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i bya bral lugs gnyis kyi dben pa'i nyams chung bdag lta bu ?la/ thugs kyi dag snang mngon par 'phro ba'i zer gyis bskul te/ nyid kyi sku skye sngon ma gang du bzhes dang*/ da lta'i gnas tshul ji lta bu yar lung phyogs su bzhugs tshe/ ltas mtshan gsal bar byung ba la/ rjes su dpag na sngon nas bdag dang 'brel ba ji lta bu yod snyam pa rnams la lan dgos zhes gsung ba la/ bdag nyid skyes sbyangs kyi spobs pa dben zhing*/ ye shes gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa dang mi ldan pa'i tshe/ ji lta ba'i lan 'don pa'i nus pa lta ga la mchis pa lags// 'on kyang brtag pa bzhin byas pa la/ nyid dang bdag gi skye ba gong ma ji ltar 'brel tshul ni/ bdag sngon lha sras mu tig btsan por skyes pa'i dus su/ nyid sgrags kyi mdar/ khyim pa zhig gi bur skyes te/ skyed cher longs nas/ rgyal po la phul zhing bdag dang lhan cig 'khod pa na/ shin tu mthun par gyur te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang nas/ sngags kyi don la mos shing bsgrub pa na/ grogs shig gis bar chad kyi blos bskul te/ khyed kyi 'di lta bu'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i nyams len bgyis kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ slob dpon nyid kyang rdzu 'phrul phra mo 'grub pa'i rtags ldan zhig las/ mchog grub pa ni ma yin zhing*/ gzhan yang rang sdom pa dang mi ldan pas gzhan gyi mkhan po ni mi 'os na/ khyed la sdom pa yang mi ldan pa kho na nyid do zhes bsnyad pas/ de'i ngag la nyan te// bslab pa las 'das shing mtshams bcad pa grol lo// de la bdag gis lan du mar bcos kyang yid ma 'gyur bas khyim pa'i tshul gyis bag med pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa zhig tu gyur pas/ sku skye de'i 'og ma rnams su dman pa dang*/ mchog gi sku skye yang 'ga' bzhes par mngon/

de dag rnams su'ang bdag nyid kyi gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gang du'ang phan par gyur pa'i bzhed pa gang 'grub gyis pa zhig yin par go lags// ༈'di stod lung snang rtse ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ bdag ni thog med 'khor ba ru// nying mtshams sbyar ba'i sgrib pa yis// kun nas bsgribs par gyur pa las// sngon gnas rjes su dran pa yi// spobs pa mchis pa ma yin kyang*// gcig las mang du mi spel phyir// zog pa'i rdzun tshig 'di ltar zhu// bdag ni sngon dus bod yul 'dir// lha sras ming du grags pa'i tshe// nyid ni blon sras dha na shri// mkhan po la ni rab byung te// rgyu 'bras chos la sems sbyangs kyang*// rgyu 'bras 'das chos snying po las// drang ba'i chos kyi ma ngoms pas// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i spyan mnga' ru// nges don theg pa'i mchog la sbyangs// de las 'das na bod yul 'dir// sku yi skye ba du ma'i rjes// rgya gar ka ma ta'i yul// rgyal bu de ba zhes byar 'khrungs// grub chen dza har pir gyi drung*// rnal 'byor chen po'i lung nod cing*// gdams pa thugs su bzhes pa'i 'phro// dzo ki de wā nā tha de// shākya mu ne mjal du byon// chos 'khor lha sar mya ngan 'das// de yi sku skye 'di ru mthong*// ji ltar rab rib mig can gyis// pha rol dngos po gang gang la// bltas na dngos la gzhan mthong zhing*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma mchis pas// ma rtogs log rtog dris mchis na// gnyis med mkhyen pa'i spyan sngar bshags// zhes phul lo/// / ༈ ye)rgya stong chos rje kun spangs pas brgya tshan gsum gyi 'bul skyel byung dus gnang ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ mnyam med shākya'i dbang po yi// lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa la// mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen pa dang*// spangs dang rtogs pa'i dpal yon gyis// thugs kyi bang mdzod rab gtams pa// 'phags pa smra ba'i seng ge bzhin// skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kyi// yid kyi re ba yongs skong bar// dus las mi yol brtse ba ni// 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhin// gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// bka' yi gsang ba yongs 'dzin zhing*// dam tshig mchog la rab gnas pa// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje bzhin// gdams pa ston pa'i slob dpon la// sgo gsum mos pa'i gdung shugs kyis// snying nas mchod cing bkur ba ni// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// gang zhig mkhyen pa'i nam mkha' la// legs byas legs pa'i 'od stong can// chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab sbreng ba// rgyal stong kun spangs chen po zhes// gang de'i gsung gi glegs bam ni// rab snyan tshig gi sdeb sbyor la// don bzang dga' ba'i mchid dang bcas// rab mdzes thub dbang sku 'dra ni// gser bzang btso ma'i 'od 'phro bzhin// gangs can mgon po'i phan yon mdo// phyag rgya nyams pa med pa dang*// su ri mchod sdong dbang po dang*// dri med shel mtshungs kha btags bkra// dri zhim reng bu bcu phrag tshun// gan pa'i dar chen yug dang ni// rab bkra'i cod pan ze prog bcas// gse'u'i tshems las grub pa dang*// bkra shis rtags kyi mtshan pa yi// gan dkar nyams pa med pa dang*// dngul las grub pa'i dkar gzugs ni// dbyar skyes rnga bo'i gzugs kyi mtshan// ghun+de rgyan drug gis mdzes pa// skyems kyi snod bzang dbyibs legs rnams// mnyam med ha lo'i shugs ldan zhing*// dkar 'dzin gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa// gan gyi gos chen rta hun ni// gser tham sdum gtsigs ri mo can// cha mdzes bzo dbyibs nang dar bcas// dpung dar cod pan dkar po bkra// slar yang rgyu bzang dbyibs mdzes pa'i// cha mdzes gser mdog gsar pa'i gon// dbyar gyi nam sbyor zil gnon pa'i// byin za'i 'od 'bar bgo ba dang*// bla gos char rung phrug gi gzan// byu ru'i mdog mtshungs ma nyams shing*// ji ltar 'os pa'i nyer spyad rgyu// srab chen ta hun sgril mar bcas// nyi byed 'char kha'i zer mtshungs pa'i// rked chings ser po mchur ring ba// dri med rā ga'i mdangs 'phrog pa'i// stan dgab gding ba tshal ldan zhing*// bkra rje 'od 'bar zhes bya ba'i// ut+pal 'dab mtshungs ral gri bzang*// lo ma'i btung ba mchog gi rgyu// ser nag sig grags bcu phrag cig// a yu ral pas sna drangs pa'i// theg chen mdzo g.yag bcu phrag bcas// ngal sos dbang po'i bzhon pa yi// khengs pa 'phrog byed rta'i mchog// rgyal chen kun dgas sna drangs pa'i// mtha' yi shar ldan mda' dang ni// theg gsum dre'u pañtsa'i grangs// gnam lcags drag po'i mtshon gyis kyang*// gzhom par mi nus rdo rje'i go// zhang mkhar dang bcas rgyal mtshan dang*// rgyu dang byed po'i zol spangs pa'i// dri med dngul dkar srang rgya dang*// rin chen gser bzang zho brgyar bcas// brgya tshan gsum gyi skyes bcas te// mdo sngags 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes// dge slong ma ti'i mtshan 'dzin zhing// ci bgyis las kyi pho nya la// brtson pa'i khur 'dzin chos grags dang*/
