dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang bcas te// sgos su mngags pa ma nus yi// grangs ldan pho nyas son pa spro// nyid sku mi nub rgyal mtshan ni// 'gro ba'i dpal du rab brtan zhing*// skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la// zab yangs chos kyi char phab ste// nges don bdud rtsis tshim mdzad spro// kho bo cag kyang 'byung bzhi yi// phung po 'dus pa'i sgyu lus 'di// dus kyi ba mos ma nongs shing*// bya bral 'dus par bcas pa kun// nges med kun rgyu'i spyod yul gyis// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma la// mos par lhur len ma bor tsam// da lta phyogs 'dir bde bar gnas// skabs kyi zhu mchid gsol ba ni// sngon gyi las 'phro smin pa yis// legs par mtshams sbyar phyogs der ni// slad nas bdag lus phyin na zhes// yang yang bskul bar mdzad gyur kyang*// dus dang stobs kyi dbang gyur pas// re zhig phyin pa'i thabs ma rnyed// 'on kyang lhag bsam bden pa yis// legs smon zab mos mtshams sbyar te// mi 'gyang myur du mjal ba yin// rten 'brel mtshon phyin rtags tsam zhig /slar yang pho nya'i lag 'tshal gyis// chu skyes dbang po'i mdangs mchog las// brtson pa'i bung ba bskyed de 'bul// khro mo nag pa zla ba yi// dga' ba dang po'i tshes bzang la// spro lung bla brang rtse nas dge// / ༈ re)de'i yig chung zhu lan// ༈ yig chung mdzad don/ snga sor nas 'di phyogs phebs bzhed ched po mdzad 'dug kyang*/ lcam sring yum sras kyi gnad bskul ches pa che ba ?la brten phebs ma thub pa thugs bden zhing*/ da lam 'bul ba dngos gtsang zhing rgya spangs yod par gnang byung ba rnams 'dus byas mngon gyur gyi dge rtsa bzhin sgrub pa ni/ lag g.yog pa'ang sha tsha snying nye las 'bras la 'dzems pa dkon par gda' bas mi 'grub par gda'/ dge 'dun bya bral rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen/ bsam gtan kyi sgrub rgyags su ci 'gyur bgyid par yod cing*/

ma rgan mo'i 'das mchod kyang phyi ma'i rnam smin la ma lus tsam thon pas nan ltar thugs rjes bzung bar mchis shing*/ dge rtsa ma lus pa sems can thams cad byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam gyis rgyas btab yod lags/ da res bdag kyang mjal shin tu spro ba nas/ al rngod tsam du e phyin gyis 'dun pa byas// 'dir khang thog so sor bskor byang bzhin byas pa yin kyang*/ chos dam tshig la brtsi bzhag byed mkhan med pa'i/ gnas skabs kyi khyi kha rdo len du chos 'chad re dgos 'dug pas/ bdag kyang cis kyang sdod dgos zer nan byed pa dang*/ khyad par a lce 'di sa gang yang gi dbye ba ma phyaid pas sdod dgos zer shin tu nan che ba'i gnad tshig byed pa zhig byung bas/ da lam res la myur thabs de phyogs yong thub pa zhig ma byung ba de ltar yin zhing*/ slad nas myur du mjal ba'i smon lam kyang 'tshal/ yangs pa can pa dpon slaub kyi gnas tshul gang dang ci slad nas/ dge slong gi ngag nas 'bul/ da lta dus snyigs ma'i dbang gi sems can thams cad nyon mongs hrag cing*/ khyad par rgyal ba'i bka' lung dang snying po'i don la yid ches pa dka' ba'i dus red gda' bas/ gdams pa lhad med zab dgu bstan kyang*/ yid gnyis dang the tshom gyi gzhi che zhing*/ chos spong gi las sogs pa las/ don du 'gyur ba mi gda' bas bdag gi gter chos 'dra phran bu 'di yang*/ rang nyams len pa las gzhan du 'phel na snyam pa'i blo 'dod ma mchis nges yin kyang*/ nyid sku skye sngon ma'i 'brel pa zab mo la brten/ bla ma dang chos kyi phyogs su/ log g.yem 'khrul pa'i bar chad kyi glags mi rnyed pa'i ri mo ltar/ dad pa dang dam tshig la 'gyur ba med pa yid ches pa la brten/ nga rang gi 'chi chos// yid kyi gnag pa dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi chos tshan bzhi pa 'di gsung rten du 'bul bas/ bdag dang mjal yang 'di las zab pa'i chos 'bul rgyu ma mchis shing*/

der ma zad a+yon rin po che nyid dang dngos su mjal yang*/ gdams pa 'di las lhag pa ni yod mnyam pa ma mchis pas/ 'di nas spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nub 'dun pa bgyid pas// lung bzhed pa 'tshal zhing*/ thugs nyams su bzhes na/ thugs yid ches pa'i rtags 'char ba lags// sku skye snga ma'i 'brel pa dang*/ a+yon rin po che'i gter chos kyi dbang skal ji ltar yod sogs snga sor thungs pa phul ba las gsal ba 'bul rgyu ma mchis shing*/ sku skye 'dir rdzogs chen la nyams len mthar phyin na bar ma chod par 'bras bu thob par go lags/ de ltar ma gyur zhing*/ bdag gi tshe yang bar chad du gyur na/ sku skye rting ma mjal yong bar 'dug /yang da res rdzogs chen la thugs dam gnang rgyu ma byung zhing*/ bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par mthar phyin na/ sku skye kha shas dngos su mjal snyams pa zhig ma byung lags/ 'on kyang smon lam dbang btsan pas/ ji ltar mdzad pa'i smon lam ltar bdag gis kyang 'dun pa bgyid pas/ dus dang gnas skabs kun tu 'bral mi yong lags/ spyan la phan pa'i sngags shig phul yod pas thugs nyams su bzhes pa zhu/ 'di phan po zhig yong gin yod lags/ dgongs gcig gi dpe bdag la med kyang btsal nas 'bul ba yod/ sngags gul dang sman thum mtshon pa yang 'bul// ༈ le)gtsang se brag bla ma'i zhu lan//

(105) ༈ rigs dang chos kyi 'byor pas rgyas kyang*// dman pa'i brtul zhugs dang du blangs te// snying po'i lam la bdag gzhan gzud pa// dus mthar snying nas khyod tsam min pa/ kha zhe'i ngo stod gting nas spangs so// bdag la 'phrin yig lan du springs te// lo gcig chos kyi skal pa lta bur// gdams pa'i yi ge bskur zhes 'phrod par// chos kyi dri med legs bshad 'di ni// slad ma'ang rgyang nas 'bod pa gsan cig /'khor ba'i spyi babs gnas tshul 'di ni// mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon lags so// yod med rtag chad phyogs 'dzin 'di ni// a 'thas 'jig pa'i mkhan po lags so// theg pa'i rang gzhung grub mtha' 'di ni// gnas skabs lam gyi skyel ma lags so// rgyu 'bras ston pa'i drang ston 'di ni/ lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don lags so// rang bzhin stong pa'i chos dbyings 'di ni// rdzun phugs gtib pa'i snying po lags so// dbyer med gdod ma'i zung 'jug 'di ni// bcos sgyur bral ba'i byar med lags so// 'di ni gshis babs gnas tshul zhes su// rgyal bas mdo rgyud gsungs zhes grags so// de las ma g.yos rang babs skyong bar// bla ma rnams kyi lam tshul lags so// spyad bya spyod bya'i mtha' dang bral bar// skyon med tshul khrims spyod mchog lags so// 'di ni gdod nas dri ma ye bral// ka nas dag pa'i chos sku lags so// sna tshogs 'char zhing kun tu 'phro bas// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan can lags so// 'khor dang myang 'das kun 'das kun la khyab pas// sprul sku'i 'phrin las rgyun lam 'chad do// de ltar phyogs go'i blo yul 'di ni// chos grogs khyed la rgyang nas springs so// 'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba gang de// mar gyur sems can kun don bsngo'o// zhes pa 'di ni dge byed ces bya yi// hor zla drug pa'i yar gyi tshes la// gnas chen 'dabs nas bris pa dge'o//

༈ she)mthil gyi gzims khang rtser gnang ba'o// ༈ gang gi 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir// yang yang skye zhing 'khrul pa'i tshul// smon pa bzang po'i stobs 'chang ba// gdul bya bde la 'god mdzad de'i// gsung bris blo ba nye ba'i gtam/ legs par son la rjes yi rang*// 'khor bcas snyigs dus 'dren pa de'i// thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs bkang ste// slad nas kun bzang nags khrod du// rim par byon pa'i sgra snyan thos/ kho bo dus mtha'i bya bral ba// chos dang srid kyi bya bas dben// phyogs 'dir son nas zhag gi grangs// bdun gsum nye bar mtshams su mchis// rgyal ba'i bstan la rab byung yang*// smon lam dbang gi mgo skyes dang*// go ba dkar po'i tshul 'chang zhing*// nges med 'chol pa'i yid spyod can// gang de dge 'dun ngur pa'i tshogs/ khri phrag dbus su spobs pa ni// kun nas zhum zhing sngo ma thog /de phyir rang gnas dben pa'i mtshor// ci dgar rgyu ba'i chu bya dag /gtad med lhug pa'i 'gros skyong snyam// 'on kyang bstan 'di'i snang byed mgon// rin po che yi bkas bskul nas// da lo'i bca' sgrigs dbyar gyi chos// bdag la shod ces snga phyir phebs// gnas skabs rgyu mtshan sngar ltar phul// slar yang bka' nan che ba nas// 'dus byas chos nyid ma bstan na// dus kyi snga phyi gang babs su// da lo ci gsung bsgrub par zhus// nyid kyang thugs la legs bzhugs shing*// slad nas gnang 'os rim gyis 'tshal// chu stag hor zla drug pa yi// rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes bya la// 'brong ngur dben pa'i gnas nas dge // ༈ sa)e waṃ du shes rab 'od zer la gnang ba/ ༈ bdag gi bu skyes sbyangs kyi shes rab dang ldan zhing*/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan du mas phyug pa de'i yi ge zhib cha son/ khyed kyi nad de la sngon las dang*/ 'phral rkyen du ma zhig gis/ lhongs kyi rnam pa shin tu che bar byung 'dug pa de yin/

re zhig sems kyi snang ba zil gyis ma non gyi bar/ bag chags rgyud goms 'di shas 'thug drags pas/ rten 'brel rgyu 'bras kyi cha mi 'dor ba'i phy-ir/ sman dpyad rim 'gro yang bsten 'tshal/ ces rim par srings pa de yin/ snang ba sems su shes pa'i gang zag la/ ha cang rgyu 'bras kyi rtsis gdab kyi lhan pa mang na/ slar la chings pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ gang gis kyang mi shigs pas rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ gang gis kyang mi rdzi bas seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes kyang ste/ ngo bo rang bzhin la bcos bslad dang bral ba'i rang 'gros/ ji ltar snang yang ma 'gags pa rtsal/ gang ltar shar yang rkyen gyi phyir du mi 'breng bar rang sa zin pa ni/ rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i chos nyams su myong ba zhes bya/ yang zab rdzogs chen gyi lta ba'i phugs snyogs pa yin pas/ rgyun du de las ma 'da' zhig zug gzer sgyu ma'i snang brnyan du rtsal kyang*/ skabs su bogs 'don du la dor zhing*/ lam du btang bar mdzod/ bdag kyang nyer gsum nas mtshams bcad/ da lo mtshams pa byed snyam gyi mdun pa byas yod pas/ myur du ma mjal yang 'du 'bral med/ gsang spyod kyi rnal 'byor de kho na ltar 'tshal/ de res nga rang gi skra thum bu la rgya 'byar yod/ tshes la// ༈ he)rgyal 'bod du bla ma gtsang pa la gnang ba// ༈ mched grogs gtsang pa dam tshig gtsang ba'i yi ge dang ni las kyi 'brel pa'i ja bzang 'byor// da lta'i dus 'dir lab lob mang po'i dus skabs min kyang smras na zhen 'dzin ya mtshan che/ kho bo sprang po sna tshogs rang grol rang don rdzogs kyang gzhan don ma rdzogs zhing 'dir skyes// mthong thos dran reg mthar phyin grol ba'i smon lam btab kyang las ngan bsags rnams grol ba nyung*// de nyid phyir du che khyer dang ni 'gying ra gtsang sbra ber thul gyon 'dod ma shes min// kun la phan phyir dman pa'i cha 'dzin mtho dman gang la'ang 'brel pa 'jog pa yid ma yin// rab dga' 'phel gnyis bsod nams e yod 'dzom par e gyur da res lta// rgyu lus 'di yi byang chub ma grub da dung 'khor ba'i zhen 'khris dam pos bcings pa na// da lta'i nad 'di sos par gyur yang skye bar sa bdag klu'i nad kyis zin// gti mug chen pos 'jig rten la dga' de phyir 'khor ba'i bya ba sgrub pa rje rigs te// zhe sdang gis ni phyi nang dgra gnyen kun la sdang 'khrugs rgyal rigs bdag nyid dngos// 'dod chags kyi zhen rang gzhan yul nor chags 'dzin kun byed bram ze dmar po ste// ser snas dkris pas yul dang yulacan 'dzin zhing 'ching ba dam pos rab dkris dmangs rigs so// phrag dog gdug pas rang gzhan kun 'tshe sdug bsngal bsgrub pas gdol pa nag pos gtong mi shes// dug lnga ma spangs sa bdag klu nad sos pa kho bor ma zad rgyal bas kyang ni gzigs pa nyin skar tsam// de bas shes ldan yod na da ni rang gzhan bya ba rkyen 'dis bskul te ma bsgrubs na// phyi nas byang chub sgrub pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba kho bos ma mthong gzigs pa 'dug na dris// zhes pa tsam 'di snying nas ma bzod grogs po la smras don 'gyur 'dug na gzhan la'ang smros// gzhan du ma 'chad 'di min gtam gyis chog par zad do snying nas yin ston bcang ba dge

/zhes pa'i gtam gyi gang byung 'phreng ba yid sngar gang shar spang blang bral ba bdag gis bris// dge bar gyur cig khams gsum sems can 'khor ba'i gnas la zhen pa log te byang chub shog /sa mā staḥ / ༈ e)'bri gung mthil gyi slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen pa la gnang ba/ ༈ gang zhig 'phra ba'i dmigs pa'i yul bral yang*// ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ji snyed pa// gzhan gyi lkog gyur 'dir ni mngon sum bzhin// mchog gi dngos grub lta bu'i dpes mtshon par// rig byed mkhas pa'i lag gi 'du byed kyi// rab skrun lha rdzas mtshon gyis byugs 'dra ba'i// mdzes byed sam+bho tra'i ngos yangs su// snyan dngags tshig gi 'phreng bas spel mkhas shing*// don bzang ljang yul skyes pa'i ro mchog bda'// dgun dus bsil ngad skyob pa'i go bar bcas// nub gling chos kyi mtho ba'i khang bzang nas// 'bad pas brtson pas pho nyas bskyod pa las// dus ngan longs spyod brgyad cu'i dus sleb ces// glegs bam la ni skyon pa'i gsung 'phrin dang*// rgya yul lan mang bgrod pa'i tshong pa bzhin// sna gcig lan lnga'i thum bur grangs bcad cing*// e mkho e mgu'i 'bru tshad phyag rgyas spras// mun khung nang du mchi ba ltar gab pa'i// ldom bus 'tsho ba pa'i bug sgo ru// shog shog sgra dang bcas te phebs pa na// nam yul grang yang 'bad pas hor langs byas// lag pa 'khyags kyang brtson pas nang du grangs// thog mar sgo chung nang du mi shong shong*// de nas shog bu'i na bza' rim bzhin bshus// re re kha nas zhal mjal zhib du byas// dngos na tshang ba grangs su dngos mi gsal// e ma 'di phyi rmi lam sgyu ma'am// ji ltar yin snyam rtog dpyod yang yang btang*// de tshe 'gyu byed rig shes 'di snyam du// e ma khyed nyid mi bden rtag 'dzin can// med par yod 'khrul 'khor 'das chos ji snyed// 'di nyid kho na dag dang mtshungs pa ni// rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma dam pa'i lung*// lo rgyus tshad ma rnal 'byor myong grub chos// 'di nyid kyis mtshon logs su 'tshol sems bor// zhes pa'i nges shes gting nas rnyed gyur pas// kun rdzob gsol ja'i gsung bzang gnang sbyin gyis// zung 'jug don dam bden pa'i ngo sprod byung*// med pa ma yin ja bzang nges pa rnyed// yod pa ma yin dngos por dmigs su med// gnyis med ye shes don du thag chod pas// bka' drin che'o thugs la legs par btags// zhes pa'i rang bzhin brjod rgyan gyis spras pa'i// 'phrin yig nyams dga'i khye'u khyod song la// nub gling skyid mos tshal gyi kun dga' der/

brag cog chos rje'i snyan du lhang lhang sgrogs/ e waṃ// ༈ ko)rgyam 'bed dben gnas su bla ma gtsang pas mched grogs la gnang ba/ ༈ sngags ma nus kyi dge slong dang*// rngo bzo rgas pa'i bya btang gi /rtog 'phreng yi ge nar mo son// rnal 'byor nyams kyi 'char sgo dang*// sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul byed pa las// rmi lam sna tshogs rmi ba dang*// 'byung bzhi las grub sgyu lus la// byer zug snyoms pa'i zlos gar las// bde sdug sna tshogs 'char ba ni// ji ltar nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la// nyi zla gza' skar sprin tshogs 'khrigs// sna tshogs snang ba ji bzhin mtshungs// brag phug mi med skam po ru// mi yis mthong dgos phyi ru yib// do nub rmi lam ci 'byung zhes// 'khrul snang 'dun rjes nyid nas bsu// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu byung na snyam// bya byed rtsis sdings 'khor yug khyer// khyed cag jag ar chom po 'dra/ kho bo chos brgyad rang grol dang*// bde dang snyan pa ring du bor// phyi nang du kha'i 'tshe bas bskor// rang gsal 'khor 'das rjen khrol le// ji ltar gyur kyang mnyam khris se// re dogs med par yangs khrol le// de ltar gda' yi bde de ?bzhin mdzod// ha ha a cang da dung sngar mus 'thud pa gal che'o// yang gsung bris zhib cha'i dbyar rnga son// slad nas 'bras don mchid 'di springs// dben pa bsten pa'i dgos pa ni// gsal gsum ldan la bar mi chod// de min mthong 'dres bsrung ba'i ni// dben pa brten pa'i dgos pa chung*// bsgrubs pas 'bras 'byung rten 'brel yin// re dogs 'ching bas 'bras bu gtor// rmi lam gsung ba ya mtshan na'ang// byung tshad gsung na zhal 'gram snyung*// kho bo bde snyan ring bor rjes// du khas bskorab a cang che// thugs gzhig med pa'i thal 'bud 'di// sngo lo 'char ba'i mtshan nyid 'dra// khyed cag sgrub par nus 'don 'tshal// ces so//

༈ khe)'phyong rgyas pa tshe dbang phun tshogs kyi pha la dad rten du zhus pa'i tshig bcad/ ༈ rje btsun skyes mchog dam pa rnams la 'dud// legs pa'i lam la mos pa'i blo mchis na// bslab bya'i snying po gdams pa 'di mnyan te// sgo gsum 'bad pas nyams su blang bar 'tshal// lus kyi mi dge bcu ni ci nus spang*// phyag skor bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams la bkur// ngag gi mi dge bcu las bzlog bya zhing*// yi ge drug sogs chos spyod smon lam gdab// yid kyi nyes pa gsum ni rab spangs la// mi rtag dad pa skye med don la sbyangs// de ltar tshe 'dir 'bad pa lhur blangs na// bla med byang chub snying po thob par gyur// ༈ go)gung red dpon po kun dga' la gnang ba// ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngo bo rang rig thugs rje 'od mi 'gyur// ma 'gags thugs rje gsal la ma 'dres rdzogs// 'khor 'das shes dang shes bya'i dbyings mkhyen pas// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa kun gyis skyobs// dam ldan slob ma kun dga'i mtshan 'chang ba// sgrub pa'i bgegs med 'gro don mthar phyin pa'i// rten 'brel smon lam 'dun pa gtad pa'i tshe// nyams la shar ba'i sgra tshig 'di lta ste// nags shod phyogs su yun ring gnas byas na// za ma'i rkyen dbang tshe'i bar chad 'byung*// sgrub pa mi 'phel dad pa'i 'tsho bas g.yengs// nang mi mthun zhing 'khor la skyo ba'i gzhi// rang smin sgrub pa 'bri yi gzho stod du// gegs byung 'bras tshe dge sbyor brtan pa thob// ma 'ongs 'gro don khams kyi phyogs su 'byung*// 'on kyang tshe tshad rten 'brel yun thung bas// tshe sgrub gdams pa'i bsnyen pa rtags bstun 'bad// bar chad dam sel grib la 'dzem pa gces// zhes pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug dge ba'i 'bras// bdag gi shes bya'i yun du gang shar rnams// dri med lhag bsam dag pas 'dir bkod bzhin// gegs med bsgrubs na bdag gzhan dge bar 'gyur//

༈ nge)khro phu dbon po'i zhu lan/ ༈ gang zhig mos pa de la 'dud byed cing*// de bstan chos la spangs rtogs 'bras brnyed de// rang gzhan de yi lam du 'jug 'god na// sngon nas skye bar sbyangs pa'i las sad bu// yid ches yin tshul 'bral ba zab nges kyang*// brjod pa mang na rang gzhan ya ga'i rgyu// de bas lus kyi pad mtsho ring nges kyang*// yid kyi bung ba dga' ba'i 'dab gshog gis// yang yang bskyod de 'bral med smon lam 'tshal// ces pa 'di yang khro phu ba'i gdung rigs bstan 'dzin phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'o/// / ༈ co)chos rje blo gros rab yangs pa'i zhu lan/ ༈ phebs don rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che zhing 'dir yun ji tsam gnas/ mdo sde rnams nas bshad tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su 'dug pa'i gtan tshigs kyi bye brag tha dad pa lugs mang zhing*/ lung bstan rnams na yang*/ bstan pa'i dus dma' mor slebs par bshad 'dug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang zag la rag lus pa la/ da dus kyi chos byed rnams kyis/ bstan pa'i don nyams su len tshul la dpags na// bzla reg pa tsam du 'dug lags/ lha sa'i jo bo chab kyis nyen pa 'di la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lung bstan rten 'brel dus gnad kyi bsgrub dgos mang tsam 'dug pa la/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mthun grub phyag len la thebs pa byung na/ lung bstan gyi dus gnad bstan pa 'di rnams nyen che tsam min/ da lo na ning nang du chab kyi gdan 'dren pa zhig ma shes lags na yang*/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi smon lam gyi rten 'brel ma 'grig na/ snga sor yang chab kyis nyen byung ba mang zhing*/ lo dus 'di yang shin tu skag par 'dug hor smad nas yong ba sgra skad che yang*/ stod nas shar te 'ong zhes pas/ da lta'i dus 'di rang dgongs pas chod pa ltar lags/ lar bzhin ni mtha' dmag rnams kyang phyogs nas g.yo zhing*/ bod nang 'khrugs pa'i da phyin ltas 'tshub tsam yong ba zhig 'dug

da lta'i dus kyi sangs rgyas kyi byang sems dang*/ rgyal blon gyi rnam 'phrul gang dag bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang 'phrin las kyi sgo/ sems can gyi bsod nams la rags par 'dug pa la brten/ lung du bstan pa bzhin/ dus gnas kyi rten 'brel ma tshogs na bar chad kyang shin tu che bar go /lung bstan bka' rgya nas/ lha sras mu ne dang*/ mu tig sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs ma gtogs don la gcig par bshad pa dang*/ rgyal po bka' thang sogs nas mched du bshad pa ni gang yang mchis/ rang ngos smon lam gyi shugs tsam la brten/ lung bstan phran bu rnyed pa ma gtogs/ gsal bar nges chod zhu rgyu ma mchis/ yi ger bris pa sogs la/ rgyal po bka' thang lugs bzhin 'dod pa lags/ mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i thabs/ gter kha rnams nas 'byon pa mang zhig yod 'dug na'ang*/ lag tu yig cha 'dzom po med lags/ nga rang bab pa'i gnam khog gi mchod rten 'bum chung ke ru zhes pa nas bton pa'i bh+yo bzlog gi rdo gsum pa zhig snga sor sa dmigs stod smad gang du 'khyol tsam byas/ da dung nyen che sar de nas bton pa'i/ bh+yo bzlog gi rdo re 'khyol na khyad che tsam 'dug kyang*/ go nad che ba zhig byung*/ skyes bu chen po rnams ni smon lam gyi mthu gzhan dang mi 'dra bas/ de tsho nas kyang*/ rgyud sde dang man ngag las bshad pa'i spyir sems can/ sgos bod 'bangs la bde thabs kyi thugs dam la 'bad pa 'tshal/ de lta na dkon mchog thugs rje gzhan dang mi 'dra bas// lo shas mtha' mi dbus su mi 'chud pa'i rten 'brel smon lam kyang 'tshal lo/// / ༈ cho)bya btang rin chen 'phel la gnang ba/ ༈ byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgoms// snang stong lha sku'i bskyed rdzogs dwangs// mtshan ldan rje la gsol ba thob// gnyug ma lhan skyes rang zhal ltos// bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub bsngo/// / ༈ jo)'phyong rgyas pa rgyal bu 'gres pa'i zhu lan// ༈

yig chung du ji ltar phebs pa bzhin/ nyid a+yon rin po che la thugs mos shing de'i bstan pa rin po che la nyams bzhes kyi dgongs pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba ni sngon nas kyi las 'phro bzang po'i rten 'brel tshogs su 'grigs pa lags shing*/ lhag par gzhigs na/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di zin med 'bras chung*/ las shugs kyi 'phen pa gtso ba'i mtho dman mi rtag pa kho na nyid gcig 'dug pa ji bzhin gzigs pa kho na nyid yin lags na/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bdag gzhan gyi don mthar 'byin pa mdzad pa rmad du 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul yin pas/ chos dang srid kyi mdzad pa bzang po da lta'i rgyun las ches cher 'phel zhing mi nyams pa'i dgongs pa bzang pos dbyar gyi bkod ma'i chu rgyun ltar bar med 'tshal/ thugs dag pa'i snang ba la brten/ spangs rtogs kyi dben pa'i nyam chung bdag lta bu la'ang*/ brtse bas gzung ba'i cha nas/ nyid kyi da lta'i snang tshul dang*/ phyis 'byung sogs kyi lung bstan 'bul dgos phebs kyang*/ bdag la blo mig rnam par dag pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan ma mchis/ lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa ni med/ 'khrul snang gi rmi lam sgugs pa'i/ mun tshod tsam 'bul 'os byung na phyis 'bul ba byed/ dben gnas brag dkar chu bzang du sgrub sde'i dgongs pa bka' drin bskyangs 'dug pa'i cha la/ 'dun pa bzhin byas tshe/ gnas gzhi der lha bsangs dang*/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog lha klu gsol mchod sogs gnang tshe/ bzhed don gegs med du 'grub snyam pa zhig byung lags/ bdag kyang spre'u lo'i bar 'dir/ lo mtshams kyi 'dun pa zhig byas yod pa grol ba dang*/ dus bde ba tsam gyis skabs gseng 'dzom par gyur na/ lhag pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa la bgegs dang log 'dren gyi bar du mi chod pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa 'bul phyir mjal ba'i smon lam kyang 'tshal zhing*/ ji srid ma mjal bar sogs dus gnas kun tu/

sku'i rim gror gang 'gyur gyi 'dun pa bgyi bar yod lags/ bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i rin chen gter// ma lus 'gro la phun tshogs mchog rtsol ba// dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// mos pa'i bu la mchog thun dngos grub stsaul// zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig pa 'di nyid// gsung mi bcag pa'i phyir du bris pa lags pas/ spyi dang bye brag mtho dman kun tu gsang rgya ldan pa 'tshal/// / ༈ nye)phan yul mkhar rtse'i lha bris pa la gnang ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzñā bh+yaḥ bod yul gangs can ri bo'i khrod gnas pa'i// 'jig rten skyong ba rang rang sder bcas pa// sde brgyad 'byung po lha 'dre mthu chen dpal// phan dang gnod pa'i 'bras bu rtsol phod pa// ma lus 'khor dang bcas la tshig 'di springs// da lta'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i gzugs sku mchog /ri mo'i 'du byed bskrun la bsgrun med pa// rin byed mkhan po bsam 'grub dpal ldan dang*// rin chen bkra shis dharma'i ming can gyis// ji srin mi rgyud chu bo'i rgyun 'bab ltar// mnyam med srid mtha'i bar du gnas pa yi// yul dang sa phyogs gang du phyin nas kyang*// rgyud sde bzhi dang rim dgu'i gzugs kyi sku// zhi dang khro bo'i cha 'dzin gang dang gang*// ji bzhin 'bri la log 'dren phrag dog pa// nyer 'tshe gnod pa'i gdug rtsub mi 'byung zhing*// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'bras bu mchog stsol ba'i// 'phrin las ma lus yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces pa 'gro 'dul gnam lcags me 'bar zhes// gsang ba sngags kyi tshul 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// rgyal 'bod dben pa'i yang rdzong de nas bris/// / ༈ to)sa pho spre'u lo sku mtshams dus su bla ma gtsang pa la gnang ba/ ༈ mdang tsho thel gyi shar phyogs lhun po yin rgyu ba'i 'du khang la me shor nas/ me lce nam mkha'i mthongs su dum bur 'chad 'gro yin 'dug pa la/

bdag gis sngags btab pas/ me tshur la ma mched par zhi song ba la/ mi mang po rtsi di ri ri byed cing 'dug pa la ji ltar byung dris pas/ mi gcig tsam mes bshur snang zer/ 'du khang ni me la thams cad shor/ thog rdib song zer ba zhig rmis pa/ sems rmis yin na ni cung grag /de min na ni gling stod smad gzims khang phar tshur/ lhun po sogs la me 'chor ba e yin/ zon gnas kyi bkod pa mdzod zer ba zhig gi lan/ dge slong la khyed kyi yi ge zhig mdzad na ci 'thad/ bdag mtshams kyi lugs nas yi ge sogs mi thub par 'dug /yang byed rgyu mang pa la'ang e 'gro na gzhig pa mdzod/// / ༈ bre)yang bla ma gtsang pa la gnang ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ yang dag nges pa'i don 'di la bza' btung gos gsum dgos pa zhig mi 'dug kyang*/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las grub pa'i lus 'di la gdams ngag med na mi dgos ka med cig 'dug de dgos par byung na/ snang grags kun rdzob kyi chos 'di yang mi bden ka med cig 'dug 'di dang bstun pa'i bza' btung gos gsum 'ju ba'i thabs gcig 'dug na da dung tshol dgos/ 'on kyang rang rig dbang du gyur na/ 'khor 'das snang grags 'di rang sems kyi 'od zer du thag chod pas/ gang ltar byas kyang mi bde med pa nga e ma ho/ he he he/// / ༈ do)yang bla ma gtsang pa'i zhu lan/ ༈ yang tshes drug bdun tsho'i skabs su/ gnas skabs gzhan rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten/ bdag tsho la'ang sku khams zhu ba'i sam+bu tra'i zhu lan gzhan ci yang med pa'i phaṭa/ zer ba'i phyag bris shig gnang byung ba la bdag gi bsam blo ma bde ba'i zhu tshig dang bcas/ sam+bu tra bskyar phul zhus dus lan du phaṭa/ gang la 'ang re dogs ched 'dzin med par gcer khris se bskyur dang aḥ mdangs khams kyang mu 'thud rang byung*/ gang min rang ma bsam par rang so zhig bzung mdzod dang zhes pa phebs so/// ༈ ne)yang de'i dus su bla ma gtsang pa'i zhu lan/

༈ skye ba du mar las smon dag pa'i mthus// yang yang 'tshams sbyar 'bral med rgyun 'grogs pa'i// bhik+ṣu ngag gi dbang po tshig 'di gsan// gzhan la bsgrag bya min no gsang ba'i gtam// nga ni rang don snga nas mthar phyin kyang*// gdul bya smon lam ma rdzogs yang yang 'dir// skye ba'i cho 'phrul du ma snang ngam snyam// don du da lta'i dus mtshungs zhing 'dir ni// nga dang 'dra ba'ang cha tsam mthong dka' na// nga bas lhag pa 'dug na a+ṣ+tsā d+yaṃ// 'on kyang dman pa'i cha 'dzin 'og ma bkur// ma mthong mi shes khengs pa bskyung ba dang*// skye rga na 'chi'i tshul dang de'i 'jig rten// 'dis kyang gzhan la phan re bstan na'ang*// las ldan 'ga' las go ba cang ma mthong*// de bas rang gzhan don mdzad thams cad kun// dman pa 'dzin na gdams ngag bcud min pa// grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar mchog tu 'dug /kun gyis dmod na dman cha dbang med 'byung*// yon tan men na gang gi'ang bkur mi 'gyur// bkur zhing bstod pa'i dus 'dir rang gi rang*// dran pa'i lcags 'debs rgyal sras lag len lags/ khyed kyi tshig la zur za ma mchis kyang*// 'a ro'i gtam la mtho dman 'byung srid na// rang gi skyon yin khyed la nyes ma mchis// gnas skabs lus kyi cha stod mi bde tsam// 'di don 'di ltar 'dug gam dpyad par rigs// nyi zla ga'u+i rlung nad 'di nyid kyang*// dza pīr rlung gi gnad 'dis 'jug par go /de yang g.yas g.yon gang nas 'byung rngubs kyang*// zhi bar bza' mtshungs ro stod lhod byas la// pho smad shed skyed 'then gal che bar 'dug /sngon chad khyed rlung cung zad rtsub par go// de bas 'jam btsal rlung gseng byug pa mdzod// de yi bgegs sel bzhed 'dod sgrub par nges// ༈ po)phyag mdzod pa sga ma mo ba la gnang ba/ ༈ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid/ rang re sngon bsags cha mthun pa rnams kyi snang ngor/

sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las de tsam zhig las ma byung ba mngon/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la'ang*/ sku tshe dang mdzad 'phrin gyi snang tshul mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma mchis te/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs chen gtso bo lta bu/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ nyin zhag phrug gcig las ma bzhugs pa sogs bshad cing*/ mdzad pa dang 'phrin las kyi snang brnyan kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu dang*/ gdul bya'i bsags pa'i rten 'brel gyi rgyu 'bras drang nges kyi tshul sogs nas/ rang re'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor nas gdul bya rnams byang chub kyi lam la bkod pa'i mdzad pa bas/ mthar shing sa la zung gi tshal du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa 'phrin las che bar gsung 'dug pa sogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa la/ rang re so skye 'khrul pa'i sbubs su gnas pa'i rtog pas 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes blos dpag par mi nus pas/ sprul pa'i sku rim par phebs pa dang*/ skye dang skye bar rjes su 'dzin zhing bdag gzhan gyi don 'grub par smon pa la/ log pa'i 'khrul rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang bar 'tshal ba ltar/ rten 'brel gyi sgo mi 'phyug pa'i phyir/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu nyid kyang*/ rtogs ldan rin po che'i gsung bzhin/ bzhugs lugs kyi rten 'brel ma log pa'i ngos/ ril por bzhugs pa mi 'thad pa med pa 'dra snyam pa shar zhing*/ bzhugs yul dus bskal la dpag na/ blos chod pa zhig dka' bar 'dug kyang*/ gdul bya rnams kyis gsol ba 'debs par rag las 'dug pa dang*/ de tsho nas kyang mkhyen dgongs kyi chod 'dun pa ltar/ slar sde srid khu dbon drung du dgongs len gtang yod pa 'khor bstun thugs 'dun gcig par byung na/

yangs pa can rang du bzhugs pa mi 'thad rgyu mi 'dug pas/ bzhugs yul gang 'gab sogs slad nas bka' bgros gnang dgos pa'ang thugs yul bzhugs pa 'tshal/// / ༈ pho)bla ma chu 'phur ba la skyor mo lung nas gnyan mkhar nag rtser gnang ba/ ༈ ji ltar shar ba'i rtogs pa la// nyams myong the tshom dri ma bral// dri med ye shes 'khor yug la// 'di phyi bar do'i khyad ma mchis// 'khor 'das ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// 'on kyang 'gro ba'i mig 'dren phyir// dben gnas ri khrod 'grim pa ni// grubathob gong ma'i phyag bzhes yin// ya mtshan che'o 'di 'drar smon// skad cig rig pa'i ngo bo 'di// ngo bo'i bla ma dam pa yin// 'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba na// ma nges rkyen gyis 'jigs pa bral// rang rig bla ma dam pa dang*// 'bral ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// kun kyang kun bzang nyid gyur cig// / ༈ bo)dge bsnyen chen po bar lha dang sog ra/ chu 'phan rnams kyis gtsos pa'i 'bri gung gi gzhi bdag rnams la bka' shog gnang ba/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang sogs brgyud par bcas pa yi// bla ma rnams dang yi dam rgyud sde bzhi// chos skyong bstan srung tshogs dang bcas pa la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi// sngon tshe rgyal dang rgyal sras spyan mnga' ru/ khas blangs dam bcas bstan pa'i gnyer gtad pa'i// dge bsnyen chen po bar lha sog ra dang*// chu 'phan la sogs ri klung mthil nyin sribs// la 'phrang chu dang sa rdo gnyan gnas pa'i// lha klu btsan bdud rang sde 'khor bcas la// sngon dus smon lam mthu yi 'dir smin pa'i// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gnam lcags me 'bar gyis// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa 'di springs so// gnas skabs 'gro ba'i du khaḥzhi ba dang*// mthar thug byang chub bde ba'i lam bgrod phyir// shākya'i dge slong bsod nams rin chen dang*// rnam dkar blo can yon bdag tshe brtan gyis// rdo mdud rtsub pa'i lam 'phreng brtson pa yi// 'dun pa rab bskyed sbyin bdag spro bcas te// rnam par dkar ba'i las 'di bsgrub pa la// ru nga phrag dog gdug pa'i sems spongs la// zhi bde byang chub sems dang ldan pa yi// mthun rkyen yid bzhin bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las bsgrubs// rang dgar gnas dang pho brang bcas rnams kyang*// 'phrang rtsub gdug pa'i lcong rong 'di bor la// zhi bde byang chub sems kyi gzhan du dengs// gal te gdug rtsub ru nga phrag dog na// bdag nyid khros pa'i khro rgyal brtul zhugs kyis// gdug pa'i blo can gang dag brlag par byed// de bas bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig

/sa ma yā/ sa ma yā/ sa ma yā/ lcags phag hor zla bzhi pa'i dus dge la/ spro lung bde ba'i gtsug lag khang nas bris/// / ༈ me)bla ma khro phu ba nyi zla phun tshogs grags pa la gnang ba'i zhu lan/ ༈ rigs rus cho 'brang skyes sbyangs phun tshogs pa// yongs 'dzin du ma'i gdams pa'i bcud gtams pa// gang gi gsung bris lag gi pad+mor son// rgya gar dzo ki las 'ongs zab gyur pa'i// sat+ta mū la zhes pa'i sman mchog la// brten pa'i bogs 'don rdzas sbyor mchis gyur kyang*// rlung sems dbu mar bzhugs pa'i sman mchog gis// gdams pa phyag len bcas pa mchis gyur na// cis kyang 'tshal lo gnang ba stsal du gsol// zang zing 'bul ba rmi lam nyid dang mtshungs// mchog gi 'bul ba kun bzang mchod pa dngos// de phyir rab tu gnang ba stsol bar rigs/// / ༈ tse)bka' brgyad sgrub chen sman sgrub dang bcas pa grol 'phral rtsa rir sman mchod 'bul ba'i lam yig dang smon lam/ ༈ gdan sa chen po dpal gyi 'bri gung nas/ gsang ba sngags kyi rig pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gnam lcags me 'bar gyi gtam/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams chab srid brtan pa/ rgyal khams thams cad du yams dang dus 'khrug zhi ba/ char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang*/ lo chu rtag tu legs pa/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'gro ba rnams kyis bde blag tu thob pa'i phyir/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa rgyud lung man ngag dang mthun par bsgrub zhing 'grub pa'i sman phud kyi mchod pa/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du byin gyis brlabs te/ dpal rtsa ri tra dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la/ mchod pa'i phyir dad pa dang dam tshig tu ldan pa'i/ bya btang gsum sbrel 'di bzhin btang ba/ mtho dman drag zhan thams cad kyi/

skyel bsu sgrol 'don gnas mal chas kyi mthun rkyen sogs legs phyogs kyi grogs dan du gang 'gyur byas na/ 'di nas kyang bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs shing*/ gal srid gong shar las 'gal ba byung na/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nus bka' chad drag po chod/ chu byi hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum la 'bri gung sgar nas bris/// / ༈ tsho)smon lam ni/ ༈ phyogs bcu dus kyi zhing khams kun bzhugs pa'i// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ma lus zhing gi rdul snyed 'khor bcas la// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bcud chen po// nyon mongs dug 'joms rigs lnga sku lnga'i dngos// ye shes mchog rtsol bdud rtsi ra sa yan// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' bkang te 'bul// rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas shing*// 'jig rten 'tshe med bde legs phun tshogs ldan// 'gro kun tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang bla med myur du 'grub gyur cig / ༈ dze)grog sna ba mgon po rgyal gyi zhu lan/ ༈ chos ma nus kyi slob dpon ming btags kyang*// slar yang khyim na lhung ba'i go rgan gyis/ yi ge mi zer zer blos bskur ba 'byor// don med smra ba ngag 'khyal nyes yin kyang*// 'khor 'das sgra rnams brten na 'di khar mtshungs// de phyir slar yang lan du 'di bskur ro// rta rgan gnyis kyi ngag lan bskur ba 'byor// sngon dus bskal bzang dud 'gros mi skad smra// da dus khyed gnyis bla ma'i rta yin pas// mkha' spyod ma bgrod kyang ni ya mtshan che// na ning gzhe ning nam zla'i bab ser gyi// rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag thams cad du// spyir yang bskal pa bzang ba dka' bar 'dug /sgos su gzho rong lung pa'i stod phyogs 'dir// sngar gyi phyug po da lta 'gron la re// med po rnams ni ar jag yengs la re// thams cad bzang btung dkon pa'i sa 'di ru/

khyed gnyis rlung khrid 'byongs pa cis kyang legs// spyir du gdams pa zab mo'i rlung khrid 'di// sems can kun gyis shes na dga' ba la// rigs drug g.yang sa gcod pas dga' ba la// sgos su gzho rong lung pa'i phyug po rnams// yon bdag rlung khrid shes na skyid pa la// med pa 'tshol sems mi dgos ya mtshan che// rje mo rlung khrid shes na dga' ba la// ster rgyu mi rnyed mi dgos ya mtshan che// phrag phrug rlung khrid shes na skyid pa la// pha mar 'khang ra mi dgos ya mtshan che// rta nor rlung khrid shes na skyid pa la// rta mgron phrag dog mi dgos ya mtshan che// g.yog 'khor rlung khrid shes na skyid pa la// yi mug zhai zhum mi dgos ya mtshan che// de la sogs pa mang kyang bri ma lang*// rta rgan gnyis kyi dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha zhig /yun ring mi dgos rtsig rmang rtags shig yong*// zhes pa 'di/ grog snar rta gnyis gso bcos du yod thog yig lan bzhad bgad du bgyis pa'o/// / ༈ wo)dar rtse mdor rgya mi chen la zhu lan du gnang ba'i bka' shog /༈ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rol pa las byung ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ gong ma mi'i dbang po/ sa yi bdag po chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i lung gis dbang bskur ba/ 'bri gung pa chen kya'u wang rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal pos/ chang ho'i btsun rje la springs pa/ bsten par spro ba'i gtam gyi 'phreng ba/ yi ger bkod pa dang*/ zi tha hu'i srab skyogs sogs kyi rten rgya ma nyams par 'tsho byed kyis 'byor/ der sang spyi sgos kyi khams snyoms shing*/ dus spyod bde nas/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bsgrub phyi nang gi spang blang la g.yel ba med pa'i khrims kyi snyoms 'tsho ba yod 'dug pa yid spro/ 'dir yang yab mes gong ma rnams kyi mdzad srol bzhin/

gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rim dang*/ sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i nyams len 'phel rgyas su gang 'gyur/ khyad par dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba las kyang thal nas spyod pa'i dus 'dir/ a+yon gyi rig pa 'dzin pa chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung las byung ltar/ dus mtha'i dmag rnams kyi sa phyogs kun tu 'tshe ba'i/ kha gnon gyi bar 'os pa dang*/ 'grub pa rnams la sgo gsum gyis sbyor ba mi lhod pa'i 'dun pa tsam du gnas/ slar nged kyi grwa pa dang sbyin bdag mchod gzhis kyi tshong pa sogs de phyogs slebs pa rnams la/ mgo 'dren phan thogs gang che'i skyong dar sems khur du blangs pa gal che zhing*/ 'di nas kyang 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen mtha' dag yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la 'dun pa mi lhod par bgyi bas nges shing*/ 'phrod srid 'os kyang rim par 'tshal/ da lam sngags mang du btab pa'i bsrung ba rdo rje'i mdud pa tshan lnga dang*/ dngul srang do la rgya 'byar ba yod/ chu pho byi ba'i lo hor zla bdun pa'i dus tshes dge ba la dpal 'bri gung gi sa yi cha bde skyid smon pa thang gi sgar nas bris/// / ༈ zho)rin chen bsam grub la sam bho tra'i lan gdams pa/ ༈ snang srid bde chen kyi rol par shar zhing*/ gang shar lam du slong pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis sam+bho tra 'byor/ chos thams cad kun tu bzang po yin pa la/ res 'jog ci 'char/ dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ zo)dpon rgyal po la springs pa/ ༈ gsung bris drang nges ri mo'i don can// sprang po bdag gi mdun du son no// chos byed bya btang smyon pa bdag ni// mtho sa spangs te dma' ba bzung bas// re dogs ma dgos snang ba bde'o// thun sgom bzhag nas rang gshis bskyangs pas// rtsol sgrub ma dgos gu yangs bde'o// ya mthar ma re ma mthar bsdad pas// g.yang sa'i 'khor bas nyam nga med do// pha yul bzhag nas sa kun bgrod pas// bstod smad dga' sdug chags sdang bral lo// nga la gus pas dga' dga' bstod dang*// nga la sdang bas ya ga sgrog sogs// mnyam nyid snang ba rang sar gda'o// bdag gzhan kun 'dul nus pa med kyang*// blo gtad nus na mi ltung gda'o// sprang po bya btang snyoms las ngang nas// nyams dga'i gang byung tshig bshad yin no// hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bzang por// bde chen zil gnon gnas nas dge'o/// /

༈ 'o)gdan sa chen po 'bri gung mthil kyi tshogs pa spyi pa la/ ༈ dus gsum rgyal dngos rje btsun bla ma yis// lung bstan byin rlabs dngos grub mchog mnyes shing*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong 'du ba'i zhing*// rdo rje gdan mtshungs 'bri gung gling mchog tu// bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus par bcas pa yis// brjod tshig gsal ba'i ri mo rab bkra ba// pho nya'i lam gyisabagrod pa mi dman pas// phyogs 'dir son pas mchog tu spro ba 'phel// phyogs kun rgyu ba'i spong ba pa nyid kyang*// 'byung bzhi'i phung po 'tshe ba ma mchis shing*// bya bral brtul zhugs 'dzin pas 'khor du bcas// deng tshe snye mo phyogs su bde bar mchis// skabs mchid bdag cag sa phyogs de nyid du// myur bar slebs na bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs// rab dgyes 'gyur zhes gsal bar grags na yang*/ kho bo cag ni kun tu rgyu bas 'tsho// sde rigs phyogs can 'dzin dang ma mthun dogs/ kho bo cag ni gang byung bgo bas 'tsho// dmar ser tshul 'chos can dang ma mthun dogs/ kho bo cag ni dman pa'i brtul zhugs brtan// nga rgyal khong rlum can dang ma mthun dogs/ kho bo cag ni gtad med lta bar 'chol/ kha mkhas skam khrigs can dang ma mthun dogs/ kho bo cag ni byar med sgom pa'i ngang*// dran 'dzin sdug sgur can dang ma mthun dogs/ kho bo cag ni blang dor spyod pas dben// tshul mdzes don stor can dang ma mthun dogs// de lta bas na bdag 'dra der mchis kyang*// bstan pa'i gsal byed nyid las phyir gyur pa'i// rang gzhan kun la du kha'i sa bon gzhir// go bar gyur na thugs kyi bzod par 'tshal// slad nas zhing mchog gdan sa chen po ni// chab srid mnga' 'bang nyams pa mi mnga' zhing*// grogs mchog dge 'dun tshogs bcas 'tsho ba bzang*// bstan pa'i lha lam phyogs kun gsal bzhin du// myur du mjal ba'i bkra shis smon lam 'tshal// lcags byi hor zla bdun pa'i bcu drug gi// snga dro'i cha la phun tshogs rab brtan nas// dge bas rab bris mchog tu shis gyur cig// /

༈ yo)rgya ston dbon nam mkha' rdo rje la/ ༈ rang re bka' brgyud rin po che'i rigs kyi dbon dang chos kyi rgyal tshab/ bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gtsug tu 'dzin pa/ dbon nam mkha' rdo rje ba'i gsung bris/ der shar gyi sna grangs sum cu tshan dang bcas nyams pa med par/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang shes rab seng ge can gyis 'byor/ deng sang sku khams snyoms shing*/ nang ya gnyis kyi phyogs su/ 'phrin las rgyas pa'i ngos/ gdul bar bya ba'i skye dgu mtha' dag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la 'god bzhin par chen 'phel rdzong brda byas pa yin/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig la/ sgar pa 'phring po seng ge sgang du yod dus bris/// / ༈ lo)skyor mo lung pa gdung rgyud rin po cher phul ba/ ༈ zhabs drung rin po che/ snga sor zhu tho rten bcas phul ba spyan lam smin pa ji ltar byung*/ deng sang sku khams rin po che mchog tu snyoms shing*/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul ma lta bur zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i/ rim gnyis zab mo'i thugs dam nyams bzhes mi g.yel bar bzhugs pa che/ dngos cag kyang 'byung 'khrugs kyi 'tshe bas ma mchis tsam nas/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi dgai ba'i las lam 'dun pa ma bor tsam du gnas/ slad ma'ang mtho dman thams cad kyi 'di phyi dus rnam kun gyi skyabs mchog bslu ba med pa/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs brtse ba can/ rje btsun pad+ma kā ra las/ gsol ba gang gis btab na bar chad ma lus pa sel zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis gegs med du bstsol ba lags na/ mkhyen pa'i lha lam yangs par mdzes pa'i rgyan du bzhes pa 'tshal/// / ༈ she)bla ma chos dbang la gnang ba/ ༈ bla ma chos dbang gi yi ge zhib cha 'byor/ khams snyoms zhing*/ slad kyi myur du mjal ba'i smon lam yang 'tshal/ lo gsar gyi zla ba'i tshes lnga la rgya ma phu'i ri khrod/

mngon dga' chos rdzong nas bris/// / ༈ ro)zla dgon spyi par gnang ba/ ༈ zla dgon spyi pa'i yi ge der 'khod pa'i rten dang bcas pa thol bcas pa thel rtse ma nyams par 'byor/ der 'dus dge 'dun thams cad khams bde zhing*/ chos dang mthun par gnas pa spro ba 'phel 'di pa'ang*/ sngon gyis smon lam gyi dbang gis phyogs med kun tu rgyu zhing*/ gzhan phan gang 'grub kyi 'dun par yod/ mtshams don skor cig de phyogs slebs dgos tshul du 'dug pa/ dpon slob gra nang thams cad dang 'phrad 'dod che bar yod na'ang*/ da lo res thon pa zhig ma byung tshul sbrel po'i ngag nas gsal zhing*/ slar bdag gzhan thams cad la phan stobs su 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel byung na phyis skor cig yong ba'i 'dun pa byed/ da lam rten du bdud rtsi a mṛ ta'i thum bu/ dam rdzas myong grol gyi rdzas mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rten byin rlabs can du ma'i rgyun 'dre ba/ bde gshegs sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du/ sgrub rtags thon par bsgrub pa'i phur ma gcig dang*/ phyag gcig bskur yod cing*/ mgon po'i dbang lung las 'grig rnams nges par byas pa'i sku rim pa rim bzhugs zhes thos pas yid kyi dbang po dang ba spro/ 'di pa'ang rang re sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson pa ma bor tsam gyis nges/ a+yon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' lung bzhin/ spyir sems can sgos dbus gtsang byang bod bde thabs kyi 'dun pa re tsam ci 'grub bsam pa gzung yang*/ sems can spyi sgos kyi bsod nams la brten 'grub pa yang dka' tsam mchis kyang/ dkon mchog rin po cher gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis ci 'os su yang 'grub/ bar skabs 'byung 'khrugs kyi na yun ring tsam byung yang*/ deng sang bde ba nas mtshams yun mthud pa'i khams kyi 'phrod bsten tsam du yod/

slad du'ang bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa lhag par 'pher ba sngar kho ltar 'tshal zhes/ skra chings kyi kha thags kyi dkyil du/ skra yi zer bu ril ba la rdo rje'i mdud pas mtshan pa gcig /bdud rtsi a mṛ ta gtor kha mang po'i phabs rgyun 'dre ba'i phur ma thum bu gcig skye bdun ril bu khungs gtsang mang du 'dre ba'i ril bu thum bu gcig rin chen ril bu kha zas ngan pa'i 'jigs pa sel nus pa bsil sbyor chen mo ri bo'i grangs can thum bu gcig nam bza' gzims thul rgya tshos ma bzang ba gyon mus tshas bcas gcig spos dkar thum bu gcig ras dkar yug gcig rnams yod pa rtsis len 'tshal/????????.08388863(shog grangs chad pa 'dra)00000000 shing dge sbyor 'phel bar yod pa legs/ bdag kyang khams bde mus 'thud pa byung*/ khyed la dngos nyams rmi lam gyi myong rtags gsal ba mang bar byung 'dug pa/ nged rang la brda don ngo sprod pa'i spangs rtogs ma mchis kyang*/ rang re sgrub brgyud 'di'i nyams len/ dngos nyams rmi lam bzang ngan gyi rtags kyi mtshan ma ji ltar shar yang*/ bzang ba la mchog 'dzin mi byed/ ngan pa la rnam rtog mi byed par/ rang gshis kyi ngo bo skyong ba 'di gol sa chung zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba zhig 'dug pas nges pa 'tshal zhing*/ mngon sum gyi 'char sgo rnams la'ang*/ rang shar bskyangs pas snang bzhi mthar phyin par gsungs pas sems yul nges 'tshal/// / ༈ mon pa brtson 'grus phun tshogs la gnang ba/ ༈ bla ma mon pa la yig lan zur du ma thub/ rtsed mo zhig smra na/ bla ma bdag 'phreng zhing dran byung zer bar 'dug pas/ khyod rang gi blo snang ngor bla ma bdag tu gzung ba min pa/ bla ma nga nam mkha' dang 'dra ba zhig yin pa la/ a 'thas su 'dzin pa 'di 'khrul rtsa ma chod pa'i sbyabs ??su gda'/ da yin na bla ma dang rang sems sangs rgyas gsum// dbye sdu dang dgag sgrub kyi 'khri ba chod// dus da nas btsan sa ma zin bar// 'du 'bral med do rigs kyi bu// 'on kyang 'phrad na snyam pa 'dug na/

yongs rang chog sems kyi bde khrol yin pas/ re dogs gzhan mi dgos so// dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ ho)g.yu shel ban brgyud la gnang ba/ ༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzñā bh+yaḥ chos sku'i ston pa kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku dpal ldan he ru kaḥ /sprul sku'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba shākya thub// kun 'dus rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud// rgyal dang rgyal sras pad+mas lung bstan zhing*// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa rnams kyi gtso// rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po yi// lugs gnyis bstan 'dzin rgyal sras brgyud pa'i tshogs// skye dgu'i zhing mchog dam pa brtan gyur cig /bag yod ces bya ba'i chu mo glang lor// rgyu skar bdag pos longs spyod pa'i tshe/ dus 'khor ba'i ston ra khrums stod bu mo'i khyim/ hor zla brgyad pa'i phyi ma gza' tshes dus 'phrod sbyor bzang ba la/ rā hu la drag po'i gdong gi stobs cing*/ dbang rab tu byas te/ spu shel gyi pha tsho yon bdag grwa ma'i rgyun ma chad pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu las/ sgos su ban rgyud ces pa rigs rus longs spyod kyi 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ dge bshes bzang po bkra shis pa sngon sbyin shugs kyi 'bras bu la/ dal 'byor longs spyod pa'i/ 'jig rten 'di'i longs spyod du mar ldan pas/ skye bo rnams kyi smon pa'i gnas/ 'jig rten phyi mar phan pa dkar po dge ba'i las la chog shes kyi blo dang bral ba/ zhing mchog rnam par dag pa rnams la/ yang dang yang du tshogs bsags pa'i sbyin pa la brtson zhing*/ khyad par pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa dang*/ longs spyod kyi snying po len pa'i phyir du/ gzhan gyis bskul ba ma yin par/ dad pa bzang pos gzhi las blangs te/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas gdung rab bcu pa/ chos kyi brgyud pa ma 'chol bas/ dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyis bar ma chod/ gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyar bas/

mi brgyud bcu gsum gyi bar du 'brel tshad don dang ldan par slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las grub pas/ gzhan snang du cho 'phral du ma ston cing*/ sde brgyad bran du 'khol bas dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal dang ldan pa/ rgya nag gong ma rgyal po'i lung gis mngags shing*/ shākya'i bstan pa la bzhugs pa'i ming yongs su grags pa chen kya'u wang*/ rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po zhal ngo brgyud pa dang bcas pa la/ gzho stod phyug po na ga dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i thig ler sgar pa spyan drangs/ zhabs tog snyen bkur dang bcas/ skyu ra rin po che zhal ngo gdung rabs kyi bar dang*/ ban rgyu mi ngo bcas pa'i bar/ sbra dngos grub 'khyil pa/ sgo nor gzho zo sgo khyi lcags thag dang bcas pa'i mthun gyur/ don grub bkra shis bsam 'grub bzang po rnams kyis zur brgyan/ mo thal dkyil du sbra kha'i gzhi btsugs phul ba yin pas/ 'di pa rnams zhal ngo dpon blon/ slob chos kyis thog drangs khral mda' ru grogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ sngar 'bab kyi sgrub srol ma gtogs/ gsar spros med pa dang*/ byams shog gi skyong ba zhig 'tshal zhing gal che/ 'di pa rnams kyis kyang*/ sngar 'bab kyi sgrub blangs gang ci 'dzem med dang*/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba kha zhe med par byung phyin/ nged rang gis bden pa dang 'brel pa'i mgo 'don bdag gnyer lugs gnyis nas byed rgyu yin pa'i don du 'dzin rgyu'i yi ge sbyin pa yin/ zla ba de nyid kyi bzang po drug pa la bris pa dge// / ༈ o)zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu la springs pa/ ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi bka'i srung ma/ 'phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba thob pa/ zhing skyong dbang po kun dga' gzhon nu la springs pa/ da lam 'di nas rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bzang po dpon slob rnams song yod pa/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang*/

'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi yi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes bdud rtsi a mṛ ta'i thum bu dang*/ sna lnga'i mdud pa zhig bskur yod/ chu mo glang lau zla ba drug pa'i nyer lnga la/ 'bri gung spro lung gi bla brang nas bris/// / ༈ kā)chos skyong chen po la bkra shis rab brtan nas gnang ba/ ༈ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang thams cad skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong chen po/ sngon tshe las las grub pa'i dam tshig can gyi gsung bris mdzad pa 'byor/ rang ngos 'khor ba spyi dang bye bra gi gnas tshul mthong bas shin tu yid skyo ba'i snying po'i nyams len cig ci nus snyam yang*/ zhing 'di pa'i 'gro ba rnams sems kyis ma bzod/ phan stobs su 'gyur ram snyam/ phyogs 'dir son pa yin kyang*/ blo gzu bor gnas pas spang blang gi kha ta bgyis pa la nyams len chung zhing*/ rang 'dod phyogs lhung gi bskyod stobs che ba nas dka' las che tsam 'dug na'ang*/ rang 'khris dang nye ring spangs pa'i phan sems gtsor bzung*/ sde srid phag mo gru pa'i dgongs par 'dug pas/ nang so dga' ldan pa dang*/ nged mchod yod rnams blo bsdur/ dus gnas dang bstun pa'i zhu mtshams gang 'grub kyi brtson pa mi 'dor bar yod pas/ myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ mgar nag gis ra la sus zhon 'dis zhon med pa'i/ gar 'gro 'dir 'gro mi 'dug pas/ chos skyong khyed kyis brtse bas mthun grogs sgrubs shig /ces smon lam rnam dag btab pa'i bkra shis kha btags smon nas kyi thum bu dang*/ gser mchod zho'i 'khor lo yongs su gang ba zhig 'bul/ tshes bcu lnga la bkris rab brtan nas bris dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig// / ༈ lā)bla ma la stod pa la gnang ba/ ༈ bla ma la bstod pa'i gsung bris mdzad 'byor/ khyed mkhyen stobs dang ldan zhing bu slob dang gra tshogs kyis bskor/

'gro don phyogs med du mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul du 'dug cing*/ mdzad rgyu chos dang bsam rgyu bla ma/ las su 'gro don mdzad pa yod bzhin/ bdag mthon nor gzigs la/ khyed smas pa'i thugs med brnyas yod bzhin med/ nga yi zlar byon nas dgos pa ci yod/ mkhyen rtogs ni khyed rang rgyas/ bu slob ni khyed bzang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i mthu stobs yod bzhin mod/ khyi chu gtor gyi rjes la rgyugs pa ltar kun tu 'byon pa'i ci zer gzigs pa ni/ rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa'i srol e yin/ bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i chos bzhin spyad na/ rang gzhan la phan pa de che/ de ma gtogs pa khyed zog po'am/ dam nyams sam/ bdud sprul e yin khyed rang shes/ gra yon skyong mi skyong dang*/ bstan pa la bsam pa'i 'chad nyan sogs skabs su ci babs/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis kyang*/ rang nyams dang bstun par bshad 'dug par dgongs las che/ da yang khyed dang nga mjal mi mjal dang*/ ches 'bul thub mi thub sogs/ rang rang gi khams gshis dang bstun pa ma gtogs gsal cha 'bul rgyu med/ khyed kyi mtshan ma shes kyang*/ gsung rigs 'di bla ma g.yag lo ba yin par ngo shes byung lags/ tshes gnam gang la dbu rtse g.yu zhal steng nas gang byung khyag pa'i rtsis phul ba'i zhu yig// / ༈ gā)dus 'khrug gi dus su gsungs pa/ ༈bdud bzhi'i dgra 'dul stobs chen lha yi lha// thugs rje'i dpal yon tshad gzung ma mchis pas// snyigs dus 'gro ba dug lnga'i dbang gyur rnams// log pa'i bsam sbyor gdug pa zhi bar gsol/ khyad par yul phyogs bde ldan zhing*// mi dbang 'khor bcas sku tshe brtan// mnga' 'bangs bgegs dgra'i gnod 'tshe zhi// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /sarba dza ga taṃ/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// rgyal ba'i yum gyur tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis skyob tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// zhes brjod/
shu bhaṃ sarba mastu dza ga taṃ/ dus mtha'i sprang po rin chen bsam 'grub bdag gis bris/ maṅgalaṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/

༈ thugs rje chen po'i nyams len rgyun khyer snying po gsal ba bzhugs so/// / bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// yi dam gyi lha 'di'i dbang dang lung nod pa'i gang zag gis/ thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gdams pa/ zung 'jug sgyu ma'i 'phrul ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ skyabs 'gro byams snying rje sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don dran pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa yi ge hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ mchog tu zhi ba'i nyams can/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla steng hrīḥl yi ge drug gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pas/ dbang bskur zhing sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes dmigs la mchod cing bstod do// thugs ka'i sngags 'khor sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang zhing sdig sgrib nad gdon bar char zhi bar byas/

phyir 'phros pa'i 'od des reg pa tsam gyis snod kyi 'jig rten rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can ma lus pa thugs rje chen po'i skur gsal ba las/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra sgrog bzhin pa dang*/ 'od zer tshur bsdu ba na/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje dang*/ byang sems mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad spyan drangs te/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim par dmigs bzhin pas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrīḥzhes bzla bar bya/ dmigs pas skyo na/ phyi snod kyi gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi yi dam la th-im/ de rnams kyang rang gi lus la bsdus te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yig drug gi sgra la grangs te bzlas pas 'byung ba'i rlung du yang 'pho zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// des kyang ngal na rang lus kyang stod smad nas snying ga'i hrīḥl thim zhing*/ de yang mthar gyi mi dmigs pa las/ mig gi gtad sor yi ge drug dkar ram pa la shes pa'i rten tsam bgyis te bcos med du bzhag go /des ni ka dag gi don mthong bar 'gyur ro// de las rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs ldang na/ seng glang drang srong gi lus gnad dang ldan pa'am/ ci bder gnas pas/ gzigs stangs gcun zhing/ bla gab med par nyams su blang ste/ ngang las ma g.yos par yig drug bzla ba la 'bad na/ snang ba rnam pa bzhi mthar phyin te/ gzugs phung 'di nyid lhag ma med par mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog thob par 'gyur ro// thun bar dang tha ma rnams su dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i nyams len la 'bad par 'tshal/ 'di na pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags gsar rnying du grags pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bsdus te bkod pa lags pas/ gang zag phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis bka' mi bkyon pa zhu/ zhes sna tshogs rang grol bdag gis gsol to// 'di na lo pa bya btang grags pa tshul khrims bzhed pa ltar/

gzho spro lung gi lcang khrod skyid tshal du bris pa'o// lan gcig zhus// / maṅga laṃ / ༈ yang gsang zab mo'i tshe sgrub snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ yang gsang zab mo'i tshe sgrub ni/ skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang nyid tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ longs sku rgyan can mnyam gzhag gi stong du tshe bum 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum dang*/ thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor ba dmigs pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rten g.yo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags 'khor sa bon dang bcas pa la thim zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ lus thams cad bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyis gang bas gzi brjid bkrag mdangs dang ldan par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a yu ṣe hūṃ bh+rūm̐/ tshe bh+rūm̐/ g.yu bh+rūm̐/ ṇi bh+rūm̐/ ban+dha bh+rūm̐/ a yu dzñā na bh+rūm̐/ a ma ra ṇi dzi wan tā ye sid+dhi pha la hūṃ a/ zhes zhag bdun sogs su bsnyen pas/ tshe'i mtshan ma mthong bar yid ches so// thun mtshams su mchod cing bstod la/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma/ a ka ros byin gyis brlabs la dbul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ lha'i nga rgyal gyi spyod lam bya/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// zhes pa'i tshe sgrub rgyun khyer shin tu bsdus pa 'di yang*/ 'bri gung pa'i ldom bu bas rgya ma khri khang du bris pa'o/// / lan gcig zhus so/ (128) ༈ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas snying po gsal ba bzhugs so/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bha wa shūd+dha sarba r+harmaḥswa bha wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcos ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon de'i yu bas byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yāṃ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi mthar/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi tshang bug la brgyud/ lus kyi nang gang*/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/

badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā'aḥ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bo bdag la skyobs/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad mthol lo bshags so// nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur// dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas 'di nyid bya btang rin chen mgon pos bskul ba las 'bri gung bya bral bas bris pa'o// (129) ༈ sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub snying po gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dha rmā swa bhā shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ rang rig pa'i ngo bo tāṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thugs rje byin rlabs dang tshe dpal ma lus pa bsdus/ sa bon la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog dkar mo mchog tu zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mtheb srin sbyar ba'i bar du ut+pal dkar po yal 'dab rgyas pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras shing*/ zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ gyi 'od zer gyis/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan par gyur/ rang gi snying gar yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud rim pa bzhi pa'i dbus su/ oṃ ha'i bar du rang dang bsrung bya'i ming gi yi ge rtsibs rnams la tā re tuta tā re tu re swā hā/ phyi yi mu khyud nang ma la ā li g.yon skor/ bar pa la kā li g.yas bskor/ phyi ma la ye dharmā g.yas su bskor ba rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ mkhyen brtse nus mthu byin rlabs rtsi bcud ro nus tshe dpal longs spyod 'byor pa ma lus pa bkug ste/ 'khor lo dang yig 'bru rnams la thim pas 'chi ba med pa tshe dang rdo rje lta bu'i srog thob par gyur zhes dmigs shing*/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma a yur dzñā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mtshan ma nye bar mthong ngo*// thun mtshams su mchod cing bstod la/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam btab/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang snying po'i bstan pa rin po che la brtson pa lhur len zhing*/ yon tan dang ldan pa chos mdzad rin chen nyi mas bskul ba las/ 'bri gung bya bral bas/ bsam yas dbu rtsal pho brang du bris pa'o/// //lan gcig zhus so/ ༈ /rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa sbrul mjug ltar bsgrub pa snying po gsal ba bzhugs so/ ༈ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rgya mtsho chen po sngo la dngas pa'i nang du/ rin po che dang sa bdag klu gnyan gyis gang ba'i dbus/

pad dkar sdong po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ sbrul gyi phung po'i sku rgyab brten cing*/ gdengs ka mdun du phyogs pa/ de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mtha' bskor du/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ oṃ hriṃ ma hriṃ mā a su swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng dkar pos bskor ba la dmigs te bzlas pas// sngags 'phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor ba las/ bdud brtsi'i rgyun bab lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ steng 'og bar gdon gyi nad thams cad zhi zhing*/ nad bdag gi bsam ngan gdug rtsub kyi gnod pa thams cad dang bral/ bgegs gdon rnams nya sbal sbrul lcong*/ sdig sdom rta bla grog sbur gyi rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas 'thon/ rgya mtsho'i nang du thim pas thams cad zhi bde'i sems dang ldan par dmigs shing*/ bzlas pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams su gtor ma a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la gtor mgron spyan drangs la dbul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ mchod bstod nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ dus rgyun du sdug bsngal lam gtong gi nyams len la 'bad pa gal che/ gtsang kha rag gi bya gtang mkha' spyod rdo rje'i nyams len yi dam du/ stod lung bde chen gzhis kar bris pa'o/ maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so// ༈ /sku gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i nyams len snying po gsal ba bzhugs/ ༈ /na mo/

bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum mo// sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis// 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca'o// lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad 'od gsal ba stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad hūm̐ sngo char gyis gang ba'i sngon po rnams las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bsra zhing brtan la yangs shing rgya che ba/ dmar po rnams las ye shes kyi me ri/ me lce rab tu 'bar bas phyogs kun gtams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'di lan gsum bzla/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri la pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phro ba yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid pad+ma tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal mthing nag khros pa/ zhi ba'i zhal gnyis spyan gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ khro zhal spyan gsum pa dbu skra snum zhing gnag pa thor tshugs su bcings shing*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan rna cha mgul rgyan do shal ska rags dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bus brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ phyag dang po gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ bar pa gnyis gri gug dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/

tha ma'i phyag gnyis pad+ma dmar po'i 'phreng ba dang*/ pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'o// zhes bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed ni/ rang gi mdun du pad+ma tshe dpag med pa// zhes pa nas zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la bzhugs shing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'o// bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ mdun bskyed kyi sa bon las sngags 'phreng me tog gi phreng ba lta bu 'thon/ zhal nas byung ba'i sngags las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rten pa snod kyi bcud dang bkrag mdangs nus pa gzi brjid/ g.yo ba bcud sems can gyi tshe srog dbang thang bsod nams 'byor pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te/ sngags phreng la thim sngags 'phreng rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de las kyang sngags phreng byung lte ba nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur/ zhes dmigs/ bsgoms pas dub na/ sngags 'khor la dmigs pa ma yengs tsam nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ badz+ra ā yu ṣeḥ hūm̐ bh+ruṃ ṇi dzaḥ bdag gi tshe 'phel bar gyur cig tshe rgyas par gyur cig tshe la dbang thob par gyur cig sidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzla/ thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/

a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+ruṃ ṇi dzaḥb liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul shing*/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ mtshan dpe gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i sku// yan lag drug cu chos rab sgrog pa'i gsung*// ji lta ji snyed ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs// tshe dbang 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi tshe 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe la dbang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed 'od du zhu rang la thim/ bdag nyid pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes dmigs la/ dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med pa 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /de nas sgrub pa bum dbang gi dbang bzhi'i nyams len ni/ spyi bor pad dmar zla steng tshe dbang rtsal// gos dkar dmar mo gri thod 'dzin 'khyud 'khril// 'od zer dkar po spyi nas spyi bor thim// smin mtshams yan gang bum pa'i bum dbang thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ slar rkang pa gong ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ 'od zer dmar po mgrin nas mgrin par thim// mgrin pa yan gang bum pa'i gsang dbang thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ 'od zer sngon po thugs nas thugs su thim// snying ga yan gang bum pa'i sher dbang thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ 'od zer ser po lte nas lte bar thim// lus kun gang bas bum dbang bzhi pa thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/

bsdu bar mos na tshe zan tshai chang rnams// sngar ltar dbul zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab// yab yum dgyes thim bdag nyid lha ru gsal// dge ba 'di sogs byang chub chen por bsngo// de nas gsang dbang gi nyams len/ bdag nyid pad+ma tshe dpag stong ra'i dbus// ā wa dhu ti ro rkyang 'khor lo bzhi// tshigs chen bcu gnyis tshigs phran ba spu'i rtsa/dbu ma spyi bo nas gsang bar zug pa/ ro rkyang lte 'og nas spyi bo'i bar song nas sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ spyi bor 'dab ma so gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug snying gar brgyad/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ tshigs bcu gnyis su rtsa 'dab sum cu re/ nying lag gi sor tshigs la drug re/ de rnams las gyes pa'i rtsa phran ba spu'i mthar thug gi bar khyab pa'o/ sog sbubs nyi 'od lta bur dmar gsal dngas// spyi bor pad dmar zla steng tshe dbang rtsal// gos dkar dmar mo gri thod 'dzin 'khyud 'khril// sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar pos phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs yab zhal zhugs// thugs kar zhu nas rdo rje pad+mar babs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ghu ru ka wa tsa dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi bab pa tshangs bug brgyud// smin mtshams yan gang gsang ba'i bum dbang thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ rkang pa gong ma kun la 'gre/ mgrin pa yan gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ sgrub bsnyen bya/ snying ga yan gang gsang ba'i gsum pa thob/ sgrub bsnyen bya/ lus kun gang bas gsang ba'i bzhi pa thob// bsgrub bsnyen bya/ bzlas pas skyo na tshe zan tshe chang rnams// sngar ltar dbul zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ yab yum dgyes thim bdag nyid lha ru gsal// dge ba 'di sogs byang chub chen por bsngo// de nas dbang gsum pa'i nyams len ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum rang la thim// bdag nyid pad+ma tshe bdag yum dang bcas// sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros// shes rab ye shes bum pa'i dbang mchog thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/

'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud bkrag mdangs rgyas// shes rab ye shes gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ snod bcud bkrag mdangs bsdus te lus kun thim// shes rab ye shes gsum pa'i dbang mchog thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ rang nyid tshe bsod gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas// shes rab ye shes bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob// sgrub bsnyen bya/ snyoms 'jug bde bas gang ste byang sems bab// yum zhu 'od dmar gsang ba'i sbugs nas drangs// lte 'og me gnas thig le dmar po bkag /lte bar bab pa'i byang sems gyen du 'phyur// dbu ma'i yar sna thig le dkar pos bkag /tshe yi brten phur gdams pas 'pho 'gyur bral// sgrub bsnyen bya/ thun mtshams mchod gtor byin brlabs bdud rtsir mos// snying ga'i sa bon 'od kyis bskul ba yi// bla ma tshe dpag yab yum spyan drangs gyur// sngar ltar dbul zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab// yab yum dgyes thim bdag nyid lha ru gsal// dge ba 'di sogs byang chub chen por bsngo// bzhi pa'i nyams len ni/ spyi bor pad dmar zla steng tshe dpag med// gos dkar dmar mo gri thod 'dzin 'khyud 'khril// gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skye med mi 'gyur tshe yi rang bzhin la// spros na khams gsum kun kyang bkrag dang ldan// bsdus na srid pa gsum gyi gzi mdangs 'phrog /'du 'bral med pa tshe'i lu gu rgyud// brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje gdan dang 'dra// bcings pas mi phyed rdo rje'i sku thob shog /lan gsum mo// rang lus gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa// lus tshad mnyam pa bzhi pa'i bum dbang gsal/ sgrub bsnyen bya/ lte ba'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po ni// ring cha tsheg drag ldan pa gsang ba'i dbang*// sgrub bsnyen bya/ de mthar bsgrub bya'i ming gi yi ge ni/ dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba gsum pa'i dbang*// sgrub bsnyen bya/ thams cad dbyer med bde ba chen por 'dre// ma bcos rang babs bzhag pa bzhi pa'i dbang*// sgrub bsnyen bya/

slar yang skad cig rang nyid tshe dpag med// thugs kar pad zla'i dbus su hrīḥyis mtshan// thun mthar mchod gtor byin rlabs bdud rtsir mos// snying ga'i sa bon 'od kyis bskul ba yis// bla ma tshe dpag yab yum spyan drangs gyur// sngar ltar dbul zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab// yab yum dgyes thim bdag nyid lha ru gsal// dge ba 'di sogs byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes tshe sgrub zab mo'i ngag 'don dmigs rim 'khyer bde bkod pa 'di yang*/ bya bral 'bri gung pa rat+nas/ gzho spro lung gi bla brang du bris pa'o// lan gcig zhus so/// / maṅga laṃ/

drang srong dri med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/ ༈ /drang srong dri med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub ni/ rang drang srong dri med 'od zer mngon rtogs ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi zla ga'u'i dbus traṃ dkar po'i mthar/ oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dza ma ma a yu tshe bh+ruṃ nṛ dzaḥzhes bya ba mu tig gi 'phreng ba ltar bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ brten g.yo snod bcud ma lus pa'i tshe bcud ro nus yon tan thams cad bsdus te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par dm-igs la bzlas pa la 'bad/ las gzhung thams cad gzhung bzhin bya'o// 'di nyid kyang dri med 'od zer la mchog tu 'dzin pa rin chen bzang pos bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa bya bral bas 'phreng po seng ge sgang du sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/ ༈ /log tri'i ngag 'don bsgrigs pa snying po gsal ba yod/ ༈ /rang tha mal gyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang snying ga'i thad du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su nyi zla'i steng du aḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas lte ba'i 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du āḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ rang dang mchod rten dkar po'i phyi rol du 'khor lo dkar po'i gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol rim pa bzhin du rdo rje sngon po/ rin po che ser po/ pad+ma dmar po/ ral gri sngo ljang rnams kyi gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rang lus gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa chen po/ yar rtse nam mkha'i dbyings su reg cing*/ mar rtse dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i rwa rtses byad ma gan rkyal du gnas pa lces brang kheb pa'i dkyil du btab pas snying ga'i nri dang

bcas pa gzer ba/ yar gyi rwa nang rnams su bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rtse mor rdo rje bya khyung dang bcas pa/ mar gyi rwa nang rnams su chos skyong srung ma 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu byad ma'i lha srung pho nya las mkhan rnams kyis rang gshed rang la 'bebs pa'i las byed par gyur/ rdo rje'i lte ba nang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥ'od du zhu ba las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid drang srong khros pa'i khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis tho ba dang ral gri/ tha ma gnyis mchod rten bteg pa/ bzlog bsad gnyis la gnam lcags kyi thal mo brdab pas/ mnan pa la ri rab bteg pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du rdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis nyi zla'i steng du bsgrad pa/ gcer bu rgyan med shin tu khro zhing mi sdug pa/ de'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngam/ pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal rigs bdag gi tshul du dbu brgyan can/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥlas 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus pad nyi'i gdan la rang 'dra ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rin po che'i gur khang gi nang du bsrung ba'i bsgrub bya mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsal bar gyur/ rang gi mdun nam phrag pa g.yas su drang srong dri med 'od zer skem zhing rad pa'i lus can/ smin ma dang ag tshom brang gi rgya mdor sleb pa/ ras dkar gyi smad dkris dang stod g.yogs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ phyag g.yas na ril ba spyi blugs dang g.yon lung thang gi phreng ba bsnams pa/ 'khor drang srong 'bum phrag du mas bskor ba/ de ltar bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rgya gar yul lho phyogs ri bo kun 'dus kyi rtse mo nas drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

oṃ trang du tri na trang du dza dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs ngos// yul ni rgya gar in+d+ra'i yul// ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo na// nags tshal dra ba'i klong dkyil na// rin chen sna lnga'i khri stengs na// slob dpon drang srong dri med ni// drang srong 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sems can don las gshegs su gsol// sde brgyad 'dul phyir= /byad ma bzlog phyir= /'byung po 'dul phyir= /rgyal bsen 'dul phyir= /dgra bgegs 'dul phyir= /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐ bdag cag bsod nams bskal bar ldan// drang srong 'khor bcas byon pa legs// ji srid brtan par bzhugs su gsol// ji srid brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*/ khyed kyis thugs rjes bdag la gzigs// thugs rjes bdag la dbang bzhi bskur/ hūm̐ slob dpon dri med 'khor bcas la// bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// sde brgyad dbang bsdud dngos grub rtsol// mthu rtsal dbang gi dngos grub stsol// oṃ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// drang srong rgyal po rigs sngags bdag /drag sngags bdag po mthu rtsal can// sde brgyad 'dul ba'i drag shul can/ khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// snang gsal sgron me 'bar ba 'dis// ma rig mun pa sel bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ khyed sku sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// bdud rtsi khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sku rnams dbyings nas dag pa bzhin// sems can sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐// bdud rtsi dang ldan spos mchog 'di// drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rje byin brlabs bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra dhu pe aḥhūm̐// bskal pa bzang po'i nas 'bru bzhin// zhal zas ro mchog brgya ldan 'di// drang srong khyed la 'bul lags na// thugs rje dang ni dam tshig dang*// gnyis med don gyi bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra n+yai we d+ya āḥhūm̐/

ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs bzhin// sgra brnyan rgyun rnams thams cad kun// drang srong khyed la 'bul lags na// thugs rje dang dang ni dam tshig dang*// gnyis med don gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra shab+ta āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yi// drang srong chen po dri med ni// bag chags sgrib pa mi mnga'i phyir// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i phyir// zhal gcig phyag gnyis drang srong sku// 'dod chags dug lnga spangs pa'i phyir// sku mdog sngo skya keng rus gzugs/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i phyir// dbu skra
