lcang lo gyen du 'khyil// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// zhal nas sde brgyad spu gri gsung*// sde brgyad gnad la 'bor ba'i phyir// phyag na gser gyi rdo rje bsnams// sprul pas kun la khyab pa'i phyir// 'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor// sde brgyad dbang du bsdud pa'i phyir// ri bo kun 'dus rtse la bzhugs// sangs rgyas (137) sprul pa yin pa'i phyir// sku la na bza' ras gos gsol// sa bcu zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir// nags tshal dra ba'i phug na bzhugs// tshe dang bsod nams spel ba'i phyir// shing thog sna tshogs zhal du gsol// sangs rgyas stong gi sprul pa'i sku// drang srong khyod la gus phyag 'tshal/ khyod kyis bdag la dngos grub stsol// sde brgyad dbang du bsdud pa'i phyir// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bdag la stsol// 'dir tshig zhig chad 'dug pa slar 'bri dgos/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// las ngan dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// bar chad rgyal 'gong 'dul ba dang*// byad ma sbod gtong bzlog pa dang*// lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i phyir// drang srong chen po rab khros zhing*// nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// zhe sdang dug lnga gzhom pa'i phyir// rigs lnga sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// mi dge bcu rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i phyir// drang srong 'khor bcas thams cad bzhengs// bar chad log 'dren 'dul ba'i phyir// phyag mtshan thams cad mtshon char bzhengs// bzhengs shig drang srong chen po'i tshogs// 'dir byon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig

/'phrin las bcol ba'i dus la babs// rgyal 'gong 'dul ba'i dus la bab// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab// rang gi lce rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sde brgyad thams cad kyi snying nas drangs te/ mdun du 'khod pa'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram re bkab pas 'gul 'khyogs mi shes par gyur/ hūm̐ nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab// nga ni gshin rje kun gyi yum// nga ni khams gsum kun gyi bdag /nga ni dbang phyug chen po ste// nga ni srog gcod kun gyi rje// nga ni srid pa kun gyi bdag /nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi bdag /nga ni snying khrag kun gyi bdag /khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod// nga yi las rnams khyod kyis bsgrubs// hūm̐ sangs rgyas thams cad gzu dang dpang*// dam chos thams cad gzu dang dpang*// dge 'dun 'dus pa gzu dang dpang*// dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang*// chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang*// rgyal 'gong chen po 'dul ba'i phyir// drang srong chen po dri med khyod// sku ni mi 'gyur brtan pa la// phyag mtshan 'khor lo bsgyur bzhin du// dgra bgegs mgo la 'khor lo bskor// rgyal 'gong lus la 'khor lo bskor// sde brgyad srog la 'khor lo bskor// 'khor lo g.yas su bskor tsa na// rgyal 'gong snying la 'khor lo rgyob// 'khor lo g.yon du bskor tsa na// mo gdong snying la 'khor lo rgyob// rang gi lce gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lce rtsar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor āḥs mtshan pa'i mthar sngags 'gal me lta bus bskor ba// oṃ trang du tri na trang du dza dza/ lce rdo rje rtse dgu pa khong gseng can du yod pa'i rwa bar gyi rtse thams cad du/ phaṭa dmar po mchong chag pa lta bu dgu las/ me'i tsha tsha mang du 'phros pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje 'bar ba mgar gyi tsha tsha lta bu 'phros pas gnod byed rnams la phog pas tsheg sgra dang bcas te rtsa sbur bsregs pa bzhin rdul du brlag par gyur/

log tri bsnyen sngags dang srung sngags bzla/ mdun gyi brub khung lcags khang nag po gru gsum pa dug gi me 'bar ba/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa'i nang du/ phag spyang gi thod pa gshin rje pho mo 'jigs su rung ba gnyis kyi bar du/ dgra gdon byad ma shin tu nyam thag pa/ mtha' bskor du lha ma srin sde brgyad mtshon cha sna tshogs thod pas rngam zhing za bar gyur/ dgug gzhug drag tu bya/ yang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sde brgyad snying gar yod pa'i srog yig nas drangs pas/ 'dar zhing thal mo sbyor/ phyag 'tshal ci gsung bgyid do zhes smra zhing*/ sa bon rnams drangs/ hūm̐ gi gdan du byas par dmigs/ rang gis sngags bzlas pas/ byad ma'i sbad 'dre thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer gyis hrag hrag tshig cing phar log pas kho rang gi gshed byas te/ sha zos khrag 'thungs/ gshin rje pho mo'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gi dug gis/ kho yi rtsa rgyus rul zhing myags/ byad ma'i snying nang du dhi las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa g.yon du 'khor bas gnod byed de'i srog rtsa mya la la bcad cing sde brgyad rnams kyis bsad bcad gtubs sha zos khrag 'thung bar gyur/ bzlog bsad mnan sngags sogs bzla/ thun mthar/ rang gi lag pa rdo rje'i brag ri lta bur gyur pa'i mthil gnyis nyi zla/ sor mdzub thams cad lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa/ thal mo brdabs pas dgra bgegs gnod byed bsgral ba'i sha khrag dum bu thor thor song ba/ sdig pa rnams kyi lcib lcib zos par gyur par dmigs/ thal mo brdab bo/ thun mtshams zhi gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gyis 'bag btsog dag par gyur// āḥyis rgya mtshor spel nas kyang*// hūm̐ gis gtor ma bdud rtsir zhu// rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ri rab ri'i rtse mo nas// dri med 'od zer spyan drangs te// mdun du pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/

kha kha khā hi khā hi du na ya swā hā/ drang srong dri med 'od zer la sogs drang srong rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ drang srong thams cad dgyes nas ni/ drang srong sde brgyad dmod pa bzlog 'khor bcas gnas su gshegs par gyur/ maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/// / ༄// rgyan khyer gyi tshe sgrub sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa sku bgres pa la gnang ba'o/ ༈ / 00000255chad pa00000000 ye shes tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun du thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i man ngag ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rigs kun 'dus pa'i gu ru pad+ma la tshig bdun mas gsol ba snying thag pa nas btab la/ lho nub rnga yab kyi gling*/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ gu ru'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/ bdag gi lus la thim pas/ sdig sgrib dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs te/ bdag lus rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas/ 'chi med kyi tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rang 'dra'i yum dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ gu ru pad+ma tshe dpag med yab yum gyi tshul can/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par bstim pa la/ gsol ba btab pa'i tshul du bsnyen pa 'di nyid bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru pad+ma badz+ra satwa dharmā kā ya a yur dzñā na sidhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ sku gang sbyor mtshams nas bab pas spyi bo nas zhugs/ rang gi lus gang nas/

lus snang stong ngag grags stong*/ yid rig stong*/ sgo gsum dbyer med bde stong zag med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mnyam par gzhag thun mtshams dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ gnas skabs su sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen gyi sku tshe'i bar chad dang myong 'gyur gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa zhi/ kun 'dus bla ma tshe dpag med la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas tshe'i lha ma ma lus kun rdzogs/ tshe dang ye shes chos sku mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i 'dzab bzlas pas/ 'dod pa'i don mchog thun ma lus pa 'grub/ rgyun du bskyaid rdzogs zung 'jug gi ngang du gnas pas/ bar chod dang gdon bgegs kyi glags mi rnyed/ mthar dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas/ bdag gzhan gyi don mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo la spyod par 'gyur ba la lags pas/ thugs nyams su bzhes par zhu/ maṅga laṃ/ lan gcig zhus so/// /

༄/ nā ga rak+sha'i bsnyen sgrub bzhugs/ ༈ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya zhing*/ khyad par gti mug gi kun nas blangs pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gdug pa can dug gis zin pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing*/ nad de dag gtong ba'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi tshogs kyi las 'bras sdug bsngal drag po nyams su myong bar gyur pa snying re rje/ de dag gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bral zhing*/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bya/ de'i phyir bdag gi lus kyi nad 'di nyid kyis klu dug gis zin pa'i nad thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi go chod par bya ba'i phyir/ nā ga rak+sha'i bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par bgyi'o// swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las/ rgya mtsho chen po sa bdag klu gnyan du mas gang ba'i dbus su/ rang nyid klu bdud nag po chu srin gyi mgo bo can phyag gnyis klu gnyan gdug pa tshar bcad cing rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir sbrul sna tshogs zhal du gsol zhing tshems kyis 'cha' ba/ sku smad sbrul mjug g.yo bas rgya mtsho dkrug pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su pha mthing nag gi mthar/ oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus kyi phyi nang thams cad mes bsregs pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon bar chad bsregs te me dpung du gyur par bsams la/ bsnyen pa drag po gnyid med zhag bdun tsam du bya/ yang phe dang sngags phreng dkar po las 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu bsil bar byung bas rang dang sems can gyi nad gdon ma lus pa sbyangs zhing dkrus te thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral khyab bdag nā ga rak+sha'i skur gyur par mos la zhag bdun tsam dal bus bsnyen pa bya/ de nas zhag bdun gyi bar gang yang yid la mi byed par durakhrod kyi mi ro bor ba ltar skyur la bzhag dus rgyun du rang gi nad 'dis sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyi go chod par gyur cig

khyad par dus snyigs ma'i sems can klu nad kyi kun tu gtses pa thams cad bdag gi nad 'dis rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam pa'i lam gtong gi ngang nas/ dge sbyor la mnyam par gzhag go /de las gzhan du bdag gi nad 'di phan na ci ma rung snyam pa dang*/ 'di bas thu ru song na ci rung snyam pa dang*/ sa bdag klu gnyan la zhe sdang gi kun bslong rtsub po skad cig kyang mi bya ba ni dam tshig yin no// de ltar na nus 'chi nus kyis dge sbyor byed nus na/ gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis gnas skabs su lus kyi nad gdon zhi ba yang srid cing*/ gal te sngon gyi las ngan da lta lhongs pa'i nad dang bcas na'ang*/ skye ba mang por myong gyur gyi las rnams tshe 'dir skad cig gi smin te/ myur du sangs rgya ba la nye lcag tu 'gyur bas/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul ma bya ba de la zer ba yin/ thun mtshams kun tu dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang sa bdag klu gnyan gyi dug gis zin pa rnams la phan pa'i blos 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis/ rgyal 'bod mngon dga' chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/// / ༄/ 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs so/ ༈ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bha shud+dhaḥhaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag cig tu gyur/ de las e 'phros pas/ gnam lcags kyi gur khang du gyur/ laṃ 'phros pas de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i gur khang cis kyang mi shigs pa zhig tu gyur/ raṃ 'phros pas de'i phyi rol du ye shes me'i gur khang gnod byed log 'dren gang gis kyang lta bas mi bzod pa bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i dbus su ya ma ti ra baṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ gshin rje pho mo gdan du bting ba/ de'i steng du ma he glang rgod pho mo snol ba'i khri/ nyi zla pad+ma gsum rtsegs kyi gdan gyi steng du/

hūm̐ nyid babs pas de 'od du zhu ba las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'od zer dang bcas pas/ de 'od du zhu ba las/ oṃ ā kro te ka ya man ta ka hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ sku mdog mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag phyag drug g.yas dang po 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa/ bar pa ral gri tha ma rdo rje/ g.yon lcags kyu/ bar pa btun shing*/ tha ma sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyi gtsug tu bya khyung nag po lding ba/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khyung dang rdo rjes gtams pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ sku stod zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ sku smad stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris pa/ sbrul rigs lngas brgyan cing*/ nag khras se ral khar brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gcig gsal bar gyur/ g.yon du yum khrag mig ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃḥ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ a kro te ka ya man ta ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bzlas so// lan gcig zhus so// maṅga laṃ/// / ༄/ lnga bsdus kyi rtsis gzhi gser 'phyang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ༈ /na ma shrī ka la tsakra ye/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*// dbyer med dus kyi 'khor lo dngos// rje btsun mtshan ldan bla ma la// btud de lnga bsdus byed pa bshad// gser 'phyang la sogs 'das lo rnams// nyis bsgyur nag sogs 'das bzla bsre// de dag gnas gnyis 'og ma ni// mig gis bsgyur la bug mda' byin// mda' ros bgos lhag zla theb brtag

/rnyed pa steng byin zla dag go /zla ba dag pa gnas gsum bzhag /steng nas rim bzhin zla ba dang*// gzugs med mkha' dbang gis bsgyur la// zla ba tshes dang phyogs kyi brgyan// mkha' ro mkha' ros rnyed pa dril// lhag ma chu srang chu tshod do// steng ma ri yis rnyed dor gza'// zla dag gnas gnyis steng nas rim// mig dang gzugs kyi bsnun pa la// tshes dang bse ru klu yis brgyan// 'og ma dus gnyis thob pa'i nor// steng byin lhag ma cha shas so// gong la klu lag gis bgos pa'i// lha la dag ni ril po'o// zla ba dag pa gnas lngar bzhag /steng nas mig phyogs klu dbang dang*// 'khrig pa phyogs kyi bsgyur ba la// de nyid ri me phyogs mtsho klu// byin la 'dod pa dus mkha' ro// mkha' ro rnams ni mas rim dril// steng ma 'khor los rnyed dor lhag /skar ma'i rgyu ba rnam par dag /bsgyur byed so so byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rgyu ba 'char// tshes kyi nges pa 'tshol ba ni// bug mda' chu tshod yon tan bsrang*// dbug mtsho rnams ni tshes grangs kyi// bsgyur la bza' yi rgyu bar byin// rang rang 'khor los steng dril dor// ril por tshes byin chu zlas bgo /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*// 'byung dang 'byung dbang mtsho mi mig /bsil zer can rnams lnga rkang dang*// de las bzlog pa phyi rkang ngo*// thig le stong pa rnam par dag gzugs dang 'dod pa dag la mda'// mig dang nyi ma la ni phyogs// me dang drag po tshes zhes bya// chu dang phyogs la bcu dgu ste// mda' dang bu gar 'khrig pa zung*// dus dang klu la nyi shu bzhi// thub pa la ni de nyid ste// snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang bzung bdun mas cha shas bsgyur// ma zin dang por bsgyur ba la// dus gnyis bgos pa'i rnyed pa ni// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod do// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// dus gnyis thob pa chu srang ngo*// de lhag ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs// yang lhag 'dod bsgyur rnyed pa cha// rkang pa ma zin mtshams ma 'das// de tshe chu tshod gnyis po bsre// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yi// rkang pa'i chu tshod la ni sbyang*// de las slar yang chu srang dang*// dbugs dang 'dod pa'i char phab la// rang cha rnams kyis sbyang bar bya// de rnams gza' yi longs spyod du// sngar gyi rnyed nor mkha' mtsho bzung*// de tshe mnyam pas byin bya zhing*// gzugs dang me la de yis sbyangs// rig byed chu tshod mda' mig bsrang*// dbugs mda' 'dod char bu ga rnams// tshes grangs kyis bsgyur nyi rgyur byin// rang rang 'khor los steng dril ba// de ni nyi ma bar pa'o// nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar mar dus dang chu tshod du// 'da' chu yi ni sbyang bar bya// ma ldang 'khor lo mnan la dor// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bya ste// ma mnan ma dor lho bgrod la// mnan dang dor ba byang bgrod do// lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur// chu tshod bcud la mda' yon bzlas// rnyed pas nyi ma'i rkang pa bzung*// dus dang rgya mtsho ri bong can// bzlog pa dang bcas gnas drug ste// ri bong can dang mda' la dus// mig dang chu bo la ni phyogs// rtse mo can la drag po ste// snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang pa'i mdun mas lhag rnams sgyur// ma zin dang pos bsgyur ba la// rang rang 'khor lo'i rnyed pa ni/

steng byin mda' yon zlas thob pa// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod do// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bzhug mda' yon zlas rnyed la// chu srang yin te lhag ros bsgyur// thob pa dbugs la 'dod pas bsnun// thob pa cha ste snga rkang dang*// phyi rkang snon 'bri bya ba'i tshul// 'khor byed dor sbyin ma dor sbyang*// de rnams gza' nyi'i longs spyod du/ byang bsgrod la byin lho bgrod dor// de yi gza' nyi rnam par dag /nyi dag gnas gnyis gcig shos kyi// skar mar gang rtsi'i tshes grangs phyin// tshes de logs bsgris dus kyi bsgre// thob na mkha' ro'i rnyed pa yis/ skar ma nas sbyangs lhag mas ni// dbyug gu'i gnas nas sbyang bar bya// de ni tshes 'khyud zla ba'o// de la res gza'i longs spyod kyi/ dman pa res 'grogs zla ba zhes// zla skar rnam par dag pa'o// zla nyi bsres pa'i sbyor ba te// tshes grangs lag snun cig dman pa// ri yi bgos lhag byed pa ste// lnga bsdus ri mo rnam par dag maṅga laṃ// lan gcig zhus so/// / (146) ༄/ gnam mtsho se mo dor rtogs ldan kun dga' shes rab dang gung red gnyer pa gnyis rdzangs pa'i ri chos bzhugs/ 08388863(chad)00000000 kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ rang lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa snying gi dbus su bsgom/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ don phyag rgya chen po dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// rang gnas gang du 'gro yang*/ yul phyogs de dang ri la sogs sgrub gnas dang bcas pa 'phags pa thugs rje chen por bsgom/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar pad zla'i gdan la/ thugs rje chen po bsgom/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyi mthar yi ge drug ma dmigs te/ ci nus su bzla/ gnas bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad la byams snying rje bsgom/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros/

sdig pa dang sdug bsngal sbyangs/ thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur par dmigs/ gtor ma sbyin/ dge ba'i grogs bgyid pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ rgyun du lus sbyin dkar 'gyed dang*/ rin po che sman la sogs pa sbyin par bsam/ yang stan mi sprug sprug na lung pa'i phu la'o// gshang ci yang lung pa'i phu la gtor/ yong dus rang 'gro phyogs la gtor/ yang sdod mi 'dod pa sogs byung na/ ri de'i dbus kyi phug dmigs pas/ gzhal ci nus na/ gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du/ bla ma bsgom/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ dus thams cad du byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la nan tan bya/ yong dus gtor ma sbyin/ 'phrin las bcol/ phyi 'brang mi byed par bka' bsgo/ byang chub ma thob bar du/ dge ba'i grogs gyis bya'o// yang thab 'khon gzhob/ gsum gyi skyon byung na rang rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra swa twa hūm̐ bzla zhing*/ sa chu me rlung rim par btab la byin gyis brlabs so// gzhan ci shar ci byung thams cad la rang gshis steng du 'jog pa gal che'o/ bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga mngon mtho dang nges legs ky-i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa sbyin zhing len par 'dod pas/ don gsum gyis bstan te/ sdom pa len pa'i cho ga dang*/ ji ltar bsrung tshul/ nyams su blang ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog gi rten dang*/ mchod pa bsham/ slob dpon gyi drung du/ len pa pos khrus phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ tsog pur 'dug thal mo sbyar te rjes bzlos bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes gyi ba dus 'di nas gzung ste/

ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste/ sang nyi ma ma shar bar du/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gnyis dang*/ rjes mar/ slob dpon zhes bsgyur/ thabs legs bya/ des sdom pa'i ngo bo thob nas/ bslab pa brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi/ bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su sgrub po// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ myos par gyur pa/ bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra dang 'phreng ba dang*/ spos nyug pa dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri gdan mthon po dang khri gdan chen po dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spangs te/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas gzung te/ sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba/ 'bru yi chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ myos par 'gyur ba/ bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ 'phreng ba dang*/ spos nyug pa dang*/

rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan mthon po dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spangs te/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag brgyad pa 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa/ de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// zhes lan gcig brjod/ thabs legs sngar bzhin bya/ de ltar khas blangs pa'i yan lag brgyad kyi sdom pa ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ srog gcod pa ni/ mi'am mir chags pa bsad pa 'dir yang mtshungs mod kyi/ srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyi srog gcod spongs dgos shing*/ ma byin par len pa rin thang tshang ba nas til gyi phub ma tsam yang mi blang*/ bud med dang 'khrig pa sogs rma yi sgo gsum du mi tshangs par spyod pa mi byed pa sogs/ yon tan gyi khyad par ma thob bzhin mi chos las bla mar gyur pa'i rdzun mi smra ba sogs dang*/ chang gi btung ba'i bye brag myos gyur gyi rigs/ bag med pa 'byung ba'i gnas thams cad spangs dgos shing*/ glu gar rol mo'i sgra sogs/ dkyus su brten pa'am/ ldag pa'i dregs chos spongs pa dang*/ rang gling gi nyi ma phyed yol nas/ skya rengs shar gyi bar phyi dror brtsi ste/ de'i bar kha zas zar mi rung bas bza' ba spangs/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa nyin zhag yin yang de ma 'das bar sdom pa btong ba'i rgyu yod dam zhe na/ bsdu bar log ltar skye ba'am/ sdom pa phul ba'am/ nyi ma ma shar gong shi bas stong bar bshad do// 'di ma nyams par srung ba'i phan yon ni/ byams pas lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang*// de bzhin zla phyed tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrungs na// nga yi bstan la lhags so zhes// don 'di rab tu bsrung bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de bas kyang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob ste/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis/

zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrung na// de ni nga dang 'dra bar 'gyur// zhes smras pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kau shi ka de skad ma zer cig zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang*/ cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrung na/ de ni nga dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ zhes thams cad mkhyen pa ni bden par gsungs te/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi zin pa'am/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sdom pa nyams su blangs na/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam bzang zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rigs rus 'byor pa'i dpal gyi mngon par mtho zhing*/ lugs gnyis dkyil 'khor la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa/ lcam dpal ldan rgyal mo dang*/ khyim pa'i rten la rnam par dkar ba'i blo can/ kirti dang*/ nā tha'i ming 'dzin pa rnams kyis bskur ba las/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis la thun bde skyid smon pa thang gi sgar du sbyar ba'o// lan gcig zhus so/// / maṅga laṃ/

༄/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 08388863(chad)00000000 kyi rang bzhin sku/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog bla na med// dus gsum gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// rab tu btud de sems bskyed cho ga bshad/ de yang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par 'dod pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ mchod pa'i bkod pas mdzes par bya/ gtor ma gong ma dag ni bla ma yi dam chos skyong la 'bul/ 'og ma gnyis gzhi bgegs la byin la/ bar chad zhi ba'i bka' bsgos te/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang yan lag bdun pa phul te/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag dang bdag cag thams cad la sdang dgra dang gnod bgegs kyis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde bar dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de yi phyir du/ bdag gi spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba la bkol/ ji srid sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan po re bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po dag /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol gyur pa// de la bag can rnams kyi cis mi brten// zhes gsungs so// de nas slar yang rang re thams cad gnas pa'i yul phyogs 'di nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i skur bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rje btsun 'phags pa mi g.yo ba gang rung*/ de'i thugs kar yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal btab te cung zad mnyam par gzhag nas mnyan 'tshal/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang re thams cad 'jig rten 'dir yun ring po mi sdod/ mi rtag te/ nam 'chi cha med/ de la chos min pa gang gis kyang phan par mi 'gyur te/ chos thams cad kyi snying po ni byang chub kyi sems yin pas/

snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar bas 'di yi rjes bzlos bgyis shig ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa mdzad pa de bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la me tog dor/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no// zhes dang*/ slob mas legs so// zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi byang chub tu sems bskyed par byed pa la gnyis te/ kun rdzob dang don dam mo/ dang po la gnyis las/ smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'o// dang po ni/ smon pa'i ngo bo skye bar byed pa'i rgyu bzhi/ jo bo chen po'i bzhed de/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par ba dang*/ tshad med bzhi la blo sbyang ba dang*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos par gsungs te/ dang po rang cag rnams kyi mdun 'dir/ rgya mtsho chen po rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga lo 'bras du mas spud pa'i dbus kyi pad mo'i lte ba la/ gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du slob dpon bdag nyid/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur bsam/ de'i mdun du rang gang mos yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ bla ma'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gyi pad+ma mtha' yas pa dpag tu med pa rnams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang bla ma'i phrag gong yan gyi pad 'dab rnams la rang rang tha dad kyi bla ma dang slob dpon rnams bzhugs pa/ bla ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bdag gi rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams bzhugs pa/

khri'i thad sor chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa rnams kyang sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa rnams la/ lus ngag yid mos pa'i gdung ba dang bcas pas/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba 'di rjes bzlos bgyid 'tshal/ ji snyed su dag sogs sam bsdus par na/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci mchis pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems phyir bsngo'o// zhes lan gsum brjod*/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad gyi don du sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs zhu snyams pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsal/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// rgyas par na skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang phan yon bshad/ gsum pa ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las grol/ bde ba phun gsum tshogs pa dang ldan na re dga'/ dgra gnyen nye ring chags sdang kun dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par bgyi'o// snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang ldan pas/ cho ga'i rjes bzlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpas bdag byang chub sems par gzung du gsol/ zhes lan

gsum brjod cing*/ me tog gtor/ dngos gzhi ni/ sdom pa brjod cing khas blang ba dang*/ bslab bya brjod pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i ngang nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ bsgoms pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// des smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dngos gzhi grub pa yin/ de dag mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa la/ bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags par bya ba dang*/ phan yon rjes su dran pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems spel zhing sbyang ba dang*/ sems can blos mi spang ba la slob par bya'o// gzhan yang bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslus pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ngan smras brjod pa/

rang gzhan gyi dge ba la 'gyod pa skyes pa/ sems can la g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa rnams nag po'i chos bzhi yin pas spang zhing*/ mchod par 'os pa rnams mchod pa dang*/ sems bskyed kyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bskyed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la phan bde bsgrub pa rnams dkar po'i chos bzhi yin te/ nyams su blang ba la nan tan du byos shig ces brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang yan lag bdun pa phul la/ dngos gzhi gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bar chad dri ba/ sdom pa'i dngos gzhi 'bogs pa/ mkhyen par gsol ba/ gsang bar gdams pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon khyed las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa len par 'tshal gyi gnod pa ma mchis na myur du bstsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog dor/ thabs legs sngar bzhin bya/ yang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ slob dpon khyod las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len par 'tshal gyi/ rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam zhes pa la/ yin lags zhes brjod/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ btab lags/ byang chub tu bsngos sam/ bsngos lags/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la bslabs sam/ bslabs lags/ slob bam/ slob lags/ zhes lan so sor btab bo// des bar chad med par bsal bas/ bdag gi khyod la 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes brjod/ sdom pa dngos ni/ rjes bzlos spangs te/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes gyi ba la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thob par 'dod dam/

zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mtshams so sor/ 'tshal lags zhes brjod/ thabs legs bya/ de la 'thob rgyu'i sdom pa'i ngo bo de gang yin na/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims zhes bya ba/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa gang dag nyams su blang ba dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ sems can gyi don du phan pa gang 'gyur thams cad bsgrub pa dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nas/ gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa man chad bsrung ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blang ba dag gi lan gsum du brjod pa lan gsum rdzogs pa'i skabs su khyod kyi sdom pa dri ma med pa legs par thob pa yin/ rigs kyi bu khyod bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang dag la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab par gyur pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab par 'gyur ba dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob par mdzad pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang tshul khrims gang dag dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims rnams thob par 'dod dam/ zhes gsum dang*/ 'tshal lags zhes brjod/ thabs legs bya/ de nas dpon slob thams cad 'grengs te gnas pas/ slob dpon gyis rjes bzlos bya ba ni/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/ nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po nas dbugs 'byin par gyur cig ces brjod mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ yang slob dpon gyis snyem pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas 'di skad ces/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams kyi/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa bslang ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par mnos lags te/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba spang du gyur pa/ 'phags pa'i tshogs lkog tu gyur kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mthas klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas btugs pa'i chos thams cad ni lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa 'bog cing blang ba'i skabs 'dir/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang chos nyid gcig pas/ zhing de dang de dag rnams su ltas bzang po dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ so so'i zhing gi gtso bo rnams la 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis gsol bas/ rigs kyi bu/ de ltar mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams na byang chub sems dpa'i ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blangs so zhes mkhyen par 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi// dge ba'i thugs kyi rtag par yang*// bu sdug 'dra bar dgos par 'gyur// zhes gsungs par deng phyin chad khyed cag rnams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la ni yab kyi 'du shes/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni spun drung po'i 'du shes bya ste/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras dag ces dang*/

rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo zhes pa rnams kyang khyed cag la zer ba lags pas/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gi// 'khor ba'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya ste// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de nas khyed cag rnams kyi 'jug pa sems bskyed phyin chad/ bag med par gnas kyang*/ bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ deng nas gzung ste sems can khams/ mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa'i sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa// deng nas gzung te gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs// rgyun mi chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gsang bar gdams pa ni/ 'di ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa 'di dag gang mi dad pa rnams la smra ba bgyis na/ gzhi de la ma dad nas dmod par 'gyur bas/ ji snyed byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po/ de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po dang ldan par 'gyur bas snod ma yin pa la yongs su gsang bar bya'o// zhes brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gnyis pa don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa 'dzin pa khas blang bas don dam pa'i gnas lugs ngo sprad pa/ mjug smon lam gdab pa/ slar yang nyams len gyi rim pa 'bog pa'o// don dam sems bskyed zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang yan lag bdun pa phul la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas chos sku'i 'du shes bskyed la/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar bas/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung dang thugs zhes 'don pa bsgyur la/

skyabs 'gro lan gsum bya zhing thabs legs bya'o// slar yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ de yi ngang la rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha nges gzung can nam/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen por bsam/ sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i skur bsam/ de ltar lus yi dam gyi lhar mos pa na de nyid snang ste tha mal gyi lus gar yang song ba med/ tha mal gyi lus su gzung ba'i dus su/ der snang te yi dam gyi lha gang du yang song ba med/ rtog pa gnyis ka yang byung gnas 'gro gsum dang bral te byed pa po gzhan du yang grub pa med pa 'di la snang ba rang sems zhes gsung ba lags/ slar yang bla ma la chos sku'i 'du shes dang ldan pas phyag mchod phul nas me tog dang bcas pas rjes bzlos rnam snang sngon byang las gsungs pa ltar bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phung po dang khams dang*/ bskyed mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes gsum gyi mthar thabs legs bya'o// de'i sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ rang gi sems don dam pa'i rang bzhin 'di nyid yin te/ ji skad du/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di yi don ni rab kyis 'di nyid du ngo 'phrod/ 'bring gi nus pa 'jug tha ma dag ni snod kha sbub kyi steng du chu sbreng kyang mi chags pa ltar 'gyur zhes gsung yang*/ de lta bu'i don la mos nam zhig par 'gyur ro// don dam pa 'dus ma byas mi 'gyur ba lhun gyis grub pa chos dang gang zag gi bdag med pa rang gi sems nyid 'di kho na yin te/

'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang gi sems nyid de kho na nyid kyi don la mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// zhes brjod slar yang slob mas mchog tu mos pa'i yid kyis yan lag bdun sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pas smon lam btab pa'i rjes bzlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ nam zhig tshe rabs thams cad du// byang chub sems ni mi brjed cing*// byang chub mchog tu sems skyaid pa'i// bla ma rin po che dang ni// nam du'ang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar thabs legs bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis/ de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ rgyun du nyams len 'di ltar bya ste/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun nam/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas pas/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyaid pa 'di nye ring gsum gyis dam bca' dang ldan pas lus yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung bar bsgom/ bla ma snying gar dran par bya/ de nas rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo la gcer gyis blta/ ltas tsam nyid nas ci yi ngo bor yang ma grub pa de la/ rtog cing dpyad par bya ba gang yang mi bya ste/ rje bram ze chen pos/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku// 'bras bu gang la 'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs pa'i dngos gzhi de ni/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas de kho na nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa lags/ de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slob bya sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa la sogs las bshad pa ltar nyams su blang bar byos shig ces brjod/ btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bya'o// bla mas kyang tshogs rten rnams la gtang rag gi mchod pas mnyes par byas/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/

gshegs bsdu/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// thub bstan chu gter zab yangs klong dbus nas// snying po yid bzhin rin chen byang chub sems// 'gro kun phan bde'i ye shes mchog stsol ba'i// sems bskyed cho ga yid bzhin nor bu 'di// ded dpon chos kyi spyan ldan byams pa'i mtshan// gang gi bka' yis bskul ltar ldom bu ba// rat+na'i ming can bdag gis gus pas blangs// dge des 'gro kun bde chen myur thob shog /sems bskyed kyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lugs gnyis kyi dpal la dbang 'byor zhing*/ skye dgu chos kyi skyong ba'i drung chen rin po che'i bkas bskul ba las/ dgongs bzhed dang sbyar te/ skyob pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo las nyung bar btus te/ gser 'phyang zhes bya ba me bya hor zla bcu pa'i rgyal ba gnyis pa la dpal 'bri gung gi khang gsar yang dgon du bris pa'o// lan gcig zhus so/ maṅga laṃ/// /

༄/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtshan dang tshon yig ༈ 08388863(chad)00000000 gdan gtso 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon re kha gru bzhi'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma/ dbus dang g.yas g.yon sum bsgrigs kyi dbus su hūm̐ ser po/ g.yas g.yon gyi lte bar rnga yab ser po dang dkar po nor bu'i yu ba can bri'o// gnyis pa yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor la/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus dang g.yas g.yon du/ pad dkar che chung sum bsgrigs kyi dbus su zla gdan la hrīḥdakar po 'bri'o// gsum pa kha sar pā ṇi gtso 'khor la/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su zla gdan la hrīḥdakar po bri'o// mdun du traṃ ljang khu/ g.yas su baṃ ser po/ rgyab tu bh+riṃ gser mdog g.yon du haṃ dmar po bri'o// bzhi pa seng ge sgra la/ phyogs tshon gru bzhi'i dbus su/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su seng ge'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po bri'o// lnga pa 'jig rten dbang phyug hā la hā la'i dal ni phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po bri'o// drug pa pad+ma gar gyi dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gru bzhi'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad zla la hrīḥdamar po/ 'dab ma rnams la/ shar dkar/ lho ljang*/ nub ser/ byang ser shar lho ser/ lho nub sngo/ nub byang dkar/ byang shar du kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshom bu bkod do// bdun pa spyan ras gzigs hā ri hā ri la zhon pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gru bzhi'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri'o// brgyad pa 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri'o// dgu pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i dkyil 'khor ni/

sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nyi gdan hrīḥdamar po/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'dab mar ljang khu dang ser po'i tshom bu dgod do// bcu pa lhag par dbang du bya ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gru bzhi'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po bri'o// bcu tshan gnyis pa'i dang po/ spyan ras gzigs mgrin pa sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥser po bri'o// gnyis pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ril ba'i spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su rdo ra dur khrod kyi lte bar/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥnag po bri'o// gsum pa sran ma la ṣa'i zhal gyi gzungs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po bri'o// bzhi pa 'jig rten dbang phyug don zhags lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma che chung lnga mtshams kyi dbus su/ zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po/ mdun du pad zla'i dbus su ha dmar po/ g.yas su pad nyi la hūm̐ btsod kha/ rgyab tu pad zla la ha sngon po/ g.yon du pad zla la da ser po rnams bri'o// lnga pa 'phags pa bh+k+mu lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dbus che zhing*/ zur bzhir chung ba bzhi'i dbus kyi lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ me'i dbus su lāṃ dkar po/ bden bral du māṃ sngon po/ rlung du pāṃ dmar po/ dbang ldan du tāṃ gser mdog tu bri'o// de ltar spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi'o// drug pa 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar muḥdamar ser bri'o// bdun pa 'jam dpal seng ge sgra gtso 'khor bcu gcig dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar māṃ ser po/ g.yas su sum dkar po/ g.yon du hūm̐ nag po/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar shar du oṃ dkar po/ lho traṃ ser po/ nub tu hrīḥdamar po/ byang du a ljang khu/ mer lāṃ dkar mo/ bden bral du māṃ sngon mo/ rlung du pāṃ dmar mo/ dbang ldan du tāṃ gser mdog rnams bri'o// brgyad pa 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la maṃ gur gum gyi mdog can/ 'dab ma brgyad la seng ge'i sgra ltar rigs bzhi yum bzhi'i sa bon bri'am/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog gong ltar bya'o// dgu pa 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ muṃ gser gyi mdog can bkod do/ bcu pa 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dhiḥdakar po dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab mar ra/ g.yas su tsa/ rgyab tu pa/ g.yon tu na rnams dkar po'i kha dog can du bri'o// bcu tshan gsum pa'i dang po/ 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla gdan dhiḥdamar po mdun gyi 'dab mar ra ljang khu/ g.yas su pa ser po/ rgyab tu tsa dkar po/ g.yon du na dmar po rnams bri'o// gnyis pa 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar baṃ ser po bri'o// gsum pa 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan la āḥdakar po bri'o// bzhi pa 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang phyag gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ang dkar po bri'o// lnga pa 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ni/

re kha bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal mchog chog ltar tshom bu dgod do// drug pa 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po bri'o// bdun pa 'jam dpal rgyal chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar maṃ ser po bri'o// brgyad pa 'jam dpal zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba muḥser po bri'o// dgu pa mtshan brjod 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a dkar po bri bar bya'o// bcu pa mtshan brjod 'jam dpal zhag gsum phyag bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar muḥdakar dmar gyi mdog dag bri'o// bcu tshan bzhi pa'i dang po/ 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba la rdo rje ral gri me 'bar ba dar dpyangs dang bcas pas mtshan pa bri'o// de ltar 'jam dbyangs bcu drug go// gnyis pa rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nyi ma la/ hūm̐ nag po dgod par bya'o// phyag rdor gcig go/ gsum pa seng lding nags kyi sgrol ma lha bcu gsum dang*/ mchod sbyin sgrol ma lha lnga ma thun mong gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar ut+pa la dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar/ shar du rnga yab ljang khu/ lhor ba ku la'i yal ga rgyab tu rnga yab ser po/ g.yon du gri gug nag po rnams bri bar bya'o/ bzhi pa gur las gsungs pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ nyi gdan la tāṃ ser po/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du me tog gi 'phreng ba/

lhor spos phor/ nub tu mar me'i sdong bu/ byang du dri'i dung chos/ shar lhor byang sems kyi bum pa/ lho nub tu ri rab/ nub byang me thab/ byang shar du rgyal mtshan/ shar sgo'i thad sor lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor dril bu ma/ lcags kyu'i steng gi rdo rje/ lcags sgrog gi rgyab tu sbrul zhags rnams bri'o// lnga pa rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar gri gug dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bri'o// drug pa 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol dkar gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar tāṃ dkar po dgod do// bdun pa sgrol dkar phyag bzhi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon shar dkar/ lho sngo nub dmar byang ser ba'i dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ dkar po/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar/ tshom bu ser po dang*/ ljang khu bri bar bya'o// brgyad pa sgrol dkar phyag drug ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rdo ra dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ dkar po bri bar bya'o// dgu pa sgrol ma dug sel ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri'o// bcu pa nor sbyin sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba'i gdan la/ tāṃ ljang khu 'dab ma rnams la/ shar du rdo rje nag po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du 'khor lo dkar po/ mer me tog gi 'phreng ba dkar po/ srin por spos phor nag po/ rlung du mar me ser po/ dbang ldan du dung chos dmar po/ shar sgor thad sor lcags kyu nag po/ lhor rdo rje'i zhags pa ser po/ nub tu lcags sgrog dmar po/ byang du dril bu dkar po rnams bri bar bya'o// bcu tshan lnga pa'i dang po/

ngan song las grol ba'i sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ tāṃ sngo ljang bkod do// gnyis pa sna tshogs yum gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar sbrul gyi gdan la pheṃ dmar po bri bar bya'o// gsum pa don thams cad rab tu sbyin pa sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ chos 'byung dkar dmar gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar tāṃ ser po bri'o// de ltar sgrol ma bcu'o// bzhi pa dug sel ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la dzaṃ ser po bri'o// lnga pa rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i dug sel ma ljang gu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar dzaṃ ljang khu bri bar bya'o// drug pa dug sel ma dkar mo'i dkyil 'khaur ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri bar bya'o// de ltar dug sel ma gsum mo// bdun pa ral gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus thod pa dkar po gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po'i hūm̐ mthing nag bri'o// brgyad pa ral gcig ma phyag bzhi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag go /de ltar ral gcig ma gnyis so// dgu pa tsan dan ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar tsuṃ dkar po bri'o// bcu pa rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can ma dkar mo lha bzhi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar māṃ dkar po mdun nag g.yas dmar/ g.yon dmar po'i tshom bu bri bar bya'o// bcu tshan drug pa'i dang po/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar māṃ ser po bri bar bya'o// gnyis pa rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ zlum skor sngo nag kyi dbus su māṃ ser po/ phyogs bzhir shar dmar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang dkar po'i tshom bu bri bar bya'o// gsum pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 'od zer can gtso 'khor gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su phyag gis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du oṃ dmar po bri bar bya'o// bzhi pa au ḍi ni'i 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ rdo ra dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i chos 'byung dmar po la phyag mtshan hūm̐ ngam māṃ dmar mo bri bar bya'o// lnga pa 'od zer pi tsu ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su ri rab gru bzhi pa bang rim bzhi pa phyogs mdog dbus su zla ba la māṃ ser po bri bar bya'o// drug pa 'od zer can zhal gsum phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar māṃ dmar po bri bar bya'o// bdun pa mdor bsdus pa'i 'od zer can lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su rlung dkyil zlum po sngo nag gi dbus me tog gi bcal bkram pa'i lte bar māṃ ser po/ phyogs bzhir/ shar dmar lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang dmar po'i tshom bu bri'o// de ltar 'od zer can brgyad do// brgyad pa ri khrod lo ma can ser mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi dbus saṃ ser po bri bar bya'o// dgu pa lo ma can ljang khu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar paṃ ljang khu bri bar bya ste/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi rigs gnyis so// bcu pa sher phyin ma dkar mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar pāṃ dkar po bri bar bya'o// bcu tshan bdun pa'i dang po/ sher phyin ser mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dhīḥser po bri'o// gnyis pa sher phyin gser mdog can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar/ dhiḥser po dgod par bya'o// gsum pa sher phyin ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar dhīḥser po bri'o// de ltar sher phyin ma rigs bzhi'o/ bzhi pa dbyangs can ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba doḥdamar po dgod par bya'o// lnga pa dbyangs can ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri'o/ drug pa pi wang dbyangs can ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad lte bar hrīḥdakar po bri'o// bdun pa rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad dbus su hrīḥdakar po bri'o// brgyad pa rdo rje dbyangs can ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ doḥdamar po bri'o/ de ltar dbyangs can ma rigs lnga'o// dgu pa khro gnyer can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bh+riṃḥser po bri ste/ khro gnyer can gcig go/ bcu pa/ sgrol ma'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i ku ru ku l+le'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ ut+pa la dmar po'i dbus su/ taṃ dmar po dgod pa'o// bcu tshan brgyad pa'i dang po la/ 'phags ma rig byed ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su/ pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥdamar po bri bar bya'o// gnyis pa oḍ+yi na las byung ba'i rig byed ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon rdo ra dur khrod kyi dbus su/ chos 'byung dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po bri bar bya'o// gsum pa rig byed ma phyag drug ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs tshon dbus su pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ tāṃ dmar pos mtshan par bri'o// bzhi pa rig byed ma phyag brgyad lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus su/ pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥdamar po 'dab ma rnams la tshom bu dmar po re re dang*/ sgo bzhir shar dmar/ lho ser/ nub nag byang ljang ser rnams kyi tshom bu bri'o// lnga pa rig byed ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho zlum po dkar po la gnas pa'i pad dkar 'dab brgyad hrīḥdakar pos mtshan pa bri'o// drug pa ku ru kul+le khyung gdan ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus su/ rdo rje rā bas bskor ba'i gzhi sngon po la/ chos 'byung dkar dmar gyi dbus su pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ zla gdan la hrīḥdakar po bri bar bya'o// de ltar ku ru kul+le bdun no// bdun pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la bh+ruṃ dkar po lte ba'i g.yas su dkar po dang*/ g.yon du sngon po'i tshom bu bri/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la tshom bu sngon po dgod do// brgyad pa 'phags ma gdugs dkar can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po bri bar bya'o// dgu pa rdo rje tsar tsi ka'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tsam dmar po bri'o// bcu pa so sor 'brangs ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sraṃ ser po bri bar bya'o/ bcu tsan dgu pa'i dang po/ rma bya chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi gdan la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su/ māṃ ljang khu bri'o// gnyis pa stong chen rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs mdog sna tshogs pad+ma dang bcas pa'i lte bar bum dkar po bri'o// gsum pa gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon sna tshogs pad+ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ māṃ nag po bri'o// bzhi pa bsil ba'i tshal ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su/ dz+ri dmar po bri'o// lnga pa phyir log chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la/ hūm̐ nag po bri bar bya'o// drug pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la dh+waṃ ser po bri'o// bdun pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar aṃ ser po bri bar bya'o// brgyad pa rdo rje gan dha ri'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog dang sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po bri'o// dgu pa rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// phyogs tshon la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan du hūm̐ ljang khu bri bar bya'o/ bcu pa nor rgyun ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di nyid kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod chog gam/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad zla gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su baṃ ser po/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ tshom bu ser po re re bri/ bcu tshan bcu pa'i dang po la/ rdo rje phag mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rtsig pa tshon byed kyi re kha ljang khus gru bzhir bcad pa'i nang phyogs mdog gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar baṃ dmar pos mtshan pa dang phyogs bzhir/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i tshom bu dang*/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar re re bri bar bya'o// gnyis pa rdo rje phag mo shes rab snang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ hrīḥdakar po bri'o// gsum pa don yod grub ma phyogs mtshan dbus re khas bskor ba'i chos 'byung dkar dmar gyi nang du/

pad dmar 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po dang*/ phyogs bzhir thod pa re bri bar bya'o// bzhi pa byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar maiṃ ser po bri'o// lnga pa dzaṃ bha la nag po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po bri'o// drug pa dzaṃ bha la ser po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar dzaṃ ser po bkod/ bdun pa dzaṃ ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus/ nyi ma'i gdan la dzaṃ ser po dgod do// brgyad pa rta mchog ye shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la haṃ dmar po bri'o// dgu pa rtogs pa bdun brgya pa'i rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus nyi dkyil hūm̐ dmar po bri bar bya'o// bcu pa rgyud phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su/ pad dmar 'dab bzhi'i dbus su hūm̐ dmar po/ shar gyi 'dab mar hrī ljang khu/ lhor haṃ nag po/ nub tu hrīḥser po/ byang du hrīḥdamar po rnams bri'o// bcu tshan bcu gc-ig pa'i dang po/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus nyi dkyil zlum po 'od 'phreng gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag bri'o// gnyis pa rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gong bzhin gyis lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag bri bar bya'o// gsum pa rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dang sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ dmar po bri bar bya'o// bzhi pa gshed dmar gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po bri'o// lnga pa gshed nag gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag bkod do// drug pa dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor ni/

phyogs mdog gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag bri'o// bdun pa gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar yaṃ nag po bri'o// brgyad pa bgegs mthar byed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag bri bar bya'o// dgu pa hūm̐ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po dgod par bya'o// bcu pa stobs po che'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus pad dkar 'dab brgyad ky-i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po bri'o// lnga tshan dang po kyai rdor he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag bri'o// gnyis pa bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs mdog gi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar ro'i snying gar zla ba la/ aṃ nag po bri'o// gsum pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag dgod par bya'o// bzhi pa nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon pad+ma'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po bri'o// lnga pa nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ phyogs tshon gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po rnams bri bar bya'o// lan gcig zhus so// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
